name: Karna Parva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato droNe hate rAjanduryodhanamukhA nRRipAH |
bhRRishamudvignamanaso droNaputramupAgaman
shlokas.2:
te droNamupashochantaH kashmalAbhihataujasaH |
paryupAsanta shokArtAstataH shAradvatIsutam
shlokas.3:
muhUrtaM te samAshvAsya hetubhiH shAstrasaMmitaiH |
rAtryAgame mahIpAlAH svAni veshmAni bhejire
shlokas.4:
visheShataH sUtaputro rAjA chaiva suyodhanaH |
duHshAsano.atha shakunirna nidrAmupalebhire
shlokas.5:
te veshmasvapi kauravya pRRithvIshA nApnuvansukham |
chintayantaH kShayaM tIvraM nidrAM naivopalebhire
shlokas.6:
sahitAste nishAyAM tu duryodhananiveshane |
atiprachaNDAdvidveShAtpANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.7:
yattaddyUtaparikliShTAM kRRiShNAmAninyire sabhAm |
tatsmaranto.anvatapyanta bhRRishamudvignachetasaH
shlokas.8:
chintayantashcha pArthAnAM tAnkleshAndyUtakAritAn |
kRRichChreNa kShaNadAM rAjanninyurabdashatopamAm
shlokas.9:
tataH prabhAte vimale sthitA diShTasya shAsane |
chakrurAvashyakaM sarve vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.10:
te kRRitvAvashyakAryANi samAshvasya cha bhArata |
yogamAj~nApayAmAsuryuddhAya cha viniryayuH
shlokas.11:
karNaM senApatiM kRRitvA kRRitakautukama~NgalAH |
vAchayitvA dvijashreShThAndadhipAtraghRRitAkShataiH
shlokas.12:
niShkairgobhirhiraNyena vAsobhishcha mahAdhanaiH |
vardhyamAnA jayAshIrbhiH sUtamAgadhabandibhiH
shlokas.13:
tathaiva pANDavA rAjankRRitasarvAhNikakriyAH |
shibirAnniryayU rAjanyuddhAya kRRitanishchayAH
shlokas.14:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM romaharShaNam |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha parasparavadhaiShiNAm
shlokas.15:
tayordve divase yuddhaM kurupANDavasenayoH |
karNe senApatau rAjannabhUdadbhutadarshanam
shlokas.16:
tataH shatrukShayaM kRRitvA sumahAntaM raNe vRRiShaH |
pashyatAM dhArtarAShTrANAM phalgunena nipAtitaH
shlokas.17:
tatastatsa~njayaH sarvaM gatvA nAgAhvayaM puram |
Achakhyau dhRRitarAShTrAya yadvRRittaM kurujA~Ngale
shlokas.18:
janamejaya uvAcha||
ApageyaM hataM shrutvA droNaM cha samare paraiH |
yo jagAma parAmArtiM vRRiddho rAjAmbikAsutaH
shlokas.19:
sa shrutvA nihataM karNaM duryodhanahitaiShiNam |
kathaM dvijavara prANAnadhArayata duHkhitaH
shlokas.20:
yasmi~njayAshAM putrANAmamanyata sa pArthivaH |
tasminhate sa kauravyaH kathaM prANAnadhArayat
shlokas.21:
durmaraM bata manye.ahaM nRRiNAM kRRichChre.api vartatAm |
yatra karNaM hataM shrutvA nAtyajajjIvitaM nRRipaH
shlokas.22:
tathA shAntanavaM vRRiddhaM brahmanbAhlikameva cha |
droNaM cha somadattaM cha bhUrishravasameva cha
shlokas.23:
tathaiva chAnyAnsuhRRidaH putrapautrA.nshcha pAtitAn |
shrutvA yannAjahAtprANA.nstanmanye duShkaraM dvija
shlokas.24:
etanme sarvamAchakShva vistareNa tapodhana |
na hi tRRipyAmi pUrveShAM shRRiNvAnashcharitaM mahat
shlokas.25:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
hate karNe mahArAja nishi gAvalgaNistadA |
dIno yayau nAgapuramashvairvAtasamairjave
shlokas.26:
sa hAstinapuraM gatvA bhRRishamudvignamAnasaH |
jagAma dhRRitarAShTrasya kShayaM prakShINabAndhavam
shlokas.27:
sa samudvIkShya rAjAnaM kashmalAbhihataujasam |
vavande prA~njalirbhUtvA mUrdhnA pAdau nRRipasya ha
shlokas.28:
sampUjya cha yathAnyAyaM dhRRitarAShTraM mahIpatim |
hA kaShTamiti choktvA sa tato vachanamAdade
shlokas.29:
sa~njayo.ahaM kShitipate kachchidAste sukhaM bhavAn |
svadoSheNApadaM prApya kachchinnAdya vimuhyasi
shlokas.30:
hitAnyuktAni viduradroNagA~NgeyakeshavaiH |
agRRihItAnyanusmRRitya kachchinna kuruShe vyathAm
shlokas.31:
rAmanAradakaNvaishcha hitamuktaM sabhAtale |
nagRRihItamanusmRRitya kachchinna kuruShe vyathAm
shlokas.32:
suhRRidastvaddhite yuktAnbhIShmadroNamukhAnparaiH |
nihatAnyudhi sa.nsmRRitya kachchinna kuruShe vyathAm
shlokas.33:
tameva.nvAdinaM rAjA sUtaputraM kRRitA~njalim |
sudIrghamabhiniHshvasya duHkhArta idamabravIt
shlokas.34:
gA~Ngeye nihate shUre divyAstravati sa~njaya |
droNe cha parameShvAse bhRRishaM me vyathitaM manaH
shlokas.35:
yo rathAnAM sahasrANi da.nshitAnAM dashaiva hi |
ahanyahani tejasvI nijaghne vasusambhavaH
shlokas.36:
sa hato yaj~nasenasya putreNeha shikhaNDinA |
pANDaveyAbhiguptena bhRRishaM me vyathitaM manaH
shlokas.37:
bhArgavaH pradadau yasmai paramAstraM mahAtmane |
sAkShAdrAmeNa yo bAlye dhanurveda upAkRRitaH
shlokas.38:
yasya prasAdAtkaunteyA rAjaputrA mahAbalAH |
mahArathatvaM samprAptAstathAnye vasudhAdhipAH
shlokas.39:
taM droNaM nihataM shrutvA dhRRiShTadyumnena sa.nyuge |
satyasandhaM maheShvAsaM bhRRishaM me vyathitaM manaH
shlokas.40:
trailokye yasya shAstreShu na pumAnvidyate samaH |
taM droNaM nihataM shrutvA kimakurvata mAmakAH
shlokas.41:
sa.nshaptakAnAM cha bale pANDavena mahAtmanA |
dhana~njayena vikramya gamite yamasAdanam
shlokas.42:
nArAyaNAstre nihate droNaputrasya dhImataH |
hatasheSheShvanIkeShu kimakurvata mAmakAH
shlokas.43:
vipradrutAnahaM manye nimagnaH shokasAgare |
plavamAnAnhate droNe sannanaukAnivArNave
shlokas.44:
duryodhanasya karNasya bhojasya kRRitavarmaNaH |
madrarAjasya shalyasya drauNeshchaiva kRRipasya cha
shlokas.45:
matputrasheShasya tathA tathAnyeShAM cha sa~njaya |
viprakIrNeShvanIkeShu mukhavarNo.abhavatkatham
shlokas.46:
etatsarvaM yathA vRRittaM tattvaM gAvalgaNe raNe |
AchakShva pANDaveyAnAM mAmakAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.47:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pANDaveyairhi yadvRRittaM kauraveyeShu mAriSha |
tachChrutvA mA vyathAM kArShIdiShTe na vyathate manaH
shlokas.48:
yasmAdabhAvI bhAvI vA bhavedartho naraM prati |
aprAptau tasya vA prAptau na kashchidvyathate budhaH
shlokas.49:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
na vyathA shRRiNvataH kAchidvidyate mama sa~njaya |
diShTametatpurA manye kathayasva yathechChakam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hate droNe maheShvAse tava putrA mahArathAH |
babhUvurAshvastamukhA viShaNNA gatachetasaH
shlokas.2:
avA~NmukhAH shastrabhRRitaH sarva eva vishAM pate |
aprekShamANAH shokArtA nAbhyabhAShanparasparam
shlokas.3:
tAndRRiShTvA vyathitAkArAnsainyAni tava bhArata |
UrdhvamevAbhyavekShanta duHkhatrastAnyanekashaH
shlokas.4:
shastrANyeShAM cha rAjendra shoNitAktAnyasheShataH |
prAbhrashyanta karAgrebhyo dRRiShTvA droNaM nipAtitam
shlokas.5:
tAni baddhAnyaniShTAni lambamAnAni bhArata |
adRRishyanta mahArAja nakShatrANi yathA divi
shlokas.6:
tathArtaM stimitaM dRRiShTvA gatasattvamiva sthitam |
svaM balaM tanmahArAja rAjA duryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.7:
bhavatAM bAhuvIryaM hi samAshritya mayA yudhi |
pANDaveyAH samAhUtA yuddhaM chedaM pravartitam
shlokas.8:
tadidaM nihate droNe viShaNNamiva lakShyate |
yudhyamAnAshcha samare yodhA vadhyanti sarvataH
shlokas.9:
jayo vApi vadho vApi yudhyamAnasya sa.nyuge |
bhavetkimatra chitraM vai yudhyadhvaM sarvatomukhAH
shlokas.10:
pashyadhvaM cha mahAtmAnaM karNaM vaikartanaM yudhi |
pracharantaM maheShvAsaM divyairastrairmahAbalam
shlokas.11:
yasya vai yudhi santrAsAtkuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
nivartate sadAmarShAtsiMhAtkShudramRRigo yathA
shlokas.12:
yena nAgAyutaprANo bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
mAnuSheNaiva yuddhena tAmavasthAM praveshitaH
shlokas.13:
yena divyAstravichChUro mAyAvI sa ghaTotkachaH |
amoghayA raNe shaktyA nihato bhairavaM nadan
shlokas.14:
tasya duShpAravIryasya satyasandhasya dhImataH |
bAhvordraviNamakShayyamadya drakShyatha sa.nyuge
shlokas.15:
droNaputrasya vikrAntaM rAdheyasyaiva chobhayoH |
pANDupA~nchAlasainyeShu drakShyathApi mahAtmanoH
shlokas.16:
sarva eva bhavantashcha shUrAH prAj~nAH kulodgatAH |
shIlavantaH kRRitAstrAshcha drakShyathAdya parasparam
shlokas.17:
evamukte mahArAja karNo vaikartano nRRipaH |
siMhanAdaM vinadyochchaiH prAyudhyata mahAbalaH
shlokas.18:
sa sRRi~njayAnAM sarveShAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha pashyatAm |
kekayAnAM videhAnAmakarotkadanaM mahat
shlokas.19:
tasyeShudhArAH shatashaH prAdurAsa~nsharAsanAt |
agre pu~Nkhe cha sa.nsaktA yathA bhramarapa~NktayaH
shlokas.20:
sa pIDayitvA pA~nchAlAnpANDavA.nshcha tarasvinaH |
hatvA sahasrasho yodhAnarjunena nipAtitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA mahArAja dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
shokasyAntamapashyanvai hataM matvA suyodhanam
vihvalaH patito bhUmau naShTachetA iva dvipaH
shlokas.2:
tasminnipatite bhUmau vihvale rAjasattame |
ArtanAdo mahAnAsItstrINAM bharatasattama
shlokas.3:
sa shabdaH pRRithivIM sarvAM pUrayAmAsa sarvashaH |
shokArNave mahAghore nimagnA bharatastriyaH
shlokas.4:
rAjAnaM cha samAsAdya gAndhArI bharatarShabha |
niHsa~nj~nA patitA bhUmau sarvANyantaHpurANi cha
shlokas.5:
tatastAH sa~njayo rAjansamAshvAsayadAturAH |
muhyamAnAH subahusho mu~nchantyo vAri netrajam
shlokas.6:
samAshvastAH striyastAstu vepamAnA muhurmuhuH |
kadalya iva vAtena dhUyamAnAH samantataH
shlokas.7:
rAjAnaM vidurashchApi praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram |
AshvAsayAmAsa tadA si~ncha.nstoyena kauravam
shlokas.8:
sa labdhvA shanakaiH sa~nj~nAM tAshcha dRRiShTvA striyo nRRipa |
unmatta iva rAjA sa sthitastUShNIM vishAM pate
shlokas.9:
tato dhyAtvA chiraM kAlaM niHshvasa.nshcha punaH punaH |
svAnputrAngarhayAmAsa bahu mene cha pANDavAn
shlokas.10:
garhayitvAtmano buddhiM shakuneH saubalasya cha |
dhyAtvA cha suchiraM kAlaM vepamAno muhurmuhuH
shlokas.11:
sa.nstabhya cha mano bhUyo rAjA dhairyasamanvitaH |
punargAvalgaNiM sUtaM paryapRRichChata sa~njayam
shlokas.12:
yattvayA kathitaM vAkyaM shrutaM sa~njaya tanmayA |
kachchidduryodhanaH sUta na gato vai yamakShayam
brUhi sa~njaya tattvena punaruktAM kathAmimAm
shlokas.13:
evamukto.abravItsUto rAjAnaM janamejaya |
hato vaikartano rAjansaha putrairmahArathaiH
bhrAtRRibhishcha maheShvAsaiH sUtaputraistanutyajaiH
shlokas.14:
duHshAsanashcha nihataH pANDavena yashasvinA |
pItaM cha rudhiraM kopAdbhImasenena sa.nyuge

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA mahArAja dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
abravItsa~njayaM sUtaM shokavyAkulachetanaH
shlokas.2:
duShpraNItena me tAta manasAbhiplutAtmanaH |
hataM vaikartanaM shrutvA shoko marmANi kRRintati
shlokas.3:
kRRitAstraparamAH shalye duHkhapAraM titIrShavaH |
kurUNAM sRRi~njayAnAM cha ke nu jIvanti ke mRRitAH
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hataH shAntanavo rAjandurAdharShaH pratApavAn |
hatvA pANDavayodhAnAmarbudaM dashabhirdinaiH
shlokas.5:
tato droNo maheShvAsaH pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAn |
nihatya yudhi durdharShaH pashchAdrukmaratho hataH
shlokas.6:
hatashiShTasya bhIShmeNa droNena cha mahAtmanA |
ardhaM nihatya sainyasya karNo vaikartano hataH
shlokas.7:
vivi.nshatirmahArAja rAjaputro mahAbalaH |
AnartayodhA~nshatasho nihatya nihato raNe
shlokas.8:
atha putro vikarNaste kShatravratamanusmaran |
kShINavAhAyudhaH shUraH sthito.abhimukhataH parAn
shlokas.9:
ghorarUpAnparikleshAnduryodhanakRRitAnbahUn |
pratij~nAM smaratA chaiva bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.10:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau rAjaputrau mahAbalau |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma gatau vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.11:
sindhurAShTramukhAnIha dasha rAShTrANi yasya vai |
vashe tiShThanti vIrasya yaH sthitastava shAsane
shlokas.12:
akShauhiNIrdashaikAM cha nirjitya nishitaiH sharaiH |
arjunena hato rAjanmahAvIryo jayadrathaH
shlokas.13:
tathA duryodhanasutastarasvI yuddhadurmadaH |
vartamAnaH pituH shAstre saubhadreNa nipAtitaH
shlokas.14:
tathA dauHshAsanirvIro bAhushAlI raNotkaTaH |
draupadeyena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.15:
kirAtAnAmadhipatiH sAgarAnUpavAsinAm |
devarAjasya dharmAtmA priyo bahumataH sakhA
shlokas.16:
bhagadatto mahIpAlaH kShatradharmarataH sadA |
dhana~njayena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.17:
tathA kauravadAyAdaH saumadattirmahAyashAH |
hato bhUrishravA rAja~nshUraH sAtyakinA yudhi
shlokas.18:
shrutAyurapi chAmbaShThaH kShatriyANAM dhanurdharaH |
charannabhItavatsa~Nkhye nihataH savyasAchinA
shlokas.19:
tava putraH sadA sa~Nkhye kRRitAstro yuddhadurmadaH |
duHshAsano mahArAja bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.20:
yasya rAjangajAnIkaM bahusAhasramadbhutam |
sudakShiNaH sa sa~NgrAme nihataH savyasAchinA
shlokas.21:
kosalAnAmadhipatirhatvA bahushatAnparAn |
saubhadreNa hi vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.22:
bahusho yodhayitvA cha bhImasenaM mahArathaH |
chitrasenastava suto bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.23:
madrarAjAtmajaH shUraH pareShAM bhayavardhanaH |
asicharmadharaH shrImAnsaubhadreNa nipAtitaH
shlokas.24:
samaH karNasya samare yaH sa karNasya pashyataH |
vRRiShaseno mahAtejAH shIghrAstraH kRRitanishchayaH
shlokas.25:
abhimanyorvadhaM smRRitvA pratij~nAmapi chAtmanaH |
dhana~njayena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.26:
nityaprasaktavairo yaH pANDavaiH pRRithivIpatiH |
vishrAvya vairaM pArthena shrutAyuH sa nipAtitaH
shlokas.27:
shalyaputrastu vikrAntaH sahadevena mAriSha |
hato rukmaratho rAjanbhrAtA mAtulajo yudhi
shlokas.28:
rAjA bhagIratho vRRiddho bRRihatkShatrashcha kekayaH |
parAkramantau vikrAntau nihatau vIryavattarau
shlokas.29:
bhagadattasuto rAjankRRitapraj~no mahAbalaH |
shyenavachcharatA sa~Nkhye nakulena nipAtitaH
shlokas.30:
pitAmahastava tathA bAhlikaH saha bAhlikaiH |
bhImasenena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.31:
jayatsenastathA rAja~njArAsandhirmahAbalaH |
mAgadho nihataH sa~Nkhye saubhadreNa mahAtmanA
shlokas.32:
putraste durmukho rAjanduHsahashcha mahArathaH |
gadayA bhImasenena nihatau shUramAninau
shlokas.33:
durmarShaNo durviShaho durjayashcha mahArathaH |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma gatA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.34:
sachivo vRRiShavarmA te sUtaH paramavIryavAn |
bhImasenena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.35:
nAgAyutabalo rAjA nAgAyutabalo mahAn |
sagaNaH pANDuputreNa nihataH savyasAchinA
shlokas.36:
vasAtayo mahArAja dvisAhasrAH prahAriNaH |
shUrasenAshcha vikrAntAH sarve yudhi nipAtitAH
shlokas.37:
abhIShAhAH kavachinaH praharanto madotkaTAH |
shibayashcha rathodArAH kali~NgasahitA hatAH
shlokas.38:
gokule nityasa.nvRRiddhA yuddhe paramakovidAH |
shreNayo bahusAhasrAH sa.nshaptakagaNAshcha ye
te sarve pArthamAsAdya gatA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.39:
syAlau tava mahArAja rAjAnau vRRiShakAchalau |
tvadarthe samparAkrAntau nihatau savyasAchinA
shlokas.40:
ugrakarmA maheShvAso nAmataH karmatastathA |
shAlvarAjo mahArAja bhImasenena pAtitaH
shlokas.41:
oghavA.nshcha mahArAja bRRihantaH sahito raNe |
parAkramantau mitrArthe gatau vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.42:
tathaiva rathinAM shreShThaH kShemadhUrtirvishAM pate |
nihato gadayA rAjanbhImasenena sa.nyuge
shlokas.43:
tathA rAjA maheShvAso jalasandho mahAbalaH |
sumahatkadanaM kRRitvA hataH sAtyakinA raNe
shlokas.44:
alAyudho rAkShasendraH kharabandhurayAnagaH |
ghaTotkachena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.45:
rAdheyAH sUtaputrAshcha bhrAtarashcha mahArathAH |
kekayAH sarvashashchApi nihatAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.46:
mAlavA madrakAshchaiva draviDAshchogravikramAH |
yaudheyAshcha lalitthAshcha kShudrakAshchApyushInarAH
shlokas.47:
mAvellakAstuNDikerAH sAvitrIputrakA~nchalAH |
prAchyodIchyAH pratIchyAshcha dAkShiNAtyAshcha mAriSha
shlokas.48:
pattInAM nihatAH sa~NghA hayAnAmayutAni cha |
rathavrajAshcha nihatA hatAshcha varavAraNAH
shlokas.49:
sadhvajAH sAyudhAH shUrAH savarmAmbarabhUShaNAH |
kAlena mahatA yattAH kule ye cha vivardhitAH
shlokas.50:
te hatAH samare rAjanpArthenAkliShTakarmaNA |
anye tathAmitabalAH parasparavadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.51:
ete chAnye cha bahavo rAjAnaH sagaNA raNe |
hatAH sahasrasho rAjanyanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
evameSha kShayo vRRittaH karNArjunasamAgame
shlokas.52:
mahendreNa yathA vRRitro yathA rAmeNa rAvaNaH |
yathA kRRiShNena nihato muro raNanipAtitaH
kArtavIryashcha rAmeNa bhArgaveNa hato yathA
shlokas.53:
saj~nAtibAndhavaH shUraH samare yuddhadurmadaH |
raNe kRRitvA mahAyuddhaM ghoraM trailokyavishrutam
shlokas.54:
tathArjunena nihato dvairathe yuddhadurmadaH |
sAmAtyabAndhavo rAjankarNaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.55:
jayAshA dhArtarAShTrANAM vairasya cha mukhaM yataH |
tIrNaM tatpANDavai rAjanyatpurA nAvabudhyase
shlokas.56:
uchyamAno mahArAja bandhubhirhitakA~NkShibhiH |
tadidaM samanuprAptaM vyasanaM tvAM mahAtyayam
shlokas.57:
putrANAM rAjyakAmAnAM tvayA rAjanhitaiShiNA |
ahitAnIva chIrNAni teShAM te phalamAgatam
shlokas.58:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
AkhyAtA mAmakAstAta nihatA yudhi pANDavaiH |
nihatAnpANDaveyAnAM mAmakairbrUhi sa~njaya
shlokas.59:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kuntayo yudhi vikrAntA mahAsattvA mahAbalAH |
sAnubandhAH sahAmAtyA bhIShmeNa yudhi pAtitAH
shlokas.60:
samaH kirITinA sa~Nkhye vIryeNa cha balena cha |
satyajitsatyasandhena droNena nihato raNe
shlokas.61:
tathA virATadrupadau vRRiddhau sahasutau nRRipau |
parAkramantau mitrArthe droNena nihatau raNe
shlokas.62:
yo bAla eva samare saMmitaH savyasAchinA |
keshavena cha durdharSho baladevena chAbhibhUH
shlokas.63:
sa eSha kadanaM kRRitvA mahadraNavishAradaH |
parivArya mahAmAtraiH ShaDbhiH paramakai rathaiH
ashaknuvadbhirbIbhatsumabhimanyurnipAtitaH
shlokas.64:
taM kRRitaM virathaM vIraM kShatradharme vyavasthitam |
dauHshAsanirmahArAja saubhadraM hatavAnraNe
shlokas.65:
bRRihantastu maheShvAsaH kRRitAstro yuddhadurmadaH |
duHshAsanena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.66:
maNimAndaNDadhArashcha rAjAnau yuddhadurmadau |
parAkramantau mitrArthe droNena vinipAtitau
shlokas.67:
a.nshumAnbhojarAjastu sahasainyo mahArathaH |
bhAradvAjena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.68:
chitrAyudhashchitrayodhI kRRitvA tau kadanaM mahat |
chitramArgeNa vikramya karNena nihatau yudhi
shlokas.69:
vRRikodarasamo yuddhe dRRiDhaH kekayajo yudhi |
kekayenaiva vikramya bhrAtrA bhrAtA nipAtitaH
shlokas.70:
janamejayo gadAyodhI pArvatIyaH pratApavAn |
durmukhena mahArAja tava putreNa pAtitaH
shlokas.71:
rochamAnau naravyAghrau rochamAnau grahAviva |
droNena yugapadrAjandivaM sampreShitau sharaiH
shlokas.72:
nRRipAshcha pratiyudhyantaH parAkrAntA vishAM pate |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma gatA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.74:
abhibhUH kAshirAjashcha kAshikairbahubhirvRRitaH |
vasudAnasya putreNa nyAsito dehamAhave
shlokas.75:
amitaujA yudhAmanyuruttamaujAshcha vIryavAn |
nihatya shatashaH shUrAnparairvinihatau raNe
shlokas.76:
kShatradharmA cha pA~nchAlyaH kShatravarmA cha mAriSha |
droNena parameShvAsau gamitau yamasAdanam
shlokas.77:
shikhaNDitanayo yuddhe kShatradevo yudhAM patiH |
lakShmaNena hato rAja.nstava pautreNa bhArata
shlokas.78:
suchitrashchitradharmA cha pitAputrau mahArathau |
pracharantau mahAvIryau droNena nihatau raNe
shlokas.79:
vArdhakShemirmahArAja kRRitvA kadanamAhave |
bAhlikena mahArAja kauraveNa nipAtitaH
shlokas.80:
dhRRiShTaketurmahArAja chedInAM pravaro rathaH |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma gato vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.81:
tathA satyadhRRitistAta kRRitvA kadanamAhave |
pANDavArthe parAkrAnto gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.82:
putrastu shishupAlasya suketuH pRRithivIpate |
nihatya shAtravAnsa~Nkhye droNena nihato yudhi
shlokas.83:
tathA satyadhRRitirvIro madirAshvashcha vIryavAn |
sUryadattashcha vikrAnto nihato droNasAyakaiH
shlokas.84:
shreNimA.nshcha mahArAja yudhyamAnaH parAkramI |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma gato vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.85:
tathaiva yudhi vikrAnto mAgadhaH paravIrahA |
bhIShmeNa nihato rAjanyudhyamAnaH parAkramI
shlokas.86:
vasudAnashcha kadanaM kurvANo.atIva sa.nyuge |
bhAradvAjena vikramya gamito yamasAdanam
shlokas.87:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
hatA droNena vikramya yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.88:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
hatapravIre sainye.asminmAmake vadatAM vara |
ahatA~nsha.nsa me sUta ye.atra jIvanti kechana
shlokas.89:
eteShu nihateShvadya ye tvayA parikIrtitAH |
ahatAnmanyase yA.nstvaM te.api svargajito matAH
shlokas.90:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yasminmahAstrANi samarpitAni; chitrANi shubhrANi chaturvidhAni |
divyAni rAjannihitAni chaiva; droNena vIradvijasattamena
shlokas.91:
mahArathaH kRRitimAnkShiprahasto; dRRiDhAyudho dRRiDhamuShTirdRRiDheShuH |
sa vIryavAndroNaputrastarasvI; vyavasthito yoddhukAmastvadarthe
shlokas.92:
AnartavAsI hRRidikAtmajo.asau; mahArathaH sAtvatAnAM variShThaH |
svayaM bhojaH kRRitavarmA kRRitAstro; vyavasthito yoddhukAmastvadarthe
shlokas.93:
shAradvato gautamashchApi rAja;nmahAbalo bahuchitrAstrayodhI |
dhanushchitraM sumahadbhArasAhaM; vyavasthito yotsyamAnaH pragRRihya
shlokas.94:
ArtAyaniH samare duShprakampyaH; senAgraNIH prathamastAvakAnAm |
svasreyA.nstAnpANDaveyAnvisRRijya; satyAM vAchaM tAM chikIrShustarasvI
shlokas.95:
tejovadhaM sUtaputrasya sa~Nkhye; pratishrutvAjAtashatroH purastAt |
durAdharShaH shakrasamAnavIryaH; shalyaH sthito yoddhukAmastvadarthe
shlokas.96:
AjAneyaiH saindhavaiH pArvatIyai;rnadIjakAmbojavanAyubAhlikaiH |
gAndhArarAjaH svabalena yukto; vyavasthito yoddhukAmastvadarthe
shlokas.97:
tathA sutaste jvalanArkavarNaM; rathaM samAsthAya kurupravIra |
vyavasthitaH kurumitro narendra; vyabhre sUryo bhrAjamAno yathA vai
shlokas.98:
duryodhano nAgakulasya madhye; mahAvIryaH saha sainyapravIraiH |
rathena jAmbUnadabhUShaNena; vyavasthitaH samare yoddhukAmaH
shlokas.99:
sa rAjamadhye puruShapravIro; rarAja jAmbUnadachitravarmA |
padmaprabho vahnirivAlpadhUmo; meghAntare sUrya iva prakAshaH
shlokas.100:
tathA suSheNo.apyasicharmapANi;stavAtmajaH satyasenashcha vIraH |
vyavasthitau chitrasenena sArdhaM; hRRiShTAtmAnau samare yoddhukAmau
shlokas.101:
hrIniShedhA bharatA rAjaputrA;shchitrAyudhaH shrutakarmA jayashcha |
shalashcha satyavrataduHshalau cha; vyavasthitA balino yoddhukAmAH
shlokas.102:
kaitavyAnAmadhipaH shUramAnI; raNe raNe shatruhA rAjaputraH |
patrI hayI nAgarathaprayAyI; vyavasthito yoddhukAmastvadarthe
shlokas.103:
vIraH shrutAyushcha shrutAyudhashcha; chitrA~NgadashchitravarmA sa vIraH |
vyavasthitA ye tu sainye narAgryAH; prahAriNo mAninaH satyasandhAH
shlokas.104:
karNAtmajaH satyaseno mahAtmA; vyavasthitaH samare yoddhukAmaH |
athAparau karNasutau varArhau; vyavasthitau laghuhastau narendra
balaM mahaddurbhidamalpadhairyaiH; samAshritau yotsyamAnau tvadarthe
shlokas.105:
etaishcha mukhyairaparaishcha rAja;nyodhapravIrairamitaprabhAvaiH |
vyavasthito nAgakulasya madhye; yathA mahendraH kururAjo jayAya
shlokas.106:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
AkhyAtA jIvamAnA ye parebhyo.anye yathAtatham |
itIdamabhigachChAmi vyaktamarthAbhipattitaH
shlokas.107:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bruvanneva tadA dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
hatapravIraM vidhvastaM ki~nchichCheShaM svakaM balam
shrutvA vyAmohamagamachChokavyAkulitendriyaH
shlokas.108:
muhyamAno.abravIchchApi muhUrtaM tiShTha sa~njaya |
vyAkulaM me manastAta shrutvA sumahadapriyam
naShTachittastataH so.atha babhUva jagatIpatiH

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
shrutvA karNaM hataM yuddhe putrA.nshchaivApalAyinaH |
narendraH ki~nchidAshvasto dvijashreShTha kimabravIt
shlokas.2:
prAptavAnparamaM duHkhaM putravyasanajaM mahat |
tasminyaduktavAnkAle tanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA karNasya nidhanamashraddheyamivAdbhutam |
bhUtasaMmohanaM bhImaM meroH paryasanaM yathA
shlokas.4:
chittamohamivAyuktaM bhArgavasya mahAmateH |
parAjayamivendrasya dviShadbhyo bhImakarmaNaH
shlokas.5:
divaH prapatanaM bhAnorurvyAmiva mahAdyuteH |
sa.nshoShaNamivAchintyaM samudrasyAkShayAmbhasaH
shlokas.6:
mahIviyaddigIshAnAM sarvanAshamivAdbhutam |
karmaNoriva vaiphalyamubhayoH puNyapApayoH
shlokas.7:
sa~nchintya nipuNaM buddhyA dhRRitarAShTro janeshvaraH |
nedamastIti sa~nchintya karNasya nidhanaM prati
shlokas.8:
prANinAmetadAtmatvAtsyAdapIti vinAshanam |
shokAgninA dahyamAno dhamyamAna ivAshayaH
shlokas.9:
vidhvastAtmA shvasandIno hA hetyuktvA suduHkhitaH |
vilalApa mahArAja dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH
shlokas.10:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sa~njayAdhiratho vIraH siMhadviradavikramaH |
vRRiShamapratimaskandho vRRiShabhAkShagatisvanaH
shlokas.11:
vRRiShabho vRRiShabhasyeva yo yuddhe na nivartate |
shatrorapi mahendrasya vajrasaMhanano yuvA
shlokas.12:
yasya jyAtalashabdena sharavRRiShTiraveNa cha |
rathAshvanaramAta~NgA nAvatiShThanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.13:
yamAshritya mahAbAhuM dviShatsa~Nghaghnamachyutam |
duryodhano.akarodvairaM pANDuputrairmahAbalaiH
shlokas.14:
sa kathaM rathinAM shreShThaH karNaH pArthena sa.nyuge |
nihataH puruShavyAghraH prasahyAsahyavikramaH
shlokas.15:
yo nAmanyata vai nityamachyutaM na dhana~njayam |
na vRRiShNInapi tAnanyAnsvabAhubalamAshritaH
shlokas.16:
shAr~NgagANDIvadhanvAnau sahitAvaparAjitau |
ahaM divyAdrathAdekaH pAtayiShyAmi sa.nyuge
shlokas.17:
iti yaH satataM mandamavochallobhamohitam |
duryodhanamapAdInaM rAjyakAmukamAturam
shlokas.18:
yashchAjaiShIdatibalAnamitrAnapi durjayAn |
gAndhArAnmadrakAnmatsyA.nstrigartA.nsta~NgaNA~nshakAn
shlokas.19:
pA~nchAlA.nshcha videhA.nshcha kuNindAnkAshikosalAn |
suhmAna~NgA.nshcha puNDrA.nshcha niShAdAnva~NgakIchakAn
shlokas.20:
vatsAnkali~NgA.nstaralAnashmakAnRRiShikA.nstathA |
yo jitvA samare vIrashchakre balibhRRitaH purA
shlokas.21:
uchchaiHshravA varo.ashvAnAM rAj~nAM vaishravaNo varaH |
varo mahendro devAnAM karNaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.22:
yaM labdhvA mAgadho rAjA sAntvamAnArthagauravaiH |
arautsItpArthivaM kShatramRRite kauravayAdavAn
shlokas.23:
taM shrutvA nihataM karNaM dvairathe savyasAchinA |
shokArNave nimagno.ahamaplavaH sAgare yathA
shlokas.24:
IdRRishairyadyahaM duHkhairna vinashyAmi sa~njaya |
vajrAddRRiDhataraM manye hRRidayaM mama durbhidam
shlokas.25:
j~nAtisambandhimitrANAmimaM shrutvA parAjayam |
ko madanyaH pumA.Nlloke na jahyAtsUta jIvitam
shlokas.26:
viShamagniM prapAtaM vA parvatAgrAdahaM vRRiNe |
na hi shakShyAmi duHkhAni soDhuM kaShTAni sa~njaya
shlokas.27:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shriyA kulena yashasA tapasA cha shrutena cha |
tvAmadya santo manyante yayAtimiva nAhuSham
shlokas.28:
shrute maharShipratimaH kRRitakRRityo.asi pArthiva |
paryavasthApayAtmAnaM mA viShAde manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.29:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
daivameva paraM manye dhikpauruShamanarthakam |
yatra rAmapratIkAshaH karNo.ahanyata sa.nyuge
shlokas.30:
hatvA yudhiShThirAnIkaM pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAn |
pratApya sharavarSheNa dishaH sarvA mahArathaH
shlokas.31:
mohayitvA raNe pArthAnvajrahasta ivAsurAn |
sa kathaM nihataH shete vAtarugNa iva drumaH
shlokas.32:
shokasyAntaM na pashyAmi samudrasyeva viplukAH |
chintA me vardhate tIvrA mumUrShA chApi jAyate
shlokas.33:
karNasya nidhanaM shrutvA vijayaM phalgunasya cha |
ashraddheyamahaM manye vadhaM karNasya sa~njaya
shlokas.34:
vajrasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM sudRRiDhaM mama |
yachChrutvA puruShavyAghraM hataM karNaM na dIryate
shlokas.35:
AyurnUnaM sudIrghaM me vihitaM daivataiH purA |
yatra karNaM hataM shrutvA jIvAmIha suduHkhitaH
shlokas.36:
dhigjIvitamidaM me.adya suhRRiddhInasya sa~njaya |
adya chAhaM dashAmetAM gataH sa~njaya garhitAm
kRRipaNaM vartayiShyAmi shochyaH sarvasya mandadhIH
shlokas.37:
ahameva purA bhUtvA sarvalokasya satkRRitaH |
paribhUtaH kathaM sUta punaH shakShyAmi jIvitum
duHkhAtsuduHkhaM vyasanaM prAptavAnasmi sa~njaya
shlokas.38:
tasmAdbhIShmavadhe chaiva droNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
nAtra sheShaM prapashyAmi sUtaputre hate yudhi
shlokas.39:
sa hi pAraM mahAnAsItputrANAM mama sa~njaya |
yuddhe vinihataH shUro visRRijansAyakAnbahUn
shlokas.40:
ko hi me jIvitenArthastamRRite puruSharShabham |
rathAdatiratho nUnamapatatsAyakArditaH
shlokas.41:
parvatasyeva shikharaM vajrapAtavidAritam |
shayIta pRRithivIM nUnaM shobhayanrudhirokShitaH
mAta~Nga iva mattena mAta~Ngena nipAtitaH
shlokas.42:
yadbalaM dhArtarAShTrANAM pANDavAnAM yato bhayam |
so.arjunena hataH karNaH pratimAnaM dhanuShmatAm
shlokas.43:
sa hi vIro maheShvAsaH putrANAmabhaya~NkaraH |
shete vinihato vIraH shakreNeva yathA balaH
shlokas.44:
pa~NgorivAdhvagamanaM daridrasyeva kAmitam |
duryodhanasya chAkUtaM tRRiShitasyeva piplukAH
shlokas.45:
anyathA chintitaM kAryamanyathA tattu jAyate |
aho nu balavaddaivaM kAlashcha duratikramaH
shlokas.46:
palAyamAnaH kRRipaNaM dInAtmA dInapauruShaH |
kachchinna nihataH sUta putro duHshAsano mama
shlokas.47:
kachchinna nIchAcharitaM kRRitavA.nstAta sa.nyuge |
kachchinna nihataH shUro yathA na kShatriyA hatAH
shlokas.48:
yudhiShThirasya vachanaM mA yuddhamiti sarvadA |
duryodhano nAbhyagRRihNAnmUDhaH pathyamivauShadham
shlokas.49:
sharatalpe shayAnena bhIShmeNa sumahAtmanA |
pAnIyaM yAchitaH pArthaH so.avidhyanmedinItalam
shlokas.50:
jalasya dhArAM vihitAM dRRiShTvA tAM pANDavena ha |
abravItsa mahAbAhustAta sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.51:
prashamAddhi bhavechChAntirmadantaM yuddhamastu cha |
bhrAtRRibhAvena pRRithivIM bhu~NkShva pANDusutaiH saha
shlokas.52:
akurvanvachanaM tasya nUnaM shochati me sutaH |
tadidaM samanuprAptaM vachanaM dIrghadarshinaH
shlokas.53:
ahaM tu nihatAmAtyo hataputrashcha sa~njaya |
dyUtataH kRRichChramApanno lUnapakSha iva dvijaH
shlokas.54:
yathA hi shakuniM gRRihya ChittvA pakShau cha sa~njaya |
visarjayanti saMhRRiShTAH krIDamAnAH kumArakAH
shlokas.55:
ChinnapakShatayA tasya gamanaM nopapadyate |
tathAhamapi samprApto lUnapakSha iva dvijaH
shlokas.56:
kShINaH sarvArthahInashcha nirbandhurj~nAtivarjitaH |
kAM dishaM pratipatsyAmi dInaH shatruvashaM gataH
shlokas.57:
duryodhanasya vRRiddhyarthaM pRRithivIM yo.ajayatprabhuH |
sa jitaH pANDavaiH shUraiH samarthairvIryashAlibhiH
shlokas.58:
tasminhate maheShvAse karNe yudhi kirITinA |
ke vIrAH paryavartanta tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.59:
kachchinnaikaH parityaktaH pANDavairnihato raNe |
uktaM tvayA purA vIra yathA vIrA nipAtitAH
shlokas.60:
bhIShmamapratiyudhyantaM shikhaNDI sAyakottamaiH |
pAtayAmAsa samare sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.61:
tathA draupadinA droNo nyastasarvAyudho yudhi |
yuktayogo maheShvAsaH sharairbahubhirAchitaH
nihataH khaDgamudyamya dhRRiShTadyumnena sa~njaya
shlokas.62:
antareNa hatAvetau Chalena cha visheShataH |
ashrauShamahametadvai bhIShmadroNau nipAtitau
shlokas.63:
bhIShmadroNau hi samare na hanyAdvajrabhRRitsvayam |
nyAyena yudhyamAnau hi tadvai satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.64:
karNaM tvasyantamastrANi divyAni cha bahUni cha |
kathamindropamaM vIraM mRRityuryuddhe samaspRRishat
shlokas.65:
yasya vidyutprabhAM shaktiM divyAM kanakabhUShaNAm |
prAyachChaddviShatAM hantrIM kuNDalAbhyAM pura.ndaraH
shlokas.66:
yasya sarpamukho divyaH sharaH kanakabhUShaNaH |
asheta nihataH patrI chandaneShvarisUdanaH
shlokas.67:
bhIShmadroNamukhAnvIrAnyo.avamanya mahArathAn |
jAmadagnyAnmahAghoraM brAhmamastramashikShata
shlokas.68:
yashcha droNamukhAndRRiShTvA vimukhAnarditA~nsharaiH |
saubhadrasya mahAbAhurvyadhamatkArmukaM sharaiH
shlokas.69:
yashcha nAgAyutaprANaM vAtaraMhasamachyutam |
virathaM bhrAtaraM kRRitvA bhImasenamupAhasat
shlokas.70:
sahadevaM cha nirjitya sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
kRRipayA virathaM kRRitvA nAhanaddharmavittayA
shlokas.71:
yashcha mAyAsahasrANi dhva.nsayitvA raNotkaTam |
ghaTotkachaM rAkShasendraM shakrashaktyAbhijaghnivAn
shlokas.72:
etAni divasAnyasya yuddhe bhIto dhana~njayaH |
nAgamaddvairathaM vIraH sa kathaM nihato raNe
shlokas.73:
rathasa~Ngo na chettasya dhanurvA na vyashIryata |
na chedastrANi nirNeshuH sa kathaM nihataH paraiH
shlokas.74:
ko hi shakto raNe karNaM vidhunvAnaM mahaddhanuH |
vimu~nchantaM sharAnghorAndivyAnyastrANi chAhave
jetuM puruShashArdUlaM shArdUlamiva vegitam
shlokas.75:
dhruvaM tasya dhanushChinnaM ratho vApi gato mahIm |
astrANi vA pranaShTAni yathA sha.nsasi me hatam
na hyanyadanupashyAmi kAraNaM tasya nAshane
shlokas.76:
na hanyAmarjunaM yAvattAvatpAdau na dhAvaye |
iti yasya mahAghoraM vratamAsInmahAtmanaH
shlokas.77:
yasya bhIto vane nityaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
trayodasha samA nidrAM na lebhe puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.78:
yasya vIryavato vIryaM samAshritya mahAtmanaH |
mama putraH sabhAM bhAryAM pANDUnAM nItavAnbalAt
shlokas.79:
tatra chApi sabhAmadhye pANDavAnAM cha pashyatAm |
dAsabhAryeti pA~nchAlImabravItkurusa.nsadi
shlokas.80:
yashcha gANDIvamuktAnAM sparshamugramachintayan |
apatirhyasi kRRiShNeti bruvanpArthAnavaikShata
shlokas.81:
yasya nAsIdbhayaM pArthaiH saputraiH sajanArdanaiH |
svabAhubalamAshritya muhUrtamapi sa~njaya
shlokas.82:
tasya nAhaM vadhaM manye devairapi savAsavaiH |
pratIpamupadhAvadbhiH kiM punastAta pANDavaiH
shlokas.83:
na hi jyAM spRRishamAnasya talatre chApi gRRihNataH |
pumAnAdhiratheH kashchitpramukhe sthAtumarhati
shlokas.84:
api syAnmedinI hInA somasUryaprabhA.nshubhiH |
na vadhaH puruShendrasya samareShvapalAyinaH
shlokas.85:
yadi mandaH sahAyena bhrAtrA duHshAsanena cha |
vAsudevasya durbuddhiH pratyAkhyAnamarochayat
shlokas.86:
sa nUnamRRiShabhaskandhaM dRRiShTvA karNaM nipAtitam |
duHshAsanaM cha nihataM manye shochati putrakaH
shlokas.87:
hataM vaikartanaM shrutvA dvairathe savyasAchinA |
jayataH pANDavAndRRiShTvA kiM svidduryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.88:
durmarShaNaM hataM shrutvA vRRiShasenaM cha sa.nyuge |
prabhagnaM cha balaM dRRiShTvA vadhyamAnaM mahArathaiH
shlokas.89:
parA~NmukhA.nstathA rAj~naH palAyanaparAyaNAn |
vidrutAnrathino dRRiShTvA manye shochati putrakaH
shlokas.90:
aneyashchAbhimAnena bAlabuddhiramarShaNaH |
hatotsAhaM balaM dRRiShTvA kiM svidduryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.91:
bhrAtaraM nihataM dRRiShTvA bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
rudhiraM pIyamAnena kiM svidduryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.92:
saha gAndhArarAjena sabhAyAM yadabhAShata |
karNo.arjunaM raNe hantA hate tasminkimabravIt
shlokas.93:
dyUtaM kRRitvA purA hRRiShTo va~nchayitvA cha pANDavAn |
shakuniH saubalastAta hate karNe kimabravIt
shlokas.94:
kRRitavarmA maheShvAsaH sAtvatAnAM mahArathaH |
karNaM vinihataM dRRiShTvA hArdikyaH kimabhAShata
shlokas.95:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyA yasya shikShAmupAsate |
dhanurvedaM chikIrShanto droNaputrasya dhImataH
shlokas.96:
yuvA rUpeNa sampanno darshanIyo mahAyashAH |
ashvatthAmA hate karNe kimabhAShata sa~njaya
shlokas.97:
AchAryatvaM dhanurvede gataH paramatattvavit |
kRRipaH shAradvatastAta hate karNe kimabravIt
shlokas.98:
madrarAjo maheShvAsaH shalyaH samitishobhanaH |
diShTaM tena hi tatsarvaM yathA karNo nipAtitaH
shlokas.99:
ye cha kechana rAjAnaH pRRithivyAM yoddhumAgatAH |
vaikartanaM hataM dRRiShTvA kimabhAShanta sa~njaya
shlokas.100:
karNe tu nihate vIre rathavyAghre nararShabhe |
kiM vo mukhamanIkAnAmAsItsa~njaya bhAgashaH
shlokas.101:
madrarAjaH kathaM shalyo niyukto rathinAM varaH |
vaikartanasya sArathye tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.102:
ke.arakShandakShiNaM chakraM sUtaputrasya sa.nyuge |
vAmaM chakraM rarakShurvA ke vA vIrasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.103:
ke karNaM vAjahuH shUrAH ke kShudrAH prAdravanbhayAt |
kathaM cha vaH sametAnAM hataH karNo mahArathaH
shlokas.104:
pANDavAshcha kathaM shUrAH pratyudIyurmahAratham |
sRRijantaM sharavarShANi vAridhArA ivAmbudam
shlokas.105:
sa cha sarpamukho divyo maheShupravarastadA |
vyarthaH kathaM samabhavattanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.106:
mAmakasyAsya sainyasya hRRitotsedhasya sa~njaya |
avasheShaM na pashyAmi kakude mRRidite sati
shlokas.107:
tau hi vIrau maheShvAsau madarthe kurusattamau |
bhIShmadroNau hatau shrutvA ko nvartho jIvitena me
shlokas.108:
na mRRiShyAmi cha rAdheyaM hatamAhavashobhinam |
yasya bAhvorbalaM tulyaM ku~njarANAM shataM shatam
shlokas.109:
droNe hate cha yadvRRittaM kauravANAM paraiH saha |
sa~NgrAme naravIrANAM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.110:
yathA cha karNaH kaunteyaiH saha yuddhamayojayat |
yathA cha dviShatAM hantA raNe shAntastaduchyatAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hate droNe maheShvAse tasminnahani bhArata |
kRRite cha moghasa~Nkalpe droNaputre mahArathe
shlokas.2:
dravamANe mahArAja kauravANAM bale tathA |
vyUhya pArthaH svakaM sainyamatiShThadbhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.3:
tamavasthitamAj~nAya putraste bharatarShabha |
dravachcha svabalaM dRRiShTvA pauruSheNa nyavArayat
shlokas.4:
svamanIkamavasthApya bAhuvIrye vyavasthitaH |
yuddhvA cha suchiraM kAlaM pANDavaiH saha bhArata
shlokas.5:
labdhalakShaiH parairhRRiShTairvyAyachChadbhishchiraM tadA |
sandhyAkAlaM samAsAdya pratyAhAramakArayat
shlokas.6:
kRRitvAvahAraM sainyAnAM pravishya shibiraM svakam |
kuravo.a.atmahitaM mantraM mantrayAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.7:
parya~NkeShu parArdhyeShu spardhyAstaraNavatsu cha |
varAsaneShUpaviShTAH sukhashayyAsvivAmarAH
shlokas.8:
tato duryodhano rAjA sAmnA paramavalgunA |
tAnAbhAShya maheShvAsAnprAptakAlamabhAShata
shlokas.9:
matiM matimatAM shreShThAH sarve prabrUta mAchiram |
evaM gate tu yatkAryaM bhavetkAryakaraM nRRipAH
shlokas.10:
evamukte narendreNa narasiMhA yuyutsavaH |
chakrurnAnAvidhAshcheShTAH siMhAsanagatAstadA
shlokas.11:
teShAM nishamye~NgitAni yuddhe prANA~njuhUShatAm |
samudvIkShya mukhaM rAj~no bAlArkasamavarchasaH
AchAryaputro medhAvI vAkyaj~no vAkyamAdade
shlokas.12:
rAgo yogastathA dAkShyaM nayashchetyarthasAdhakAH |
upAyAH paNDitaiH proktAH sarve daivasamAshritAH
shlokas.13:
lokapravIrA ye.asmAkaM devakalpA mahArathAH |
nItimantastathA yuktA dakShA raktAshcha te hatAH
shlokas.14:
na tveva kAryaM nairAshyamasmAbhirvijayaM prati |
sunItairiha sarvArthairdaivamapyanulomyate
shlokas.15:
te vayaM pravaraM nR^INAM sarvairguNagaNairyutam |
karNaM senApatiM kRRitvA pramathiShyAmahe ripUn
shlokas.16:
tato duryodhanaH prItaH priyaM shrutvA vachastadA |
prItisa.nskArasa.nyuktaM tathyamAtmahitaM shubham
shlokas.17:
svaM manaH samavasthApya bAhuvIryamupAshritaH |
duryodhano mahArAja rAdheyamidamabravIt
shlokas.18:
karNa jAnAmi te vIryaM sauhRRidaM cha paraM mayi |
tathApi tvAM mahAbAho pravakShyAmi hitaM vachaH
shlokas.19:
shrutvA yatheShTaM cha kuru vIra yattava rochate |
bhavAnprAj~natamo nityaM mama chaiva parA gatiH
shlokas.20:
bhIShmadroNAvatirathau hatau senApatI mama |
senApatirbhavAnastu tAbhyAM draviNavattaraH
shlokas.21:
vRRiddhau cha tau maheShvAsau sApekShau cha dhana~njaye |
mAnitau cha mayA vIrau rAdheya vachanAttava
shlokas.22:
pitAmahatvaM samprekShya pANDuputrA mahAraNe |
rakShitAstAta bhIShmeNa divasAni dashaiva ha
shlokas.23:
nyastashastre cha bhavati hato bhIShmaH pitAmahaH |
shikhaNDinaM puraskRRitya phalgunena mahAhave
shlokas.24:
hate tasminmahAbhAge sharatalpagate tadA |
tvayokte puruShavyAghra droNo hyAsItpuraHsaraH
shlokas.25:
tenApi rakShitAH pArthAH shiShyatvAdiha sa.nyuge |
sa chApi nihato vRRiddho dhRRiShTadyumnena satvaram
shlokas.26:
nihatAbhyAM pradhAnAbhyAM tAbhyAmamitavikrama |
tvatsamaM samare yodhaM nAnyaM pashyAmi chintayan
shlokas.27:
bhavAneva tu naH shakto vijayAya na sa.nshayaH |
pUrvaM madhye cha pashchAchcha tavaiva viditaM hi tat
shlokas.28:
sa bhavAndhuryavatsa~Nkhye dhuramudvoDhumarhasi |
abhiShechaya senAnye svayamAtmAnamAtmanA
shlokas.29:
devatAnAM yathA skandaH senAnIH prabhuravyayaH |
tathA bhavAnimAM senAM dhArtarAShTrIM bibhartu me
jahi shatrugaNAnsarvAnmahendra iva dAnavAn
shlokas.30:
avasthitaM raNe j~nAtvA pANDavAstvAM mahAratham |
draviShyanti sapA~nchAlA viShNuM dRRiShTveva dAnavAH
tasmAttvaM puruShavyAghra prakarShethA mahAchamUm
shlokas.31:
bhavatyavasthite yatte pANDavA gatachetasaH |
bhaviShyanti sahAmAtyAH pA~nchAlaiH sRRi~njayaiH saha
shlokas.32:
yathA hyabhyuditaH sUryaH pratapansvena tejasA |
vyapohati tamastIvraM tathA shatrUnvyapoha naH
shlokas.33:
karNa uvAcha||
uktametanmayA pUrvaM gAndhAre tava saMnidhau |
jeShyAmi pANDavAnrAjansaputrAnsajanArdanAn
shlokas.34:
senApatirbhaviShyAmi tavAhaM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
sthiro bhava mahArAja jitAnviddhi cha pANDavAn
shlokas.35:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamukto mahAtejAstato duryodhano nRRipaH |
uttasthau rAjabhiH sArdhaM devairiva shatakratuH
senApatyena satkartuM karNaM skandamivAmarAH
shlokas.36:
tato.abhiShiShichustUrNaM vidhidRRiShTena karmaNA |
duryodhanamukhA rAjanrAjAno vijayaiShiNaH
shAtakaumbhamayaiH kumbhairmAheyaishchAbhimantritaiH
shlokas.37:
toyapUrNairviShANaishcha dvIpikhaDgamaharShabhaiH |
maNimuktAmayaishchAnyaiH puNyagandhaistathauShadhaiH
shlokas.38:
audumbare samAsInamAsane kShaumasa.nvRRitam |
shAstradRRiShTena vidhinA sambhAraishcha susambhRRitaiH
shlokas.39:
jaya pArthAnsagovindAnsAnugA.nstvaM mahAhave |
iti taM bandinaH prAhurdvijAshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.40:
jahi pArthAnsapA~nchAlAnrAdheya vijayAya naH |
udyanniva sadA bhAnustamA.nsyugrairgabhastibhiH
shlokas.41:
na hyalaM tvadvisRRiShTAnAM sharANAM te sakeshavAH |
kRRitaghnAH sUryarashmInAM jvalatAmiva darshane
shlokas.42:
na hi pArthAH sapA~nchAlAH sthAtuM shaktAstavAgrataH |
Attashastrasya samare mahendrasyeva dAnavAH
shlokas.43:
abhiShiktastu rAdheyaH prabhayA so.amitaprabhaH |
vyatyarichyata rUpeNa divAkara ivAparaH
shlokas.44:
senApatyena rAdheyamabhiShichya sutastava |
amanyata tadAtmAnaM kRRitArthaM kAlachoditaH
shlokas.45:
karNo.api rAjansamprApya senApatyamari.ndamaH |
yogamAj~nApayAmAsa sUryasyodayanaM prati
shlokas.46:
tava putrairvRRitaH karNaH shushubhe tatra bhArata |
devairiva yathA skandaH sa~NgrAme tArakAmaye

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
senApatyaM tu samprApya karNo vaikartanastadA |
tathoktashcha svayaM rAj~nA snigdhaM bhrAtRRisamaM vachaH
shlokas.2:
yogamAj~nApya senAyA Aditye.abhyudite tadA |
akarotkiM mahAprAj~nastanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNasya matamAj~nAya putraste bharatarShabha |
yogamAj~nApayAmAsa nAndItUryapuraHsaram
shlokas.4:
mahatyapararAtre tu tava putrasya mAriSha |
yogo yogeti sahasA prAdurAsInmahAsvanaH
shlokas.5:
nAgAnAM kalpamAnAnAM rathAnAM cha varUthinAm |
saMnahyatAM padAtInAM vAjinAM cha vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
kroshatAM chApi yodhAnAM tvaritAnAM parasparam |
babhUva tumulaH shabdo divaspRRiksumahA.nstadA
shlokas.7:
tataH shvetapatAkena bAlArkAkAravAjinA |
hemapRRiShThena dhanuShA hastikakShyeNa ketunA
shlokas.8:
tUNena sharapUrNena sA~Ngadena varUthinA |
shataghnIki~NkiNIshaktishUlatomaradhAriNA
shlokas.9:
kArmukeNopapannena vimalAdityavarchasA |
rathenAtipatAkena sUtaputro vyadRRishyata
shlokas.10:
dhamantaM vArijaM tAta hemajAlavibhUShitam |
vidhunvAnaM mahachchApaM kArtasvaravibhUShitam
shlokas.11:
dRRiShTvA karNaM maheShvAsaM rathasthaM rathinAM varam |
bhAnumantamivodyantaM tamo ghnantaM sahasrashaH
shlokas.12:
na bhIShmavyasanaM kechinnApi droNasya mAriSha |
nAnyeShAM puruShavyAghra menire tatra kauravAH
shlokas.13:
tatastu tvarayanyodhA~nsha~Nkhashabdena mAriSha |
karNo niShkAsayAmAsa kauravANAM varUthinIm
shlokas.14:
vyUhaM vyUhya maheShvAso mAkaraM shatrutApanaH |
pratyudyayau tadA karNaH pANDavAnvijigIShayA
shlokas.15:
makarasya tu tuNDe vai karNo rAjanvyavasthitaH |
netrAbhyAM shakuniH shUra ulUkashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.16:
droNaputrastu shirasi grIvAyAM sarvasodarAH |
madhye duryodhano rAjA balena mahatA vRRitaH
shlokas.17:
vAme pAde tu rAjendra kRRitavarmA vyavasthitaH |
nArAyaNabalairyukto gopAlairyuddhadurmadaH
shlokas.18:
pAde tu dakShiNe rAjangautamaH satyavikramaH |
trigartaishcha maheShvAsairdAkShiNAtyaishcha sa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.19:
anupAdastu yo vAmastatra shalyo vyavasthitaH |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM madradeshasamutthayA
shlokas.20:
dakShiNe tu mahArAja suSheNaH satyasa~NgaraH |
vRRito rathasahasraishcha dantinAM cha shataistathA
shlokas.21:
puchChe AstAM mahAvIrau bhrAtarau pArthivau tadA |
chitrasenashcha chitrashcha mahatyA senayA vRRitau
shlokas.22:
tataH prayAte rAjendra karNe naravarottame |
dhana~njayamabhiprekShya dharmarAjo.abravIdidam
shlokas.23:
pashya pArtha mahAsenAM dhArtarAShTrasya sa.nyuge |
karNena nirmitAM vIra guptAM vIrairmahArathaiH
shlokas.24:
hatavIratamA hyeShA dhArtarAShTrI mahAchamUH |
phalgusheShA mahAbAho tRRiNaistulyA matA mama
shlokas.25:
eko hyatra maheShvAsaH sUtaputro vyavasthitaH |
sadevAsuragandharvaiH sakiMnaramahoragaiH
charAcharaistribhirlokairyo.ajayyo rathinAM varaH
shlokas.26:
taM hatvAdya mahAbAho vijayastava phalguna |
uddhRRitashcha bhavechChalyo mama dvAdashavArShikaH
evaM j~nAtvA mahAbAho vyUhaM vyUha yathechChasi
shlokas.27:
bhrAtustadvachanaM shrutvA pANDavaH shvetavAhanaH |
ardhachandreNa vyUhena pratyavyUhata tAM chamUm
shlokas.28:
vAmapArshve.abhavadrAjanbhImaseno vyavasthitaH |
dakShiNe cha maheShvAso dhRRiShTadyumno mahAbalaH
shlokas.29:
madhye vyUhasya sAkShAttu pANDavaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha dharmarAjashcha pRRiShThataH
shlokas.30:
chakrarakShau tu pA~nchAlyau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
nArjunaM jahaturyuddhe pAlyamAnau kirITinA
shlokas.31:
sheShA nRRipatayo vIrAH sthitA vyUhasya da.nshitAH |
yathAbhAvaM yathotsAhaM yathAsattvaM cha bhArata
shlokas.32:
evametanmahAvyUhaM vyUhya bhArata pANDavAH |
tAvakAshcha maheShvAsA yuddhAyaiva mano dadhuH
shlokas.33:
dRRiShTvA vyUDhAM tava chamUM sUtaputreNa sa.nyuge |
nihatAnpANDavAnmene tava putraH sahAnvayaH
shlokas.34:
tathaiva pANDavIM senAM vyUDhAM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiraH |
dhArtarAShTrAnhatAnmene sakarNAnvai janAdhipa
shlokas.35:
tataH sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha paNavAnakagomukhAH |
sahasaivAbhyahanyanta sashabdAshcha samantataH
shlokas.36:
senayorubhayo rAjanprAvAdyanta mahAsvanAH |
siMhanAdashcha sa~njaj~ne shUrANAM jayagRRiddhinAm
shlokas.37:
hayaheShitashabdAshcha vAraNAnAM cha bRRiMhitam |
rathanemisvanAshchogrAH sambabhUvurjanAdhipa
shlokas.38:
na droNavyasanaM kashchijjAnIte bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTvA karNaM maheShvAsaM mukhe vyUhasya da.nshitam
shlokas.39:
ubhe sene mahAsattve prahRRiShTanaraku~njare |
yoddhukAme sthite rAjanhantumanyonyama~njasA
shlokas.40:
tatra yattau susa.nrabdhau dRRiShTvAnyonyaM vyavasthitau |
anIkamadhye rAjendra rejatuH karNapANDavau
shlokas.41:
nRRityamAne tu te sene sameyAtAM parasparam |
tayoH pakShaiH prapakShaishcha nirjagmurvai yuyutsavaH
shlokas.42:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM naravAraNavAjinAm |
rathinAM cha mahArAja anyonyaM nighnatAM dRRiDham

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
te sene.anyonyamAsAdya prahRRiShTAshvanaradvipe |
bRRihatyau samprajahrAte devAsurachamUpame
shlokas.2:
tato gajA rathAshchAshvAH pattayashcha mahAhave |
samprahAraM paraM chakrurdehapApmapraNAshanam
shlokas.3:
pUrNachandrArkapadmAnAM kAntitviDgandhataH samaiH |
uttamA~NgairnRRisiMhAnAM nRRisiMhAstastarurmahIm
shlokas.4:
ardhachandraistathA bhallaiH kShuraprairasipaTTishaiH |
parashvadhaishchApyakRRintannuttamA~NgAni yudhyatAm
shlokas.5:
vyAyatAyatabAhUnAM vyAyatAyatabAhubhiH |
vyAyatA bAhavaH petushChinnamuShTyAyudhA~NgadAH
shlokas.6:
taiH sphuradbhirmahI bhAti raktA~NgulitalaistadA |
garuDaprahatairugraiH pa~nchAsyairiva pannagaiH
shlokas.7:
hayasyandananAgebhyaH peturvIrA dviShaddhatAH |
vimAnebhyo yathA kShINe puNye svargasadastathA
shlokas.8:
gadAbhiranyairgurvIbhiH parighairmusalairapi |
pothitAH shatashaH peturvIrA vIratarai raNe
shlokas.9:
rathA rathairvinihatA mattA mattairdvipairdvipAH |
sAdinaH sAdibhishchaiva tasminparamasa~Nkule
shlokas.10:
rathA vararathairnAgairashvArohAshcha pattibhiH |
ashvArohaiH padAtAshcha nihatA yudhi sherate
shlokas.11:
rathAshvapattayo nAgai rathairnAgAshcha pattayaH |
rathapattidvipAshchAshvairnRRibhishchAshvarathadvipAH
shlokas.12:
rathAshvebhanarANAM cha narAshvebharathaiH kRRitam |
pANipAdaishcha shastraishcha rathaishcha kadanaM mahat
shlokas.13:
tathA tasminbale shUrairvadhyamAne hate.api cha |
asmAnabhyAgamanpArthA vRRikodarapurogamAH
shlokas.14:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha draupadeyAH prabhadrakAH |
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha draviDaiH sainikaiH saha
shlokas.15:
bhRRitA vittena mahatA pANDyAshchauDrAH sakeralAH |
vyUDhoraskA dIrghabhujAH prA.nshavaH priyadarshanAH
shlokas.16:
ApIDino raktadantA mattamAta~NgavikramAH |
nAnAvirAgavasanA gandhachUrNAvachUrNitAH
shlokas.17:
baddhAsayaH pAshahastA vAraNaprativAraNAH |
samAnamRRityavo rAjannanIkasthAH parasparam
shlokas.18:
kalApinashchApahastA dIrghakeshAH priyAhavAH |
pattayaH sAtyakerandhrA ghorarUpaparAkramAH
shlokas.19:
athApare punaH shUrAshchedipA~nchAlakekayAH |
karUShAH kosalAH kAshyA mAgadhAshchApi dudruvuH
shlokas.20:
teShAM rathAshcha nAgAshcha pravarAshchApi pattayaH |
nAnAvidharavairhRRiShTA nRRityanti cha hasanti cha
shlokas.21:
tasya sainyasya mahato mahAmAtravarairvRRitaH |
madhyaM vRRikodaro.abhyAgAttvadIyaM nAgadhUrgataH
shlokas.22:
sa nAgapravaro.atyugro vidhivatkalpito babhau |
udayAdryagryabhavanaM yathAbhyuditabhAskaram
shlokas.23:
tasyAyasaM varmavaraM vararatnavibhUShitam |
tArodbhAsasya nabhasaH shAradasya samatviSham
shlokas.24:
sa tomaraprAsakarashchArumauliH svala~NkRRitaH |
charanmadhya.ndinArkAbhastejasA vyadahadripUn
shlokas.25:
taM dRRiShTvA dviradaM dUrAtkShemadhUrtirdvipasthitaH |
AhvayAno.abhidudrAva pramanAH pramanastaram
shlokas.26:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM dvipayorugrarUpayoH |
yadRRichChayA drumavatormahAparvatayoriva
shlokas.27:
sa.nsaktanAgau tau vIrau tomarairitaretaram |
balavatsUryarashmyAbhairbhittvA bhittvA vinedatuH
shlokas.28:
vyapasRRitya tu nAgAbhyAM maNDalAni vicheratuH |
pragRRihya chaiva dhanuShI jaghnaturvai parasparam
shlokas.29:
kShveDitAsphoTitaravairbANashabdaishcha sarvashaH |
tau janAnharShayitvA cha siMhanAdAnprachakratuH
shlokas.30:
samudyatakarAbhyAM tau dvipAbhyAM kRRitinAvubhau |
vAtoddhUtapatAkAbhyAM yuyudhAte mahAbalau
shlokas.31:
tAvanyonyasya dhanuShI ChittvAnyonyaM vinedatuH |
shaktitomaravarSheNa prAvRRiNmeghAvivAmbubhiH
shlokas.32:
kShemadhUrtistadA bhImaM tomareNa stanAntare |
nirbibheda tu vegena ShaDbhishchApyaparairnadan
shlokas.33:
sa bhImasenaH shushubhe tomaraira~NgamAshritaiH |
krodhadIptavapurmeghaiH saptasaptirivA.nshumAn
shlokas.34:
tato bhAskaravarNAbhama~njogatimayasmayam |
sasarja tomaraM bhImaH pratyamitrAya yatnavAn
shlokas.35:
tataH kulUtAdhipatishchApamAyamya sAyakaiH |
dashabhistomaraM ChittvA shaktyA vivyAdha pANDavam
shlokas.36:
atha kArmukamAdAya mahAjaladanisvanam |
riporabhyardayannAgamunmadaH pANDavaH sharaiH
shlokas.37:
sa sharaughArdito nAgo bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
nigRRihyamANo nAtiShThadvAtadhvasta ivAmbudaH
shlokas.38:
tAmabhyadhAvaddviradaM bhImasenasya nAgarAT |
mahAvAteritaM meghaM vAtoddhUta ivAmbudaH
shlokas.39:
saMnivartyAtmano nAgaM kShemadhUrtiH prayatnataH |
vivyAdhAbhidrutaM bANairbhImasenaM saku~njaram
shlokas.40:
tataH sAdhuvisRRiShTena kShureNa puruSharShabhaH |
ChittvA sharAsanaM shatrornAgamAmitramArdayat
shlokas.41:
tataH khajAkayA bhImaM kShemadhUrtiH parAbhinat |
jaghAna chAsya dviradaM nArAchaiH sarvamarmasu
shlokas.42:
purA nAgasya patanAdavaplutya sthito mahIm |
bhImaseno ripornAgaM gadayA samapothayat
shlokas.43:
tasmAtpramathitAnnAgAtkShemadhUrtimavadrutam |
udyatAsimupAyAntaM gadayAhanvRRikodaraH
shlokas.44:
sa papAta hataH sAsirvyasuH svamabhito dvipam |
vajraprarugNamachalaM siMho vajrahato yathA
shlokas.45:
nihataM nRRipatiM dRRiShTvA kulUtAnAM yashaskaram |
prAdravadvyathitA senA tvadIyA bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH karNo maheShvAsaH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
jaghAna samare shUraH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.2:
tathaiva pANDavA rAja.nstava putrasya vAhinIm |
karNasya pramukhe kruddhA vinijaghnurmahArathAH
shlokas.3:
karNo rAjanmahAbAhurnyavadhItpANDavIM chamUm |
nArAchairarkarashmyAbhaiH karmAraparimArjitaiH
shlokas.4:
tatra bhArata karNena nArAchaistADitA gajAH |
neduH sedushcha mamlushcha babhramushcha disho dasha
shlokas.5:
vadhyamAne bale tasminsUtaputreNa mAriSha |
nakulo.abhyadravattUrNaM sUtaputraM mahAraNe
shlokas.6:
bhImasenastathA drauNiM kurvANaM karma duShkaram |
vindAnuvindau kaikeyau sAtyakiH samavArayat
shlokas.7:
shrutakarmANamAyAntaM chitraseno mahIpatiH |
prativindhyaM tathA chitrashchitraketanakArmukaH
shlokas.8:
duryodhanastu rAjAnaM dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
sa.nshaptakagaNAnkruddho abhyadhAvaddhana~njayaH
shlokas.9:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH kRRipaM chAtha tasminvIravarakShaye |
shikhaNDI kRRitavarmANaM samAsAdayadachyutam
shlokas.10:
shrutakIrtistathA shalyaM mAdrIputraH sutaM tava |
duHshAsanaM mahArAja sahadevaH pratApavAn
shlokas.11:
kekayau sAtyakiM yuddhe sharavarSheNa bhAsvatA |
sAtyakiH kekayau chaiva ChAdayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.12:
tAvenaM bhrAtarau vIraM jaghnaturhRRidaye bhRRisham |
viShANAbhyAM yathA nAgau pratinAgaM mahAhave
shlokas.13:
sharasambhinnavarmANau tAvubhau bhrAtarau raNe |
sAtyakiM satyakarmANaM rAjanvivyadhatuH sharaiH
shlokas.14:
tau sAtyakirmahArAja prahasansarvatodisham |
ChAdaya~nsharavarSheNa vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.15:
vAryamANau tatastau tu shaineyasharavRRiShTibhiH |
shaineyasya rathaM tUrNaM ChAdayAmAsatuH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
tayostu dhanuShI chitre ChittvA shaurirmahAhave |
atha tau sAyakaistIkShNaishChAdayAmAsa duHsahaiH
shlokas.17:
athAnye dhanuShI mRRiShTe pragRRihya cha mahAsharAn |
sAtyakiM pUrayantau tau cheraturlaghu suShThu cha
shlokas.18:
tAbhyAM muktA mahAbANAH ka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH |
dyotayanto dishaH sarvAH sampetuH svarNabhUShaNAH
shlokas.19:
bANAndhakAramabhavattayo rAjanmahAhave |
anyonyasya dhanushchaiva chichChiduste mahArathAH
shlokas.20:
tataH kruddho mahArAja sAtvato yuddhadurmadaH |
dhanuranyatsamAdAya sajyaM kRRitvA cha sa.nyuge
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena anuvindashiro.aharat
shlokas.21:
tachChiro nyapatadbhUmau kuNDalotpIDitaM mahat |
shambarasya shiro yadvannihatasya mahAraNe
shoShayankekayAnsarvA~njagAmAshu vasundharAm
shlokas.22:
taM dRRiShTvA nihataM shUraM bhrAtA tasya mahArathaH |
sajyamanyaddhanuH kRRitvA shaineyaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.23:
sa shaktyA sAtyakiM viddhvA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
nanAda balavannAdaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.24:
sa sAtyakiM punaH kruddhaH kekayAnAM mahArathaH |
sharairagnishikhAkArairbAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.25:
sa sharaiH kShatasarvA~NgaH sAtvataH sattvakovidaH |
rarAja samare rAjansapatra iva ki.nshukaH
shlokas.26:
sAtyakiH samare viddhaH kekayena mahAtmanA |
kekayaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA vivyAdha prahasanniva
shlokas.27:
shatachandrachite gRRihya charmaNI subhujau tu tau |
vyarochetAM mahAra~Nge nistri.nshavaradhAriNau
yathA devAsure yuddhe jambhashakrau mahAbalau
shlokas.28:
maNDalAni tatastau cha vicharantau mahAraNe |
anyonyamasibhistUrNaM samAjaghnaturAhave
shlokas.29:
kekayasya tatashcharma dvidhA chichCheda sAtvataH |
sAtyakeshcha tathaivAsau charma chichCheda pArthivaH
shlokas.30:
charma chChittvA tu kaikeyastArAgaNashatairvRRitam |
chachAra maNDalAnyeva gatapratyAgatAni cha
shlokas.31:
taM charantaM mahAra~Nge nistri.nshavaradhAriNam |
apahastena chichCheda shaineyastvarayAnvitaH
shlokas.32:
savarmA kekayo rAjandvidhA Chinno mahAhave |
nipapAta maheShvAso vajranunna ivAchalaH
shlokas.33:
taM nihatya raNe shUraH shaineyo rathasattamaH |
yudhAmanyo rathaM tUrNamAruroha parantapaH
shlokas.34:
tato.anyaM rathamAsthAya vidhivatkalpitaM punaH |
kekayAnAM mahatsainyaM vyadhamatsAtyakiH sharaiH
shlokas.35:
sA vadhyamAnA samare kekayasya mahAchamUH |
tamutsRRijya rathaM shatruM pradudrAva disho dasha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutakarmA mahArAja chitrasenaM mahIpatim |
Ajaghne samare kruddhaH pa~nchAshadbhiH shilImukhaiH
shlokas.2:
abhisArastu taM rAjA navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
shrutakarmANamAhatya sUtaM vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.3:
shrutakarmA tataH kruddhashchitrasenaM chamUmukhe |
nArAchena sutIkShNena marmadeshe samardayat
shlokas.4:
etasminnantare chainaM shrutakIrtirmahAyashAH |
navatyA jagatIpAlaM ChAdayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.5:
pratilabya tataH sa~nj~nAM chitraseno mahArathaH |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena taM cha vivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.6:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya vegaghnaM rukmabhUShaNam |
chitrarUpataraM chakre chitrasenaM sharormibhiH
shlokas.7:
sa sharaishchitrito rAja.nshchitramAlyadharo yuvA |
yuveva samashobhatsa goShThImadhye svala~NkRRitaH
shlokas.8:
shrutakarmANamatha vai nArAchena stanAntare |
bibheda samare kruddhastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.9:
shrutakarmApi samare nArAchena samarditaH |
susrAva rudhiraM bhUri gairikAmbha ivAchalaH
shlokas.10:
tataH sa rudhirAktA~Ngo rudhireNa kRRitachChaviH |
rarAja samare rAjansapuShpa iva ki.nshukaH
shlokas.11:
shrutakarmA tato rAja~nshatrUNAM samabhidrutaH |
shatrusa.nvaraNaM kRRitvA dvidhA chichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.12:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM nArAchAnAM tribhiH shataiH |
vivyAdha bharatashreShTha shrutakarmA mahAyashAH
shlokas.13:
tato.apareNa bhallena bhRRishaM tIkShNena satvaraH |
jahAra sashirastrANaM shirastasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
tachChiro nyapatadbhUmau sumahachchitravarmaNaH |
yadRRichChayA yathA chandrashchyutaH svargAnmahItale
shlokas.15:
rAjAnaM nihataM dRRiShTvA abhisAraM cha mAriSha |
abhyadravanta vegena chitrasenasya sainikAH
shlokas.16:
tataH kruddho maheShvAsastatsainyaM prAdravachCharaiH |
antakAle yathA kruddhaH sarvabhUtAni pretarAT
drAvayanniShubhistUrNaM shrutakarmA vyarochata
shlokas.17:
prativindhyastatashchitraM bhittvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
sArathiM tribhirAnarchChaddhvajamekeShuNA tataH
shlokas.18:
taM chitro navabhirbhallairbAhvorurasi chArdayat |
svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAdhautaiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH
shlokas.19:
prativindhyo dhanustasya ChittvA bhArata sAyakaiH |
pa~nchabhirnishitairbANairathainaM samprajaghnivAn
shlokas.20:
tataH shaktiM mahArAja hemadaNDAM durAsadAm |
prAhiNottava putrAya ghorAmagnishikhAmiva
shlokas.21:
tAmApatantIM sahasA shaktimulkAmivAmbarAt |
dvidhA chichCheda samare prativindhyo hasanniva
shlokas.22:
sA papAta tadA ChinnA prativindhyasharaiH shitaiH |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni trAsayantI yathAshaniH
shlokas.23:
shaktiM tAM prahatAM dRRiShTvA chitro gRRihya mahAgadAm |
prativindhyAya chikShepa rukmajAlavibhUShitAm
shlokas.24:
sA jaghAna hayA.nstasya sArathiM cha mahAraNe |
rathaM pramRRidya vegena dharaNImanvapadyata
shlokas.25:
etasminneva kAle tu rathAdAplutya bhArata |
shaktiM chikShepa chitrAya svarNaghaNTAmala~NkRRitAm
shlokas.26:
tAmApatantIM jagrAha chitro rAjanmahAmanAH |
tatastAmeva chikShepa prativindhyAya bhArata
shlokas.27:
samAsAdya raNe shUraM prativindhyaM mahAprabhA |
nirbhidya dakShiNaM bAhuM nipapAta mahItale
patitAbhAsayachchaiva taM deshamashaniryathA
shlokas.28:
prativindhyastato rAja.nstomaraM hemabhUShitam |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddhashchitrasya vadhakAmyayA
shlokas.29:
sa tasya devAvaraNaM bhittvA hRRidayameva cha |
jagAma dharaNIM tUrNaM mahoraga ivAshayam
shlokas.30:
sa papAta tadA rAja.nstomareNa samAhataH |
prasArya vipulau bAhU pInau parighasaMnibhau
shlokas.31:
chitraM samprekShya nihataM tAvakA raNashobhinaH |
abhyadravanta vegena prativindhyaM samantataH
shlokas.32:
sRRijanto vividhAnbANA~nshataghnIshcha saki~NkiNIH |
ta enaM ChAdayAmAsuH sUryamabhragaNA iva
shlokas.33:
tAnapAsya mahAbAhuH sharajAlena sa.nyuge |
vyadrAvayattava chamUM vajrahasta ivAsurIm
shlokas.34:
te vadhyamAnAH samare tAvakAH pANDavairnRRipa |
viprakIryanta sahasA vAtanunnA ghanA iva
shlokas.35:
vipradrute bale tasminvadhyamAne samantataH |
drauNireko.abhyayAttUrNaM bhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.36:
tataH samAgamo ghoro babhUva sahasA tayoH |
yathA devAsure yuddhe vRRitravAsavayorabhUt

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenaM tato drauNI rAjanvivyAdha patriNA |
tvarayA parayA yukto darshayannastralAghavam
shlokas.2:
athainaM punarAjaghne navatyA nishitaiH sharaiH |
sarvamarmANi samprekShya marmaj~no laghuhastavat
shlokas.3:
bhImasenaH samAkIrNo drauNinA nishitaiH sharaiH |
rarAja samare rAjanrashmivAniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.4:
tataH sharasahasreNa suprayuktena pANDavaH |
droNaputramavachChAdya siMhanAdamamu~nchata
shlokas.5:
sharaiH sharA.nstato drauNiH sa.nvArya yudhi pANDavam |
lalATe.abhyahanadrAjannArAchena smayanniva
shlokas.6:
lalATasthaM tato bANaM dhArayAmAsa pANDavaH |
yathA shRRi~NgaM vane dRRiptaH khaDgo dhArayate nRRipa
shlokas.7:
tato drauNiM raNe bhImo yatamAnaM parAkramI |
tribhirvivyAdha nArAchairlalATe vismayanniva
shlokas.8:
lalATasthaistato bANairbrAhmaNaH sa vyarochata |
prAvRRiShIva yathA siktastrishRRi~NgaH parvatottamaH
shlokas.9:
tataH sharashatairdrauNimardayAmAsa pANDavaH |
na chainaM kampayAmAsa mAtarishveva parvatam
shlokas.10:
tathaiva pANDavaM yuddhe drauNiH sharashataiH shitaiH |
nAkampayata saMhRRiShTo vAryogha iva parvatam
shlokas.11:
tAvanyonyaM sharairghoraishChAdayAnau mahArathau |
rathacharyAgatau shUrau shushubhAte raNotkaTau
shlokas.12:
AdityAviva sa.ndIptau lokakShayakarAvubhau |
svarashmibhirivAnyonyaM tApayantau sharottamaiH
shlokas.13:
kRRitapratikRRite yatnaM kurvANau cha mahAraNe |
kRRitapratikRRite yatnaM chakrAte tAvabhItavat
shlokas.14:
vyAghrAviva cha sa~NgrAme cheratustau mahArathau |
sharadaMShTrau durAdharShau chApavyAttau bhayAnakau
shlokas.15:
abhUtAM tAvadRRishyau cha sharajAlaiH samantataH |
meghajAlairiva chChannau gagane chandrabhAskarau
shlokas.16:
prakAshau cha muhUrtena tatraivAstAmari.ndamau |
vimuktau meghajAlena shashisUryau yathA divi
shlokas.17:
apasavyaM tatashchakre drauNistatra vRRikodaram |
kira~nsharashatairugrairdhArAbhiriva parvatam
shlokas.18:
na tu tanmamRRiShe bhImaH shatrorvijayalakShaNam |
pratichakre cha taM rAjanpANDavo.apyapasavyataH
shlokas.19:
maNDalAnAM vibhAgeShu gatapratyAgateShu cha |
babhUva tumulaM yuddhaM tayostatra mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.20:
charitvA vividhAnmArgAnmaNDalaM sthAnameva cha |
sharaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.21:
anyonyasya vadhe yatnaM chakratustau mahArathau |
IShaturvirathaM chaiva kartumanyonyamAhave
shlokas.22:
tato drauNirmahAstrANi prAdushchakre mahArathaH |
tAnyastraireva samare pratijaghne.asya pANDavaH
shlokas.23:
tato ghoraM mahArAja astrayuddhamavartata |
grahayuddhaM yathA ghoraM prajAsaMharaNe abhUt
shlokas.24:
te bANAH samasajjanta kShiptAstAbhyAM tu bhArata |
dyotayanto dishaH sarvAstachcha sainyaM samantataH
shlokas.25:
bANasa~NghAvRRitaM ghoramAkAshaM samapadyata |
uklApAtakRRitaM yadvatprajAnAM sa~NkShaye nRRipa
shlokas.26:
bANAbhighAtAtsa~njaj~ne tatra bhArata pAvakaH |
savisphuli~Ngo dIptArchiH so.adahadvAhinIdvayam
shlokas.27:
tatra siddhA mahArAja sampatanto.abruvanvachaH |
ati yuddhAni sarvANi yuddhametattato.adhikam
shlokas.28:
sarvayuddhAni chaitasya kalAM nArhanti ShoDashIm |
naitAdRRishaM punaryuddhaM na bhUtaM na bhaviShyati
shlokas.29:
aho j~nAnena sa.nyuktAvubhau chograparAkramau |
aho bhIme balaM bhImametayoshcha kRRitAstratA
shlokas.30:
aho vIryasya sAratvamaho sauShThavametayoH |
sthitAvetau hi samare kAlAntakayamopamau
shlokas.31:
rudrau dvAviva sambhUtau yathA dvAviva bhAskarau |
yamau vA puruShavyAghrau ghorarUpAvimau raNe
shlokas.32:
shrUyante sma tadA vAchaH siddhAnAM vai muhurmuhuH |
siMhanAdashcha sa~njaj~ne sametAnAM divaukasAm
adbhutaM chApyachintyaM cha dRRiShTvA karma tayormRRidhe
shlokas.33:
tau shUrau samare rAjanparasparakRRitAgasau |
parasparamudaikShetAM krodhAdudvRRitya chakShuShI
shlokas.34:
krodharaktekShaNau tau tu krodhAtprasphuritAdharau |
krodhAtsa.ndaShTadashanau sa.ndaShTadashanachChadau
shlokas.35:
anyonyaM ChAdayantau sma sharavRRiShTyA mahArathau |
sharAmbudhArau samare shastravidyutprakAshinau
shlokas.36:
tAvanyonyaM dhvajau viddhvA sArathI cha mahArathau |
anyonyasya hayAnviddhvA bibhidAte parasparam
shlokas.37:
tataH kruddhau mahArAja bANau gRRihya mahAhave |
ubhau chikShipatustUrNamanyonyasya vadhaiShiNau
shlokas.38:
tau sAyakau mahArAja dyotamAnau chamUmukhe |
AjaghnAte samAsAdya vajravegau durAsadau
shlokas.39:
tau parasparavegAchcha sharAbhyAM cha bhRRishAhatau |
nipetaturmahAvIrau svarathopasthayostadA
shlokas.40:
tatastu sArathirj~nAtvA droNaputramachetanam |
apovAha raNAdrAjansarvakShatrasya pashyataH
shlokas.41:
tathaiva pANDavaM rAjanvihvalantaM muhurmuhuH |
apovAha rathenAjau sArathiH shatrutApanam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yathA sa.nshaptakaiH sArdhamarjunasyAbhavadraNaH |
anyeShAM cha madIyAnAM pANDavaistadbravIhi me
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathAvRRittaM sa~NgrAmaM bruvato mama |
vIrANAM shatrubhiH sArdhaM dehapApmapraNAshanam
shlokas.3:
pArthaH sa.nshaptakagaNaM pravishyArNavasaMnibham |
vyakShobhayadamitraghno mahAvAta ivArNavam
shlokas.4:
shirA.nsyunmathya vIrANAM shitairbhallairdhana~njayaH |
pUrNachandrAbhavaktrANi svakShibhrUdashanAni cha
santastAra kShitiM kShipraM vinAlairnalinairiva
shlokas.5:
suvRRittAnAyatAnpuShTA.nshchandanAgurubhUShitAn |
sAyudhAnsatanutrANAnpa~nchAsyoragasaMnibhAn
bAhUnkShurairamitrANAM vichakartArjuno raNe
shlokas.6:
dhuryAndhuryatarAnsUtAndhvajA.nshchApAni sAyakAn |
pANInaratnInasakRRidbhallaishchichCheda pANDavaH
shlokas.7:
dvipAnhayAnrathA.nshchaiva sArohAnarjuno raNe |
sharairanekasAhasrai rAjanninye yamakShayam
shlokas.8:
taM pravIraM pratIyAtA nardamAnA ivarShabhAH |
vAshitArthamabhikruddhA hu~NkRRitvA chAbhidudruvuH
nighnantamabhijaghnuste sharaiH shRRi~NgairivarShabhAH
shlokas.9:
tasya teShAM cha tadyuddhamabhavallomaharShaNam |
trailokyavijaye yAdRRigdaityAnAM saha vajriNA
shlokas.10:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya dviShatAM sarvato.arjunaH |
iShubhirbahubhistUrNaM viddhvA prANAnrarAsa saH
shlokas.11:
ChinnatriveNuchakrAkShAnhatayodhAshvasArathIn |
vidhvastAyudhatUNIrAnsamunmathitaketanAn
shlokas.12:
sa~nChinnayoktrarashmIkAnvitriveNUnvikUbarAn |
vidhvastabandhurayugAnvishastAyudhamaNDalAn
rathAnvishakalIkurvanmahAbhrANIva mArutaH
shlokas.13:
vismApayanprekShaNIyaM dviShAtAM bhayavardhanam |
mahArathasahasrasya samaM karmArjuno.akarot
shlokas.14:
siddhadevarShisa~NghAshcha chAraNAshchaiva tuShTuvuH |
devadundubhayo neduH puShpavarShANi chApatan
keshavArjunayormUrdhni prAha vAkchAsharIriNI
shlokas.15:
chandrArkAnilavahnInAM kAntidIptibaladyutIH |
yau sadA bibhraturvIrau tAvimau keshavArjunau
shlokas.16:
brahmeshAnAvivAjayyau vIrAvekarathe sthitau |
sarvabhUtavarau vIrau naranArAyaNAvubhau
shlokas.17:
ityetanmahadAshcharyaM dRRiShTvA shrutvA cha bhArata |
ashvatthAmA susa.nyattaH kRRiShNAvabhyadravadraNe
shlokas.18:
atha pANDavamasyantaM yamakAlAntakA~nsharAn |
seShuNA pANinAhUya hasandrauNirathAbravIt
shlokas.19:
yadi mAM manyase vIra prAptamarhamivAtithim |
tataH sarvAtmanAdya tvaM yuddhAtithyaM prayachCha me
shlokas.20:
evamAchAryaputreNa samAhUto yuyutsayA |
bahu mene.arjuno.a.atmAnamidaM chAha janArdanam
shlokas.21:
sa.nshaptakAshcha me vadhyA drauNirAhvayate cha mAm |
yadatrAnantaraM prAptaM prashAdhi tvaM mahAbhuja
shlokas.22:
evamukto.avahatpArthaM kRRiShNo droNAtmajAntikam |
jaitreNa vidhinAhUtaM vAyurindramivAdhvare
shlokas.23:
tamAmantryaikamanasA keshavo drauNimabravIt |
ashvatthAmansthiro bhUtvA praharAshu sahasva cha
shlokas.24:
nirveShTuM bhartRRipiNDaM hi kAlo.ayamupajIvinAm |
sUkShmo vivAdo viprANAM sthUlau kShAtrau jayAjayau
shlokas.25:
yAM na sa~NkShamase mohAddivyAM pArthasya satkriyAm |
tAmAptumichChanyudhyasva sthiro bhUtvAdya pANDavam
shlokas.26:
ityukto vAsudevena tathetyuktvA dvijottamaH |
vivyAdha keshavaM ShaShTyA nArAchairarjunaM tribhiH
shlokas.27:
tasyArjunaH susa~NkruddhastribhirbhallaiH sharAsanam |
chichChedAthAnyadAdatta drauNirghorataraM dhanuH
shlokas.28:
sajyaM kRRitvA nimeShAttadvivyAdhArjunakeshavau |
tribhiH sharairvAsudevaM sahasreNa cha pANDavam
shlokas.29:
tataH sharasahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
sasRRije drauNirAyastaH sa.nstabhya cha raNe.arjunam
shlokas.30:
iShudherdhanuSho jyAyA a~NgulIbhyashcha mAriSha |
bAhvoH karAbhyAmuraso vadanaghrANanetrataH
shlokas.31:
karNAbhyAM shiraso.a~Ngebhyo lomavartmabhya eva cha |
rathadhvajebhyashcha sharA niShpeturbrahmavAdinaH
shlokas.32:
sharajAlena mahatA viddhvA keshavapANDavau |
nanAda mudito drauNirmahAmeghaughanisvanaH
shlokas.33:
tasya nAnadataH shrutvA pANDavo.achyutamabravIt |
pashya mAdhava daurAtmyaM droNaputrasya mAM prati
shlokas.34:
vadhaprAptau manyate nau praveshya sharaveshmani |
eSho.asya hanmi sa~NkalpaM shikShayA cha balena cha
shlokas.35:
ashvatthAmnaH sharAnastA.nshChittvaikaikaM tridhA tridhA |
vyadhamadbharatashreShTho nIhAramiva mArutaH
shlokas.36:
tataH sa.nshaptakAnbhUyaH sAshvasUtarathadvipAn |
dhvajapattigaNAnugrairbANairvivyAdha pANDavaH
shlokas.37:
ye ye dadRRishire tatra yadyadrUpaM yathA yathA |
te te tattachCharairvyAptaM menire.a.atmAnameva cha
shlokas.38:
te gANDIvapraNuditA nAnArUpAH patatriNaH |
kroshe sAgre sthitAnghnanti dvipA.nshcha puruShAnraNe
shlokas.39:
bhallaishChinnAH karAH petuH kariNAM madakarShiNAm |
ChinnA yathA parashubhiH pravRRiddhAH sharadi drumAH
shlokas.40:
pashchAttu shailavatpetuste gajAH saha sAdibhiH |
vajrivajrapramathitA yathaivAdrichayAstathA
shlokas.41:
gandharvanagarAkArAnvidhivatkalpitAnrathAn |
vinItajavanAnyuktAnAsthitAnyuddhadurmadAn
shlokas.42:
sharairvishakalIkurvannamitrAnabhyavIvRRiShat |
ala~NkRRitAnashvasAdInpattI.nshchAhandhana~njayaH
shlokas.43:
dhana~njayayugAntArkaH sa.nshaptakamahArNavam |
vyashoShayata duHshoShaM tIvraiH sharagabhastibhiH
shlokas.44:
punardrauNimahAshailaM nArAchaiH sUryasaMnibhaiH |
nirbibheda mahAvegaistvaranvajrIva parvatam
shlokas.45:
tamAchAryasutaH kruddhaH sAshvayantAramAshugaiH |
yuyutsurnAshakadyoddhuM pArthastAnantarAchChinat
shlokas.46:
tataH paramasa~NkruddhaH kANDakoshAnavAsRRijat |
ashvatthAmAbhirUpAya gRRihAnatithaye yathA
shlokas.47:
atha sa.nshaptakA.nstyaktvA pANDavo drauNimabhyayAt |
apA~Nkteyamiva tyaktvA dAtA pA~Nkteyamarthinam
shlokas.48:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM shukrA~NgirasavarchasoH |
nakShatramabhito vyomni shukrA~Ngirasayoriva
shlokas.49:
santApayantAvanyonyaM dIptaiH sharagabhastibhiH |
lokatrAsakarAvAstAM vimArgasthau grahAviva
shlokas.50:
tato.avidhyadbhruvormadhye nArAchenArjuno bhRRisham |
sa tena vibabhau drauNirUrdhvarashmiryathA raviH
shlokas.51:
atha kRRiShNau sharashatairashvatthAmnArditau bhRRisham |
sarashmijAlanikarau yugAntArkAvivAsatuH
shlokas.52:
tato.arjunaH sarvatodhAramastra;mavAsRRijadvAsudevAbhiguptaH |
drauNAyaniM chAbhyahanatpRRiShatkai;rvajrAgnivaivasvatadaNDakalpaiH
shlokas.53:
sa keshavaM chArjunaM chAtitejA; vivyAdha marmasvatiraudrakarmA |
bANaiH sumuktairatitIvravegai;ryairAhato mRRityurapi vyatheta
shlokas.54:
drauNeriShUnarjunaH saMnivArya; vyAyachChatastaddviguNaiH supu~NkhaiH |
taM sAshvasUtadhvajamekavIra;mAvRRitya sa.nshaptakasainyamArChat
shlokas.55:
dhanUMShi bANAniShudhIrdhanurjyAH; pANInbhujAnpANigataM cha shastram |
ChatrANi ketU.nsturagAnathaiShAM; vastrANi mAlyAnyatha bhUShaNAni
shlokas.56:
charmANi varmANi manorathA.nshcha; priyANi sarvANi shirA.nsi chaiva |
chichCheda pArtho dviShatAM pramuktai;rbANaiH sthitAnAmaparA~NmukhAnAm
shlokas.57:
sukalpitAH syandanavAjinAgAH; samAsthitAH kRRitayatnairnRRivIraiH |
pArtheritairbANagaNairnirastA;staireva sArdhaM nRRivarairnipetuH
shlokas.58:
padmArkapUrNendusamAnanAni; kirITamAlAmukuTotkaTAni |
bhallArdhachandrakShurahi.nsitAni; prapetururvyAM nRRishirA.nsyajasram
shlokas.59:
atha dvipairdevapatidvipAbhai;rdevAridarpolbaNamanyudarpaiH |
kali~Ngava~NgA~NganiShAdavIrA; jighA.nsavaH pANDavamabhyadhAvan
shlokas.60:
teShAM dvipAnAM vichakarta pArtho; varmANi marmANi karAnniyantR^In |
dhvajAH patAkAshcha tataH prapetu;rvajrAhatAnIva gireH shirA.nsi
shlokas.61:
teShu prarugNeShu gurostanUjaM; bANaiH kirITI navasUryavarNaiH |
prachChAdayAmAsa mahAbhrajAlai;rvAyuH samudyuktamivA.nshumantam
shlokas.62:
tato.arjuneShUniShubhirnirasya; drauNiH sharairarjunavAsudevau |
prachChAdayitva divi chandrasUryau; nanAda so.ambhoda ivAtapAnte
shlokas.63:
tamarjunastA.nshcha punastvadIyA;nabhyarditastairavikRRittashastraiH |
bANAndhakAraM sahasaiva kRRitvA; vivyAdha sarvAniShubhiH supu~NkhaiH
shlokas.64:
nApyAdadatsa.ndadhannaiva mu~ncha;nbANAnraNe.adRRishyata savyasAchI |
hatA.nshcha nAgA.nsturagAnpadAtI;nsa.nsyUtadehAndadRRishU rathA.nshcha
shlokas.65:
sandhAya nArAchavarAndashAshu; drauNistvarannekamivotsasarja |
teShAM cha pa~nchArjunamabhyavidhya;npa~nchAchyutaM nirbibhiduH sumuktAH
shlokas.66:
tairAhatau sarvamanuShyamukhyA;vasRRikkSharantau dhanadendrakalpau |
samAptavidyena yathAbhibhUtau; hatau svidetau kimu menire.anye
shlokas.67:
athArjunaM prAha dashArhanAthaH; pramAdyase kiM jahi yodhametam |
kuryAddhi doShaM samupekShito.asau; kaShTo bhavedvyAdhirivAkriyAvAn
shlokas.68:
tatheti choktvAchyutamapramAdI; drauNiM prayatnAdiShubhistatakSha |
ChittvAshvarashmI.nsturagAnavidhya;tte taM raNAdUhuratIva dUram
shlokas.69:
AvRRitya neyeSha punastu yuddhaM; pArthena sArdhaM matimAnvimRRishya |
jAna~njayaM niyataM vRRiShNivIre; dhana~njaye chA~NgirasAM variShThaH
shlokas.70:
pratIpakAye tu raNAdashvatthAmni hRRite hayaiH |
mantrauShadhikriyAdAnairvyAdhau dehAdivAhRRite

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
athottareNa pANDUnAM senAyAM dhvanirutthitaH |
rathanAgAshvapattInAM daNDadhAreNa vadhyatAm
shlokas.2:
nivartayitvA tu rathaM keshavo.arjunamabravIt |
vAhayanneva turagAngaruDAnilaraMhasaH
shlokas.3:
mAgadho.athApyatikrAnto dviradena pramAthinA |
bhagadattAdanavaraH shikShayA cha balena cha
shlokas.4:
enaM hatvA nihantAsi punaH sa.nshaptakAniti |
vAkyAnte prApayatpArthaM daNDadhArAntikaM prati
shlokas.5:
sa mAgadhAnAM pravaro.a~Nkushagraho; graheShvasahyo vikacho yathA grahaH |
sapatnasenAM pramamAtha dAruNo; mahIM samagrAM vikacho yathA grahaH
shlokas.6:
sukalpitaM dAnavanAgasaMnibhaM; mahAbhrasaMhrAdamamitramardanam |
rathAshvamAta~NgagaNAnsahasrashaH; samAsthito hanti sharairdvipAnapi
shlokas.7:
rathAnadhiShThAya savAjisArathI;nrathA.nshcha padbhistvarito vyapothayat |
dvipA.nshcha padbhyAM charaNaiH kareNa cha; dvipAsthito hanti sa kAlachakravat
shlokas.8:
narA.nshcha kArShNAyasavarmabhUShaNA;nnipAtya sAshvAnapi pattibhiH saha |
vyapothayaddantivareNa shuShmiNA; sashabdavatsthUlanaDAnyathA tathA
shlokas.9:
athArjuno jyAtalaneminisvane; mRRida~NgabherIbahusha~NkhanAdite |
narAshvamAta~NgasahasranAditai; rathottamenAbhyapataddvipottamam
shlokas.10:
tato.arjunaM dvAdashabhiH sharottamai;rjanArdanaM ShoDashabhiH samArdayat |
sa daNDadhArasturagA.nstribhistribhi;stato nanAda prajahAsa chAsakRRit
shlokas.11:
tato.asya pArthaH saguNeShukArmukaM; chakarta bhallairdhvajamapyala~NkRRitam |
punarniyantR^Insaha pAdagoptRRibhi;statastu chukrodha girivrajeshvaraH
shlokas.12:
tato.arjunaM bhinnakaTena dantinA; ghanAghanenAnilatulyaraMhasA |
atIva chukShobhayiShurjanArdanaM; dhana~njayaM chAbhijaghAna tomaraiH
shlokas.13:
athAsya bAhU dvipahastasaMnibhau; shirashcha pUrNendunibhAnanaM tribhiH |
kShuraiH prachichCheda sahaiva pANDava;stato dvipaM bANashataiH samArdayat
shlokas.14:
sa pArthabANaistapanIyabhUShaNaiH; samAruchatkA~nchanavarmabhRRiddvipaH |
tathA chakAshe nishi parvato yathA; davAgninA prajvalitauShadhidrumaH
shlokas.15:
sa vedanArto.ambudanisvano nadaM;shchalanbhramanpraskhalito.a.aturo dravan |
papAta rugNaH saniyantRRikastathA; yathA girirvajranipAtachUrNitaH
shlokas.16:
himAvadAtena suvarNamAlinA; himAdrikUTapratimena dantinA |
hate raNe bhrAtari daNDa Avraja;jjighA.nsurindrAvarajaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.17:
sa tomarairarkakaraprabhaistribhi;rjanArdanaM pa~nchabhireva chArjunam |
samarpayitvA vinanAda chArdayaM;stato.asya bAhU vichakarta pANDavaH
shlokas.18:
kShuraprakRRittau subhRRishaM satomarau; chyutA~Ngadau chandanarUShitau bhujau |
gajAtpatantau yugapadvirejatu;ryathAdrishRRi~NgAtpatitau mahoragau
shlokas.19:
athArdhachandreNa hRRitaM kirITinA; papAta daNDasya shiraH kShitiM dvipAt |
tachChoNitAbhaM nipatadvireje; divAkaro.astAdiva pashchimAM disham
shlokas.20:
atha dvipaM shvetanagAgrasaMnibhaM; divAkarA.nshupratimaiH sharottamaiH |
bibheda pArthaH sa papAta nAnada;nhimAdrikUTaH kulishAhato yathA
shlokas.21:
tato.apare tatpratimA gajottamA; jigIShavaH sa.nyati savyasAchinam |
tathA kRRitAstena yathaiva tau dvipau; tataH prabhagnaM sumahadriporbalam
shlokas.22:
gajA rathAshvAH puruShAshcha sa~NghashaH; parasparaghnAH paripeturAhave |
parasparapraskhalitAH samAhatA; bhRRishaM cha tattatkulabhAShiNo hatAH
shlokas.23:
athArjunaM sve parivArya sainikAH; pura.ndaraM devagaNA ivAbruvan |
abhaiShma yasmAnmaraNAdiva prajAH; sa vIra diShTyA nihatastvayA ripuH
shlokas.24:
na chetparitrAsya imA~njanAnbhayA;ddviShadbhirevaM balibhiH prapIDitAn |
tathAbhaviShyaddviShatAM pramodanaM; yathA hateShveShviha no.ariShu tvayA
shlokas.25:
itIva bhUyashcha suhRRidbhirIritA; nishamya vAchaH sumanAstato.arjunaH |
yathAnurUpaM pratipUjya taM janaM; jagAma sa.nshaptakasa~NghahA punaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pratyAgatya punarjiShNurahansa.nshaptakAnbahUn |
vakrAnuvakragamanAda~NgAraka iva grahaH
shlokas.2:
pArthabANahatA rAjannarAshvarathaku~njarAH |
vichelurbabhramurneduH peturmamlushcha mAriSha
shlokas.3:
dhuryaM dhuryatarAnsUtAnrathA.nshcha parisa~NkShipan |
pANInpANigataM shastraM bAhUnapi shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.4:
bhallaiH kShurairardhachandrairvatsadantaishcha pANDavaH |
chichChedAmitravIrANAM samare pratiyudhyatAm
shlokas.5:
vAshitArthe yuyutsanto vRRiShabhA vRRiShabhaM yathA |
ApatantyarjunaM shUrAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.6:
teShAM tasya cha tadyuddhamabhavallomaharShaNam |
trailokyavijaye yAdRRigdaityAnAM saha vajriNA
shlokas.7:
tamavidhyattribhirbANairdandashUkairivAhibhiH |
ugrAyudhastatastasya shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.8:
te.arjunaM sarvataH kruddhA nAnAshastrairavIvRRiShan |
marudbhiH preShitA meghA himavantamivoShNage
shlokas.9:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya dviShatAM sarvato.arjunaH |
samyagastaiH sharaiH sarvAnsahitAnahanadbahUn
shlokas.10:
ChinnatriveNuja~NgheShAnnihatapArShNisArathIn |
sa~nChinnarashmiyoktrAkShAnvyanukarShayugAnrathAn
vidhvastasarvasaMnAhAnbANaishchakre.arjunastvaran
shlokas.11:
te rathAstatra vidhvastAH parArdhyA bhAntyanekashaH |
dhaninAmiva veshmAni hatAnyagnyanilAmbubhiH
shlokas.12:
dvipAH sambhinnamarmANo vajrAshanisamaiH sharaiH |
peturgiryagraveshmAni vajravAtAgnibhiryathA
shlokas.13:
sArohAsturagAH peturbahavo.arjunatADitAH |
nirjihvAntrAH kShitau kShINA rudhirArdrAH sudurdRRishaH
shlokas.14:
narAshvanAgA nArAchaiH sa.nsyUtAH savyasAchinA |
babhramushchaskhaluH peturnedurmamlushcha mAriSha
shlokas.15:
aNakaishcha shilAdhautairvajrAshaniviShopamaiH |
sharairnijaghnivAnpArtho mahendra iva dAnavAn
shlokas.16:
mahArhavarmAbharaNA nAnArUpAmbarAyudhAH |
sarathAH sadhvajA vIrA hatAH pArthena sherate
shlokas.17:
vijitAH puNyakarmANo vishiShTAbhijanashrutAH |
gatAH sharIrairvasudhAmUrjitaiH karmabhirdivam
shlokas.18:
athArjunarathaM vIrAstvadIyAH samupAdravan |
nAnAjanapadAdhyakShAH sagaNA jAtamanyavaH
shlokas.19:
uhyamAnA rathAshvaiste pattayashcha jighA.nsavaH |
samabhyadhAvannasyanto vividhaM kShipramAyudham
shlokas.20:
tadAyudhamahAvarShaM kShiptaM yodhamahAmbudaiH |
vyadhamannishitairbANaiH kShipramarjunamArutaH
shlokas.21:
sAshvapattidviparathaM mahAshastraughamaplavam |
sahasA santitIrShantaM pArthaM shastrAstrasetunA
shlokas.22:
athAbravIdvAsudevaH pArthaM kiM krIDase.anagha |
sa.nshaptakAnpramathyaitA.nstataH karNavadhe tvara
shlokas.23:
tathetyuktvArjunaH kShipraM shiShTAnsa.nshaptakA.nstadA |
AkShipya shastreNa balAddaityAnindra ivAvadhIt
shlokas.24:
Adadhatsa.ndadhanneShUndRRiShTaH kaishchidraNe.arjunaH |
vimu~nchanvA sharA~nshIghraM dRRishyate sma hi kairapi
shlokas.25:
Ashcharyamiti govindo bruvannashvAnachodayat |
ha.nsA.nsagaurAste senAM ha.nsAH sara ivAvishan
shlokas.26:
tataH sa~NgrAmabhUmiM tAM vartamAne janakShaye |
avekShamANo govindaH savyasAchinamabravIt
shlokas.27:
eSha pArtha mahAraudro vartate bharatakShayaH |
pRRithivyAM pArthivAnAM vai duryodhanakRRite mahAn
shlokas.28:
pashya bhArata chApAni rukmapRRiShThAni dhanvinAm |
mahatAmapaviddhAni kalApAniShudhIstathA
shlokas.29:
jAtarUpamayaiH pu~NkhaiH sharA.nshcha nataparvaNaH |
tailadhautA.nshcha nArAchAnnirmuktAniva pannagAn
shlokas.30:
hastidantatsarUnkhaDgA~njAtarUpapariShkRRitAn |
AkIrNA.nstomarA.nshchApA.nshchitrAnhemavibhUShitAn
shlokas.31:
varmANi chApaviddhAni rukmapRRiShThAni bhArata |
suvarNavikRRitAnprAsA~nshaktIH kanakabhUShitAH
shlokas.32:
jAmbUnadamayaiH paTTairbaddhAshcha vipulA gadAH |
jAtarUpamayIshcharShTIH paTTishAnhemabhUShitAn
shlokas.33:
daNDaiH kanakachitraishcha vipraviddhAnparashvadhAn |
ayaskushAntAnpatitAnmusalAni gurUNi cha
shlokas.34:
shataghnIH pashya chitrAshcha vipulAnparighA.nstathA |
chakrANi chApaviddhAni mudgarA.nshcha bahUnraNe
shlokas.35:
nAnAvidhAni shastrANi pragRRihya jayagRRiddhinaH |
jIvanta iva lakShyante gatasattvAstarasvinaH
shlokas.36:
gadAvimathitairgAtrairmusalairbhinnamastakAn |
gajavAjirathakShuNNAnpashya yodhAnsahasrashaH
shlokas.37:
manuShyagajavAjInAM sharashaktyRRiShTitomaraiH |
nistri.nshaiH paTTishaiH prAsairnakharairlaguDairapi
shlokas.38:
sharIrairbahudhA bhinnaiH shoNitaughapariplutaiH |
gatAsubhiramitraghna sa.nvRRitA raNabhUmayaH
shlokas.39:
bAhubhishchandanAdigdhaiH sA~NgadaiH shubhabhUShaNaiH |
satalatraiH sakeyUrairbhAti bhArata medinI
shlokas.40:
sA~NgulitrairbhujAgraishcha vipraviddhairala~NkRRitaiH |
hastihastopamaishChinnairUrubhishcha tarasvinAm
shlokas.41:
baddhachUDAmaNivaraiH shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH |
nikRRittairvRRiShabhAkShANAM virAjati vasundharA
shlokas.42:
kabandhaiH shoNitAdigdhaishChinnagAtrashirodharaiH |
bhUrbhAti bharatashreShTha shAntArchirbhirivAgnibhiH
shlokas.43:
rathAnbahuvidhAnbhagnAnhemaki~NkiNinaH shubhAn |
ashvA.nshcha bahudhA pashya shoNitena pariplutAn
shlokas.44:
yodhAnAM cha mahAsha~NkhAnpANDurA.nshcha prakIrNakAn |
nirastajihvAnmAta~NgA~nshayAnAnparvatopamAn
shlokas.45:
vaijayantIvichitrA.nshcha hatA.nshcha gajayodhinaH |
vAraNAnAM paristomAnsuyuktAmbarakambalAn
shlokas.46:
vipATitA vichitrAshcha rUpachitrAH kuthAstathA |
bhinnAshcha bahudhA ghaNTAH patadbhishchUrNitA gajaiH
shlokas.47:
vaiDUryamaNidaNDA.nshcha patitAna~NkushAnbhuvi |
baddhAH sAdidhvajAgreShu suvarNavikRRitAH kashAH
shlokas.48:
vichitrAnmaNichitrA.nshcha jAtarUpapariShkRRitAn |
ashvAstaraparistomAnrA~NkavAnpatitAnbhuvi
shlokas.49:
chUDAmaNInnarendrANAM vichitrAH kA~nchanasrajaH |
ChatrANi chApaviddhAni chAmaravyajanAni cha
shlokas.50:
chandranakShatrabhAsaishcha vadanaishchArukuNDalaiH |
kL^iptashmashrubhiratyarthaM vIrANAM samala~NkRRitaiH
vadanaiH pashya sa~nChannAM mahIM shoNitakardamAm
shlokas.51:
sajIvA.nshcha narAnpashya kUjamAnAnsamantataH |
upAsyamAnAnbahubhirnyastashastrairvishAM pate
shlokas.52:
j~nAtibhiH sahitaistatra rodamAnairmuhurmuhuH |
vyutkrAntAnaparAnyodhA.nshChAdayitvA tarasvinaH
punaryuddhAya gachChanti jayagRRiddhAH pramanyavaH
shlokas.53:
apare tatra tatraiva paridhAvanti mAninaH |
j~nAtibhiH patitaiH shUrairyAchyamAnAstathodakam
shlokas.54:
jalArthaM cha gatAH kechinniShprANA bahavo.arjuna |
saMnivRRittAshcha te shUrAstAndRRiShTvaiva vichetasaH
shlokas.55:
jalaM dRRiShTvA pradhAvanti kroshamAnAH parasparam |
jalaM pItvA mRRitAnpashya pibato.anyA.nshcha bhArata
shlokas.56:
parityajya priyAnanye bAndhavAnbAndhavapriya |
vyutkrAntAH samadRRishyanta tatra tatra mahAraNe
shlokas.57:
pashyAparAnnarashreShTha sa.ndaShTauShThapuTAnpunaH |
bhrukuTIkuTilairvaktraiH prekShamANAnsamantataH
shlokas.58:
etattavaivAnurUpaM karmArjuna mahAhave |
