divi vA devarAjasya tvayA yatkRRitamAhave
shlokas.59:
evaM tAM darshayankRRiShNo yuddhabhUmiM kirITine |
gachChannevAshRRiNochChabdaM duryodhanabale mahat
shlokas.60:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShAnbherIpaNavamishritAn |
rathAshvagajanAdA.nshcha shastrashabdA.nshcha dAruNAn
shlokas.61:
pravishya tadbalaM kRRiShNasturagairvAtavegibhiH |
pANDyenAbhyarditAM senAM tvadIyAM vIkShya dhiShThitaH
shlokas.62:
sa hi nAnAvidhairbANairiShvAsapravaro yudhi |
nyahanaddviShatAM vrAtAngatAsUnantako yathA
shlokas.63:
gajavAjimanuShyANAM sharIrANi shitaiH sharaiH |
bhittvA praharatAM shreShTho videhAsU.nshchakAra saH
shlokas.64:
shatrupravIrairastAni nAnAshastrANi sAyakaiH |
bhittvA tAnahanatpANDyaH shatrU~nshakra ivAsurAn

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
proktastvayA pUrvameva pravIro lokavishrutaH |
na tvasya karma sa~NgrAme tvayA sa~njaya kIrtitam
shlokas.2:
tasya vistarato brUhi pravIrasyAdya vikramam |
shikShAM prabhAvaM vIryaM cha pramANaM darpameva cha
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
droNabhIShmakRRipadrauNikarNArjunajanArdanAn |
samAptavidyAndhanuShi shreShThAnyAnmanyase yudhi
shlokas.4:
tulyatA karNabhIShmAbhyAmAtmano yena dRRishyate |
vAsudevArjunAbhyAM cha nyUnatAM nAtmanIchChati
shlokas.5:
sa pANDyo nRRipatishreShThaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
karNasyAnIkamavadhItparibhUta ivAntakaH
shlokas.6:
tadudIrNarathAshvaM cha pattipravaraku~njaram |
kulAlachakravadbhrAntaM pANDyenAdhiShThitaM balam
shlokas.7:
vyashvasUtadhvajarathAnvipraviddhAyudhAnripUn |
samyagastaiH sharaiH pANDyo vAyurmeghAnivAkShipat
shlokas.8:
dviradAnprahataprothAnvipatAkadhvajAyudhAn |
sapAdarakShAnavadhIdvajreNArInivArihA
shlokas.9:
sashaktiprAsatUNIrAnashvArohAnhayAnapi |
pulindakhashabAhlIkAnniShAdAndhrakata~NgaNAn
shlokas.10:
dAkShiNAtyA.nshcha bhojA.nshcha krUrAnsa~NgrAmakarkashAn |
vishastrakavachAnbANaiH kRRitvA pANDyo.akarodvyasUn
shlokas.11:
chatura~NgaM balaM bANairnighnantaM pANDyamAhave |
dRRiShTvA drauNirasambhrAntamasambhrAntataro.abhyayAt
shlokas.12:
AbhAShya chainaM madhuramabhi nRRityannabhItavat |
prAha praharatAM shreShThaH smitapUrvaM samAhvayan
shlokas.13:
rAjankamalapatrAkSha pradhAnAyudhavAhana |
vajrasaMhananaprakhya pradhAnabalapauruSha
shlokas.14:
muShTishliShTAyudhAbhyAM cha vyAyatAbhyAM mahaddhanuH |
dorbhyAM visphArayanbhAsi mahAjaladavadbhRRisham
shlokas.15:
sharavarShairmahAvegairamitrAnabhivarShataH |
madanyaM nAnupashyAmi prativIraM tavAhave
shlokas.16:
rathadviradapattyashvAnekaH pramathase bahUn |
mRRigasa~NghAnivAraNye vibhIrbhImabalo hariH
shlokas.17:
mahatA rathaghoSheNa divaM bhUmiM cha nAdayan |
varShAnte sasyahA pItho bhAbhirApUrayanniva
shlokas.18:
sa.nspRRishAnaH sharA.nstIkShNA.nstUNAdAshIviShopamAn |
mayaivaikena yudhyasva tryambakeNAndhako yathA
shlokas.19:
evamuktastathetyuktvA prahareti cha tADitaH |
karNinA droNatanayaM vivyAdha malayadhvajaH
shlokas.20:
marmabhedibhiratyugrairbANairagnishikhopamaiH |
smayannabhyahanaddrauNiH pANDyamAchAryasattamaH
shlokas.21:
tato navAparA.nstIkShNAnnArAchAnka~NkavAsasaH |
gatyA dashamyA sa.nyuktAnashvatthAmA vyavAsRRijat
shlokas.22:
teShAM pa~nchAchChinatpANDyaH pa~nchabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
chatvAro.abhyAhananvAhAnAshu te vyasavo.abhavan
shlokas.23:
atha droNasutasyeShU.nstA.nshChittvA nishitaiH sharaiH |
dhanurjyAM vitatAM pANDyashchichChedAdityavarchasaH
shlokas.24:
vijyaM dhanurathAdhijyaM kRRitvA drauNiramitrahA |
tataH sharasahasrANi preShayAmAsa pANDyataH
iShusambAdhamAkAshamakaroddisha eva cha
shlokas.25:
tatastAnasyataH sarvAndrauNerbANAnmahAtmanaH |
jAnAno.apyakShayAnpANDyo.ashAtayatpuruSharShabhaH
shlokas.26:
prahitA.nstAnprayatnena ChittvA drauNeriShUnariH |
chakrarakShau tatastasya prANudannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.27:
athArerlAghavaM dRRiShTvA maNDalIkRRitakArmukaH |
prAsyaddroNasuto bANAnvRRiShTiM pUShAnujo yathA
shlokas.28:
aShTAvaShTagavAnyUhuH shakaTAni yadAyudham |
ahnastadaShTabhAgena drauNishchikShepa mAriSha
shlokas.29:
tamantakamiva kruddhamantakAlAntakopamam |
ye ye dadRRishire tatra visa~nj~nAH prAyasho.abhavan
shlokas.30:
parjanya iva gharmAnte vRRiShTyA sAdridrumAM mahIm |
AchAryaputrastAM senAM bANavRRiShTyAbhyavIvRRiShat
shlokas.31:
drauNiparjanyamuktAM tAM bANavRRiShTiM suduHsahAm |
vAyavyAstreNa sa kShipraM ruddhvA pANDyAnilo.anadat
shlokas.32:
tasya nAnadataH ketuM chandanAgurubhUShitam |
malayapratimaM drauNishChittvAshvA.nshchaturo.ahanat
shlokas.33:
sUtamekeShuNA hatvA mahAjaladanisvanam |
dhanushChittvArdhachandreNa vyadhamattilasho ratham
shlokas.34:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya ChittvA sarvAyudhAni cha |
prAptamapyahitaM drauNirna jaghAna raNepsayA
shlokas.35:
hateshvaro dantivaraH sukalpita;stvarAbhisRRiShTaH pratisharmago balI |
tamadhyatiShThanmalayeshvaro mahA;nyathAdrishRRi~NgaM harirunnada.nstathA
shlokas.36:
sa tomaraM bhAskararashmisaMnibhaM; balAstrasargottamayatnamanyubhiH |
sasarja shIghraM pratipIDayangajaM; guroH sutAyAdripatIshvaro nadan
shlokas.37:
maNipratAnottamavajrahATakai;rala~NkRRitaM chA.nshukamAlyamauktikaiH |
hato.asyasAvityasakRRinmudA nada;nparAbhinaddrauNivarA~NgabhUShaNam
shlokas.38:
tadarkachandragrahapAvakatviShaM; bhRRishAbhighAtAtpatitaM vichUrNitam |
mahendravajrAbhihataM mahAvanaM; yathAdrishRRi~NgaM dharaNItale tathA
shlokas.39:
tataH prajajvAla pareNa manyunA; padAhato nAgapatiryathA tathA |
samAdadhe chAntakadaNDasaMnibhA;niShUnamitrAntakarA.nshchaturdasha
shlokas.40:
dvipasya pAdAgrakarAnsa pa~nchabhi;rnRRipasya bAhU cha shiro.atha cha tribhiH |
jaghAna ShaDbhiH ShaDRRitUttamatviShaH; sa pANDyarAjAnucharAnmahArathAn
shlokas.41:
sudIrghavRRittau varachandanokShitau; suvarNamuktAmaNivajrabhUShitau |
bhujau dharAyAM patitau nRRipasya tau; viveShTatustArkShyahatAvivoragau
shlokas.42:
shirashcha tatpUrNashashiprabhAnanaM; saroShatAmrAyatanetramunnasam |
kShitau vibabhrAja patatsakuNDalaM; vishAkhayormadhyagataH shashI yathA
shlokas.43:
samAptavidyaM tu guroH sutaM nRRipaH; samAptakarmANamupetya te sutaH |
suhRRidvRRito.atyarthamapUjayanmudA; jite balau viShNumivAmareshvaraH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
pANDye hate kimakarodarjuno yudhi sa~njaya |
ekavIreNa karNena drAviteShu pareShu cha
shlokas.2:
samAptavidyo balavAnyukto vIrashcha pANDavaH |
sarvabhUteShvanuj~nAtaH sha~NkareNa mahAtmanA
shlokas.3:
tasmAnmahadbhayaM tIvramamitraghnAddhana~njayAt |
sa yattatrAkarotpArthastanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hate pANDye.arjunaM kRRiShNastvarannAha vacho hitam |
pashyAtimAnyaM rAjAnamapayAtA.nshcha pANDavAn
shlokas.5:
ashvatthAmnashcha sa~NkalpAddhatAH karNena sRRi~njayAH |
tathAshvanaranAgAnAM kRRitaM cha kadanaM mahat
ityAchaShTa sudurdharSho vAsudevaH kirITine
shlokas.6:
etachChrutvA cha dRRiShTvA cha bhrAturghoraM mahadbhayam |
vAhayAshvAnhRRiShIkesha kShipramityAha pANDavaH
shlokas.7:
tataH prAyAddhRRiShIkesho rathenApratiyodhinA |
dAruNashcha punastatra prAdurAsItsamAgamaH
shlokas.8:
tataH pravavRRite bhUyaH sa~NgrAmo rAjasattama |
karNasya pANDavAnAM cha yamarAShTravivardhanaH
shlokas.9:
dhanUMShi bANAnparighAnasitomarapaTTishAn |
musalAni bhushuNDIshcha shaktiRRiShTiparashvadhAn
shlokas.10:
gadAH prAsAnasInkuntAnbhiNDipAlAnmahA~NkushAn |
pragRRihya kShipramApetuH parasparajigIShayA
shlokas.11:
bANajyAtalashabdena dyAM dishaH pradisho viyat |
pRRithivIM nemighoSheNa nAdayanto.abhyayuH parAn
shlokas.12:
tena shabdena mahatA saMhRRiShTAshchakrurAhavam |
vIrA vIrairmahAghoraM kalahAntaM titIrShavaH
shlokas.13:
jyAtalatradhanuHshabdAH ku~njarANAM cha bRRiMhitam |
tADitAnAM cha patatAM ninAdaH sumahAnabhUt
shlokas.14:
bANashabdA.nshcha vividhA~nshUrANAmabhigarjatAm |
shrutvA shabdaM bhRRishaM tresurjaghnurmamlushcha bhArata
shlokas.15:
teShAM nAnadyatAM chaiva shastravRRiShTiM cha mu~nchatAm |
bahUnAdhirathiH karNaH pramamAtha raNeShubhiH
shlokas.16:
pa~ncha pA~nchAlavIrANAM rathAndasha cha pa~ncha cha |
sAshvasUtadhvajAnkarNaH sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.17:
yodhamukhyA mahAvIryAH pANDUnAM karNamAhave |
shIghrAstrA divamAvRRitya parivavruH samantataH
shlokas.18:
tataH karNo dviShatsenAM sharavarShairviloDayan |
vijagAhe.aNDajApUrNAM padminImiva yUthapaH
shlokas.19:
dviShanmadhyamavaskandya rAdheyo dhanuruttamam |
vidhunvAnaH shitairbANaiH shirA.nsyunmathya pAtayat
shlokas.20:
charmavarmANi sa~nChindya nirvApamiva dehinAm |
viShehurnAsya samparkaM dvitIyasya patatriNaH
shlokas.21:
varmadehAsumathanairdhanuShaH prachyutaiH sharaiH |
maurvyA talatrairnyavadhItkashayA vAjino yathA
shlokas.22:
pANDusRRi~njayapA~nchAlA~nsharagocharamAnayat |
mamarda karNastarasA siMho mRRigagaNAniva
shlokas.23:
tataH pA~nchAlaputrAshcha draupadeyAshcha mAriSha |
yamau cha yuyudhAnashcha sahitAH karNamabhyayuH
shlokas.24:
vyAyachChamAnAH subhRRishaM kurupANDavasRRi~njayAH |
priyAnasUnraNe tyaktvA yodhA jagmuH parasparam
shlokas.25:
susaMnaddhAH kavachinaH sashirastrANabhUShaNAH |
gadAbhirmusalaishchAnye parighaishcha mahArathAH
shlokas.26:
samabhyadhAvanta bhRRishaM devA daNDairivodyataiH |
nadantashchAhvayantashcha pravalgantashcha mAriSha
shlokas.27:
tato nijaghnuranyonyaM petushchAhavatADitAH |
vamanto rudhiraM gAtrairvimastiShkekShaNA yudhi
shlokas.28:
dantapUrNaiH sarudhirairvaktrairdADimasaMnibhaiH |
jIvanta iva chApyete tasthuH shastropabRRiMhitAH
shlokas.29:
parasparaM chApyapare paTTishairasibhistathA |
shaktibhirbhiNDipAlaishcha nakharaprAsatomaraiH
shlokas.30:
tatakShushchichChidushchAnye bibhidushchikShipustathA |
sa~nchakartushcha jaghnushcha kruddhA nirbibhidushcha ha
shlokas.31:
peturanyonyanihatA vyasavo rudhirokShitAH |
kSharantaH svarasaM raktaM prakRRitAshchandanA iva
shlokas.32:
rathai rathA vinihatA hastinashchApi hastibhiH |
narA naravaraiH peturashvAshchAshvaiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.33:
dhvajAH shirA.nsi chChatrANi dvipahastA nRRiNAM bhujAH |
kShurairbhallArdhachandraishcha ChinnAH shastrANi tatyajuH
shlokas.34:
narA.nshcha nAgA.nshcha rathAnhayAnmamRRidurAhave |
ashvArohairhatAH shUrAshChinnahastAshcha dantinaH
shlokas.35:
sapatAkA dhvajAH peturvishIrNA iva parvatAH |
pattibhishcha samAplutya dviradAH syandanAstathA
shlokas.36:
prahatA hanyamAnAshcha patitAshchaiva sarvashaH |
ashvArohAH samAsAdya tvaritAH pattibhirhatAH
sAdibhiH pattisa~NghAshcha nihatA yudhi sherate
shlokas.37:
mRRiditAnIva padmAni pramlAnA iva cha srajaH |
hatAnAM vadanAnyAsangAtrANi cha mahAmate
shlokas.38:
rUpANyatyarthakAmyAni dviradAshvanRRiNAM nRRipa |
samunnAnIva vastrANi prApurdurdarshatAM param

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hastibhistu mahAmAtrAstava putreNa choditAH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM jighA.nsantaH kruddhAH pArShatamabhyayuH
shlokas.2:
prAchyAshcha dAkShiNAtyAshcha pravIrA gajayodhinaH |
a~NgA va~NgAshcha puNDrAshcha mAgadhAstAmraliptakAH
shlokas.3:
mekalAH koshalA madrA dashArNA niShadhAstathA |
gajayuddheShu kushalAH kali~NgaiH saha bhArata
shlokas.4:
sharatomaranArAchairvRRiShTimanta ivAmbudAH |
siShichuste tataH sarve pA~nchAlAchalamAhave
shlokas.5:
tAnsaMmimardiShurnAgAnpArShNya~NguShThA~NkushairbhRRisham |
pothitAnpArShato bANairnArAchaishchAbhyavIvRRiShat
shlokas.6:
ekaikaM dashabhiH ShaDbhiraShTAbhirapi bhArata |
dviradAnabhivivyAdha kShiptairgirinibhA~nsharaiH
prachChAdyamAno dviradairmeghairiva divAkaraH
shlokas.7:
paryAsuH pANDupA~nchAlA nadanto nishitAyudhAH |
tAnnAgAnabhivarShanto jyAtantrIsharanAditaiH
shlokas.8:
nakulaH sahadevashcha draupadeyAH prabhadrakAH |
sAtyakishcha shikhaNDI cha chekitAnashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.9:
te mlechChaiH preShitA nAgA narAnashvAnrathAnapi |
hastairAkShipya mamRRiduH padbhishchApyatimanyavaH
shlokas.10:
bibhidushcha viShANAgraiH samAkShipya cha chikShipuH |
viShANalagnaishchApyanye paripeturvibhIShaNAH
shlokas.11:
pramukhe vartamAnaM tu dvipaM va~Ngasya sAtyakiH |
nArAchenogravegena bhittvA marmaNyapAtayat
shlokas.12:
tasyAvarjitanAgasya dviradAdutpatiShyataH |
nArAchenAbhinadvakShaH so.apatadbhuvi sAtyakeH
shlokas.13:
puNDrasyApatato nAgaM chalantamiva parvatam |
sahadevaH prayatnAttairnArAchairvyahanattribhiH
shlokas.14:
vipatAkaM viyantAraM vivarmadhvajajIvitam |
taM kRRitvA dviradaM bhUyaH sahadevo.a~NgamabhyagAt
shlokas.15:
sahadevaM tu nakulo vArayitvA~NgamArdayat |
nArAchairyamadaNDAbhaistribhirnAgaM shatena cha
shlokas.16:
divAkarakaraprakhyAna~NgashchikShepa tomarAn |
nakulAya shatAnyaShTau tridhaikaikaM tu so.achChinat
shlokas.17:
tathArdhachandreNa shirastasya chichCheda pANDavaH |
sa papAta hato mlechChastenaiva saha dantinA
shlokas.18:
AchAryaputre nihate hastishikShAvishArade |
a~NgAH kruddhA mahAmAtrA nAgairnakulamabhyayuH
shlokas.19:
chalatpatAkaiH pramukhairhemakakShyAtanuchChadaiH |
mimardishantastvaritAH pradIptairiva parvataiH
shlokas.20:
mekalotkalakAli~NgA niShAdAstAmraliptakAH |
sharatomaravarShANi vimu~nchanto jighA.nsavaH
shlokas.21:
taishChAdyamAnaM nakulaM divAkaramivAmbudaiH |
pari petuH susa.nrabdhAH pANDupA~nchAlasomakAH
shlokas.22:
tatastadabhavadyuddhaM rathinAM hastibhiH saha |
sRRijatAM sharavarShANi tomarA.nshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.23:
nAgAnAM prasphuTuH kumbhA marmANi vividhAni cha |
dantAshchaivAtividdhAnAM nArAchairbhUShaNAni cha
shlokas.24:
teShAmaShTau mahAnAgA.nshchatuHShaShTyA sutejanaiH |
sahadevo jaghAnAshu te petuH saha sAdibhiH
shlokas.25:
a~njogatibhirAyamya prayatnAddhanuruttamam |
nArAchairahanannAgAnnakulaH kuranandana
shlokas.26:
tataH shaineyapA~nchAlyau draupadeyAH prabhadrakAH |
shikhaNDI cha mahAnAgAnsiShichuH sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.27:
te pANDuyodhAmbudharaiH shatrudviradaparvatAH |
bANavarShairhatAH peturvajravarShairivAchalAH
shlokas.28:
evaM hatvA tava gajA.nste pANDunaraku~njarAH |
drutaM senAmavaikShanta bhinnakUlAmivApagAm
shlokas.29:
te tAM senAmavAlokya pANDuputrasya sainikAH |
vikShobhayitvA cha punaH karNamevAbhidudruvuH
shlokas.30:
sahadevaM tataH kruddhaM dahantaM tava vAhinIm |
duHshAsano mahArAja bhrAtA bhrAtaramabhyayAt
shlokas.31:
tau sametau mahAyuddhe dRRiShTvA tatra narAdhipAH |
siMhanAdaravA.nshchakrurvAsA.nsyAdudhuvushcha ha
shlokas.32:
tato bhArata kruddhena tava putreNa dhanvinA |
pANDuputrastribhirbANairvakShasyabhihato balI
shlokas.33:
sahadevastato rAjannArAchena tavAtmajam |
viddhvA vivyAdha saptatyA sArathiM cha tribhistribhiH
shlokas.34:
duHshAsanastadA rAja.nshChittvA chApaM mahAhave |
sahadevaM trisaptatyA bAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.35:
sahadevastataH kruddhaH khaDgaM gRRihya mahAhave |
vyAvidhyata yudhAM shreShThaH shrImA.nstava sutaM prati
shlokas.36:
samArgaNagaNaM chApaM ChittvA tasya mahAnasiH |
nipapAta tato bhUmau chyutaH sarpa ivAmbarAt
shlokas.37:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sahadevaH pratApavAn |
duHshAsanAya chikShepa bANamantakaraM tataH
shlokas.38:
tamApatantaM vishikhaM yamadaNDopamatviSham |
khaDgena shitadhAreNa dvidhA chichCheda kauravaH
shlokas.39:
tamApatantaM sahasA nistri.nshaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
pAtayAmAsa samare sahadevo hasanniva
shlokas.40:
tato bANA.nshchatuHShaShTiM tava putro mahAraNe |
sahadevarathe tUrNaM pAtayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.41:
tA~nsharAnsamare rAjanvegenApatato bahUn |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirbANaiH sahadevo nyakRRintata
shlokas.42:
sa nivArya mahAbANA.nstava putreNa preShitAn |
athAsmai subahUnbANAnmAdrIputraH samAchinot
shlokas.43:
tataH kruddho mahArAja sahadevaH pratApavAn |
samAdhatta sharaM ghoraM mRRityukAlAntakopamam
vikRRiShya balavachchApaM tava putrAya so.asRRijat
shlokas.44:
sa taM nirbhidya vegena bhittvA cha kavachaM mahat |
prAvishaddharaNIM rAjanvalmIkamiva pannagaH
tataH sa mumuhe rAja.nstava putro mahArathaH
shlokas.45:
mUDhaM chainaM samAlakShya sArathistvarito ratham |
apovAha bhRRishaM trasto vadhyamAnaM shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.46:
parAjitya raNe taM tu pANDavaH pANDupUrvaja |
duryodhanabalaM hRRiShTaH prAmathadvai samantataH
shlokas.47:
pipIlikApuTaM rAjanyathAmRRidnAnnaro ruShA |
tathA sA kauravI senA mRRiditA tena bhArata
shlokas.48:
nakulaM rabhasaM yuddhe dArayantaM varUthinIm |
karNo vaikartano rAjanvArayAmAsa vai tadA
shlokas.49:
nakulashcha tadA karNaM prahasannidamabravIt |
chirasya bata dRRiShTo.ahaM daivataiH saumyachakShuShA
shlokas.50:
yasya me tvaM raNe pApa chakShurviShayamAgataH |
tvaM hi mUlamanarthAnAM vairasya kalahasya cha
shlokas.51:
tvaddoShAtkuravaH kShINAH samAsAdya parasparam |
tvAmadya samare hatvA kRRitakRRityo.asmi vijvaraH
shlokas.52:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha nakulaM sUtanandanaH |
sadRRishaM rAjaputrasya dhanvinashcha visheShataH
shlokas.53:
praharasva raNe bAla pashyAmastava pauruSham |
karma kRRitvA raNe shUra tataH katthitumarhasi
shlokas.54:
anuktvA samare tAta shUrA yudhyanti shaktitaH |
sa yudhyasva mayA shaktyA vineShye darpamadya te
shlokas.55:
ityuktvA prAharattUrNaM pANDuputrAya sUtajaH |
vivyAdha chainaM samare trisaptatyA shilImukhaiH
shlokas.56:
nakulastu tato viddhaH sUtaputreNa bhArata |
ashItyAshIviShaprakhyaiH sUtaputramavidhyata
shlokas.57:
tasya karNo dhanushChittvA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
tri.nshatA parameShvAsaH sharaiH pANDavamArdayat
shlokas.58:
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA papuH shoNitamAhave |
AshIviShA yathA nAgA bhittvA gAM salilaM papuH
shlokas.59:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya hemapRRiShThaM durAsadam |
karNaM vivyAdha vi.nshatyA sArathiM cha tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.60:
tataH kruddho mahArAja nakulaH paravIrahA |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena karNasya dhanurachChinat
shlokas.61:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM sAyakAnAM shataistribhiH |
Ajaghne prahasanvIraH sarvalokamahAratham
shlokas.62:
karNamabhyarditaM dRRiShTvA pANDuputreNa mAriSha |
vismayaM paramaM jagmU rathinaH saha daivataiH
shlokas.63:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya karNo vaikartanastadA |
nakulaM pa~nchabhirbANairjatrudeshe samArdayat
shlokas.64:
uraHsthairatha tairbANairmAdrIputro vyarochata |
svarashmibhirivAdityo bhuvane visRRijanprabhAm
shlokas.65:
nakulastu tataH karNaM viddhvA saptabhirAyasaiH |
athAsya dhanuShaH koTiM punashchichCheda mAriSha
shlokas.66:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya samare vegavattaram |
nakulasya tato bANaiH sarvato.avArayaddishaH
shlokas.67:
sa~nChAdyamAnaH sahasA karNachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
chichCheda sa sharA.nstUrNaM sharaireva mahArathaH
shlokas.68:
tato bANamayaM jAlaM vitataM vyomnyadRRishyata |
khadyotAnAM gaNaireva sampatadbhiryathA nabhaH
shlokas.69:
tairvimuktaiH sharashataishChAditaM gaganaM tadA |
shalabhAnAM yathA vrAtaistadvadAsItsamAkulam
shlokas.70:
te sharA hemavikRRitAH sampatanto muhurmuhuH |
shreNIkRRitA abhAsanta ha.nsAH shreNIgatA iva
shlokas.71:
bANajAlAvRRite vyomni ChAdite cha divAkare |
samasarpattato bhUtaM ki~nchideva vishAM pate
shlokas.72:
niruddhe tatra mArge tu sharasa~NghaiH samantataH |
vyarochatAM mahAbhAgau bAlasUryAvivoditau
shlokas.73:
karNachApachyutairbANairvadhyamAnAstu somakAH |
avAlIyanta rAjendra vedanArtAH sharArditAH
shlokas.74:
nakulasya tathA bANairvadhyamAnA chamUstava |
vyashIryata disho rAjanvAtanunnA ivAmbudAH
shlokas.75:
te sene vadhyamAne tu tAbhyAM divyairmahAsharaiH |
sharapAtamapakramya tataH prekShakavatsthite
shlokas.76:
protsArite jane tasminkarNapANDavayoH sharaiH |
vivyAdhAte mahAtmAnAvanyonyaM sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.77:
nidarshayantau tvastrANi divyAni raNamUrdhani |
ChAdayantau cha sahasA parasparavadhaiShiNau
shlokas.78:
nakulena sharA muktAH ka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH |
te tu karNamavachChAdya vyatiShThanta yathA pare
shlokas.79:
sharaveshmapraviShTau tau dadRRishAte na kaishchana |
chandrasUryau yathA rAja.nshChAdyamAnau jalAgame
shlokas.80:
tataH kruddho raNe karNaH kRRitvA ghorataraM vapuH |
pANDavaM ChAdayAmAsa samantAchCharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.81:
sa chChAdyamAnaH samare sUtaputreNa pANDavaH |
na chakAra vyathAM rAjanbhAskaro jaladairyathA
shlokas.82:
tataH prahasyAdhirathiH sharajAlAni mAriSha |
preShayAmAsa samare shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.83:
ekachChAyamabhUtsarvaM tasya bANairmahAtmanaH |
abhrachChAyeva sa~njaj~ne sampatadbhiH sharottamaiH
shlokas.84:
tataH karNo mahArAja dhanushChittvA mahAtmanaH |
sArathiM pAtayAmAsa rathanIDAddhasanniva
shlokas.85:
tathAshvA.nshchaturashchAsya chaturbhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
yamasya sadanaM tUrNaM preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.86:
athAsya taM rathaM tUrNaM tilasho vyadhamachCharaiH |
patAkAM chakrarakShau cha dhvajaM khaDgaM cha mAriSha
shatachandraM tatashcharma sarvopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.87:
hatAshvo virathashchaiva vivarmA cha vishAM pate |
avatIrya rathAttUrNaM parighaM gRRihya viShThitaH
shlokas.88:
tamudyataM mahAghoraM parighaM tasya sUtajaH |
vyahanatsAyakai rAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.89:
vyAyudhaM chainamAlakShya sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
ArdayadbahushaH karNo na chainaM samapIDayat
shlokas.90:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare kRRitAstreNa balIyasA |
prAdravatsahasA rAjannakulo vyAkulendriyaH
shlokas.91:
tamabhidrutya rAdheyaH prahasanvai punaH punaH |
sajyamasya dhanuH kaNThe so.avAsRRijata bhArata
shlokas.92:
tataH sa shushubhe rAjankaNThAsaktamahAdhanuH |
pariveShamanuprApto yathA syAdvyomni chandramAH
yathaiva cha sito meghaH shakrachApena shobhitaH
shlokas.93:
tamabravIttadA karNo vyarthaM vyAhRRitavAnasi |
vadedAnIM punarhRRiShTo vadhyaM mAM tvaM punaH punaH
shlokas.94:
mA yotsIrgurubhiH sArdhaM balavadbhishcha pANDava |
sadRRishaistAta yudhyasva vrIDAM mA kuru pANDava
gRRihaM vA gachCha mAdreya yatra vA kRRiShNaphalgunau
shlokas.95:
evamuktvA mahArAja vyasarjayata taM tataH |
vadhaprAptaM tu taM rAjannAvadhItsUtanandanaH
smRRitvA kuntyA vacho rAja.nstata enaM vyasarjayat
shlokas.96:
visRRiShTaH pANDavo rAjansUtaputreNa dhanvinA |
vrIDanniva jagAmAtha yudhiShThirarathaM prati
shlokas.97:
Aruroha rathaM chApi sUtaputrapratApitaH |
niHshvasanduHkhasantaptaH kumbhe kShipta ivoragaH
shlokas.98:
taM visRRijya raNe karNaH pA~nchAlA.nstvarito yayau |
rathenAtipatAkena chandravarNahayena cha
shlokas.99:
tatrAkrando mahAnAsItpANDavAnAM vishAM pate |
dRRiShTvA senApatiM yAntaM pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAn
shlokas.100:
tatrAkaronmahArAja kadanaM sUtanandanaH |
madhyaM gate dinakare chakravatpracharanprabhuH
shlokas.101:
bhagnachakrai rathaiH kechichChinnadhvajapatAkibhiH |
sasUtairhatasUtaishcha bhagnAkShaishchaiva mAriSha
hriyamANAnapashyAma pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAn
shlokas.102:
tatra tatra cha sambhrAntA vicherurmattaku~njarAH |
davAgninA parItA~NgA yathaiva syurmahAvane
shlokas.103:
bhinnakumbhA virudhirAshChinnahastAshcha vAraNAH |
bhinnagAtravarAshchaiva chChinnavAlAshcha mAriSha
ChinnAbhrANIva sampeturvadhyamAnA mahAtmanA
shlokas.104:
apare trAsitA nAgA nArAchashatatomaraiH |
tamevAbhimukhA yAnti shalabhA iva pAvakam
shlokas.105:
apare niShTanantaH sma vyadRRishyanta mahAdvipAH |
kSharantaH shoNitaM gAtrairnagA iva jalaplavam
shlokas.106:
urashChadairvimuktAshcha vAlabandhaishcha vAjinaH |
rAjataishcha tathA kA.nsyaiH sauvarNaishchaiva bhUShaNaiH
shlokas.107:
hInA AstaraNaishchaiva khalInaishcha vivarjitAH |
chAmaraishcha kuthAbhishcha tUNIraiH patitairapi
shlokas.108:
nihataiH sAdibhishchaiva shUrairAhavashobhibhiH |
apashyAma raNe tatra bhrAmyamANAnhayottamAn
shlokas.109:
prAsaiH khaDgaishcha sa.nsyUtAnRRiShTibhishcha narAdhipa |
hayayodhAnapashyAma ka~nchukoShNIShadhAriNaH
shlokas.115:
shirA.nsi bAhUnUrU.nshcha ChinnAnanyA.nstathA yudhi |
karNachApachyutairbANairapashyAma vinAkRRitAn
shlokas.116:
mahAnvyatikaro raudro yodhAnAmanvadRRishyata |
karNasAyakanunnAnAM hatAnAM nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.117:
te vadhyamAnAH samare sUtaputreNa sRRi~njayAH |
tamevAbhimukhA yAnti pata~NgA iva pAvakam
shlokas.118:
taM dahantamanIkAni tatra tatra mahAratham |
kShatriyA varjayAmAsuryugAntAgnimivolbaNam
shlokas.119:
hatasheShAstu ye vIrAH pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathAH |
tAnprabhagnAndrutAnkarNaH pRRiShThato vikira~nsharaiH
abhyadhAvata tejasvI vishIrNakavachadhvajAn
shlokas.120:
tApayAmAsa tAnbANaiH sUtaputro mahArathaH |
madhya.ndinamanuprApto bhUtAnIva tamonudaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yuyutsuM tava putraM tu prAdravantaM mahadbalam |
ulUko.abhyapatattUrNaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.2:
yuyutsustu tato rAja~nshitadhAreNa patriNA |
ulUkaM tADayAmAsa vajreNendra ivAchalam
shlokas.3:
ulUkastu tataH kruddhastava putrasya sa.nyuge |
kShurapreNa dhanushChittvA tADayAmAsa karNinA
shlokas.4:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM yuyutsurvegavattaram |
anyadAdatta sumahachchApaM sa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.5:
shAkuniM cha tataH ShaShTyA vivyAdha bharatarShabha |
sArathiM tribhirAnarChattaM cha bhUyo vyavidhyata
shlokas.6:
ulUkastaM tu vi.nshatyA viddhvA hemavibhUShitaiH |
athAsya samare kruddho dhvajaM chichCheda kA~nchanam
shlokas.7:
sa chChinnayaShTiH sumahA~nshIryamANo mahAdhvajaH |
papAta pramukhe rAjanyuyutsoH kA~nchanojjvalaH
shlokas.8:
dhvajamunmathitaM dRRiShTvA yuyutsuH krodhamUrChitaH |
ulUkaM pa~nchabhirbANairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.9:
ulUkastasya bhallena tailadhautena mAriSha |
shirashchichCheda sahasA yanturbharatasattama
shlokas.10:
jaghAna chaturo.ashvA.nshcha taM cha vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
so.atividdho balavatA pratyapAyAdrathAntaram
shlokas.11:
taM nirjitya raNe rAjannulUkastvarito yayau |
pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayA.nshchaiva vinighnannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
shatAnIkaM mahArAja shrutakarmA sutastava |
vyashvasUtarathaM chakre nimeShArdhAdasambhramam
shlokas.13:
hatAshve tu rathe tiShTha~nshatAnIko mahAbalaH |
gadAM chikShepa sa~Nkruddhastava putrasya mAriSha
shlokas.14:
sA kRRitvA syandanaM bhasma hayA.nshchaiva sasArathIn |
papAta dharaNIM tUrNaM dArayantIva bhArata
shlokas.15:
tAvubhau virathau vIrau kurUNAM kIrtivardhanau |
apAkrametAM yuddhArtau prekShamANau parasparam
shlokas.16:
putrastu tava sambhrAnto vivitso rathamAvishat |
shatAnIko.api tvaritaH prativindhyarathaM gataH
shlokas.17:
sutasomastu shakuniM vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH |
nAkampayata sa.nrabdho vAryogha iva parvatam
shlokas.18:
sutasomastu taM dRRiShTvA pituratyantavairiNam |
sharairanekasAhasraishChAdayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.19:
tA~nsharA~nshakunistUrNaM chichChedAnyaiH patatribhiH |
laghvastrashchitrayodhI cha jitakAshI cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.20:
nivArya samare chApi sharA.nstAnnishitaiH sharaiH |
AjaghAna susa~NkruddhaH sutasomaM tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.21:
tasyAshvAnketanaM sUtaM tilasho vyadhamachCharaiH |
syAlastava mahAvIryastataste chukrushurjanAH
shlokas.22:
hatAshvo virathashchaiva ChinnadhanvA cha mAriSha |
dhanvI dhanurvaraM gRRihya rathAdbhUmAvatiShThata
vyasRRijatsAyakA.nshchaiva svarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn
shlokas.23:
ChAdayAmAsuratha te tava syAlasya taM ratham |
pata~NgAnAmiva vrAtAH sharavrAtA mahAratham
shlokas.24:
rathopasthAnsamIkShyApi vivyathe naiva saubalaH |
pramRRidna.nshcha sharA.nstA.nstA~nsharavrAtairmahAyashAH
shlokas.25:
tatrAtuShyanta yodhAshcha siddhAshchApi divi sthitAH |
sutasomasya tatkarma dRRiShTvAshraddheyamadbhutam
rathasthaM nRRipatiM taM tu padAtiH sannayodhayat
shlokas.26:
tasya tIkShNairmahAvegairbhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
vyahanatkArmukaM rAjA tUNIraM chaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.27:
sa chChinnadhanvA samare khaDgamudyamya nAnadan |
vaiDUryotpalavarNAbhaM hastidantamayatsarum
shlokas.28:
bhrAmyamANaM tatastaM tu vimalAmbbaravarchasam |
kAlopamaM tato mene sutasomasya dhImataH
shlokas.29:
so.acharatsahasA khaDgI maNDalAni sahasrashaH |
chaturvi.nshanmahArAja shikShAbalasamanvitaH
shlokas.30:
saubalastu tatastasya sharA.nshchikShepa vIryavAn |
tAnApatata evAshu chichCheda paramAsinA
shlokas.31:
tataH kruddho mahArAja saubalaH paravIrahA |
prAhiNotsutasomasya sharAnAshIviShopamAn
shlokas.32:
chichCheda tA.nshcha khaDgena shikShayA cha balena cha |
darshaya.NllAghavaM yuddhe tArkShyavIryasamadyutiH
shlokas.33:
tasya sa~ncharato rAjanmaNDalAvartane tadA |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena khaDgaM chichCheda suprabham
shlokas.34:
sa chChinnaH sahasA bhUmau nipapAta mahAnasiH |
avashasya sthitaM haste taM khaDgaM satsaruM tadA
shlokas.35:
ChinnamAj~nAya nistri.nshamavaplutya padAni ShaT |
prAvidhyata tataH sheShaM sutasomo mahArathaH
shlokas.36:
sa chChittvA saguNaM chApaM raNe tasya mahAtmanaH |
papAta dharaNIM tUrNaM svarNavajravibhUShitaH
sutasomastato.agachChachChrutakIrtermahAratham
shlokas.37:
saubalo.api dhanurgRRihya ghoramanyatsuduHsaham |
abhyayAtpANDavAnIkaM nighna~nshatrugaNAnbahUn
shlokas.38:
tatra nAdo mahAnAsItpANDavAnAM vishAM pate |
saubalaM samare dRRiShTvA vicharantamabhItavat
shlokas.39:
tAnyanIkAni dRRiptAni shastravanti mahAnti cha |
drAvyamANAnyadRRishyanta saubalena mahAtmanA
shlokas.40:
yathA daityachamUM rAjandevarAjo mamarda ha |
tathaiva pANDavIM senAM saubaleyo vyanAshayat
shlokas.41:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM kRRipo rAjanvArayAmAsa sa.nyuge |
yathA dRRiptaM vane nAgaM sharabho vArayedyudhi
shlokas.42:
niruddhaH pArShatastena gautamena balIyasA |
padAtpadaM vichalituM nAshaknottatra bhArata
shlokas.43:
gautamasya vapurdRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnarathaM prati |
vitresuH sarvabhUtAni kShayaM prAptaM cha menire
shlokas.44:
tatrAvochanvimanaso rathinaH sAdinastathA |
droNasya nidhane nUnaM sa~Nkruddho dvipadAM varaH
shlokas.45:
shAradvato mahAtejA divyAstravidudAradhIH |
api svasti bhavedadya dhRRiShTadyumnasya gautamAt
shlokas.46:
apIyaM vAhinI kRRitsnA muchyeta mahato bhayAt |
apyayaM brAhmaNaH sarvAnna no hanyAtsamAgatAn
shlokas.47:
yAdRRishaM dRRishyate rUpamantakapratimaM bhRRisham |
gamiShyatyadya padavIM bhAradvAjasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.48:
AchAryaH kShiprahastashcha vijayI cha sadA yudhi |
astravAnvIryasampannaH krodhena cha samanvitaH
shlokas.49:
pArShatashcha bhRRishaM yuddhe vimukho.adyApi lakShyate |
ityevaM vividhA vAchastAvakAnAM paraiH saha
shlokas.50:
viniHshvasya tataH kruddhaH kRRipaH shAradvato nRRipa |
pArShataM ChAdayAmAsa nishcheShTaM sarvamarmasu
shlokas.51:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare gautamena mahAtmanA |
kartavyaM na prajAnAti mohitaH paramAhave
shlokas.52:
tamabravIttato yantA kachchitkShemaM nu pArShata |
IdRRishaM vyasanaM yuddhe na te dRRiShTaM kadAchana
shlokas.53:
daivayogAttu te bANA nAtaranmarmabhedinaH |
preShitA dvijamukhyena marmANyuddishya sarvashaH
shlokas.54:
vyAvartaye tatra rathaM nadIvegamivArNavAt |
avadhyaM brAhmaNaM manye yena te vikramo hataH
shlokas.55:
dhRRiShTadyumnastato rAja~nshanakairabravIdvachaH |
muhyate me manastAta gAtre svedashcha jAyate
shlokas.56:
vepathuM cha sharIre me romaharShaM cha pashya vai |
varjayanbrAhmaNaM yuddhe shanairyAhi yato.achyutaH
shlokas.57:
arjunaM bhImasenaM vA samare prApya sArathe |
kShemamadya bhavedyantariti me naiShThikI matiH
shlokas.58:
tataH prAyAnmahArAja sArathistvarayanhayAn |
yato bhImo maheShvAso yuyudhe tava sainikaiH
shlokas.59:
pradrutaM tu rathaM dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnasya mAriSha |
kira~nsharashatAnyeva gautamo.anuyayau tadA
shlokas.60:
sha~NkhaM cha pUrayAmAsa muhurmuhurari.ndamaH |
pArShataM prAdravadyantaM mahendra iva shambaram
shlokas.61:
shikhaNDinaM tu samare bhIShmamRRityuM durAsadam |
hArdikyo vArayAmAsa smayanniva muhurmuhuH
shlokas.62:
shikhaNDI cha samAsAdya hRRidikAnAM mahAratham |
pa~nchabhirnishitairbhallairjatrudeshe samArdayat
shlokas.63:
kRRitavarmA tu sa~Nkruddho bhittvA ShaShTibhirAshugaiH |
dhanurekena chichCheda hasanrAjanmahArathaH
shlokas.64:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya drupadasyAtmajo balI |
tiShTha tiShTheti sa~Nkruddho hArdikyaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.65:
tato.asya navatiM bANAnrukmapu~NkhAnsutejanAn |
preShayAmAsa rAjendra te.asyAbhrashyanta varmaNaH
shlokas.66:
vitathA.nstAnsamAlakShya patitA.nshcha mahItale |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena kArmukaM chichChide balI
shlokas.67:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM bhagnashRRi~NgamivarShabham |
ashItyA mArgaNaiH kruddho bAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.68:
kRRitavarmA tu sa~Nkruddho mArgaNaiH kRRitavikShataH |
dhanuranyatsamAdAya samArgaNagaNaM prabho
shikhaNDinaM bANavaraiH skandhadeshe.abhyatADayat
shlokas.69:
skandhadeshe sthitairbANaiH shikhaNDI cha rarAja ha |
shAkhApratAnairvimalaiH sumahAnsa yathA drumaH
shlokas.70:
tAvanyonyaM bhRRishaM viddhvA rudhireNa samukShitau |
anyonyashRRi~NgAbhihatau rejaturvRRiShabhAviva
shlokas.71:
anyonyasya vadhe yatnaM kurvANau tau mahArathau |
rathAbhyAM cheratustatra maNDalAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.72:
kRRitavarmA mahArAja pArShataM nishitaiH sharaiH |
raNe vivyAdha saptatyA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.73:
tato.asya samare bANaM bhojaH praharatAM varaH |
jIvitAntakaraM ghoraM vyasRRijattvarayAnvitaH
shlokas.74:
sa tenAbhihato rAjanmUrChAmAshu samAvishat |
dhvajayaShTiM cha sahasA shishriye kashmalAvRRitaH
shlokas.75:
apovAha raNAttaM tu sArathI rathinAM varam |
hArdikyasharasantaptaM niHshvasantaM punaH punaH
shlokas.76:
parAjite tataH shUre drupadasya sute prabho |
prAdravatpANDavI senA vadhyamAnA samantataH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shvetAshvo.api mahArAja vyadhamattAvakaM balam |
yathA vAyuH samAsAdya tUlarAshiM samantataH
shlokas.2:
pratyudyayustrigartAstaM shibayaH kauravaiH saha |
shAlvAH sa.nshaptakAshchaiva nArAyaNabalaM cha yat
shlokas.3:
satyasenaH satyakIrtirmitradevaH shruta~njayaH |
saushrutishchitrasenashcha mitravarmA cha bhArata
shlokas.4:
trigartarAjaH samare bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH |
putraishchaiva maheShvAsairnAnAshastradharairyudhi
shlokas.5:
te sRRijantaH sharavrAtAnkiranto.arjunamAhave |
abhyadravanta samare vAryoghA iva sAgaram
shlokas.6:
te tvarjunaM samAsAdya yodhAH shatasahasrashaH |
agachChanvilayaM sarve tArkShyaM dRRiShTveva pannagAH
shlokas.7:
te vadhyamAnAH samare nAjahuH pANDavaM tadA |
dahyamAnA yathA rAja~nshalabhA iva pAvakam
shlokas.8:
satyasenastribhirbANairvivyAdha yudhi pANDavam |
mitradevastriShaShTyA cha chandradevashcha saptabhiH
shlokas.9:
mitravarmA trisaptatyA saushrutishchApi pa~nchabhiH |
shatru~njayashcha vi.nshatyA susharmA navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.10:
shatru~njayaM cha rAjAnaM hatvA tatra shilAshitaiH |
saushruteH sashirastrANaM shiraH kAyAdapAharat
tvaritashchandradevaM cha sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.11:
athetarAnmahArAja yatamAnAnmahArathAn |
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhirbANairekaikaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.12:
satyasenastu sa~NkruddhastomaraM vyasRRijanmahat |
samuddishya raNe kRRiShNaM siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
shlokas.13:
sa nirbhidya bhujaM savyaM mAdhavasya mahAtmanaH |
ayasmayo mahAchaNDo jagAma dharaNIM tadA
shlokas.14:
mAdhavasya tu viddhasya tomareNa mahAraNe |
pratodaH prApataddhastAdrashmayashcha vishAM pate
shlokas.15:
sa pratodaM punargRRihya rashmI.nshchaiva mahAyashAH |
vAhayAmAsa tAnashvAnsatyasenarathaM prati
shlokas.16:
viShvaksenaM tu nirbhinnaM prekShya pArtho dhana~njayaH |
satyasenaM sharaistIkShNairdArayitvA mahAbalaH
shlokas.17:
tataH sunishitairbANai rAj~nastasya mahachChiraH |
kuNDalopachitaM kAyAchchakarta pRRitanAntare
shlokas.18:
taM nihatya shitairbANairmitravarmANamAkShipat |
vatsadantena tIkShNena sArathiM chAsya mAriSha
shlokas.19:
tataH sharashatairbhUyaH sa.nshaptakagaNAnvashI |
pAtayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
tato rajatapu~Nkhena rAj~naH shIrShaM mahAtmanaH |
mitradevasya chichCheda kShurapreNa mahAyashAH
susharmANaM cha sa~Nkruddho jatrudeshe samArdayat
shlokas.21:
tataH sa.nshaptakAH sarve parivArya dhana~njayam |
shastraughairmamRRiduH kruddhA nAdayanto disho dasha
shlokas.22:
abhyarditastu tairjiShNuH shakratulyaparAkramaH |
aindramastramameyAtmA prAdushchakre mahArathaH
tataH sharasahasrANi prAdurAsanvishAM pate
shlokas.23:
dhvajAnAM ChidyamAnAnAM kArmukANAM cha sa.nyuge |
rathAnAM sapatAkAnAM tUNIrANAM sharaiH saha
shlokas.24:
akShANAmatha yoktrANAM chakrANAM rashmibhiH saha |
kUbarANAM varUthAnAM pRRiShatkAnAM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.25:
ashmanAM patatAM chaiva prAsAnAmRRiShTibhiH saha |
gadAnAM parighANAM cha shaktInAM tomaraiH saha
shlokas.26:
shataghnInAM sachakrANAM bhujAnAmUrubhiH saha |
kaNThasUtrA~NgadAnAM cha keyUrANAM cha mAriSha
shlokas.27:
hArANAmatha niShkANAM tanutrANAM cha bhArata |
ChatrANAM vyajanAnAM cha shirasAM mukuTaiH saha
ashrUyata mahA~nshabdastatra tatra vishAM pate
shlokas.28:
sakuNDalAni svakShINi pUrNachandranibhAni cha |
shirA.nsyurvyAmadRRishyanta tArAgaNa ivAmbare
shlokas.29:
susragvINi suvAsA.nsi chandanenokShitAni cha |
sharIrANi vyadRRishyanta hatAnAM cha mahItale
gandharvanagarAkAraM ghoramAyodhanaM tadA
shlokas.30:
nihatai rAjaputraishcha kShatriyaishcha mahAbalaiH |
hastibhiH patitaishchaiva turagaishchAbhavanmahI
agamyamArgA samare vishIrNairiva parvataiH
shlokas.31:
nAsIchchakrapathashchaiva pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
nighnataH shAtravAnbhallairhastyashvaM chAmitaM mahat
shlokas.32:
A tumbAdavasIdanti rathachakrANi mAriSha |
raNe vicharatastasya tasmi.Nllohitakardame
shlokas.33:
sIdamAnAni chakrANi samUhusturagA bhRRisham |
shrameNa mahatA yuktA manomArutaraMhasaH
shlokas.34:
vadhyamAnaM tu tatsainyaM pANDuputreNa dhanvinA |
prAyasho vimukhaM sarvaM nAvatiShThata sa.nyuge
shlokas.35:
tA~njitvA samare jiShNuH sa.nshaptakagaNAnbahUn |
rarAja sa mahArAja vidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.36:
yudhiShThiraM mahArAja visRRijantaM sharAnbahUn |
svayaM duryodhano rAjA pratyagRRihNAdabhItavat
shlokas.37:
tamApatantaM sahasA tava putraM mahAbalam |
dharmarAjo drutaM viddhvA tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.38:
sA cha taM prativivyAdha navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena bhRRishaM kruddho.abhyatADayat
shlokas.39:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA hemapu~NkhA~nshilImukhAn |
duryodhanAya chikShepa trayodasha shilAshitAn
shlokas.40:
chaturbhishchaturo vAhA.nstasya hatvA mahArathaH |
pa~nchamena shiraH kAyAtsArathestu samAkShipat
shlokas.41:
ShaShThena cha dhvajaM rAj~naH saptamena cha kArmukam |
aShTamena tathA khaDgaM pAtayAmAsa bhUtale
pa~nchabhirnRRipatiM chApi dharmarAjo.ardayadbhRRisham
shlokas.42:
hatAshvAttu rathAttasmAdavaplutya sutastava |
uttamaM vyasanaM prApto bhUmAveva vyatiShThata
shlokas.43:
taM tu kRRichChragataM dRRiShTvA karNadrauNikRRipAdayaH |
abhyavartanta sahitAH parIpsanto narAdhipam
shlokas.44:
atha pANDusutAH sarve parivArya yudhiShThiram |
abhyayuH samare rAja.nstato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.45:
atha tUryasahasrANi prAvAdyanta mahAmRRidhe |
kShveDAH kilakilAshabdAH prAdurAsanmahIpate
yadabhyagachChansamare pA~nchAlAH kauravaiH saha
shlokas.46:
narA naraiH samAjagmurvAraNA varavAraNaiH |
rathAshcha rathibhiH sArdhaM hayAshcha hayasAdibhiH
shlokas.47:
dva.ndvAnyAsanmahArAja prekShaNIyAni sa.nyuge |
vismApanAnyachintyAni shastravantyuttamAni cha
shlokas.48:
ayudhyanta mahAvegAH parasparavadhaiShiNaH |
anyonyaM samare jaghnuryodhavratamanuShThitAH
na hi te samaraM chakruH pRRiShThato vai katha~nchana
shlokas.49:
muhUrtameva tadyuddhamAsInmadhuradarshanam |
tata unmattavadrAjannirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.50:
rathI nAgaM samAsAdya vicharanraNamUrdhani |
preShayAmAsa kAlAya sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.51:
nAgA hayAnsamAsAdya vikShipanto bahUnatha |
drAvayAmAsuratyugrAstatra tatra tadA tadA
shlokas.52:
vidrAvya cha bahUnashvAnnAgA rAjanbalotkaTAH |
viShANaishchApare jaghnurmamRRidushchApare bhRRisham
shlokas.53:
sAshvArohA.nshcha turagAnviShANairbibhidU raNe |
aparA.nshchikShipurvegAtpragRRihyAtibalAstathA
shlokas.54:
pAdAtairAhatA nAgA vivareShu samantataH |
chakrurArtasvaraM ghoraM vyadravanta disho dasha
shlokas.55:
padAtInAM tu sahasA pradrutAnAM mahAmRRidhe |
utsRRijyAbharaNaM tUrNamavaplutya raNAjire
shlokas.56:
nimittaM manyamAnAstu pariNamya mahAgajAH |
jagRRihurbibhidushchaiva chitrANyAbharaNAni cha
shlokas.57:
pratimAneShu kumbheShu dantaveShTeShu chApare |
nigRRihItA bhRRishaM nAgAH prAsatomarashaktibhiH
shlokas.58:
nigRRihya cha gadAH kechitpArshvasthairbhRRishadAruNaiH |
rathAshvasAdibhistatra sambhinnA nyapatanbhuvi
shlokas.59:
sarathaM sAdinaM tatra apare tu mahAgajAH |
bhUmAvamRRidnanvegena savarmANaM patAkinam
shlokas.60:
rathaM nAgAH samAsAdya dhuri gRRihya cha mAriSha |
vyAkShipansahasA tatra ghorarUpe mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.61:
nArAchairnihatashchApi nipapAta mahAgajaH |
parvatasyeva shikharaM vajrabhagnaM mahItale
shlokas.62:
yodhA yodhAnsamAsAdya muShTibhirvyahananyudhi |
kesheShvanyonyamAkShipya chichChidurbibhiduH saha
shlokas.63:
udyamya cha bhujAvanyo nikShipya cha mahItale |
padA choraH samAkramya sphurato vyahanachChiraH
shlokas.64:
mRRitamanyo mahArAja padbhyAM tADitavA.nstadA |
jIvatashcha tathaivAnyaH shastraM kAye nyamajjayat
shlokas.65:
muShTiyuddhaM mahachchAsIdyodhAnAM tatra bhArata |
tathA keshagrahashchogro bAhuyuddhaM cha kevalam
shlokas.66:
samAsaktasya chAnyena avij~nAtastathAparaH |
jahAra samare prANAnnAnAshastrairanekadhA
shlokas.67:
sa.nsakteShu cha yodheShu vartamAne cha sa~Nkule |
kabandhAnyutthitAni sma shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.68:
lohitaiH sichyamAnAni shastrANi kavachAni cha |
mahAra~NgAnuraktAni vastrANIva chakAshire
shlokas.69:
evametanmahAyuddhaM dAruNaM bhRRishasa~Nkulam |
unmattara~NgapratimaM shabdenApUrayajjagat
shlokas.70:
naiva sve na pare rAjanvij~nAyante sharAturAH |
yoddhavyamiti yudhyante rAjAno jayagRRiddhinaH
shlokas.71:
svAnsve jaghnurmahArAja parA.nshchaiva samAgatAn |
ubhayoH senayorvIrairvyAkulaM samapadyata
shlokas.72:
rathairbhagnairmahArAja vAraNaishcha nipAtitaiH |
hayaishcha patitaistatra naraishcha vinipAtitaiH
shlokas.74:
pA~nchAlAnavadhItkarNastrigartA.nshcha dhana~njayaH |
bhImasenaH kurUnrAjanhastyanIkaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.75:
evameSha kShayo vRRittaH kurupANDavasenayoH |
aparAhNe mahArAja kA~NkShantyorvipulaM jayam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
atitIvrANi duHkhAni duHsahAni bahUni cha |
tavAhaM sa~njayAshrauShaM putrANAM mama sa~NkShayam
shlokas.2:
tathA tu me kathayase yathA yuddhaM tu vartate |
na santi sUta kauravyA iti me naiShThikI matiH
shlokas.3:
duryodhanastu virathaH kRRitastatra mahAraNe |
dharmaputraH kathaM chakre tasminvA nRRipatiH katham
shlokas.4:
aparAhNe kathaM yuddhamabhavallomaharShaNam |
tanmamAchakShva tattvena kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa.nsakteShu cha sainyeShu yudhyamAneShu bhAgashaH |
rathamanyaM samAsthAya putrastava vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
krodhena mahatAviShTaH saviSho bhujago yathA |
duryodhanastu dRRiShTvA vai dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
uvAcha sUta tvaritaM yAhi yAhIti bhArata
shlokas.7:
atra mAM prApaya kShipraM sArathe yatra pANDavaH |
dhriyamANena ChatreNa rAjA rAjati da.nshitaH
shlokas.8:
sa sUtashchodito rAj~nA rAj~naH syandanamuttamam |
yudhiShThirasyAbhimukhaM preShayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.9:
tato yudhiShThiraH kruddhaH pramatta iva sadgavaH |
sArathiM chodayAmAsa yAhi yatra suyodhanaH
shlokas.10:
tau samAjagmaturvIrau bhrAtarau rathasattamau |
sametya cha mahAvIryau saMnaddhau yuddhadurmadau
tatakShaturmaheShvAsau sharairanyonyamAhave
shlokas.11:
tato duryodhano rAjA dharmashIlasya mAriSha |
shilAshitena bhallena dhanushchichCheda sa.nyuge
taM nAmRRiShyata sa~Nkruddho vyavasAyaM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
apavidhya dhanushChinnaM krodhasa.nraktalochanaH |
anyatkArmukamAdAya dharmaputrashchamUmukhe
shlokas.13:
duryodhanasya chichCheda dhvajaM kArmukameva cha |
athAnyaddhanurAdAya pratyavidhyata pANDavam
shlokas.14:
tAvanyonyaM susa.nrabdhau sharavarShANyamu~nchatAm |
siMhAviva susa~Nkruddhau parasparajigIShayA
shlokas.15:
anyonyaM jaghnatushchaiva nardamAnau vRRiShAviva |
anyonyaM prekShamANau cha cheratustau mahArathau
shlokas.16:
tataH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairanyonyaM sukRRitavraNau |
virejaturmahArAja puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.17:
tato rAjanpratibhayAnsiMhanAdAnmuhurmuhuH |
talayoshcha tathA shabdAndhanuShoshcha mahAhave
shlokas.18:
sha~NkhashabdaravA.nshchaiva chakratustau rathottamau |
anyonyaM cha mahArAja pIDayAM chakraturbhRRisham
shlokas.19:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA tava putraM tribhiH sharaiH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho vajravego durAsadaH
shlokas.20:
prativivyAdha taM tUrNaM tava putro mahIpatim |
pa~nchabhirnishitairbANairhemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.21:
tato duryodhano rAjA shaktiM chikShepa bhArata |
sarvapArashavIM tIkShNAM maholkApratimAM tadA
shlokas.22:
tAmApatantIM sahasA dharmarAjaH shilAshitaiH |
tribhishchichCheda sahasA taM cha vivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.23:
nipapAta tataH sAtha hemadaNDA mahAghanA |
nipatantI maholkeva vyarAjachChikhisaMnibhA
shlokas.24:
shaktiM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA putrastava vishAM pate |
navabhirnishitairbhallairnijaghAna yudhiShThiram
shlokas.25:
so.atividdho balavatAmagraNIH shatrutApanaH |
duryodhanaM samuddishya bANaM jagrAha satvaraH
shlokas.26:
samAdhatta cha taM bANaM dhanuShyugraM mahAbalaH |
chikShepa cha tato rAjA rAj~naH kruddhaH parAkramI
shlokas.27:
sa tu bANaH samAsAdya tava putraM mahAratham |
vyamohayata rAjAnaM dharaNIM cha jagAma ha
shlokas.28:
tato duryodhanaH kruddho gadAmudyamya vegitaH |
vidhitsuH kalahasyAntamabhidudrAva pANDavam
shlokas.29:
tamAlakShyodyatagadaM daNDahastamivAntakam |
dharmarAjo mahAshaktiM prAhiNottava sUnave
dIpyamAnAM mahAvegAM maholkAM jvalitAmiva
shlokas.30:
rathasthaH sa tayA viddho varma bhittvA mahAhave |
bhRRishaM sa.nvignahRRidayaH papAta cha mumoha cha
shlokas.31:
tatastvaritamAgatya kRRitavarmA tavAtmajam |
pratyapadyata rAjAnaM magnaM vai vyasanArNave
shlokas.32:
bhImo.api mahatIM gRRihya gadAM hemapariShkRRitAm |
abhidudrAva vegena kRRitavarmANamAhave
evaM tadabhavadyuddhaM tvadIyAnAM paraiH saha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH karNaM puraskRRitya tvadIyA yuddhadurmadAH |
punarAvRRitya sa~NgrAmaM chakrurdevAsuropamam
shlokas.2:
dviradarathanarAshvasha~NkhashabdaiH; parihRRiShitA vividhaishcha shastrapAtaiH |
dviradarathapadAtisArthavAhAH; paripatitAbhimukhAH prajahrire te
shlokas.3:
sharaparashuvarAsipaTTishai;riShubhiranekavidhaishcha sAditAH |
dviradarathahayA mahAhave; varapuruShaiH puruShAshcha vAhanaiH
shlokas.4:
kamaladinakarendusaMnibhaiH; sitadashanaiH sumukhAkShinAsikaiH |
ruchiramukuTakuNDalairmahI; puruShashirobhiravastRRitA babhau
shlokas.5:
parighamusalashaktitomarai;rnakharabhushuNDigadAshatairdrutAH |
dviradanarahayAH sahasrasho; rudhiranadIpravahAstadAbhavan
shlokas.6:
prahatanararathAshvaku~njaraM; pratibhayadarshanamulbaNaM tadA |
tadahitanihataM babhau balaM; pitRRipatirAShTramiva prajAkShaye
shlokas.7:
atha tava naradeva sainikA;stava cha sutAH surasUnusaMnibhAH |
amitabalapuraHsarA raNe; kuruvRRiShabhAH shiniputramabhyayuH
shlokas.8:
tadatiruchirabhImamAbabhau; puruShavarAshvarathadvipAkulam |
lavaNajalasamuddhatasvanaM; balamamarAsurasainyasaMnibham
shlokas.9:
surapatisamavikramastata;stridashavarAvarajopamaM yudhi |
dinakarakiraNaprabhaiH pRRiShatkai; ravitanayo.abhyahanachChinipravIram
shlokas.10:
tamapi sarathavAjisArathiM; shinivRRiShabho vividhaiH sharaistvaran |
bhujagaviShasamaprabhai raNe; puruShavaraM samavAstRRiNottadA
shlokas.11:
shinivRRiShabhasharaprapIDitaM; tava suhRRido vasuSheNamabhyayuH |
tvaritamatirathA ratharShabhaM; dviradarathAshvapadAtibhiH saha
shlokas.12:
tamudadhinibhamAdravadbalI; tvaritataraiH samabhidrutaM paraiH |
drupadasutasakhastadAkaro;tpuruSharathAshvagajakShayaM mahat
shlokas.13:
atha puruShavarau kRRitAhnikau; bhavamabhipUjya yathAvidhi prabhum |
arivadhakRRitanishchayau drutaM; tava balamarjunakeshavau sRRitau
shlokas.14:
jaladaninadanisvanaM rathaM; pavanavidhUtapatAkaketanam |
sitahayamupayAntamantikaM; hRRitamanaso dadRRishustadArayaH
shlokas.15:
atha visphArya gANDIvaM raNe nRRityannivArjunaH |
sharasambAdhamakarotkhaM dishaH pradishastathA
shlokas.16:
rathAnvimAnapratimAnsajjayantrAyudhadhvajAn |
sasArathI.nstadA bANairabhrANIvAnilo.avadhIt
shlokas.17:
gajAngajaprayantR^I.nshcha vaijayantyAyudhadhvajAn |
sAdino.ashvA.nshcha pattI.nshcha sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.18:
tamantakamiva kruddhamanivAryaM mahAratham |
duryodhano.abhyayAdeko nighnanbANaiH pRRithagvidhaiH
shlokas.19:
tasyArjuno dhanuH sUtaM ketumashvA.nshcha sAyakaiH |
hatvA saptabhirekaikaM ChatraM chichCheda patriNA
shlokas.20:
navamaM cha samAsAdya vyasRRijatpratighAtinam |
duryodhanAyeShuvaraM taM drauNiH saptadhAchChinat
shlokas.21:
tato drauNerdhanushChittvA hatvA chAshvavarA~nsharaiH |
kRRipasyApi tathAtyugraM dhanushchichCheda pANDavaH
shlokas.22:
hArdikyasya dhanushChittvA dhvajaM chAshvaM tathAvadhIt |
duHshAsanasyeShuvaraM ChittvA rAdheyamabhyayAt
shlokas.23:
atha sAtyakimutsRRijya tvarankarNo.arjunaM tribhiH |
viddhvA vivyAdha vi.nshatyA kRRiShNaM pArthaM punastribhiH
shlokas.24:
atha sAtyakirAgatya karNaM viddhvA shitaiH sharaiH |
navatyA navabhishchograiH shatena punarArdayat
shlokas.25:
tataH pravIrAH pANDUnAM sarve karNamapIDayan |
yudhAmanyuH shikhaNDI cha draupadeyAH prabhadrakAH
shlokas.26:
uttamaujA yuyutsushcha yamau pArShata eva cha |
chedikArUShamatsyAnAM kekayAnAM cha yadbalam
chekitAnashcha balavAndharmarAjashcha suvrataH
shlokas.27:
ete rathAshvadviradaiH pattibhishchogravikramaiH |
parivArya raNe karNaM nAnAshastrairavAkiran
bhAShanto vAgbhirugrAbhiH sarve karNavadhe vRRitAH
shlokas.28:
tAM shastravRRiShTiM bahudhA ChittvA karNaH shitaiH sharaiH |
apovAha sma tAnsarvAndrumAnbha~Nktveva mArutaH
shlokas.29:
rathinaH samahAmAtrAngajAnashvAnsasAdinaH |
sharavrAtA.nshcha sa~Nkruddho nighnankarNo vyadRRishyata
shlokas.30:
tadvadhyamAnaM pANDUnAM balaM karNAstratejasA |
vishastrakShatadehaM cha prAya AsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.31:
atha karNAstramastreNa pratihatyArjunaH svayam |
dishaH khaM chaiva bhUmiM cha prAvRRiNochCharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.32:
musalAnIva niShpetuH parighA iva cheShavaH |
shataghnya iva chApyanye vajrANyugrANi vApare
shlokas.33:
tairvadhyamAnaM tatsainyaM sapattyashvarathadvipam |
nimIlitAkShamatyarthamudabhrAmyatsamantataH
shlokas.34:
niShkaivalyaM tadA yuddhaM prApurashvanaradvipAH |
vadhyamAnAH sharairanye tadA bhItAH pradudruvuH
shlokas.35:
evaM teShAM tadA yuddhe sa.nsaktAnAM jayaiShiNAm |
girimastaM samAsAdya pratyapadyata bhAnumAn
shlokas.36:
tamasA cha mahArAja rajasA cha visheShataH |
na ki~nchitpratyapashyAma shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham
shlokas.37:
te trasanto maheShvAsA rAtriyuddhasya bhArata |
apayAnaM tatashchakruH sahitAH sarvavAjibhiH
shlokas.38:
kauraveShu cha yAteShu tadA rAjandinakShaye |
jayaM sumanasaH prApya pArthAH svashibiraM yayuH
shlokas.39:
vAditrashabdairvividhaiH siMhanAdaishcha nartitaiH |
parAnavahasantashcha stuvantashchAchyutArjunau
shlokas.40:
kRRite.avahAre tairvIraiH sainikAH sarva eva te |
AshiShaH pANDaveyeShu prAyujyanta nareshvarAH
shlokas.41:
tataH kRRite.avahAre cha prahRRiShTAH kurupANDavAH |
nishAyAM shibiraM gatvA nyavishanta nareshvarAH
shlokas.42:
yakSharakShaHpishAchAshcha shvApadAni cha sa~NghashaH |
jagmurAyodhanaM ghoraM rudrasyAnartanopamam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
svena chChandena naH sarvAnnAvadhIdvyaktamarjunaH |
na hyasya samare muchyetAntako.apyAtatAyinaH
shlokas.2:
pArtho hyeko.aharadbhadrAmekashchAgnimatarpayat |
ekashchemAM mahIM jitvA chakre balibhRRito nRRipAn
shlokas.3:
eko nivAtakavachAnavadhIddivyakArmukaH |
ekaH kirAtarUpeNa sthitaM sharvamayodhayat
shlokas.4:
eko.abhyarakShadbharatAneko bhavamatoShayat |
tenaikena jitAH sarve madIyA ugratejasaH
te na nindyAH prashasyAshcha yatte chakrurbravIhi tat
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hataprahatavidhvastA vivarmAyudhavAhanAH |
dInasvarA dUyamAnA mAninaH shatrubhirjitAH
shlokas.6:
shibirasthAH punarmantraM mantrayanti sma kauravAH |
bhagnadaMShTrA hataviShAH padAkrAntA ivoragAH
shlokas.7:
tAnabravIttataH karNaH kruddhaH sarpa iva shvasan |
karaM kareNAbhipIDya prekShamANastavAtmajam
shlokas.8:
yatto dRRiDhashcha dakShashcha dhRRitimAnarjunaH sadA |
sa bodhayati chApyenaM prAptakAlamadhokShajaH
shlokas.9:
sahasAstravisargeNa vayaM tenAdya va~nchitAH |
shvastvahaM tasya sa~NkalpaM sarvaM hantA mahIpate
shlokas.10:
evamuktastathetyuktvA so.anujaj~ne nRRipottamAn |
sukhoShitAste rajanIM hRRiShTA yuddhAya niryayuH
shlokas.11:
te.apashyanvihitaM vyUhaM dharmarAjena durjayam |
prayatnAtkurumukhyena bRRihaspatyushanomatAt
shlokas.12:
atha pratIpakartAraM satataM vijitAtmanAm |
sasmAra vRRiShabhaskandhaM karNaM duryodhanastadA
shlokas.13:
pura.ndarasamaM yuddhe marudgaNasamaM bale |
kArtavIryasamaM vIrye karNaM rAj~no.agamanmanaH
sUtaputraM maheShvAsaM bandhumAtyayikeShviva
shlokas.14:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yadvo.agamanmano mandAH karNaM vaikartanaM tadA |
apyadrAkShata taM yUyaM shItArtA iva bhAskaram
shlokas.15:
kRRite.avahAre sainyAnAM pravRRitte cha raNe punaH |
kathaM vaikartanaH karNastatrAyudhyata sa~njaya
kathaM cha pANDavAH sarve yuyudhustatra sUtajam
shlokas.16:
karNo hyeko mahAbAhurhanyAtpArthAnsasomakAn |
karNasya bhujayorvIryaM shakraviShNusamaM matam
tathAstrANi sughorANi vikramashcha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
duryodhanaM tadA dRRiShTvA pANDavena bhRRishArditam |
parAkrAntAnpANDusutAndRRiShTvA chApi mahAhave
shlokas.18:
karNamAshritya sa~NgrAme darpo duryodhane punaH |
jetumutsahate pArthAnsaputrAnsahakeshavAn
shlokas.19:
aho bata mahadduHkhaM yatra pANDusutAnraNe |
nAtaradrabhasaH karNo daivaM nUnaM parAyaNam
aho dyUtasya niShTheyaM ghorA samprati vartate
shlokas.20:
aho duHkhAni tIvrANi duryodhanakRRitAnyaham |
sahiShyAmi sughorANi shalyabhUtAni sa~njaya
shlokas.22:
saubalaM cha tathA tAta nItimAniti manyate |
yuddheShu nAma divyeShu vartamAneShu sa~njaya |
ashrauShaM nihatAnputrAnnityameva cha nirjitAn
shlokas.23:
na pANDavAnAM samare kashchidasti nivArakaH |
strImadhyamiva gAhanti daivaM hi balavattaram
shlokas.24:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atikrAntaM hi yatkAryaM pashchAchchintayatIti cha |
tachchAsya na bhavetkAryaM chintayA cha vinashyati
shlokas.25:
tadidaM tava kAryaM tu dUraprAptaM vijAnatA |
na kRRitaM yattvayA pUrvaM prAptAprAptavichAraNe
shlokas.26:
ukto.asi bahudhA rAjanmA yudhyasveti pANDavaiH |
gRRihNIShe na cha tanmohAtpANDaveShu vishAM pate
shlokas.27:
tvayA pApAni ghorANi samAchIrNAni pANDuShu |
tvatkRRite vartate ghoraH pArthivAnAM janakShayaH
shlokas.28:
tattvidAnImatikramya mA shucho bharatarShabha |
shRRiNu sarvaM yathAvRRittaM ghoraM vaishasamachyuta
shlokas.29:
prabhAtAyAM rajanyAM tu karNo rAjAnamabhyayAt |
sametya cha mahAbAhurduryodhanamabhAShata
shlokas.30:
adya rAjansameShyAmi pANDavena yashasvinA |
haniShyAmi cha taM vIraM sa vA mAM nihaniShyati
shlokas.31:
bahutvAnmama kAryANAM tathA pArthasya pArthiva |
nAbhUtsamAgamo rAjanmama chaivArjunasya cha
shlokas.32:
idaM tu me yathApraj~naM shRRiNu vAkyaM vishAM pate |
anihatya raNe pArthaM nAhameShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.33:
hatapravIre sainye.asminmayi chaiva sthite yudhi |
abhiyAsyati mAM pArthaH shakrashaktyA vinAkRRitam
shlokas.34:
tataH shreyaskaraM yatte tannibodha janeshvara |
AyudhAnAM cha yadvIryaM dravyANAmarjunasya cha
shlokas.35:
kAyasya mahato bhede lAghave dUrapAtane |
sauShThave chAstrayoge cha savyasAchI na matsamaH
shlokas.36:
sarvAyudhamahAmAtraM vijayaM nAma taddhanuH |
indrArthamabhikAmena nirmitaM vishvakarmaNA
shlokas.37:
yena daityagaNAnrAja~njitavAnvai shatakratuH |
yasya ghoSheNa daityAnAM vimuhyanti disho dasha
tadbhArgavAya prAyachChachChakraH paramasaMmatam
shlokas.38:
taddivyaM bhArgavo mahyamadadAddhanuruttamam |
yena yotsye mahAbAhumarjunaM jayatAM varam
yathendraH samare sarvAndaiteyAnvai samAgatAn
shlokas.39:
dhanurghoraM rAmadattaM gANDIvAttadvishiShyate |
triHsaptakRRitvaH pRRithivI dhanuShA tena nirjitA
shlokas.40:
dhanuSho yasya karmANi divyAni prAha bhArgavaH |
tadrAmo hyadadAnmahyaM yena yotsyAmi pANDavam
shlokas.41:
adya duryodhanAhaM tvAM nandayiShye sabAndhavam |
nihatya samare vIramarjunaM jayatAM varam
shlokas.42:
saparvatavanadvIpA hatadviDbhUH sasAgarA |
putrapautrapratiShThA te bhaviShyatyadya pArthiva
shlokas.43:
nAsAdhyaM vidyate me.adya tvatpriyArthaM visheShataH |
samyagdharmAnuraktasya siddhirAtmavato yathA
shlokas.44:
na hi mAM samare soDhuM sa shakto.agniM taruryathA |
avashyaM tu mayA vAchyaM yena hIno.asmi phalgunAt
shlokas.45:
jyA tasya dhanuSho divyA tathAkShayyau maheShudhI |
tasya divyaM dhanuH shreShThaM gANDIvamajaraM yudhi
shlokas.46:
vijayaM cha mahaddivyaM mamApi dhanuruttamam |
tatrAhamadhikaH pArthAddhanuShA tena pArthiva
shlokas.47:
mayA chAbhyadhiko vIraH pANDavastannibodha me |
rashmigrAhashcha dAshArhaH sarvalokanamaskRRitaH
shlokas.48:
agnidattashcha vai divyo rathaH kA~nchanabhUShaNaH |
achChedyaH sarvato vIra vAjinashcha manojavAH
dhvajashcha divyo dyutimAnvAnaro vismaya~NkaraH
shlokas.49:
kRRiShNashcha sraShTA jagato rathaM tamabhirakShati |
ebhirdravyairahaM hIno yoddhumichChAmi pANDavam
shlokas.50:
ayaM tu sadRRisho vIraH shalyaH samitishobhanaH |
sArathyaM yadi me kuryAddhruvaste vijayo bhavet
shlokas.51:
tasya me sArathiH shalyo bhavatvasukaraH paraiH |
nArAchAngArdhrapatrA.nshcha shakaTAni vahantu me
shlokas.52:
rathAshcha mukhyA rAjendra yuktA vAjibhiruttamaiH |
AyAntu pashchAtsatataM mAmeva bharatarShabha
shlokas.53:
evamabhyadhikaH pArthAdbhaviShyAmi guNairaham |
shalyo hyabhyadhikaH kRRiShNAdarjunAdadhiko hyaham
shlokas.54:
yathAshvahRRidayaM veda dAshArhaH paravIrahA |
tathA shalyo.api jAnIte hayAnAM vai mahArathaH
shlokas.55:
bAhuvIrye samo nAsti madrarAjasya kashchana |
tathAstrairmatsamo nAsti kashchideva dhanurdharaH
shlokas.56:
tathA shalyasamo nAsti hayayAne ha kashchana |
so.ayamabhyadhikaH pArthAdbhaviShyati ratho mama
shlokas.57:
etatkRRitaM mahArAja tvayechChAmi parantapa |
evaM kRRite kRRitaM mahyaM sarvakAmairbhaviShyati
shlokas.58:
tato draShTAsi samare yatkariShyAmi bhArata |
sarvathA pANDavAnsarvA~njeShyAmyadya samAgatAn
shlokas.59:
duryodhana uvAcha||
sarvametatkariShyAmi yathA tvaM karNa manyase |
sopAsa~NgA rathAH sAshvA anuyAsyanti sUtaja
shlokas.60:
nArAchAngArdhrapakShA.nshcha shakaTAni vahantu te |
anuyAsyAma karNa tvAM vayaM sarve cha pArthivAH
shlokas.61:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA mahArAja tava putrAH pratApavAn |
abhigamyAbravIdrAjA madrarAjamidaM vachaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
putrastava mahArAja madrarAjamidaM vachaH |
vinayenopasa~Ngamya praNayAdvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.2:
satyavrata mahAbhAga dviShatAmaghavardhana |
madreshvara raNe shUra parasainyabhaya~Nkara
shlokas.3:
shrutavAnasi karNasya bruvato vadatAM vara |
yathA nRRipatisiMhAnAM madhye tvAM varayatyayam
shlokas.4:
tasmAtpArthavinAshArthaM hitArthaM mama chaiva hi |
sArathyaM rathinAM shreShTha sumanAH kartumarhasi
shlokas.5:
asyAbhIshugraho loke nAnyo.asti bhavatA samaH |
sa pAtu sarvataH karNaM bhavAnbrahmeva sha~Nkaram
shlokas.6:
pArthasya sachivaH kRRiShNo yathAbhIshugraho varaH |
tathA tvamapi rAdheyaM sarvataH paripAlaya
shlokas.7:
bhIShmo droNaH kRRipaH karNo bhavAnbhojashcha vIryavAn |
shakuniH saubalo drauNirahameva cha no balam
eShAmeva kRRito bhAgo navadhA pRRitanApate
shlokas.8:
naiva bhAgo.atra bhIShmasya droNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
tAbhyAmatItya tau bhAgau nihatA mama shatravaH
shlokas.9:
vRRiddhau hi tau naravyAghrau Chalena nihatau cha tau |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma gatau svargamito.anagha
shlokas.10:
tathAnye puruShavyAghrAH parairvinihatA yudhi |
asmadIyAshcha bahavaH svargAyopagatA raNe
tyaktvA prANAnyathAshakti cheShTAH kRRitvA cha puShkalAH
shlokas.11:
karNo hyeko mahAbAhurasmatpriyahite rataH |
bhavA.nshcha puruShavyAghra sarvalokamahArathaH
tasmi~njayAshA vipulA mama madrajanAdhipa
shlokas.12:
pArthasya samare kRRiShNo yathAbhIshuvaragrahaH |
tena yukto raNe pArtho rakShyamANashcha pArthiva
yAni karmANi kurute pratyakShANi tathaiva te
shlokas.13:
pUrvaM na samare hyevamavadhIdarjuno ripUn |
ahanyahani madresha drAvayandRRishyate yudhi
shlokas.14:
bhAgo.avashiShTaH karNasya tava chaiva mahAdyute |
taM bhAgaM saha karNena yugapannAshayAhave
shlokas.15:
sUryAruNau yathA dRRiShTvA tamo nashyati mAriSha |
tathA nashyantu kaunteyAH sapA~nchAlAH sasRRi~njayAH
shlokas.16:
rathAnAM pravaraH karNo yantR^INAM pravaro bhavAn |
saMnipAtaH samo loke bhavatornAsti kashchana
shlokas.17:
yathA sarvAsvavasthAsu vArShNeyaH pAti pANDavam |
tathA bhavAnparitrAtu karNaM vaikartanaM raNe
shlokas.18:
tvayA sArathinA hyeSha apradhRRiShyo bhaviShyati |
devatAnAmapi raNe sashakrANAM mahIpate
kiM punaH pANDaveyAnAM mAtisha~NkIrvacho mama
shlokas.19:
duryodhanavachaH shrutvA shalyaH krodhasamanvitaH |
trishikhAM bhrukuTIM kRRitvA dhunvanhastau punaH punaH
shlokas.20:
krodharakte mahAnetre parivartya mahAbhujaH |
kulaishvaryashrutibalairdRRiptaH shalyo.abravIdidam
shlokas.21:
avamanyase mAM gAndhAre dhruvaM mAM parisha~Nkase |
yanmAM bravIShi visrabdhaM sArathyaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.22:
asmatto.abhyadhikaM karNaM manyamAnaH prasha.nsasi |
na chAhaM yudhi rAdheyaM gaNaye tulyamAtmanA
shlokas.23:
AdishyatAmabhyadhiko mamA.nshaH pRRithivIpate |
tamahaM samare hatvA gamiShyAmi yathAgatam
shlokas.24:
atha vApyeka evAhaM yotsyAmi kurunandana |
pashya vIryaM mamAdya tvaM sa~NgrAme dahato ripUn
shlokas.25:
na chAbhikAmAnkauravya vidhAya hRRidaye pumAn |
asmadvidhaH pravarteta mA mA tvamatisha~NkithAH
shlokas.26:
yudhi chApyavamAno me na kartavyaH katha~nchana |
pashya hImau mama bhujau vajrasaMhananopamau
shlokas.27:
dhanuH pashya cha me chitraM sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn |
rathaM pashya cha me kL^iptaM sadashvairvAtavegitaiH
gadAM cha pashya gAndhAre hemapaTTavibhUShitAm
shlokas.28:
dArayeyaM mahIM kruddho vikireyaM cha parvatAn |
shoShayeyaM samudrA.nshcha tejasA svena pArthiva
shlokas.29:
tanmAmeva.nvidhaM jAnansamarthamarinigrahe |
kasmAdyunakShi sArathye nyUnasyAdhirathernRRipa
shlokas.30:
na nAma dhuri rAjendra prayoktuM tvamihArhasi |
na hi pApIyasaH shreyAnbhUtvA preShyatvamutsahe
shlokas.31:
yo hyabhyupagataM prItyA garIyA.nsaM vashe sthitam |
vashe pApIyaso dhatte tatpApamadharottaram
shlokas.32:
brAhmaNA brahmaNA sRRiShTA mukhAtkShatramathorasaH |
UrubhyAmasRRijadvaishyA~nshUdrAnpadbhyAmiti shrutiH
tebhyo varNavisheShAshcha pratilomAnulomajAH
shlokas.33:
athAnyonyasya sa.nyogAchchAturvarNyasya bhArata |
goptAraH sa~NgrahItAro dAtAraH kShatriyAH smRRitAH
shlokas.34:
yAjanAdhyApanairviprA vishuddhaishcha pratigrahaiH |
lokasyAnugrahArthAya sthApitA brahmaNA bhuvi
shlokas.35:
kRRiShishcha pAshupAlyaM cha vishAM dAnaM cha sarvashaH |
brahmakShatravishAM shUdrA vihitAH parichArakAH
shlokas.36:
brahmakShatrasya vihitAH sUtA vai parichArakAH |
na viTshUdrasya tatraiva shRRiNu vAkyaM mamAnagha
shlokas.37:
so.ahaM mUrdhAvasiktaH sanrAjarShikulasambhavaH |
mahArathaH samAkhyAtaH sevyaH stavyashcha bandinAm
shlokas.38:
so.ahametAdRRisho bhUtvA nehArikulamardana |
sUtaputrasya sa~NgrAme sArathyaM kartumutsahe
shlokas.39:
avamAnamahaM prApya na yotsyAmi katha~nchana |
ApRRichChya tvAdya gAndhAre gamiShyAmi yathAgatam
shlokas.40:
evamuktvA naravyAghraH shalyaH samitishobhanaH |
utthAya prayayau tUrNaM rAjamadhyAdamarShitaH
shlokas.41:
praNayAdbahumAnAchcha taM nigRRihya sutastava |
abravInmadhuraM vAkyaM sAma sarvArthasAdhakam
shlokas.42:
yathA shalya tvamAtthedamevametadasa.nshayam |
abhiprAyastu me kashchittaM nibodha janeshvara
shlokas.43:
na karNo.abhyadhikastvattaH sha~Nke naiva katha~nchana |
na hi madreshvaro rAjA kuryAdyadanRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.44:
RRitameva hi pUrvAste vahanti puruShottamAH |
tasmAdArtAyaniH prokto bhavAniti matirmama
shlokas.45:
shalyabhUtashcha shatrUNAM yasmAttvaM bhuvi mAnada |
tasmAchChalyeti te nAma kathyate pRRithivIpate
shlokas.46:
yadeva vyAhRRitaM pUrvaM bhavatA bhUridakShiNa |
tadeva kuru dharmaj~na madarthaM yadyaduchyase
shlokas.47:
na cha tvatto hi rAdheyo na chAhamapi vIryavAn |
vRRiNImastvAM hayAgryANAM yantAramiti sa.nyuge
shlokas.48:
yathA hyabhyadhikaM karNaM guNaistAta dhana~njayAt |
vAsudevAdapi tvAM cha loko.ayamiti manyate
shlokas.49:
karNo hyabhyadhikaH pArthAdastraireva nararShabha |
bhavAnapyadhikaH kRRiShNAdashvayAne bale tathA
shlokas.50:
yathAshvahRRidayaM veda vAsudevo mahAmanAH |
dviguNaM tvaM tathA vettha madrarAja na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.51:
shalya uvAcha||
yanmA bravIShi gAndhAre madhye sainyasya kaurava |
vishiShTaM devakIputrAtprItimAnasmyahaM tvayi
shlokas.52:
eSha sArathyamAtiShThe rAdheyasya yashasvinaH |
yudhyataH pANDavAgryeNa yathA tvaM vIra manyase
shlokas.53:
samayashcha hi me vIra kashchidvaikartanaM prati |
utsRRijeyaM yathAshraddhamahaM vAcho.asya saMnidhau
shlokas.54:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatheti rAjanputraste saha karNena bhArata |
abravInmadrarAjasya sutaM bharatasattama

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
bhUya eva tu madresha yatte vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu |
yathA purA vRRittamidaM yuddhe devAsure vibho
shlokas.2:
yaduktavAnpiturmahyaM mArkaNDeyo mahAnRRiShiH |
tadasheSheNa bruvato mama rAjarShisattama
tvaM nibodha na chApyatra kartavyA te vichAraNA
shlokas.3:
devAnAmasurANAM cha mahAnAsItsamAgamaH |
babhUva prathamo rAjansa~NgrAmastArakAmayaH
nirjitAshcha tadA daityA daivatairiti naH shrutam
shlokas.4:
nirjiteShu cha daityeShu tArakasya sutAstrayaH |
tArAkShaH kamalAkShashcha vidyunmAlI cha pArthiva
shlokas.5:
tapa ugraM samAsthAya niyame parame sthitAH |
tapasA karshayAmAsurdehAnsvA~nshatrutApana
shlokas.6:
damena tapasA chaiva niyamena cha pArthiva |
teShAM pitAmahaH prIto varadaH pradadau varAn
shlokas.7:
avadhyatvaM cha te rAjansarvabhUteShu sarvadA |
sahitA varayAmAsuH sarvalokapitAmaham
shlokas.8:
tAnabravIttadA devo lokAnAM prabhurIshvaraH |
nAsti sarvAmaratvaM hi nivartadhvamato.asurAH
varamanyaM vRRiNIdhvaM vai yAdRRishaM samprarochate
shlokas.9:
tataste sahitA rAjansampradhAryAsakRRidbahu |
sarvalokeshvaraM vAkyaM praNamyainamathAbruvan
shlokas.10:
asmAkaM tvaM varaM deva prayachChemaM pitAmaha |
vayaM purANi trINyeva samAsthAya mahImimAm
vichariShyAma loke.asmi.nstvatprasAdapuraskRRitAH
shlokas.11:
tato varShasahasre tu sameShyAmaH parasparam |
ekIbhAvaM gamiShyanti purANyetAni chAnagha
shlokas.12:
samAgatAni chaitAni yo hanyAdbhagava.nstadA |
ekeShuNA devavaraH sa no mRRityurbhaviShyati
evamastviti tAndevaH pratyuktvA prAvishaddivam
shlokas.13:
te tu labdhavarAH prItAH sampradhArya parasparam |
puratrayavisRRiShTyarthaM mayaM vavrurmahAsuram
vishvakarmANamajaraM daityadAnavapUjitam
shlokas.14:
tato mayaH svatapasA chakre dhImAnpurANi ha |
trINi kA~nchanamekaM tu raupyaM kArShNAyasaM tathA
shlokas.15:
kA~nchanaM divi tatrAsIdantarikShe cha rAjatam |
AyasaM chAbhavadbhUmau chakrasthaM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.16:
ekaikaM yojanashataM vistArAyAmasaMmitam |
gRRihATTATTAlakayutaM bRRihatprAkAratoraNam
shlokas.17:
guNaprasavasambAdhamasambAdhamanAmayam |
prAsAdairvividhaishchaiva dvAraishchApyupashobhitam
shlokas.18:
pureShu chAbhavanrAjanrAjAno vai pRRithakpRRithak |
kA~nchanaM tArakAkShasya chitramAsInmahAtmanaH
rAjataM kamalAkShasya vidyunmAlina Ayasam
shlokas.19:
trayaste daityarAjAnastrI.NllokAnAshu tejasA |
Akramya tasthurvarShANAM pUgAnnAma prajApatiH
shlokas.20:
teShAM dAnavamukhyAnAM prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
koTyashchAprativIrANAM samAjagmustatastataH
mahadaishvaryamichChantastripuraM durgamAshritAH
shlokas.21:
sarveShAM cha punasteShAM sarvayogavaho mayaH |
tamAshritya hi te sarve avartantAkutobhayAH
shlokas.22:
yo hi yaM manasA kAmaM dadhyau tripurasa.nshrayaH |
tasmai kAmaM mayastaM taM vidadhe mAyayA tadA
shlokas.23:
tArakAkShasutashchAsIddharirnAma mahAbalaH |
tapastepe paramakaM yenAtuShyatpitAmahaH
shlokas.24:
sa tuShTamavRRiNoddevaM vApI bhavatu naH pure |
shastrairvinihatA yatra kShiptAH syurbalavattarAH
shlokas.25:
sa tu labdhvA varaM vIrastArakAkShasuto hariH |
sasRRije tatra vApIM tAM mRRitAnAM jIvanIM prabho
shlokas.26:
yena rUpeNa daityastu yena veSheNa chaiva ha |
mRRitastasyAM parikShiptastAdRRishenaiva jaj~nivAn
shlokas.27:
tAM prApya traipurasthAstu sarvA.NllokAnbabAdhire |
mahatA tapasA siddhAH surANAM bhayavardhanAH
na teShAmabhavadrAjankShayo yuddhe katha~nchana
shlokas.28:
tataste lobhamohAbhyAmabhibhUtA vichetasaH |
nirhrIkAH sa.nsthitiM sarve sthApitAM samalUlupan
shlokas.29:
vidrAvya sagaNAndevA.nstatra tatra tadA tadA |
vicheruH svena kAmena varadAnena darpitAH
shlokas.30:
devAraNyAni sarvANi priyANi cha divaukasAm |
RRiShINAmAshramAnpuNyAnyUpA~njanapadA.nstathA
vyanAshayanta maryAdA dAnavA duShTachAriNaH
shlokas.31:
te devAH sahitAH sarve pitAmahamari.ndama |
abhijagmustadAkhyAtuM viprakAraM suretaraiH
shlokas.32:
te tattvaM sarvamAkhyAya shirasAbhipraNamya cha |
vadhopAyamapRRichChanta bhagavantaM pitAmaham
shlokas.33:
shrutvA tadbhagavAndevo devAnidamuvAcha ha |
asurAshcha durAtmAnaste chApi vibudhadviShaH
aparAdhyanti satataM ye yuShmAnpIDayantyuta
shlokas.34:
ahaM hi tulyaH sarveShAM bhUtAnAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
adhArmikAstu hantavyA ityahaM prabravImi vaH
shlokas.35:
te yUyaM sthANumIshAnaM jiShNumakliShTakAriNam |
yoddhAraM vRRiNutAdityAH sa tAnhantA suretarAn
shlokas.36:
iti tasya vachaH shrutvA devAH shakrapurogamAH |
brahmANamagrataH kRRitvA vRRiShA~NkaM sharaNaM yayuH
shlokas.37:
tapaH paraM samAtasthurgRRiNanto brahma shAshvatam |
RRiShibhiH saha dharmaj~nA bhavaM sarvAtmanA gatAH
shlokas.38:
tuShTuvurvAgbhirarthyAbhirbhayeShvabhayakRRittamam |
sarvAtmAnaM mahAtmAnaM yenAptaM sarvamAtmanA
shlokas.39:
tapovisheShairbahubhiryogaM yo veda chAtmanaH |
yaH sA~NkhyamAtmano veda yasya chAtmA vashe sadA
shlokas.40:
te taM dadRRishurIshAnaM tejorAshimumApatim |
ananyasadRRishaM loke vratavantamakalmaSham
shlokas.41:
ekaM cha bhagavantaM te nAnArUpamakalpayan |
AtmanaH pratirUpANi rUpANyatha mahAtmani
parasparasya chApashyansarve paramavismitAH
shlokas.42:
sarvabhUtamayaM cheshaM tamajaM jagataH patim |
devA brahmarShayashchaiva shirobhirdharaNIM gatAH
shlokas.43:
tAnsvastivAkyenAbhyarchya samutthApya cha sha~NkaraH |
brUta brUteti bhagavAnsmayamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.44:
tryambakeNAbhyanuj~nAtAstataste.asvasthachetasaH |
namo namaste.astu vibho tata ityabruvanbhavam
shlokas.45:
namo devAtidevAya dhanvine chAtimanyave |
prajApatimakhaghnAya prajApatibhirIDyase
shlokas.46:
namaH stutAya stutyAya stUyamAnAya mRRityave |
vilohitAya rudrAya nIlagrIvAya shUline
shlokas.47:
amoghAya mRRigAkShAya pravarAyudhayodhine |
durvAraNAya shukrAya brahmaNe brahmachAriNe
shlokas.48:
IshAnAyAprameyAya niyantre charmavAsase |
taponityAya pi~NgAya vratine kRRittivAsase
shlokas.49:
kumArapitre tryakShAya pravarAyudhadhAriNe |
prapannArtivinAshAya brahmadviTsa~NghaghAtine
shlokas.50:
vanaspatInAM pataye narANAM pataye namaH |
gavAM cha pataye nityaM yaj~nAnAM pataye namaH
shlokas.51:
namo.astu te sasainyAya tryambakAyogratejase |
manovAkkarmabhirdeva tvAM prapannAnbhajasva naH
shlokas.52:
tataH prasanno bhagavAnsvAgatenAbhinandya tAn |
provAcha vyetu vastrAso brUta kiM karavANi vaH
shlokas.53:
pitRRidevarShisa~Nghebhyo vare datte mahAtmanA |
satkRRitya sha~NkaraM prAha brahmA lokahitaM vachaH
shlokas.54:
tavAtisargAddevesha prAjApatyamidaM padam |
mayAdhitiShThatA datto dAnavebhyo mahAnvaraH
shlokas.55:
tAnatikrAntamaryAdAnnAnyaH saMhartumarhati |
tvAmRRite bhUtabhavyesha tvaM hyeShAM pratyarirvadhe
shlokas.56:
sa tvaM deva prapannAnAM yAchatAM cha divaukasAm |
kuru prasAdaM devesha dAnavA~njahi shUlabhRRit
shlokas.57:
shrIbhagavAnuvAcha||
hantavyAH shatravaH sarve yuShmAkamiti me matiH |
na tveko.ahaM vadhe teShAM samartho vai suradviShAm
shlokas.58:
te yUyaM sahitAH sarve madIyenAstratejasA |
jayadhvaM yudhi tA~nshatrUnsa~NghAto hi mahAbalaH
shlokas.59:
devA UchuH||
asmattejobalaM yAvattAvaddviguNameva cha |
teShAmiti ha manyAmo dRRiShTatejobalA hi te
shlokas.60:
bhagavAnuvAcha||
vadhyAste sarvataH pApA ye yuShmAsvaparAdhinaH |
mama tejobalArdhena sarvA.nstAnghnata shAtravAn
shlokas.61:
devA UchuH||
bibhartuM tejaso.ardhaM te na shakShyAmo maheshvara |
sarveShAM no balArdhena tvameva jahi shAtravAn
shlokas.62:
duryodhana uvAcha||
tatastatheti deveshastairukto rAjasattama |
ardhamAdAya sarvebhyastejasAbhyadhiko.abhavat
shlokas.63:
sa tu devo balenAsItsarvebhyo balavattaraH |
mahAdeva iti khyAtastadAprabhRRiti sha~NkaraH
shlokas.64:
tato.abravInmahAdevo dhanurbANadharastvaham |
haniShyAmi rathenAjau tAnripUnvai divaukasaH
shlokas.65:
te yUyaM me rathaM chaiva dhanurbANaM tathaiva cha |
pashyadhvaM yAvadadyaitAnpAtayAmi mahItale
shlokas.66:
devA UchuH||
mUrtisarvasvamAdAya trailokyasya tatastataH |
rathaM te kalpayiShyAma deveshvara mahaujasam
shlokas.67:
tathaiva buddhyA vihitaM vishvakarmakRRitaM shubham |
tato vibudhashArdUlAstaM rathaM samakalpayan
shlokas.68:
vandhuraM pRRithivIM devIM vishAlapuramAlinIm |
saparvatavanadvIpAM chakrurbhUtadharAM tadA
shlokas.69:
mandaraM parvataM chAkShaM ja~NghAstasya mahAnadIH |
dishashcha pradishashchaiva parivAraM rathasya hi
shlokas.70:
anukarShAngrahAndIptAnvarUthaM chApi tArakAH |
dharmArthakAmasa.nyuktaM triveNuM chApi bandhuram
oShadhIrvividhAstatra nAnApuShpaphalodgamAH
shlokas.71:
sUryAchandramasau kRRitvA chakre rathavarottame |
pakShau pUrvAparau tatra kRRite rAtryahanI shubhe
shlokas.72:
dasha nAgapatInIShAM dhRRitarAShTramukhAndRRiDhAm |
dyAM yugaM yugacharmANi sa.nvartakabalAhakAn
shlokas.73:
shamyAM dhRRitiM cha medhAM cha sthitiM saMnatimeva cha |
grahanakShatratArAbhishcharma chitraM nabhastalam
shlokas.74:
surAmbupretavittAnAM patI.NllokeshvarAnhayAn |
sinIvAlImanumatiM kuhUM rAkAM cha suvratAm
yoktrANi chakrurvAhAnAM rohakA.nshchApi kaNThakam
shlokas.75:
karma satyaM tapo.arthashcha vihitAstatra rashmayaH |
adhiShThAnaM manastvAsItparirathyaM sarasvatI
shlokas.76:
nAnAvarNAshcha chitrAshcha patAkAH pavaneritAH |
vidyudindradhanurnaddhaM rathaM dIptaM vyadIpayat
shlokas.77:
evaM tasminmahArAja kalpite rathasattame |
devairmanujashArdUla dviShatAmabhimardane
shlokas.78:
svAnyAyudhAni mukhyAni nyadadhAchCha~Nkaro rathe |
rathayaShTiM viyatkRRiShTAM sthApayAmAsa govRRiSham
shlokas.79:
brahmadaNDaH kAladaNDo rudradaNDastathA jvaraH |
pariskandA rathasyAsya sarvatodishamudyatAH
shlokas.80:
atharvA~NgirasAvAstAM chakrarakShau mahAtmanaH |
RRigvedaH sAmavedashcha purANaM cha puraHsarAH
shlokas.81:
itihAsayajurvedau pRRiShTharakShau babhUvatuH |
divyA vAchashcha vidyAshcha paripArshvacharAH kRRitAH
shlokas.82:
tottrAdayashcha rAjendra vaShaTkArastathaiva cha |
o~NkArashcha mukhe rAjannatishobhAkaro.abhavat
shlokas.83:
vichitramRRitubhiH ShaDbhiH kRRitvA sa.nvatsaraM dhanuH |
tasmAnnR^INAM kAlarAtrirjyA kRRitA dhanuSho.ajarA
shlokas.84:
iShushchApyabhavadviShNurjvalanaH soma eva cha |
agnIShomau jagatkRRitsnaM vaiShNavaM chochyate jagat
shlokas.85:
viShNushchAtmA bhagavato bhavasyAmitatejasaH |
tasmAddhanurjyAsa.nsparshaM na viShehurharasya te
shlokas.87:
sa nIlalohito dhUmraH kRRittivAsA bhaya~NkaraH |
AdityAyutasa~NkAshastejojvAlAvRRito jvalan
shlokas.88:
dushchyAvashchyAvano jetA hantA brahmadviShAM haraH |
nityaM trAtA cha hantA cha dharmAdharmAshritA~njanAn
shlokas.90:
tasyA~NgAni samAshritya sthitaM vishvamidaM jagat |
ja~NgamAja~NgamaM rAja~nshushubhe.adbhutadarshanam
shlokas.91:
dRRiShTvA tu taM rathaM divyaM kavachI sa sharAsanI |
bANamAdatta taM divyaM somaviShNvagnisambhavam
shlokas.92:
tasya vAjA.nstato devAH kalpayAM chakrire vibhoH |
puNyagandhavahaM rAja~nshvasanaM rAjasattama
shlokas.93:
tamAsthAya mahAdevastrAsayandaivatAnyapi |
Aruroha tadA yattaH kampayanniva rodasI
shlokas.94:
sa shobhamAno varadaH khaDgI bANI sharAsanI |
hasannivAbravIddevo sArathiH ko bhaviShyati
shlokas.95:
tamabruvandevagaNA yaM bhavAnsaMniyokShyate |
sa bhaviShyati devesha sArathiste na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.96:
tAnabravItpunardevo mattaH shreShThataro hi yaH |
taM sArathiM kurudhvaM me svayaM sa~nchintya mAchiram
shlokas.97:
etachChrutvA tato devA vAkyamuktaM mahAtmanA |
gatvA pitAmahaM devaM prasAdyaivaM vacho.abruvan
shlokas.98:
deva tvayedaM kathitaM tridashArinibarhaNam |
tathA cha kRRitamasmAbhiH prasanno vRRiShabhadhvajaH
shlokas.99:
rathashcha vihito.asmAbhirvichitrAyudhasa.nvRRitaH |
sArathiM tu na jAnImaH kaH syAttasminrathottame
shlokas.100:
tasmAdvidhIyatAM kashchitsArathirdevasattama |
saphalAM tAM giraM deva kartumarhasi no vibho
shlokas.101:
evamasmAsu hi purA bhagavannuktavAnasi |
hitaM kartAsmi bhavatAmiti tatkartumarhasi
shlokas.102:
sa deva yukto rathasattamo no; durAvaro drAvaNaH shAtravANAm |
pinAkapANirvihito.atra yoddhA; vibhIShayandAnavAnudyato.asau
shlokas.103:
tathaiva vedAshchaturo hayAgryA; dharA sashailA cha ratho mahAtman |
nakShatrava.nsho.anugato varUthe; yasminyoddhA sArathinAbhirakShyaH
shlokas.104:
tatra sArathireShTavyaH sarvairetairvisheShavAn |
tatpratiShTho ratho deva hayA yoddhA tathaiva cha
kavachAni cha shastrANi kArmukaM cha pitAmaha
shlokas.105:
tvAmRRite sArathiM tatra nAnyaM pashyAmahe vayam |
tvaM hi sarvairguNairyukto devatAbhyo.adhikaH prabho
sArathye tUrNamAroha sa.nyachCha paramAnhayAn
shlokas.106:
iti te shirasA natvA trilokeshaM pitAmaham |
devAH prasAdayAmAsuH sArathyAyeti naH shrutam
shlokas.107:
brahmovAcha||
nAtra ki~nchinmRRiShA vAkyaM yaduktaM vo divaukasaH |
sa.nyachChAmi hayAneSha yudhyato vai kapardinaH
shlokas.108:
tataH sa bhagavAndevo lokasraShTA pitAmahaH |
sArathye kalpito devairIshAnasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.109:
tasminnArohati kShipraM syandanaM lokapUjite |
shirobhiragama.nstUrNaM te hayA vAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.111:
maheshvare tvAruhati jAnubhyAmagamanmahIm |
abhIshUnhi trilokeshaH sa~NgRRihya prapitAmahaH |
tAnashvA.nshchodayAmAsa manomArutaraMhasaH
shlokas.112:
tato.adhirUDhe varade prayAte chAsurAnprati |
sAdhu sAdhviti vishveshaH smayamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.113:
yAhi deva yato daityAshchodayAshvAnatandritaH |
pashya bAhvorbalaM me.adya nighnataH shAtravAnraNe
shlokas.115:
athAdhijyaM dhanuH kRRitvA sharvaH sandhAya taM sharam |
yuktvA pAshupatAstreNa tripuraM samachintayat
shlokas.116:
tasminsthite tadA rAjankruddhe vidhRRitakArmuke |
purANi tAni kAlena jagmurekatvatAM tadA
shlokas.117:
ekIbhAvaM gate chaiva tripure samupAgate |
babhUva tumulo harSho daivatAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.118:
tato devagaNAH sarve siddhAshcha paramarShayaH |
jayeti vAcho mumuchuH sa.nstuvanto mudAnvitAH
shlokas.120:
sa tadvikRRiShya bhagavAndivyaM lokeshvaro dhanuH |
trailokyasAraM tamiShuM mumocha tripuraM prati
tatsAsuragaNaM dagdhvA prAkShipatpashchimArNave
shlokas.121:
evaM tattripuraM dagdhaM dAnavAshchApyasheShataH |
maheshvareNa kruddhena trailokyasya hitaiShiNA
shlokas.122:
sa chAtmakrodhajo vahnirhAhetyuktvA nivAritaH |
mA kArShIrbhasmasAllokAniti tryakSho.abravIchcha tam
shlokas.123:
tataH prakRRitimApannA devA lokAstatharShayaH |
tuShTuvurvAgbhirarthyAbhiH sthANumapratimaujasam
shlokas.124:
te.anuj~nAtA bhagavatA jagmuH sarve yathAgatam |
kRRitakAmAH prasannena prajApatimukhAH surAH
shlokas.125:
yathaiva bhagavAnbrahmA lokadhAtA pitAmahaH |
sa.nyachCha tvaM hayAnasya rAdheyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.126:
tvaM hi kRRiShNAchcha karNAchcha phalgunAchcha visheShataH |
vishiShTo rAjashArdUla nAsti tatra vichAraNA
shlokas.127:
yuddhe hyayaM rudrakalpastvaM cha brahmasamo.anagha |
tasmAchChaktau yuvAM jetuM machChatrU.nstAvivAsurAn
shlokas.128:
yathA shalyAdya karNo.ayaM shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim |
pramathya hanyAtkaunteyaM tathA shIghraM vidhIyatAm
tvayi karNashcha rAjyaM cha vayaM chaiva pratiShThitAH
shlokas.129:
imaM chApyaparaM bhUya itihAsaM nibodha me |
piturmama sakAshe yaM brAhmaNaH prAha dharmavit
shlokas.130:
shrutvA chaitadvachashchitraM hetukAryArthasaMhitam |
kuru shalya vinishchitya mA bhUdatra vichAraNA
shlokas.131:
bhArgavANAM kule jAto jamadagnirmahAtapAH |
tasya rAmeti vikhyAtaH putrastejoguNAnvitaH
shlokas.132:
sa tIvraM tapa AsthAya prasAdayitavAnbhavam |
astrahetoH prasannAtmA niyataH sa.nyatendriyaH
shlokas.133:
tasya tuShTo mahAdevo bhaktyA cha prashamena cha |
hRRidgataM chAsya vij~nAya darshayAmAsa sha~NkaraH
shlokas.134:
Ishvara uvAcha||
rAma tuShTo.asmi bhadraM te viditaM me tavepsitam |
kuruShva pUtamAtmAnaM sarvametadavApsyasi
shlokas.135:
dAsyAmi te tadAstrANi yadA pUto bhaviShyasi |
apAtramasamarthaM cha dahantyastrANi bhArgava
shlokas.136:
ityukto jAmadagnyastu devadevena shUlinA |
pratyuvAcha mahAtmAnaM shirasAvanataH prabhum
shlokas.137:
yadA jAnAsi devesha pAtraM mAmastradhAraNe |
tadA shushrUShate.astrANi bhavAnme dAtumarhati
shlokas.138:
duryodhana uvAcha||
tataH sa tapasA chaiva damena niyamena cha |
pUjopahArabalibhirhomamantrapuraskRRitaiH
shlokas.139:
ArAdhayitavA~nsharvaM bahUnvarShagaNA.nstadA |
prasannashcha mahAdevo bhArgavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.140:
abravIttasya bahusho guNAndevyAH samIpataH |
bhaktimAneSha satataM mayi rAmo dRRiDhavrataH
shlokas.141:
evaM tasya guNAnprIto bahusho.akathayatprabhuH |
devatAnAM pitR^INAM cha samakShamarisUdanaH
shlokas.142:
etasminneva kAle tu daityA AsanmahAbalAH |
taistadA darpamohAndhairabAdhyanta divaukasaH
shlokas.143:
tataH sambhUya vibudhAstAnhantuM kRRitanishchayAH |
chakruH shatruvadhe yatnaM na shekurjetumeva te
shlokas.144:
abhigamya tato devA maheshvaramathAbruvan |
prasAdayantastaM bhaktyA jahi shatrugaNAniti
shlokas.145:
pratij~nAya tato devo devatAnAM ripukShayam |
rAmaM bhArgavamAhUya so.abhyabhAShata sha~NkaraH
shlokas.146:
ripUnbhArgava devAnAM jahi sarvAnsamAgatAn |
lokAnAM hitakAmArthaM matprItyarthaM tathaiva cha
shlokas.147:
rAma uvAcha||
akRRitAstrasya devesha kA shaktirme maheshvara |
nihantuM dAnavAnsarvAnkRRitAstrAnyuddhadurmadAn
shlokas.148:
Ishvara uvAcha||
gachCha tvaM madanudhyAnAnnihaniShyasi dAnavAn |
vijitya cha ripUnsarvAnguNAnprApsyasi puShkalAn
shlokas.149:
duryodhana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA cha vachanaM pratigRRihya cha sarvashaH |
rAmaH kRRitasvastyayanaH prayayau dAnavAnprati
shlokas.151:
sa dAnavaiH kShatatanurjAmadagnyo dvijottamaH |
sa.nspRRiShTaH sthANunA sadyo nirvraNaH samajAyata
shlokas.152:
prItashcha bhagavAndevaH karmaNA tena tasya vai |
varAnprAdAdbrahmavide bhArgavAya mahAtmane
shlokas.153:
uktashcha devadevena prItiyuktena shUlinA |
nipAtAttava shastrANAM sharIre yAbhavadrujA
shlokas.154:
tayA te mAnuShaM karma vyapoDhaM bhRRigunandana |
gRRihANAstrANi divyAni matsakAshAdyathepsitam
shlokas.155:
tato.astrANi samastAni varA.nshcha manasepsitAn |
labdhvA bahuvidhAnrAmaH praNamya shirasA shivam
shlokas.156:
anuj~nAM prApya deveshAjjagAma sa mahAtapAH |
evametatpurAvRRittaM tadA kathitavAnRRiShiH
shlokas.157:
bhArgavo.apyadadAtsarvaM dhanurvedaM mahAtmane |
karNAya puruShavyAghra suprItenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.158:
vRRijinaM hi bhavetki~nchidyadi karNasya pArthiva |
nAsmai hyastrANi divyAni prAdAsyadbhRRigunandanaH
shlokas.159:
nApi sUtakule jAtaM karNaM manye katha~nchana |
devaputramahaM manye kShatriyANAM kulodbhavam
shlokas.160:
sakuNDalaM sakavachaM dIrghabAhuM mahAratham |
kathamAdityasadRRishaM mRRigI vyAghraM janiShyati
shlokas.161:
pashya hyasya bhujau pInau nAgarAjakaropamau |
