vakShaH pashya vishAlaM cha sarvashatrunibarhaNam

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
evaM sa bhagavAndevaH sarvalokapitAmahaH |
sArathyamakarottatra yatra rudro.abhavadrathI
shlokas.2:
rathinAbhyadhiko vIraH kartavyo rathasArathiH |
tasmAttvaM puruShavyAghra niyachCha turagAnyudhi
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH shalyaH pariShvajya sutaM te vAkyamabravIt |
duryodhanamamitraghnaH prIto madrAdhipastadA
shlokas.4:
evaM chenmanyase rAjangAndhAre priyadarshana |
tasmAtte yatpriyaM ki~nchittatsarvaM karavANyaham
shlokas.5:
yatrAsmi bharatashreShTha yogyaH karmaNi karhichit |
tatra sarvAtmanA yukto vakShye kAryadhuraM tava
shlokas.6:
yattu karNamahaM brUyAM hitakAmaH priyApriyam |
mama tatkShamatAM sarvaM bhavAnkarNashcha sarvashaH
shlokas.7:
karNa uvAcha||
IshAnasya yathA brahmA yathA pArthasya keshavaH |
tathA nityaM hite yukto madrarAja bhajasva naH
shlokas.8:
shalya uvAcha||
AtmanindAtmapUjA cha paranindA parastavaH |
anAcharitamAryANAM vRRittametachchaturvidham
shlokas.9:
yattu vidvanpravakShyAmi pratyayArthamahaM tava |
AtmanaH stavasa.nyuktaM tannibodha yathAtatham
shlokas.10:
ahaM shakrasya sArathye yogyo mAtalivatprabho |
apramAdaprayogAchcha j~nAnavidyAchikitsitaiH
shlokas.11:
tataH pArthena sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnasya te.anagha |
vAhayiShyAmi turagAnvijvaro bhava sUtaja

shlokas.1:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ayaM te karNa sArathyaM madrarAjaH kariShyati |
kRRiShNAdabhyadhiko yantA devendrasyeva mAtaliH
shlokas.2:
yathA harihayairyuktaM sa~NgRRihNAti sa mAtaliH |
shalyastava tathAdyAyaM sa.nyantA rathavAjinAm
shlokas.3:
yodhe tvayi rathasthe cha madrarAje cha sArathau |
rathashreShTho dhruvaM sa~Nkhye pArtho nAbhibhaviShyati
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano bhUyo madrarAjaM tarasvinam |
uvAcha rAjansa~NgrAme sa.nyachChantaM hayottamAn
shlokas.5:
tvayAbhigupto rAdheyo vijeShyati dhana~njayam |
ityukto rathamAsthAya tatheti prAha bhArata
shlokas.6:
shalye.abhyupagate karNaH sArathiM sumano.abravIt |
svaM sUta syandanaM mahyaM kalpayetyasakRRittvaran
shlokas.7:
tato jaitraM rathavaraM gandharvanagaropamam |
vidhivatkalpitaM bhartre jayetyuktvA nyavedayat
shlokas.8:
taM rathaM rathinAM shreShThaH karNo.abhyarchya yathAvidhi |
sampAditaM brahmavidA pUrvameva purodhasA
shlokas.9:
kRRitvA pradakShiNaM yatnAdupasthAya cha bhAskaram |
samIpasthaM madrarAjaM samAropayadagrataH
shlokas.10:
tataH karNasya durdharShaM syandanapravaraM mahat |
Aruroha mahAtejAH shalyaH siMha ivAchalam
shlokas.11:
tataH shalyAsthitaM rAjankarNaH svarathamuttamam |
adhyatiShThadyathAmbhodaM vidyutvantaM divAkaraH
shlokas.12:
tAvekarathamArUDhAvAdityAgnisamatviShau |
vyabhrAjetAM yathA meghaM sUryAgnI sahitau divi
shlokas.13:
sa.nstUyamAnau tau vIrau tadAstAM dyutimattarau |
RRitviksadasyairindrAgnI hUyamAnAvivAdhvare
shlokas.14:
sa shalyasa~NgRRihItAshve rathe karNaH sthito.abhavat |
dhanurvisphArayanghoraM pariveShIva bhAskaraH
shlokas.15:
AsthitaH sa rathashreShThaM karNaH sharagabhastimAn |
prababhau puruShavyAghro mandarastha ivA.nshumAn
shlokas.16:
taM rathasthaM mahAvIraM yAntaM chAmitatejasam |
duryodhanaH sma rAdheyamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.17:
akRRitaM droNabhIShmAbhyAM duShkaraM karma sa.nyuge |
kuruShvAdhirathe vIra miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.18:
manogataM mama hyAsIdbhIShmadroNau mahArathau |
arjunaM bhImasenaM cha nihantArAviti dhruvam
shlokas.19:
tAbhyAM yadakRRitaM vIra vIrakarma mahAmRRidhe |
tatkarma kuru rAdheya vajrapANirivAparaH
shlokas.20:
gRRihANa dharmarAjaM vA jahi vA tvaM dhana~njayam |
bhImasenaM cha rAdheya mAdrIputrau yamAvapi
shlokas.21:
jayashcha te.astu bhadraM cha prayAhi puruSharShabha |
pANDuputrasya sainyAni kuru sarvANi bhasmasAt
shlokas.22:
tatastUryasahasrANi bherINAmayutAni cha |
vAdyamAnAnyarochanta meghashabdA yathA divi
shlokas.23:
pratigRRihya tu tadvAkyaM rathastho rathasattamaH |
abhyabhAShata rAdheyaH shalyaM yuddhavishAradam
shlokas.24:
chodayAshvAnmahAbAho yAvaddhanmi dhana~njayam |
bhImasenaM yamau chobhau rAjAnaM cha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.25:
adya pashyatu me shalya bAhuvIryaM dhana~njayaH |
asyataH ka~NkapatrANAM sahasrANi shatAni cha
shlokas.26:
adya kShepsyAmyahaM shalya sharAnparamatejanAn |
pANDavAnAM vinAshAya duryodhanajayAya cha
shlokas.27:
shalya uvAcha||
sUtaputra kathaM nu tvaM pANDavAnavamanyase |
sarvAstraj~nAnmaheShvAsAnsarvAneva mahArathAn
shlokas.28:
anivartino mahAbhAgAnajeyAnsatyavikramAn |
api sa~njanayeyurye bhayaM sAkShAchChatakratoH
shlokas.29:
yadA shroShyasi nirghoShaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH |
rAdheya gANDivasyAjau tadA naivaM vadiShyasi
shlokas.30:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
anAdRRitya tu tadvAkyaM madrarAjena bhAShitam |
drakShyasyadyetyavochadvai shalyaM karNo nareshvara
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTvA karNaM maheShvAsaM yuyutsuM samavasthitam |
chukrushuH kuravaH sarve hRRiShTarUpAH parantapa
shlokas.32:
tato dundubhighoSheNa bherINAM ninadena cha |
bANashabdaishcha vividhairgarjitaishcha tarasvinAm
niryayustAvakA yuddhe mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.33:
prayAte tu tataH karNe yodheShu muditeShu cha |
chachAla pRRithivI rAjanrarAsa cha suvisvaram
shlokas.34:
nishcharanto vyadRRishyanta sUryAtsapta mahAgrahAH |
ulkApAtashcha sa~njaj~ne dishAM dAhastathaiva cha
tathAshanyashcha sampeturvavurvAtAshcha dAruNAH
shlokas.35:
mRRigapakShigaNAshchaiva bahushaH pRRitanAM tava |
apasavyaM tadA chakrurvedayanto mahadbhayam
shlokas.36:
prasthitasya cha karNasya nipetusturagA bhuvi |
asthivarShaM cha patitamantarikShAdbhayAnakam
shlokas.37:
jajvalushchaiva shastrANi dhvajAshchaiva chakampire |
ashrUNi cha vyamu~nchanta vAhanAni vishAM pate
shlokas.38:
ete chAnye cha bahava utpAtAstatra mAriSha |
samutpeturvinAshAya kauravANAM sudAruNAH
shlokas.39:
na cha tAngaNayAmAsuH sarve te daivamohitAH |
prasthitaM sUtaputraM cha jayetyUchurnarA bhuvi
nirjitAnpANDavA.nshchaiva menire tava kauravAH
shlokas.40:
tato rathasthaH paravIrahantA; bhIShmadroNAvAttavIryau nirIkShya |
samajvaladbhArata pAvakAbho; vaikartano.asau rathaku~njaro vRRiShaH
shlokas.41:
sa shalyamAbhAShya jagAda vAkyaM; pArthasya karmApratimaM cha dRRiShTvA |
mAnena darpeNa cha dahyamAnaH; krodhena dIpyanniva niHshvasitvA
shlokas.42:
nAhaM mahendrAdapi vajrapANeH; kruddhAdbibhemyAttadhanU rathasthaH |
dRRiShTvA tu bhIShmapramukhA~nshayAnA;nna tveva mAM sthiratA sa~njahAti
shlokas.43:
mahendraviShNupratimAvaninditau; rathAshvanAgapravarapramAthinau |
avadhyakalpau nihatau yadA parai;stato mamAdyApi raNe.asti sAdhvasam
shlokas.44:
samIkShya sa~Nkhye.atibalAnnarAdhipai;rnarAshvamAta~NgarathA~nsharairhatAn |
kathaM na sarvAnahitAnraNe.avadhI;nmahAstravidbrAhmaNapu~Ngavo guruH
shlokas.45:
sa sa.nsmarandroNahavaM mahAhave; bravImi satyaM kuravo nibodhata |
na vo madanyaH prasahedraNe.arjunaM; kramAgataM mRRityumivograrUpiNam
shlokas.46:
shikShA prasAdashcha balaM dhRRitishcha; droNe mahAstrANi cha saMnatishcha |
sa chedagAnmRRityuvashaM mahAtmA; sarvAnanyAnAturAnadya manye
shlokas.47:
neha dhruvaM ki~nchidapi prachintyaM; vidurloke karmaNo.anityayogAt |
sUryodaye ko hi vimuktasa.nshayo; garvaM kurvItAdya gurau nipAtite
shlokas.48:
na nUnamastrANi balaM parAkramaH; kriyA sunItaM paramAyudhAni vA |
alaM manuShyasya sukhAya vartituM; tathA hi yuddhe nihataH parairguruH
shlokas.49:
hutAshanAdityasamAnatejasaM; parAkrame viShNupura.ndaropamam |
naye bRRihaspatyushanaHsamaM sadA; na chainamastraM tadapAtsuduHsaham
shlokas.50:
samprakruShTe ruditastrIkumAre; parAbhUte pauruShe dhArtarAShTre |
mayA kRRityamiti jAnAmi shalya; prayAhi tasmAddviShatAmanIkam
shlokas.51:
yatra rAjA pANDavaH satyasandho; vyavasthito bhImasenArjunau cha |
vAsudevaH sRRi~njayAH sAtyakishcha; yamau cha kastau viShahenmadanyaH
shlokas.52:
tasmAtkShipraM madrapate prayAhi; raNe pA~nchAlAnpANDavAnsRRi~njayA.nshcha |
tAnvA haniShyAmi sametya sa~Nkhye; yAsyAmi vA droNamukhAya manye
shlokas.53:
na tvevAhaM na gamiShyAmi madhyaM; teShAM shUrANAmiti mA shalya viddhi |
mitradroho marShaNIyo na me.ayaM; tyaktvA prANAnanuyAsyAmi droNam
shlokas.54:
prAj~nasya mUDhasya cha jIvitAnte; prANapramokSho.antakavaktragasya |
ato vidvannabhiyAsyAmi pArthaM; diShTaM na shakyaM vyativartituM vai
shlokas.55:
kalyANavRRittaH satataM hi rAja;nvaichitravIryasya suto mamAsIt |
tasyArthasiddhyarthamahaM tyajAmi; priyAnbhogAndustyajaM jIvitaM cha
shlokas.56:
vaiyAghracharmANamakUjanAkShaM; haimatrikoshaM rajatatriveNum |
rathaprabarhaM turagaprabarhai;ryuktaM prAdAnmahyamidaM hi rAmaH
shlokas.57:
dhanUMShi chitrANi nirIkShya shalya; dhvajaM gadAM sAyakA.nshchograrUpAn |
asiM cha dIptaM paramAyudhaM cha; sha~NkhaM cha shubhraM svanavantamugram
shlokas.58:
patAkinaM vajranipAtanisvanaM; sitAshvayuktaM shubhatUNashobhitam |
imaM samAsthAya rathaM ratharShabhaM; raNe haniShyAmyahamarjunaM balAt
shlokas.59:
taM chenmRRityuH sarvaharo.abhirakShate; sadApramattaH samare pANDuputram |
taM vA haniShyAmi sametya yuddhe; yAsyAmi vA bhIShmamukho yamAya
shlokas.60:
yamavaruNakuberavAsavA vA; yadi yugapatsagaNA mahAhave |
jugupiShava ihaitya pANDavaM; kimu bahunA saha tairjayAmi tam
shlokas.61:
iti raNarabhasasya katthata;stadupanishamya vachaH sa madrarAT |
avahasadavamanya vIryavA;npratiShiShidhe cha jagAda chottaram
shlokas.62:
virama virama karNa katthanA;datirabhaso.asyati chApyayuktavAk |
kva cha hi naravaro dhana~njayaH; kva punariha tvamupAramAbudha
shlokas.63:
yadusadanamupendrapAlitaM; tridivamivAmararAjarakShitam |
prasabhamiha vilokya ko hare;tpuruShavarAvarajAmRRite.arjunAt
shlokas.64:
tribhuvanasRRijamIshvareshvaraM; ka iha pumAnbhavamAhvayedyudhi |
mRRigavadhakalahe RRite.arjunA;tsurapativIryasamaprabhAvataH
shlokas.65:
asurasuramahoragAnnarA;ngaruDapishAchasayakSharAkShasAn |
iShubhirajayadagnigauravA;tsvabhilaShitaM cha havirdadau jayaH
shlokas.66:
smarasi nanu yadA parairhRRitaH; sa cha dhRRitarAShTrasuto vimokShitaH |
dinakaraja narottamairyadA; maruShu bahUnvinihatya tAnarIn
shlokas.67:
prathamamapi palAyite tvayi; priyakalahA dhRRitarAShTrasUnavaH |
smarasi nanu yadA pramochitAH; khacharagaNAnavajitya pANDavaiH
shlokas.68:
samuditabalavAhanAH punaH; puruShavareNa jitAH stha gograhe |
sagurugurusutAH sabhIShmakAH; kimu na jitaH sa tadA tvayArjunaH
shlokas.69:
idamaparamupasthitaM puna;stava nidhanAya suyuddhamadya vai |
yadi na ripubhayAtpalAyase; samaragato.adya hato.asi sUtaja
shlokas.70:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
iti bahuparuShaM prabhAShati; pramanasi madrapatau ripustavam |
bhRRishamatiruShitaH paraM vRRiShaH; kurupRRitanApatirAha madrapam
shlokas.71:
bhavatu bhavatu kiM vikatthase; nanu mama tasya cha yuddhamudyatam |
yadi sa jayati mAM mahAhave; tata idamastu sukatthitaM tava
shlokas.72:
evamastviti madresha uktvA nottaramuktavAn |
yAhi madresha chApyenaM karNaH prAha yuyutsayA
shlokas.73:
sa rathaH prayayau shatrU~nshvetAshvaH shalyasArathiH |
nighnannamitrAnsamare tamo ghnansavitA yathA
shlokas.74:
tataH prAyAtprItimAnvai rathena; vaiyAghreNa shvetayujAtha karNaH |
sa chAlokya dhvajinIM pANDavAnAM; dhana~njayaM tvarayA paryapRRichChat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prayAneva tadA karNo harShayanvAhinIM tava |
ekaikaM samare dRRiShTvA pANDavaM paryapRRichChata
shlokas.2:
yo mamAdya mahAtmAnaM darshayechChvetavAhanam |
tasmai dadyAmabhipretaM varaM yaM manasechChati
shlokas.3:
sa chettadabhimanyeta tasmai dadyAmahaM punaH |
shakaTaM ratnasampUrNaM yo me brUyAddhana~njayam
shlokas.4:
sa chettadabhimanyeta puruSho.arjunadarshivAn |
anyaM tasmai punardadyAM sauvarNaM hastiShaDgavam
shlokas.5:
tathA tasmai punardadyAM strINAM shatamala~NkRRitam |
shyAmAnAM niShkakaNThInAM gItavAdyavipashchitAm
shlokas.6:
sa chettadabhimanyeta puruSho.arjunadarshivAn |
anyaM tasmai varaM dadyAM shvetAnpa~nchashatAnhayAn
shlokas.7:
hemabhANDaparichChannAnsumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAn |
sudAntAnapi chaivAhaM dadyAmaShTashatAnparAn
shlokas.8:
rathaM cha shubhraM sauvarNaM dadyAM tasmai svala~NkRRitam |
yuktaM paramakAmbojairyo me brUyAddhana~njayam
shlokas.9:
anyaM tasmai varaM dadyAM ku~njarANAM shatAni ShaT |
kA~nchanairvividhairbhANDairAchChannAnhemamAlinaH
utpannAnaparAnteShu vinItAnhastishikShakaiH
shlokas.10:
sa chettadabhimanyeta puruSho.arjunadarshivAn |
anyaM tasmai varaM dadyAM yamasau kAmayetsvayam
shlokas.11:
putradArAnvihArA.nshcha yadanyadvittamasti me |
tachcha tasmai punardadyAM yadyatsa manasechChati
shlokas.12:
hatvA cha sahitau kRRiShNau tayorvittAni sarvashaH |
tasmai dadyAmahaM yo me prabrUyAtkeshavArjunau
shlokas.13:
etA vAchaH subahushaH karNa uchchArayanyudhi |
dadhmau sAgarasambhUtaM susvanaM sha~Nkhamuttamam
shlokas.14:
tA vAchaH sUtaputrasya tathA yuktA nishamya tu |
duryodhano mahArAja prahRRiShTaH sAnugo.abhavat
shlokas.15:
tato dundubhinirghoSho mRRida~NgAnAM cha sarvashaH |
siMhanAdaH savAditraH ku~njarANAM cha nisvanaH
shlokas.16:
prAdurAsIttadA rAja.nstvatsainye bharatarShabha |
yodhAnAM samprahRRiShTAnAM tathA samabhavatsvanaH
shlokas.17:
tathA prahRRiShTe sainye tu plavamAnaM mahAratham |
vikatthamAnaM samare rAdheyamarikarshanam
madrarAjaH prahasyedaM vachanaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.18:
mA sUtaputra mAnena sauvarNaM hastiShaDgavam |
prayachCha puruShAyAdya drakShyasi tvaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.19:
bAlyAdiva tvaM tyajasi vasu vaishravaNo yathA |
ayatnenaiva rAdheya draShTAsyadya dhana~njayam
shlokas.20:
parAsRRijasi mithyA kiM kiM cha tvaM bahu mUDhavat |
apAtradAne ye doShAstAnmohAnnAvabudhyase
shlokas.21:
yatpravedayase vittaM bahutvena khalu tvayA |
shakyaM bahuvidhairyaj~nairyaShTuM sUta yajasva taiH
shlokas.22:
yachcha prArthayase hantuM kRRiShNau mohAnmRRiShaiva tat |
na hi shushruma saMmarde kroShTrA siMhau nipAtitau
shlokas.23:
aprArthitaM prArthayase suhRRido na hi santi te |
ye tvAM na vArayantyAshu prapatantaM hutAshane
shlokas.24:
kAlakAryaM na jAnIShe kAlapakvo.asyasa.nshayam |
bahvabaddhamakarNIyaM ko hi brUyAjjijIviShuH
shlokas.25:
samudrataraNaM dorbhyAM kaNThe baddhvA yathA shilAm |
giryagrAdvA nipatanaM tAdRRiktava chikIrShitam
shlokas.26:
sahitaH sarvayodhaistvaM vyUDhAnIkaiH surakShitaH |
dhana~njayena yudhyasva shreyashchetprAptumichChasi
shlokas.27:
hitArthaM dhArtarAShTrasya bravImi tvA na hi.nsayA |
shraddhatsvaitanmayA proktaM yadi te.asti jijIviShA
shlokas.28:
karNa uvAcha||
svavIrye.ahaM parAshvasya prArthayAmyarjunaM raNe |
tvaM tu mitramukhaH shatrurmAM bhIShayitumichChasi
shlokas.29:
na mAmasmAdabhiprAyAtkashchidadya nivartayet |
apIndro vajramudyamya kiM nu martyaH kariShyati
shlokas.30:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
iti karNasya vAkyAnte shalyaH prAhottaraM vachaH |
chukopayiShuratyarthaM karNaM madreshvaraH punaH
shlokas.31:
yadA vai tvAM phalgunaveganunnA; jyAchoditA hastavatA visRRiShTAH |
anvetAraH ka~NkapatrAH shitAgrA;stadA tapsyasyarjunasyAbhiyogAt
shlokas.32:
yadA divyaM dhanurAdAya pArthaH; prabhAsayanpRRitanAM savyasAchI |
tvAmardayeta nishitaiH pRRiShatkai;stadA pashchAttapsyase sUtaputra
shlokas.33:
bAlashchandraM mAtura~Nke shayAno; yathA kashchitprArthayate.apahartum |
tadvanmohAdyatamAno rathastha;stvaM prArthayasyarjunamadya jetum
shlokas.34:
trishUlamAshliShya sutIkShNadhAraM; sarvANi gAtrANi nigharShasi tvam |
sutIkShNadhAropamakarmaNA tvaM; yuyutsase yo.arjunenAdya karNa
shlokas.35:
siddhaM siMhaM kesariNaM bRRihantaM; bAlo mUDhaH kShudramRRigastarasvI |
samAhvayettadvadetattavAdya; samAhvAnaM sUtaputrArjunasya
shlokas.36:
mA sUtaputrAhvaya rAjaputraM; mahAvIryaM kesariNaM yathaiva |
vane sRRigAlaH pishitasya tRRipto; mA pArthamAsAdya vina~NkShyasi tvam
shlokas.37:
IShAdantaM mahAnAgaM prabhinnakaraTAmukham |
shashakAhvayase yuddhe karNa pArthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.38:
bilasthaM kRRiShNasarpaM tvaM bAlyAtkAShThena vidhyasi |
mahAviShaM pUrNakoshaM yatpArthaM yoddhumichChasi
shlokas.39:
siMhaM kesariNaM kruddhamatikramyAbhinardasi |
sRRigAla iva mUDhatvAnnRRisiMhaM karNa pANDavam
shlokas.40:
suparNaM patagashreShThaM vainateyaM tarasvinam |
laTvevAhvayase pAte karNa pArthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.41:
sarvAmbhonilayaM bhImamUrmimantaM jhaShAyutam |
chandrodaye vivartantamaplavaH santitIrShasi
shlokas.42:
RRiShabhaM dundubhigrIvaM tIkShNashRRi~NgaM prahAriNam |
vatsa Ahvayase yuddhe karNa pArthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.43:
mahAghoShaM mahAmeghaM darduraH pratinardasi |
kAmatoyapradaM loke naraparjanyamarjunam
shlokas.44:
yathA cha svagRRihasthaH shvA vyAghraM vanagataM bhaShet |
tathA tvaM bhaShase karNa naravyAghraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.45:
sRRigAlo.api vane karNa shashaiH parivRRito vasan |
manyate siMhamAtmAnaM yAvatsiMhaM na pashyati
shlokas.46:
tathA tvamapi rAdheya siMhamAtmAnamichChasi |
apashya~nshatrudamanaM naravyAghraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.47:
vyAghraM tvaM manyase.a.atmAnaM yAvatkRRiShNau na pashyasi |
samAsthitAvekarathe sUryAchandramasAviva
shlokas.48:
yAvadgANDIvanirghoShaM na shRRiNoShi mahAhave |
tAvadeva tvayA karNa shakyaM vaktuM yathechChasi
shlokas.49:
rathashabdadhanuHshabdairnAdayantaM disho dasha |
nardantamiva shArdUlaM dRRiShTvA kroShTA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.50:
nityameva sRRigAlastvaM nityaM siMho dhana~njayaH |
vIrapradveShaNAnmUDha nityaM kroShTeva lakShyase
shlokas.51:
yathAkhuH syAdbiDAlashcha shvA vyAghrashcha balAbale |
yathA sRRigAlaH siMhashcha yathA cha shashaku~njarau
shlokas.52:
yathAnRRitaM cha satyaM cha yathA chApi viShAmRRite |
tathA tvamapi pArthashcha prakhyAtAvAtmakarmabhiH
shlokas.53:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
adhikShiptastu rAdheyaH shalyenAmitatejasA |
shalyamAha susa~Nkruddho vAkShalyamavadhArayan
shlokas.54:
guNAnguNavataH shalya guNavAnvetti nAguNaH |
tvaM tu nityaM guNairhInaH kiM j~nAsyasyaguNo guNAn
shlokas.55:
arjunasya mahAstrANi krodhaM vIryaM dhanuH sharAn |
ahaM shalyAbhijAnAmi na tvaM jAnAsi tattathA
shlokas.56:
evamevAtmano vIryamahaM vIryaM cha pANDave |
jAnannevAhvaye yuddhe shalya nAgniM pata~Ngavat
shlokas.57:
asti chAyamiShuH shalya supu~Nkho raktabhojanaH |
ekatUNIshayaH patrI sudhautaH samala~NkRRitaH
shlokas.58:
shete chandanapUrNena pUjito bahulAH samAH |
Aheyo viShavAnugro narAshvadvipasa~NghahA
shlokas.59:
ekavIro mahAraudrastanutrAsthividAraNaH |
nirbhindyAM yena ruShTo.ahamapi meruM mahAgirim
shlokas.60:
tamahaM jAtu nAsyeyamanyasminphalgunAdRRite |
kRRiShNAdvA devakIputrAtsatyaM chAtra shRRiNuShva me
shlokas.61:
tenAhamiShuNA shalya vAsudevadhana~njayau |
yotsye paramasa~Nkruddhastatkarma sadRRishaM mama
shlokas.62:
sarveShAM vAsudevAnAM kRRiShNe lakShmIH pratiShThitA |
sarveShAM pANDuputrANAM jayaH pArthe pratiShThitaH
ubhayaM tatsamAsAdya ko.ativartitumarhati
shlokas.63:
tAvetau puruShavyAghrau sametau syandane sthitau |
mAmekamabhisa.nyAtau sujAtaM shalya pashya me
shlokas.64:
pitRRiShvasAmAtulajau bhrAtarAvaparAjitau |
maNI sUtra iva protau draShTAsi nihatau mayA
shlokas.65:
arjune gANDivaM kRRiShNe chakraM tArkShyakapidhvajau |
bhIrUNAM trAsajananau shalya harShakarau mama
shlokas.66:
tvaM tu duShprakRRitirmUDho mahAyuddheShvakovidaH |
bhayAvatIrNaH santrAsAdabaddhaM bahu bhAShase
shlokas.67:
sa.nstauShi tvaM tu kenApi hetunA tau kudeshaja |
tau hatvA samare hantA tvAmaddhA sahabAndhavam
shlokas.68:
pApadeshaja durbuddhe kShudra kShatriyapA.nsana |
suhRRidbhUtvA ripuH kiM mAM kRRiShNAbhyAM bhIShayannasi
shlokas.69:
tau vA mamAdya hantArau hantAsmi samare sthitau |
nAhaM bibhemi kRRiShNAbhyAM vijAnannAtmano balam
shlokas.70:
vAsudevasahasraM vA phalgunAnAM shatAni cha |
ahameko haniShyAmi joShamAssva kudeshaja
shlokas.71:
striyo bAlAshcha vRRiddhAshcha prAyaH krIDAgatA janAH |
yA gAthAH sampragAyanti kurvanto.adhyayanaM yathA
tA gAthAH shRRiNu me shalya madrakeShu durAtmasu
shlokas.72:
brAhmaNaiH kathitAH pUrvaM yathAvadrAjasaMnidhau |
shrutvA chaikamanA mUDha kShama vA brUhi vottaram
shlokas.73:
mitradhru~Nmadrako nityaM yo no dveShTi sa madrakaH |
madrake sa~NgataM nAsti kShudravAkye narAdhame
shlokas.74:
durAtmA madrako nityaM nityaM chAnRRitiko.anRRijuH |
yAvadantaM hi daurAtmyaM madrakeShviti naH shrutam
shlokas.75:
pitA mAtA cha putrashcha shvashrUshvashuramAtulAH |
jAmAtA duhitA bhrAtA naptA te te cha bAndhavAH
shlokas.76:
vayasyAbhyAgatAshchAnye dAsIdAsaM cha sa~Ngatam |
pumbhirvimishrA nAryashcha j~nAtAj~nAtAH svayechChayA
shlokas.77:
yeShAM gRRiheShu shiShTAnAM saktumanthAshinAM sadA |
pItvA sIdhuM sagomA.nsaM nardanti cha hasanti cha
shlokas.78:
yAni chaivApyabaddhAni pravartante cha kAmataH |
kAmapralApino.anyonyaM teShu dharmaH kathaM bhavet
shlokas.79:
madrakeShu vilupteShu prakhyAtAshubhakarmasu |
nApi vairaM na sauhArdaM madrakeShu samAcharet
shlokas.80:
madrake sa~NgataM nAsti madrako hi sachApalaH |
madrakeShu cha duHsparshaM shauchaM gAndhArakeShu cha
shlokas.82:
rAjayAjakayAjyena naShTaM dattaM havirbhavet |
shUdrasa.nskArako vipro yathA yAti parAbhavam |
tathA brahmadviSho nityaM gachChantIha parAbhavam
shlokas.83:
madrake sa~NgataM nAsti hataM vRRishchikato viSham |
AtharvaNena mantreNa sarvA shAntiH kRRitA bhavet
shlokas.84:
iti vRRishchikadaShTasya nAnAviShahatasya cha |
kurvanti bheShajaM prAj~nAH satyaM tachchApi dRRishyate
evaM vidva~njoShamAssva shRRiNu chAtrottaraM vachaH
shlokas.85:
vAsA.nsyutsRRijya nRRityanti striyo yA madyamohitAH |
mithune.asa.nyatAshchApi yathAkAmacharAshcha tAH
tAsAM putraH kathaM dharmaM madrako vaktumarhati
shlokas.86:
yAstiShThantyaH pramehanti yathaivoShTrIdasherake |
tAsAM vibhraShTalajjAnAM nirlajjAnAM tatastataH
tvaM putrastAdRRishInAM hi dharmaM vaktumihechChasi
shlokas.87:
suvIrakaM yAchyamAnA madrakA kaShati sphijau |
adAtukAmA vachanamidaM vadati dAruNam
shlokas.88:
mA mA suvIrakaM kashchidyAchatAM dayito mama |
putraM dadyAM pratipadaM na tu dadyAM suvIrakam
shlokas.89:
nAryo bRRihatyo nirhrIkA madrakAH kambalAvRRitAH |
ghasmarA naShTashauchAshcha prAya ityanushushruma
shlokas.90:
evamAdi mayAnyairvA shakyaM vaktuM bhavedbahu |
A keshAgrAnnakhAgrAchcha vaktavyeShu kuvartmasu
shlokas.91:
madrakAH sindhusauvIrA dharmaM vidyuH kathaM tviha |
pApadeshodbhavA mlechChA dharmANAmavichakShaNAH
shlokas.92:
eSha mukhyatamo dharmaH kShatriyasyeti naH shrutam |
yadAjau nihataH shete sadbhiH samabhipUjitaH
shlokas.93:
AyudhAnAM samparAye yanmuchyeyamahaM tataH |
na me sa prathamaH kalpo nidhane svargamichChataH
shlokas.94:
so.ahaM priyaH sakhA chAsmi dhArtarAShTrasya dhImataH |
tadarthe hi mama prANA yachcha me vidyate vasu
shlokas.95:
vyaktaM tvamapyupahitaH pANDavaiH pApadeshaja |
yathA hyamitravatsarvaM tvamasmAsu pravartase
shlokas.96:
kAmaM na khalu shakyo.ahaM tvadvidhAnAM shatairapi |
sa~NgrAmAdvimukhaH kartuM dharmaj~na iva nAstikaiH
shlokas.97:
sAra~Nga iva gharmArtaH kAmaM vilapa shuShya cha |
nAhaM bhIShayituM shakyaH kShatravRRitte vyavasthitaH
shlokas.98:
tanutyajAM nRRisiMhAnAmAhaveShvanivartinAm |
yA gatirguruNA prA~Nme proktA rAmeNa tAM smara
shlokas.99:
sveShAM trANArthamudyuktaM vadhAya dviShatAmapi |
viddhi mAmAsthitaM vRRittaM paurUravasamuttamam
shlokas.100:
na tadbhUtaM prapashyAmi triShu lokeShu madraka |
yo mAmasmAdabhiprAyAdvArayediti me matiH
shlokas.101:
evaM vidva~njoShamAssva trAsAtkiM bahu bhAShase |
mA tvA hatvA pradAsyAmi kravyAdbhyo madrakAdhama
shlokas.102:
mitrapratIkShayA shalya dhArtarAShTrasya chobhayoH |
apavAdatitikShAbhistribhiretairhi jIvasi
shlokas.103:
punashchedIdRRishaM vAkyaM madrarAja vadiShyasi |
shiraste pAtayiShyAmi gadayA vajrakalpayA
shlokas.104:
shrotArastvidamadyeha draShTAro vA kudeshaja |
karNaM vA jaghnatuH kRRiShNau karNo vApi jaghAna tau
shlokas.105:
evamuktvA tu rAdheyaH punareva vishAM pate |
abravInmadrarAjAnaM yAhi yAhItyasambhramam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
mAriShAdhiratheH shrutvA vacho yuddhAbhinandinaH |
shalyo.abravItpunaH karNaM nidarshanamudAharan
shlokas.2:
yathaiva matto madyena tvaM tathA na cha vA tathA |
tathAhaM tvAM pramAdyantaM chikitsAmi suhRRittayA
shlokas.3:
imAM kAkopamAM karNa prochyamAnAM nibodha me |
shrutvA yatheShTaM kuryAstvaM vihIna kulapA.nsana
shlokas.4:
nAhamAtmani ki~nchidvai kilbiShaM karNa sa.nsmare |
yena tvaM mAM mahAbAho hantumichChasyanAgasam
shlokas.5:
avashyaM tu mayA vAchyaM budhyatAM yadi te hitam |
visheShato rathasthena rAj~nashchaiva hitaiShiNA
shlokas.6:
samaM cha viShamaM chaiva rathinashcha balAbalam |
shramaH khedashcha satataM hayAnAM rathinA saha
shlokas.7:
Ayudhasya parij~nAnaM rutaM cha mRRigapakShiNAm |
bhArashchApyatibhArashcha shalyAnAM cha pratikriyA
shlokas.8:
astrayogashcha yuddhaM cha nimittAni tathaiva cha |
sarvametanmayA j~neyaM rathasyAsya kuTumbinA
atastvAM kathaye karNa nidarshanamidaM punaH
shlokas.9:
vaishyaH kila samudrAnte prabhUtadhanadhAnyavAn |
yajvA dAnapatiH kShAntaH svakarmastho.abhavachChuchiH
shlokas.10:
bahuputraH priyApatyaH sarvabhUtAnukampakaH |
rAj~no dharmapradhAnasya rAShTre vasati nirbhayaH
shlokas.11:
putrANAM tasya bAlAnAM kumArANAM yashasvinAm |
kAko bahUnAmabhavaduchchiShTakRRitabhojanaH
shlokas.12:
tasmai sadA prayachChanti vaishyaputrAH kumArakAH |
mA.nsodanaM dadhi kShIraM pAyasaM madhusarpiShI
shlokas.13:
sa chochChiShTabhRRitaH kAko vaishyaputraiH kumArakaiH |
sadRRishAnpakShiNo dRRiptaH shreyasashchAvamanyate
shlokas.14:
atha ha.nsAH samudrAnte kadAchidabhipAtinaH |
garuDasya gatau tulyAshchakrA~NgA hRRiShTachetasaH
shlokas.15:
kumArakAstato ha.nsAndRRiShTvA kAkamathAbruvan |
bhavAneva vishiShTo hi patatribhyo viha~Ngama
shlokas.16:
pratAryamANastu sa tairalpabuddhibhiraNDajaH |
tadvachaH satyamityeva maurkhyAddarpAchcha manyate
shlokas.17:
tAnso.abhipatya jij~nAsuH ka eShAM shreShThabhAgiti |
uchChiShTadarpitaH kAko bahUnAM dUrapAtinAm
shlokas.18:
teShAM yaM pravaraM mene ha.nsAnAM dUrapAtinAm |
tamAhvayata durbuddhiH patAma iti pakShiNam
shlokas.19:
tachChrutvA prAhasanha.nsA ye tatrAsansamAgatAH |
bhAShato bahu kAkasya balinaH patatAM varAH
idamUchushcha chakrA~NgA vachaH kAkaM viha~NgamAH
shlokas.20:
vayaM ha.nsAshcharAmemAM pRRithivIM mAnasaukasaH |
pakShiNAM cha vayaM nityaM dUrapAtena pUjitAH
shlokas.21:
kathaM nu ha.nsaM balinaM vajrA~NgaM dUrapAtinam |
kAko bhUtvA nipatane samAhvayasi durmate
kathaM tvaM patanaM kAka sahAsmAbhirbravIShi tat
shlokas.22:
atha ha.nsavacho mUDhaH kutsayitvA punaH punaH |
prajagAdottaraM kAkaH katthano jAtilAghavAt
shlokas.23:
shatamekaM cha pAtAnAM patitAsmi na sa.nshayaH |
shatayojanamekaikaM vichitraM vividhaM tathA
shlokas.24:
uDDInamavaDInaM cha praDInaM DInameva cha |
niDInamatha saNDInaM tiryakchAtigatAni cha
shlokas.25:
viDInaM pariDInaM cha parADInaM suDInakam |
atiDInaM mahADInaM niDInaM pariDInakam
shlokas.26:
gatAgatapratigatA bahvIshcha nikuDInikAH |
kartAsmi miShatAM vo.adya tato drakShyatha me balam
shlokas.27:
evamukte tu kAkena prahasyaiko viha~NgamaH |
uvAcha ha.nsastaM kAkaM vachanaM tannibodha me
shlokas.28:
shatamekaM cha pAtAnAM tvaM kAka patitA dhruvam |
ekameva tu ye pAtaM viduH sarve viha~NgamAH
shlokas.29:
tamahaM patitA kAka nAnyaM jAnAmi ka~nchana |
pata tvamapi raktAkSha yena vA tena manyase
shlokas.30:
atha kAkAH prajahasurye tatrAsansamAgatAH |
kathamekena pAtena ha.nsaH pAtashataM jayet
shlokas.31:
ekenaiva shatasyaikaM pAtenAbhibhaviShyati |
ha.nsasya patitaM kAko balavAnAshuvikramaH
shlokas.32:
prapetatuH spardhayAtha tatastau ha.nsavAyasau |
ekapAtI cha chakrA~NgaH kAkaH pAtashatena cha
shlokas.33:
petivAnatha chakrA~NgaH petivAnatha vAyasaH |
visismApayiShuH pAtairAchakShANo.a.atmanaH kriyAm
shlokas.34:
atha kAkasya chitrANi patitAnItarANi cha |
dRRiShTvA pramuditAH kAkA vineduratha taiH svaraiH
shlokas.35:
ha.nsA.nshchAvahasanti sma prAvadannapriyANi cha |
utpatyotpatya cha prAhurmuhUrtamiti cheti cha
shlokas.36:
vRRikShAgrebhyaH sthalebhyashcha nipatantyutpatanti cha |
kurvANA vividhAnrAvAnAsha.nsantastadA jayam
shlokas.37:
ha.nsastu mRRidukenaiva vikrAntumupachakrame |
pratyahIyata kAkAchcha muhUrtamiva mAriSha
shlokas.38:
avamanya rayaM ha.nsAnidaM vachanamabravIt |
yo.asAvutpatito ha.nsaH so.asAveva prahIyate
shlokas.39:
atha ha.nsaH sa tachChrutvA prApatatpashchimAM disham |
uparyupari vegena sAgaraM varuNAlayam
shlokas.40:
tato bhIH prAvishatkAkaM tadA tatra vichetasam |
dvIpadrumAnapashyantaM nipatantaM shramAnvitam
nipateyaM kva nu shrAnta iti tasmi~njalArNave
shlokas.41:
aviShahyaH samudro hi bahusattvagaNAlayaH |
mahAbhUtashatodbhAsI nabhaso.api vishiShyate
shlokas.42:
gAmbhIryAddhi samudrasya na visheShaH kulAdhama |
digambarAmbhasAM karNa samudrasthA hi durjayAH
vidUrapAtAttoyasya kiM punaH karNa vAyasaH
shlokas.43:
atha ha.nso.abhyatikramya muhUrtamiti cheti cha |
avekShamANastaM kAkaM nAshaknodvyapasarpitum
atikramya cha chakrA~NgaH kAkaM taM samudaikShata
shlokas.44:
taM tathA hIyamAnaM cha ha.nso dRRiShTvAbravIdidam |
ujjihIrShurnimajjantaM smaransatpuruShavratam
shlokas.45:
bahUni patanAni tvamAchakShANo muhurmuhuH |
patasyavyAhara.nshchedaM na no guhyaM prabhAShase
shlokas.46:
kiM nAma patanaM kAka yattvaM patasi sAmpratam |
jalaM spRRishasi pakShAbhyAM tuNDena cha punaH punaH
shlokas.47:
sa pakShAbhyAM spRRishannArtastuNDena jalamarNave |
kAko dRRiDhaM parishrAntaH sahasA nipapAta ha
shlokas.48:
ha.nsa uvAcha||
shatamekaM cha pAtAnAM yatprabhAShasi vAyasa |
nAnAvidhAnIha purA tachchAnRRitamihAdya te
shlokas.49:
kAka uvAcha||
uchChiShTadarpito ha.nsa manye.a.atmAnaM suparNavat |
avamanya bahU.nshchAhaM kAkAnanyA.nshcha pakShiNaH
prANairha.nsa prapadye tvAM dvIpAntaM prApayasva mAm
shlokas.50:
yadyahaM svastimAnha.nsa svadeshaM prApnuyAM punaH |
na ka~nchidavamanyeyamApado mAM samuddhara
shlokas.51:
tameva.nvAdinaM dInaM vilapantamachetanam |
kAka kAketi vAshantaM nimajjantaM mahArNave
shlokas.52:
tathaitya vAyasaM ha.nso jalaklinnaM sudurdasham |
padbhyAmutkShipya vepantaM pRRiShThamAropayachChanaiH
shlokas.53:
Aropya pRRiShThaM kAkaM taM ha.nsaH karNa vichetasam |
AjagAma punardvIpaM spardhayA petaturyataH
shlokas.54:
sa.nsthApya taM chApi punaH samAshvAsya cha khecharam |
gato yathepsitaM deshaM ha.nso mana ivAshugaH
shlokas.55:
uchChiShTabhojanAtkAko yathA vaishyakule tu saH |
evaM tvamuchChiShTabhRRito dhArtarAShTrairna sa.nshayaH
sadRRishA~nshreyasashchApi sarvAnkarNAtimanyase
shlokas.56:
droNadrauNikRRipairgupto bhIShmeNAnyaishcha kauravaiH |
virATanagare pArthamekaM kiM nAvadhIstadA
shlokas.57:
yatra vyastAH samastAshcha nirjitAH stha kirITinA |
sRRigAlA iva siMhena kva te vIryamabhUttadA
shlokas.58:
bhrAtaraM cha hataM dRRiShTvA nirjitaH savyasAchinA |
pashyatAM kuruvIrANAM prathamaM tvaM palAyathAH
shlokas.59:
tathA dvaitavane karNa gandharvaiH samabhidrutaH |
kurUnsamagrAnutsRRijya prathamaM tvaM palAyathAH
shlokas.60:
hatvA jitvA cha gandharvA.nshchitrasenamukhAnraNe |
karNa duryodhanaM pArthaH sabhAryaM samamochayat
shlokas.61:
punaH prabhAvaH pArthasya purANaH keshavasya cha |
kathitaH karNa rAmeNa sabhAyAM rAjasa.nsadi
shlokas.62:
satataM cha tadashrauShIrvachanaM droNabhIShmayoH |
avadhyau vadatoH kRRiShNau saMnidhau vai mahIkShitAm
shlokas.63:
kiyantaM tatra vakShyAmi yena yena dhana~njayaH |
tvatto.atiriktaH sarvebhyo bhUtebhyo brAhmaNo yathA
shlokas.64:
idAnImeva draShTAsi pradhane syandane sthitau |
putraM cha vasudevasya pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam
shlokas.65:
devAsuramanuShyeShu prakhyAtau yau nararShabhau |
prakAshenAbhivikhyAtau tvaM tu khadyotavannRRiShu
shlokas.66:
evaM vidvAnmAvama.nsthAH sUtaputrAchyutArjunau |
nRRisiMhau tau narashvA tvaM joShamAssva vikatthana

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
madrAdhipasyAdhirathistadaivaM; vacho nishamyApriyamapratItaH |
uvAcha shalyaM viditaM mamaita;dyathAvidhAvarjunavAsudevau
shlokas.2:
shaure rathaM vAhayato.arjunasya; balaM mahAstrANi cha pANDavasya |
ahaM vijAnAmi yathAvadadya; parokShabhUtaM tava tattu shalya
shlokas.3:
tau chApradhRRiShyau shastrabhRRitAM variShThau; vyapetabhIryodhayiShyAmi kRRiShNau |
santApayatyabhyadhikaM tu rAmA;chChApo.adya mAM brAhmaNasattamAchcha
shlokas.4:
avAtsaM vai brAhmaNachChadmanAhaM; rAme purA divyamastraM chikIrShuH |
tatrApi me devarAjena vighno; hitArthinA phalgunasyaiva shalya
shlokas.5:
kRRito.avabhedena mamorumetya; pravishya kITasya tanuM virUpAm |
gurorbhayAchchApi na chelivAnahaM; tachchAvabuddho dadRRishe sa vipraH
shlokas.6:
pRRiShTashchAhaM tamavochaM maharShiM; sUto.ahamasmIti sa mAM shashApa |
sUtopadhAvAptamidaM tvayAstraM; na karmakAle pratibhAsyati tvAm
shlokas.7:
anyatra yasmAttava mRRityukAlA;dabrAhmaNe brahma na hi dhruvaM syAt |
tadadya paryAptamatIva shastra;masminsa~NgrAme tumule tAta bhIme
shlokas.8:
apAM patirvegavAnaprameyo; nimajjayiShyannivahAnprajAnAm |
mahAnagaM yaH kurute samudraM; velaiva taM vArayatyaprameyam
shlokas.9:
pramu~nchantaM bANasa~NghAnamoghA;nmarmachChido vIrahaNaH sapatrAn |
kuntIputraM pratiyotsyAmi yuddhe; jyAkarShiNAmuttamamadya loke
shlokas.10:
evaM balenAtibalaM mahAstraM; samudrakalpaM sudurApamugram |
sharaughiNaM pArthivAnmajjayantaM; veleva pArthamiShubhiH sa.nsahiShye
shlokas.11:
adyAhave yasya na tulyamanyaM; manye manuShyaM dhanurAdadAnam |
surAsurAnvai yudhi yo jayeta; tenAdya me pashya yuddhaM sughoram
shlokas.12:
atimAnI pANDavo yuddhakAmo; amAnuShaireShyati me mahAstraiH |
tasyAstramastrairabhihatya sa~Nkhye; sharottamaiH pAtayiShyAmi pArtham
shlokas.13:
divAkareNApi samaM tapantaM; samAptarashmiM yashasA jvalantam |
tamonudaM megha ivAtimAtro; dhana~njayaM ChAdayiShyAmi bANaiH
shlokas.14:
vaishvAnaraM dhUmashikhaM jvalantaM; tejasvinaM lokamimaM dahantam |
megho bhUtvA sharavarShairyathAgniM; tathA pArthaM shamayiShyAmi yuddhe
shlokas.15:
pramAthinaM balavantaM prahAriNaM; prabha~njanaM mAtarishvAnamugram |
yuddhe sahiShye himavAnivAchalo; dhana~njayaM kruddhamamRRiShyamANam
shlokas.16:
vishAradaM rathamArgeShvasaktaM; dhuryaM nityaM samareShu pravIram |
loke varaM sarvadhanurdharANAM; dhana~njayaM sa.nyuge sa.nsahiShye
shlokas.17:
adyAhave yasya na tulyamanyaM; madhyemanuShyaM dhanurAdadAnam |
sarvAmimAM yaH pRRithivIM saheta; tathA vidvAnyotsyamAno.asmi tena
shlokas.18:
yaH sarvabhUtAni sadevakAni; prasthe.ajayatkhANDave savyasAchI |
ko jIvitaM rakShamANo hi tena; yuyutsate mAmRRite mAnuSho.anyaH
shlokas.19:
ahaM tasya pauruShaM pANDavasya; brUyAM hRRiShTaH samitau kShatriyANAm |
kiM tvaM mUrkhaH prabhaShanmUDhachetA; mAmavochaH pauruShamarjunasya
shlokas.20:
apriyo yaH paruSho niShThuro hi; kShudraH kSheptA kShamiNashchAkShamAvAn |
hanyAmahaM tAdRRishAnAM shatAni; kShamAmi tvAM kShamayA kAlayogAt
shlokas.21:
avochastvaM pANDavArthe.apriyANi; pradharShayanmAM mUDhavatpApakarman |
mayyArjave jihmagatirhatastvaM; mitradrohI saptapadaM hi mitram
shlokas.22:
kAlastvayaM mRRityumayo.atidAruNo; duryodhano yuddhamupAgamadyat |
tasyArthasiddhimabhikA~NkShamANa;stamabhyeShye yatra naikAntyamasti
shlokas.23:
mitraM midernandateH prIyatervA; santrAyatermAnada modatervA |
bravIti tachchAmuta viprapUrvA;ttachchApi sarvaM mama duryodhane.asti
shlokas.24:
shatruH shadeH shAsateH shAyatervA; shRRiNAtervA shvayatervApi sarge |
upasargAdbahudhA sUdateshcha; prAyeNa sarvaM tvayi tachcha mahyam
shlokas.25:
duryodhanArthaM tava chApriyArthaM; yashorthamAtmArthamapIshvarArtham |
tasmAdahaM pANDavavAsudevau; yotsye yatnAtkarma tatpashya me.adya
shlokas.26:
astrANi pashyAdya mamottamAni; brAhmANi divyAnyatha mAnuShANi |
AsAdayiShyAmyahamugravIryaM; dvipottamaM mattamivAbhimattaH
shlokas.27:
astraM brAhmaM manasA taddhyajayyaM; kShepsye pArthAyApratimaM jayAya |
tenApi me naiva muchyeta yuddhe; na chetpatedviShame me.adya chakram
shlokas.28:
vaivasvatAddaNDahastAdvaruNAdvApi pAshinaH |
sagadAdvA dhanapateH savajrAdvApi vAsavAt
shlokas.29:
nAnyasmAdapi kasmAchchidbibhimo hyAtatAyinaH |
iti shalya vijAnIhi yathA nAhaM bibhemyabhIH
shlokas.30:
tasmAdbhayaM na me pArthAnnApi chaiva janArdanAt |
adya yuddhaM hi tAbhyAM me samparAye bhaviShyati
shlokas.31:
shvabhre te patatAM chakramiti me brAhmaNo.avadat |
yudhyamAnasya sa~NgrAme prAptasyaikAyane bhayam
shlokas.32:
tasmAdbibhemi balavadbrAhmaNavyAhRRitAdaham |
ete hi somarAjAna IshvarAH sukhaduHkhayoH
shlokas.33:
homadhenvA vatsamasya pramatta iShuNAhanam |
charantamajane shalya brAhmaNAttapaso nidheH
shlokas.34:
IShAdantAnsaptashatAndAsIdAsashatAni cha |
dadato dvijamukhyAya prasAdaM na chakAra me
shlokas.35:
kRRiShNAnAM shvetavatsAnAM sahasrANi chaturdasha |
Aharanna labhe tasmAtprasAdaM dvijasattamAt
shlokas.36:
RRiddhaM gehaM sarvakAmairyachcha me vasu ki~nchana |
tatsarvamasmai satkRRitya prayachChAmi na chechChati
shlokas.37:
tato.abravInmAM yAchantamaparAddhaM prayatnataH |
vyAhRRitaM yanmayA sUta tattathA na tadanyathA
shlokas.38:
anRRitoktaM prajA hanyAttataH pApamavApnuyAt |
tasmAddharmAbhirakShArthaM nAnRRitaM vaktumutsahe
shlokas.39:
mA tvaM brahmagatiM hi.nsyAH prAyashchittaM kRRitaM tvayA |
madvAkyaM nAnRRitaM loke kashchitkuryAtsamApnuhi
shlokas.40:
ityetatte mayA proktaM kShiptenApi suhRRittayA |
jAnAmi tvAdhikShipantaM joShamAssvottaraM shRRiNu

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH punarmahArAja madrarAjamari.ndamam |
abhyabhAShata rAdheyaH saMnivAryottaraM vachaH
shlokas.2:
yattvaM nidarshanArthaM mAM shalya jalpitavAnasi |
nAhaM shakyastvayA vAchA vibhIShayitumAhave
shlokas.3:
yadi mAM devatAH sarvA yodhayeyuH savAsavAH |
tathApi me bhayaM na syAtkimu pArthAtsakeshavAt
shlokas.4:
nAhaM bhIShayituM shakyo vA~NmAtreNa katha~nchana |
anyaM jAnIhi yaH shakyastvayA bhIShayituM raNe
shlokas.5:
nIchasya balametAvatpAruShyaM yattvamAttha mAm |
ashakto.asmadguNAnprAptuM valgase bahu durmate
shlokas.6:
na hi karNaH samudbhUto bhayArthamiha mAriSha |
vikramArthamahaM jAto yashorthaM cha tathaiva cha
shlokas.7:
idaM tu me tvamekAgraH shRRiNu madrajanAdhipa |
saMnidhau dhRRitarAShTrasya prochyamAnaM mayA shrutam
shlokas.8:
deshA.nshcha vividhA.nshchitrAnpUrvavRRittA.nshcha pArthivAn |
brAhmaNAH kathayantaH sma dhRRitarAShTramupAsate
shlokas.9:
tatra vRRiddhaH purAvRRittAH kathAH kAshchiddvijottamaH |
bAhlIkadeshaM madrA.nshcha kutsayanvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.10:
bahiShkRRitA himavatA ga~NgayA cha tiraskRRitAH |
sarasvatyA yamunayA kurukShetreNa chApi ye
shlokas.11:
pa~nchAnAM sindhuShaShThAnAM nadInAM ye.antarAshritAH |
tAndharmabAhyAnashuchInbAhlIkAnparivarjayet
shlokas.12:
govardhano nAma vaTaH subhANDaM nAma chatvaram |
etadrAjakuladvAramAkumAraH smarAmyaham
shlokas.13:
kAryeNAtyarthagADhena bAhlIkeShUShitaM mayA |
tata eShAM samAchAraH sa.nvAsAdvidito mama
shlokas.14:
shAkalaM nAma nagaramApagA nAma nimnagA |
jartikA nAma bAhlIkAsteShAM vRRittaM suninditam
shlokas.15:
dhAnAgauDAsave pItvA gomA.nsaM lashunaiH saha |
apUpamA.nsavATyAnAmAshinaH shIlavarjitAH
shlokas.16:
hasanti gAnti nRRityanti strIbhirmattA vivAsasaH |
nagarAgAravapreShu bahirmAlyAnulepanAH
shlokas.17:
mattAvagItairvividhaiH kharoShTraninadopamaiH |
AhuranyonyamuktAni prabruvANA madotkaTAH
shlokas.18:
hA hate hA hatetyeva svAmibhartRRihateti cha |
AkroshantyaH pranRRityanti mandAH parvasvasa.nyatAH
shlokas.19:
teShAM kilAvaliptAnAM nivasankurujA~Ngale |
kashchidbAhlIkamukhyAnAM nAtihRRiShTamanA jagau
shlokas.20:
sA nUnaM bRRihatI gaurI sUkShmakambalavAsinI |
mAmanusmaratI shete bAhlIkaM kuruvAsinam
shlokas.21:
shatadrukanadIM tIrtvA tAM cha ramyAmirAvatIm |
gatvA svadeshaM drakShyAmi sthUlasha~NkhAH shubhAH striyaH
shlokas.22:
manaHshilojjvalApA~NgA gauryastrikakudA~njanAH |
kevalAjinasa.nvItAH kUrdantyaH priyadarshanAH
shlokas.23:
mRRida~NgAnakasha~NkhAnAM mardalAnAM cha nisvanaiH |
kharoShTrAshvataraishchaiva mattA yAsyAmahe sukham
shlokas.24:
shamIpIlukarIrANAM vaneShu sukhavartmasu |
apUpAnsaktupiNDIshcha khAdanto mathitAnvitAH
shlokas.25:
pathiShu prabalA bhUtvA kadAsamRRidite.adhvani |
khalopahAraM kurvANAstADayiShyAma bhUyasaH
shlokas.26:
evaM hIneShu vrAtyeShu bAhlIkeShu durAtmasu |
kashchetayAno nivasenmuhUrtamapi mAnavaH
shlokas.27:
IdRRishA brAhmaNenoktA bAhlIkA moghachAriNaH |
yeShAM ShaDbhAgahartA tvamubhayoH shubhapApayoH
shlokas.28:
ityuktvA brAhmaNaH sAdhuruttaraM punaruktavAn |
bAhlIkeShvavinIteShu prochyamAnaM nibodhata
shlokas.29:
tatra sma rAkShasI gAti sadA kRRiShNachaturdashIm |
nagare shAkale sphIte Ahatya nishi dundubhim
shlokas.30:
kadA vA ghoShikA gAthAH punargAsyanti shAkale |
gavyasya tRRiptA mA.nsasya pItvA gauDaM mahAsavam
shlokas.31:
gaurIbhiH saha nArIbhirbRRihatIbhiH svala~NkRRitAH |
palANDugaNDUShayutAnkhAdante chaiDakAnbahUn
shlokas.32:
vArAhaM kaukkuTaM mA.nsaM gavyaM gArdabhamauShTrakam |
aiDaM cha ye na khAdanti teShAM janma nirarthakam
shlokas.33:
iti gAyanti ye mattAH shIdhunA shAkalAvataH |
sabAlavRRiddhAH kUrdantasteShu vRRittaM kathaM bhavet
shlokas.34:
iti shalya vijAnIhi hanta bhUyo bravImi te |
yadanyo.apyuktavAnasmAnbrAhmaNaH kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.35:
pa~ncha nadyo vahantyetA yatra pIluvanAnyapi |
shatadrushcha vipAshA cha tRRitIyerAvatI tathA
chandrabhAgA vitastA cha sindhuShaShThA bahirgatAH
shlokas.36:
AraTTA nAma te deshA naShTadharmAnna tAnvrajet |
vrAtyAnAM dAsamIyAnAM videhAnAmayajvanAm
shlokas.37:
na devAH pratigRRihNanti pitaro brAhmaNAstathA |
teShAM pranaShTadharmANAM bAhlIkAnAmiti shrutiH
shlokas.38:
brAhmaNena tathA proktaM viduShA sAdhusa.nsadi |
kAShThakuNDeShu bAhlIkA mRRiNmayeShu cha bhu~njate
saktuvATyAvalipteShu shvAdilIDheShu nirghRRiNAH
shlokas.39:
AvikaM chauShTrikaM chaiva kShIraM gArdabhameva cha |
tadvikArA.nshcha bAhlIkAH khAdanti cha pibanti cha
shlokas.40:
putrasa~NkariNo jAlmAH sarvAnnakShIrabhojanAH |
AraTTA nAma bAhlIkA varjanIyA vipashchitA
shlokas.41:
uta shalya vijAnIhi hanta bhUyo bravImi te |
yadanyo.apyuktavAnsabhyo brAhmaNaH kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.42:
yugandhare payaH pItvA proShya chApyachyutasthale |
tadvadbhUtilaye snAtvA kathaM svargaM gamiShyati
shlokas.43:
pa~ncha nadyo vahantyetA yatra niHsRRitya parvatAt |
AraTTA nAma bAhlIkA na teShvAryo dvyahaM vaset
shlokas.44:
bahishcha nAma hlIkashcha vipAshAyAM pishAchakau |
tayorapatyaM bAhlIkA naiShA sRRiShTiH prajApateH
shlokas.45:
kAraskarAnmahiShakAnkali~NgAnkIkaTATavIn |
karkoTakAnvIrakA.nshcha durdharmA.nshcha vivarjayet
shlokas.46:
iti tIrthAnusartAraM rAkShasI kAchidabravIt |
ekarAtrA shamIgehe maholUkhalamekhalA
shlokas.47:
AraTTA nAma te deshA bAhlIkA nAma te janAH |
vasAtisindhusauvIrA iti prAyo vikutsitAH
shlokas.48:
uta shalya vijAnIhi hanta bhUyo bravImi te |
uchyamAnaM mayA samyaktadekAgramanAH shRRiNu
shlokas.49:
brAhmaNaH shilpino gehamabhyagachChatpurAtithiH |
AchAraM tatra samprekShya prItaH shilpinamabravIt
shlokas.50:
mayA himavataH shRRi~NgamekenAdhyuShitaM chiram |
dRRiShTAshcha bahavo deshA nAnAdharmasamAkulAH
shlokas.51:
na cha kena cha dharmeNa virudhyante prajA imAH |
sarve hi te.abruvandharmaM yathoktaM vedapAragaiH
shlokas.52:
aTatA tu sadA deshAnnAnAdharmasamAkulAn |
AgachChatA mahArAja bAhlIkeShu nishAmitam
shlokas.53:
tatraiva brAhmaNo bhUtvA tato bhavati kShatriyaH |
vaishyaH shUdrashcha bAhlIkastato bhavati nApitaH
shlokas.54:
nApitashcha tato bhUtvA punarbhavati brAhmaNaH |
dvijo bhUtvA cha tatraiva punardAso.api jAyate
shlokas.55:
bhavatyekaH kule vipraH shiShTAnye kAmachAriNaH |
gAndhArA madrakAshchaiva bAhlIkAH ke.apyachetasaH
shlokas.56:
etanmayA shrutaM tatra dharmasa~NkarakArakam |
kRRitsnAmaTitvA pRRithivIM bAhlIkeShu viparyayaH
shlokas.57:
uta shalya vijAnIhi hanta bhUyo bravImi te |
yadapyanyo.abravIdvAkyaM bAhlIkAnAM vikutsitam
shlokas.58:
satI purA hRRitA kAchidAraTTA kila dasyubhiH |
adharmatashchopayAtA sA tAnabhyashapattataH
shlokas.59:
bAlAM bandhumatIM yanmAmadharmeNopagachChatha |
tasmAnnAryo bhaviShyanti bandhakyo vai kuleShu vaH
na chaivAsmAtpramokShyadhvaM ghorAtpApAnnarAdhamAH
shlokas.60:
kuravaH sahapA~nchAlAH shAlvA matsyAH sanaimiShAH |
kosalAH kAshayo.a~NgAshcha kali~NgA magadhAstathA
shlokas.61:
chedayashcha mahAbhAgA dharmaM jAnanti shAshvatam |
nAnAdesheShu santashcha prAyo bAhyA layAdRRite
shlokas.62:
A matsyebhyaH kurupA~nchAladeshyA; A naimiShAchchedayo ye vishiShTAH |
dharmaM purANamupajIvanti santo; madrAnRRite pa~nchanadA.nshcha jihmAn
shlokas.63:
evaM vidvandharmakathA.nshcha rAjaM;stUShNImbhUto jaDavachChalya bhUyAH |
tvaM tasya goptA cha janasya rAjA; ShaDbhAgahartA shubhaduShkRRitasya
shlokas.64:
atha vA duShkRRitasya tvaM hartA teShAmarakShitA |
rakShitA puNyabhAgrAjA prajAnAM tvaM tvapuNyabhAk
shlokas.65:
pUjyamAne purA dharme sarvadesheShu shAshvate |
dharmaM pA~nchanadaM dRRiShTvA dhigityAha pitAmahaH
shlokas.66:
vrAtyAnAM dAshamIyAnAM kRRite.apyashubhakarmaNAm |
iti pA~nchanadaM dharmamavamene pitAmahaH
svadharmastheShu varNeShu so.apyetaM nAbhipUjayet
shlokas.67:
uta shalya vijAnIhi hanta bhUyo bravImi te |
kalmAShapAdaH sarasi nimajjanrAkShaso.abravIt
shlokas.68:
kShatriyasya malaM bhaikShaM brAhmaNasyAnRRitaM malam |
malaM pRRithivyA bAhlIkAH strINAM madrastriyo malam
shlokas.69:
nimajjamAnamuddhRRitya kashchidrAjA nishAcharam |
apRRichChattena chAkhyAtaM proktavAnyannibodha tat
shlokas.70:
mAnuShANAM malaM mlechChA mlechChAnAM mauShTikA malam |
mauShTikAnAM malaM shaNDAH shaNDAnAM rAjayAjakAH
shlokas.71:
rAjayAjakayAjyAnAM madrakANAM cha yanmalam |
tadbhavedvai tava malaM yadyasmAnna vimu~nchasi
shlokas.72:
iti rakShopasRRiShTeShu viShavIryahateShu cha |
rAkShasaM bheShajaM proktaM sa.nsiddhaM vachanottaram
shlokas.73:
brAhmaM pA~nchAlAH kauraveyAH svadharmaH; satyaM matsyAH shUrasenAshcha yaj~naH |
prAchyA dAsA vRRiShalA dAkShiNAtyAH; stenA bAhlIkAH sa~NkarA vai surAShTrAH
shlokas.74:
kRRitaghnatA paravittApahAraH; surApAnaM gurudArAvamarshaH |
yeShAM dharmastAnprati nAstyadharma; AraTTakAnpA~nchanadAndhigastu
shlokas.75:
A pA~nchAlebhyaH kuravo naimiShAshcha; matsyAshchaivApyatha jAnanti dharmam |
kali~NgakAshchA~NgakA mAgadhAshcha; shiShTAndharmAnupajIvanti vRRiddhAH
shlokas.76:
prAchIM dishaM shritA devA jAtavedaHpurogamAH |
dakShiNAM pitaro guptAM yamena shubhakarmaNA
shlokas.77:
pratIchIM varuNaH pAti pAlayannasurAnbalI |
udIchIM bhagavAnsomo brahmaNyo brAhmaNaiH saha
shlokas.79:
i~Ngitaj~nAshcha magadhAH prekShitaj~nAshcha kosalAH |
ardhoktAH kurupA~nchAlAH shAlvAH kRRitsnAnushAsanAH
pArvatIyAshcha viShamA yathaiva girayastathA
shlokas.80:
sarvaj~nA yavanA rAja~nshUrAshchaiva visheShataH |
mlechChAH svasa~nj~nAniyatA nAnukta itaro janaH
shlokas.81:
pratirabdhAstu bAhlIkA na cha kechana madrakAH |
sa tvametAdRRishaH shalya nottaraM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.82:
etajj~nAtvA joShamAssva pratIpaM mA sma vai kRRithAH |
sa tvAM pUrvamahaM hatvA haniShye keshavArjunau
shlokas.83:
shalya uvAcha||
AturANAM parityAgaH svadArasutavikrayaH |
a~NgeShu vartate karNa yeShAmadhipatirbhavAn
shlokas.84:
rathAtirathasa~NkhyAyAM yattvA bhIShmastadAbravIt |
tAnviditvAtmano doShAnnirmanyurbhava mA krudhaH
shlokas.85:
sarvatra brAhmaNAH santi santi sarvatra kShatriyAH |
vaishyAH shUdrAstathA karNa striyaH sAdhvyashcha suvratAH
shlokas.86:
ramante chopahAsena puruShAH puruShaiH saha |
anyonyamavatakShanto deshe deshe samaithunAH
shlokas.87:
paravAchyeShu nipuNaH sarvo bhavati sarvadA |
AtmavAchyaM na jAnIte jAnannapi vimuhyati
shlokas.88:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNo.api nottaraM prAha shalyo.apyabhimukhaH parAn |
punaH prahasya rAdheyaH punaryAhItyachodayat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH parAnIkabhidaM vyUhamapratimaM paraiH |
samIkShya karNaH pArthAnAM dhRRiShTadyumnAbhirakShitam
shlokas.2:
prayayau rathaghoSheNa siMhanAdaraveNa cha |
vAditrANAM cha ninadaiH kampayanniva medinIm
shlokas.3:
vepamAna iva krodhAdyuddhashauNDaH parantapaH |
pativyUhya mahAtejA yathAvadbharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
vyadhamatpANDavIM senAmAsurIM maghavAniva |
yudhiShThiraM chAbhibhavannasapavyaM chakAra ha
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kathaM sa~njaya rAdheyaH pratyavyUhata pANDavAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAnvIrAnbhImasenAbhirakShitAn
shlokas.6:
ke cha prapakShau pakShau vA mama sainyasya sa~njaya |
pravibhajya yathAnyAyaM kathaM vA samavasthitAH
shlokas.7:
kathaM pANDusutAshchApi pratyavyUhanta mAmakAn |
kathaM chaitanmahAyuddhaM prAvartata sudAruNam
shlokas.8:
kva cha bIbhatsurabhavadyatkarNo.ayAdyudhiShThiram |
ko hyarjunasya sAMnidhye shakto.abhyetuM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.9:
sarvabhUtAni yo hyekaH khANDave jitavAnpurA |
kastamanyatra rAdheyAtpratiyudhyejjijIviShuH
shlokas.10:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu vyUhasya rachanAmarjunashcha yathA gataH |
paridAya nRRipaM tebhyaH sa~NgrAmashchAbhavadyathA
shlokas.11:
kRRipaH shAradvato rAjanmAgadhashcha tarasvinaH |
sAtvataH kRRitavarmA cha dakShiNaM pakShamAshritAH
shlokas.12:
teShAM prapakShe shakunirulUkashcha mahArathaH |
sAdibhirvimalaprAsaistavAnIkamarakShatAm
shlokas.13:
gAndhAribhirasambhrAntaiH pArvatIyaishcha durjayaiH |
shalabhAnAmiva vrAtaiH pishAchairiva durdRRishaiH
shlokas.14:
chatustri.nshatsahasrANi rathAnAmanivartinAm |
sa.nshaptakA yuddhashauNDA vAmaM pArshvamapAlayan
shlokas.15:
samuchchitAstava sutaiH kRRiShNArjunajighA.nsavaH |
teShAM prapakShaH kAmbojAH shakAshcha yavanaiH saha
shlokas.16:
nideshAtsUtaputrasya sarathAH sAshvapattayaH |
Ahvayanto.arjunaM tasthuH keshavaM cha mahAbalam
shlokas.17:
madhyesenAmukhaM karNo vyavAtiShThata da.nshitaH |
chitravarmA~NgadaH sragvI pAlayandhvajinImukham
shlokas.18:
rakShyamANaH susa.nrabdhaiH putraiH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
vAhinIpramukhaM vIraH samprakarShannashobhata
shlokas.19:
ayoratnirmahAbAhuH sUryavaishvAnaradyutiH |
mahAdvipaskandhagataH pi~NgalaH priyadarshanaH
duHshAsano vRRitaH sainyaiH sthito vyUhasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.20:
tamanvayAnmahArAja svayaM duryodhano nRRipaH |
chitrAshvaishchitrasaMnAhaiH sodaryairabhirakShitaH
shlokas.21:
rakShyamANo mahAvIryaiH sahitairmadrakekayaiH |
ashobhata mahArAja devairiva shatakratuH
shlokas.22:
ashvatthAmA kurUNAM cha ye pravIrA mahArathAH |
nityamattAshcha mAta~NgAH shUrairmlechChairadhiShThitAH
anvayustadrathAnIkaM kSharanta iva toyadAH
shlokas.23:
te dhvajairvaijayantIbhirjvaladbhiH paramAyudhaiH |
sAdibhishchAsthitA rejurdrumavanta ivAchalAH
shlokas.24:
teShAM padAtinAgAnAM pAdarakShAH sahasrashaH |
paTTishAsidharAH shUrA babhUvuranivartinaH
shlokas.25:
sAdibhiH syandanairnAgairadhikaM samala~NkRRitaiH |
sa vyUharAjo vibabhau devAsurachamUpamaH
shlokas.26:
bArhaspatyaH suvihito nAyakena vipashchitA |
nRRityatIva mahAvyUhaH pareShAmAdadhadbhayam
shlokas.27:
tasya pakShaprapakShebhyo niShpatanti yuyutsavaH |
pattyashvarathamAta~NgAH prAvRRiShIva balAhakAH
shlokas.28:
tataH senAmukhe karNaM dRRiShTvA rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
dhana~njayamamitraghnamekavIramuvAcha ha
shlokas.29:
pashyArjuna mahAvyUhaM karNena vihitaM raNe |
yuktaM pakShaiH prapakShaishcha senAnIkaM prakAshate
shlokas.30:
tadetadvai samAlokya pratyamitraM mahadbalam |
yathA nAbhibhavatyasmA.nstathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.31:
evamukto.arjuno rAj~nA prA~njalirnRRipamabravIt |
yathA bhavAnAha tathA tatsarvaM na tadanyathA
shlokas.32:
yastvasya vihito ghAtastaM kariShyAmi bhArata |
pradhAnavadha evAsya vinAshastaM karomyaham
shlokas.33:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tasmAttvameva rAdheyaM bhImasenaH suyodhanam |
vRRiShasenaM cha nakulaH sahadevo.api saubalam
shlokas.34:
duHshAsanaM shatAnIko hArdikyaM shinipu~NgavaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnastathA drauNiM svayaM yAsyAmyahaM kRRipam
shlokas.35:
draupadeyA dhArtarAShTrA~nshiShTAnsaha shikhaNDinA |
te te cha tA.nstAnahitAnasmAkaM ghnantu mAmakAH
shlokas.36:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityukto dharmarAjena tathetyuktvA dhana~njayaH |
vyAdidesha svasainyAni svayaM chAgAchchamUmukham
shlokas.37:
atha taM rathamAyAntaM dRRiShTvAtyadbhutadarshanam |
uvAchAdhirathiM shalyaH punastaM yuddhadurmadam
shlokas.38:
ayaM sa ratha AyAti shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
nighnannamitrAnkaunteyo yaM yaM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.39:
shrUyate tumulaH shabdo rathanemisvano mahAn |
eSha reNuH samudbhUto divamAvRRitya tiShThati
shlokas.40:
chakranemipraNunnA cha kampate karNa medinI |
pravAtyeSha mahAvAyurabhitastava vAhinIm
kravyAdA vyAharantyete mRRigAH kurvanti bhairavam
shlokas.41:
pashya karNa mahAghoraM bhayadaM lomaharShaNam |
kabandhaM meghasa~NkAshaM bhAnumAvRRitya sa.nsthitam
shlokas.42:
pashya yUthairbahuvidhairmRRigANAM sarvatodisham |
balibhirdRRiptashArdUlairAdityo.abhinirIkShyate
shlokas.43:
pashya ka~NkA.nshcha gRRidhrA.nshcha samavetAnsahasrashaH |
sthitAnabhimukhAnghorAnanyonyamabhibhAShataH
shlokas.44:
sitAshchAshvAH samAyuktAstava karNa mahArathe |
pradarAH prajvalantyete dhvajashchaiva prakampate
shlokas.45:
udIryato hayAnpashya mahAkAyAnmahAjavAn |
plavamAnAndarshanIyAnAkAshe garuDAniva
shlokas.46:
dhruvameShu nimitteShu bhUmimAvRRitya pArthivAH |
svapsyanti nihatAH karNa shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.47:
sha~NkhAnAM tumulaH shabdaH shrUyate lomaharShaNaH |
AnakAnAM cha rAdheya mRRida~NgAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.48:
bANashabdAnbahuvidhAnnarAshvarathanisvanAn |
jyAtalatreShushabdA.nshcha shRRiNu karNa mahAtmanAm
shlokas.49:
hemarUpyapramRRiShTAnAM vAsasAM shilpinirmitAH |
nAnAvarNA rathe bhAnti shvasanena prakampitAH
shlokas.50:
sahemachandratArArkAH patAkAH ki~NkiNIyutAH |
pashya karNArjunasyaitAH saudAminya ivAmbude
shlokas.51:
dhvajAH kaNakaNAyante vAtenAbhisamIritAH |
sapatAkA rathAshchApi pA~nchAlAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.52:
nAgAshvarathapattyaughA.nstAvakAnsamabhighnataH |
dhvajAgraM dRRishyate tvasya jyAshabdashchApi shrUyate
shlokas.53:
adya draShTAsi taM vIraM shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim |
nighnantaM shAtravAnsa~Nkhye yaM karNa paripRRichChasi
shlokas.54:
adya tau puruShavyAghrau lohitAkShau parantapau |
vAsudevArjunau karNa draShTAsyekarathasthitau
shlokas.55:
sArathiryasya vArShNeyo gANDIvaM yasya kArmukam |
taM cheddhantAsi rAdheya tvaM no rAjA bhaviShyasi
shlokas.56:
eSha sa.nshaptakAhUtastAnevAbhimukho gataH |
karoti kadanaM chaiShAM sa~NgrAme dviShatAM balI
iti bruvANaM madreshaM karNaH prAhAtimanyumAn
shlokas.57:
pashya sa.nshaptakaiH kruddhaiH sarvataH samabhidrutaH |
eSha sUrya ivAmbhodaishChannaH pArtho na dRRishyate
etadanto.arjunaH shalya nimagnaH shokasAgare
shlokas.58:
shalya uvAcha||
varuNaM ko.ambhasA hanyAdindhanena cha pAvakam |
ko vAnilaM nigRRihNIyAtpibedvA ko mahArNavam
shlokas.59:
IdRRigrUpamahaM manye pArthasya yudhi nigraham |
na hi shakyo.arjuno jetuM sendraiH sarvaiH surAsuraiH
shlokas.60:
athaivaM paritoShaste vAchoktvA sumanA bhava |
na sa shakyo yudhA jetumanyaM kuru manoratham
shlokas.61:
bAhubhyAmuddharedbhUmiM dahetkruddha imAH prajAH |
pAtayettridivAddevAnyo.arjunaM samare jayet
shlokas.62:
pashya kuntIsutaM vIraM bhImamakliShTakAriNam |
prabhAsantaM mahAbAhuM sthitaM merumivAchalam
shlokas.63:
amarShI nityasa.nrabdhashchiraM vairamanusmaran |
eSha bhImo jayaprepsuryudhi tiShThati vIryavAn
shlokas.64:
eSha dharmabhRRitAM shreShTho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
tiShThatyasukaraH sa~Nkhye paraiH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.65:
etau cha puruShavyAghrAvashvinAviva sodarau |
nakulaH sahadevashcha tiShThato yudhi durjayau
shlokas.66:
dRRishyanta ete kArShNeyAH pa~ncha pa~nchAchalA iva |
vyavasthitA yotsyamAnAH sarve.arjunasamA yudhi
shlokas.67:
ete drupadaputrAshcha dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
hInAH satyajitA vIrAstiShThanti paramaujasaH
shlokas.68:
iti sa.nvadatoreva tayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
te sene samasajjetAM ga~NgAyamunavadbhRRisham

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA vyUDheShvanIkeShu sa.nsakteShu cha sa~njaya |
sa.nshaptakAnkathaM pArtho gataH karNashcha pANDavAn
shlokas.2:
etadvistarato yuddhaM prabrUhi kushalo hyasi |
na hi tRRipyAmi vIrANAM shRRiNvAno vikramAnraNe
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatsthAne samavasthApya pratyamitraM mahAbalam |
avyUhatArjuno vyUhaM putrasya tava durnaye
shlokas.4:
tatsAdinAgakalilaM padAtirathasa~Nkulam |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhairvyUDhamashobhata mahadbalam
shlokas.5:
pArAvatasavarNAshvashchandrAdityasamadyutiH |
pArShataH prababhau dhanvI kAlo vigrahavAniva
shlokas.6:
pArShataM tvabhi santasthurdraupadeyA yuyutsavaH |
sAnugA bhImavapuShashchandraM tArAgaNA iva
shlokas.7:
atha vyUDheShvanIkeShu prekShya sa.nshaptakAnraNe |
kruddho.arjuno.abhidudrAva vyAkShipangANDivaM dhanuH
shlokas.8:
atha sa.nshaptakAH pArthamabhyadhAvanvadhaiShiNaH |
vijaye kRRitasa~NkalpA mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.9:
tadashvasa~NghabahulaM mattanAgarathAkulam |
pattimachChUravIraughairdrutamarjunamAdravat
shlokas.10:
sa samprahArastumulasteShAmAsItkirITinA |
tasyaiva naH shruto yAdRRi~NnivAtakavachaiH saha
shlokas.11:
rathAnashvAndhvajAnnAgAnpattInrathapatInapi |
iShUndhanUMShi khaDgA.nshcha chakrANi cha parashvadhAn
shlokas.12:
sAyudhAnudyatAnbAhUnudyatAnyAyudhAni cha |
chichCheda dviShatAM pArthaH shirA.nsi cha sahasrashaH
shlokas.13:
tasminsainye mahAvarte pAtAlAvartasaMnibhe |
nimagnaM taM rathaM matvA neduH sa.nshaptakA mudA
shlokas.14:
sa purastAdarInhatvA pashchArdhenottareNa cha |
dakShiNena cha bIbhatsuH kruddho rudraH pashUniva
shlokas.15:
atha pA~nchAlachedInAM sRRi~njayAnAM cha mAriSha |
tvadIyaiH saha sa~NgrAma AsItparamadAruNaH
shlokas.16:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha shakunishchApi saubalaH |
hRRiShTasenAH susa.nrabdhA rathAnIkaiH prahAriNaH
shlokas.17:
kosalaiH kAshimatsyaishcha kArUShaiH kekayairapi |
shUrasenaiH shUravIrairyuyudhuryuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.18:
teShAmantakaraM yuddhaM dehapApmapraNAshanam |
shUdraviTkShatravIrANAM dharmyaM svargyaM yashaskaram
shlokas.19:
duryodhano.api sahito bhrAtRRibhirbharatarShabha |
guptaH kurupravIraishcha madrANAM cha mahArathaiH
shlokas.20:
pANDavaiH sahapA~nchAlaishchedibhiH sAtyakena cha |
yudhyamAnaM raNe karNaM kuruvIro.abhyapAlayat
shlokas.21:
karNo.api nishitairbANairvinihatya mahAchamUm |
pramRRidya cha rathashreShThAnyudhiShThiramapIDayat
shlokas.22:
vipatrAyudhadehAsUnkRRitvA shatrUnsahasrashaH |
yuktvA svargayashobhyAM cha svebhyo mudamudAvahat
shlokas.23:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yattatpravishya pArthAnAM senAM kurva~njanakShayam |
karNo rAjAnamabhyarchChattanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.24:
ke cha pravIrAH pArthAnAM yudhi karNamavArayan |
kA.nshcha pramathyAdhirathiryudhiShThiramapIDayat
shlokas.25:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAnpArthAndRRiShTvA karNo vyavasthitAn |
samabhyadhAvattvaritaH pA~nchAlA~nshatrukarshanaH
shlokas.26:
taM tUrNamabhidhAvantaM pA~nchAlA jitakAshinaH |
pratyudyayurmahArAja ha.nsA iva mahArNavam
shlokas.27:
tataH sha~NkhasahasrANAM nisvano hRRidaya~NgamaH |
prAdurAsIdubhayato bherIshabdashcha dAruNaH
shlokas.28:
nAnAvAditranAdashcha dvipAshvarathanisvanaH |
siMhanAdashcha vIrANAmabhavaddAruNastadA
shlokas.29:
sAdridrumArNavA bhUmiH savAtAmbudamambaram |
sArkendugrahanakShatrA dyaushcha vyaktaM vyaghUrNata
shlokas.30:
ati bhUtAni taM shabdaM menire.ati cha vivyathuH |
yAni chAplavasattvAni prAyastAni mRRitAni cha
shlokas.31:
atha karNo bhRRishaM kruddhaH shIghramastramudIrayan |
jaghAna pANDavIM senAmAsurIM maghavAniva
shlokas.32:
sa pANDavarathA.nstUrNaM pravishya visRRija~nsharAn |
prabhadrakANAM pravarAnahanatsaptasaptatim
shlokas.33:
tataH supu~Nkhairnishitai rathashreShTho ratheShubhiH |
avadhItpa~nchavi.nshatyA pA~nchAlAnpa~nchavi.nshatim
shlokas.34:
suvarNapu~NkhairnArAchaiH parakAyavidAraNaiH |
chedikAnavadhIdvIraH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.35:
taM tathA samare karma kurvANamatimAnuSham |
parivavrurmahArAja pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAH
shlokas.36:
tataH sandhAya vishikhAnpa~ncha bhArata duHsahAn |
pA~nchAlAnavadhItpa~ncha karNo vaikartano vRRiShaH
shlokas.37:
bhAnudevaM chitrasenaM senAbinduM cha bhArata |
tapanaM shUrasenaM cha pA~nchAlAnavadhIdraNe
shlokas.38:
pA~nchAleShu cha shUreShu vadhyamAneShu sAyakaiH |
hAhAkAro mahAnAsItpA~nchAlAnAM mahAhave
shlokas.39:
teShAM sa~NkIryamANAnAM hAhAkArakRRitA dishaH |
punareva cha tAnkarNo jaghAnAshu patatribhiH
shlokas.40:
chakrarakShau tu karNasya putrau mAriSha durjayau |
suSheNaH satyasenashcha tyaktvA prANAnayudhyatAm
shlokas.41:
pRRiShThagopastu karNasya jyeShThaH putro mahArathaH |
vRRiShasenaH svayaM karNaM pRRiShThataH paryapAlayat
shlokas.42:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH sAtyakishcha draupadeyA vRRikodaraH |
janamejayaH shikhaNDI cha pravIrAshcha prabhadrakAH
shlokas.43:
chedikekayapA~nchAlA yamau matsyAshcha da.nshitAH |
samabhyadhAvanrAdheyaM jighA.nsantaH prahAriNaH
shlokas.44:
ta enaM vividhaiH shastraiH sharadhArAbhireva cha |
abhyavarShanvimRRidnantaH prAvRRiShIvAmbudA girim
shlokas.45:
pitaraM tu parIpsantaH karNaputrAH prahAriNaH |
tvadIyAshchApare rAjanvIrA vIrAnavArayan
shlokas.46:
suSheNo bhImasenasya ChittvA bhallena kArmukam |
nArAchaiH saptabhirviddhvA hRRidi bhImaM nanAda ha
shlokas.47:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sudRRiDhaM bhImavikramaH |
sajyaM vRRikodaraH kRRitvA suSheNasyAchChinaddhanuH
shlokas.48:
vivyAdha chainaM navabhiH kruddho nRRityanniveShubhiH |
karNaM cha tUrNaM vivyAdha trisaptatyA shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.49:
satyasenaM cha dashabhiH sAshvasUtadhvajAyudham |
pashyatAM suhRRidAM madhye karNaputramapAtayat
shlokas.50:
kShurapraNunnaM tattasya shirashchandranibhAnanam |
shubhadarshanamevAsInnAlabhraShTamivAmbujam
shlokas.51:
hatvA karNasutaM bhImastAvakAnpunarArdayat |
kRRipahArdikyayoshChittvA chApe tAvapyathArdayat
shlokas.52:
duHshAsanaM tribhirviddhvA shakuniM ShaDbhirAyasaiH |
ulUkaM cha patatriM cha chakAra virathAvubhau
shlokas.53:
he suSheNa hato.asIti bruvannAdatta sAyakam |
tamasya karNashchichCheda tribhishchainamatADayat
shlokas.54:
athAnyamapi jagrAha suparvANaM sutejanam |
suSheNAyAsRRijadbhImastamapyasyAchChinadvRRiShaH
shlokas.55:
punaH karNastrisaptatyA bhImasenaM ratheShubhiH |
putraM parIpsanvivyAdha krUraM krUrairjighA.nsayA
shlokas.56:
suSheNastu dhanurgRRihya bhArasAdhanamuttamam |
nakulaM pa~nchabhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.57:
nakulastaM tu vi.nshatyA viddhvA bhArasahairdRRiDhaiH |
nanAda balavannAdaM karNasya bhayamAdadhat
shlokas.58:
taM suSheNo mahArAja viddhvA dashabhirAshugaiH |
chichCheda cha dhanuH shIghraM kShurapreNa mahArathaH
shlokas.59:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya nakulaH krodhamUrchChitaH |
suSheNaM bahubhirbANairvArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.60:
sa tu bANairdisho rAjannAchChAdya paravIrahA |
Ajaghne sArathiM chAsya suSheNaM cha tatastribhiH
chichCheda chAsya sudRRiDhaM dhanurbhallaistribhistridhA
shlokas.61:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya suSheNaH krodhamUrChitaH |
avidhyannakulaM ShaShTyA sahadevaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.62:
tadyuddhaM sumahadghoramAsIddevAsuropamam |
nighnatAM sAyakaistUrNamanyonyasya vadhaM prati
shlokas.63:
sAtyakirvRRiShasenasya hatvA sUtaM tribhiH sharaiH |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena jaghAnAshvA.nshcha saptabhiH
dhvajamekeShuNonmathya tribhistaM hRRidyatADayat
shlokas.64:
athAvasannaH svarathe muhUrtAtpunarutthitaH |
atho jighA.nsuH shaineyaM khaDgacharmabhRRidabhyayAt
shlokas.65:
tasya chAplavataH shIghraM vRRiShasenasya sAtyakiH |
varAhakarNairdashabhiravidhyadasicharmaNI
shlokas.66:
duHshAsanastu taM dRRiShTvA virathaM vyAyudhaM kRRitam |
Aropya svarathe tUrNamapovAha rathAntaram
shlokas.67:
athAnyaM rathamAsthAya vRRiShaseno mahArathaH |
karNasya yudhi durdharShaH punaH pRRiShThamapAlayat
shlokas.68:
duHshAsanaM tu shaineyo navairnavabhirAshugaiH |
visUtAshvarathaM kRRitvA lalATe tribhirArpayat
shlokas.69:
sa tvanyaM rathamAsthAya vidhivatkalpitaM punaH |
yuyudhe pANDubhiH sArdhaM karNasyApyAyayanbalam
shlokas.70:
dhRRiShTadyumnastataH karNamavidhyaddashabhiH sharaiH |
draupadeyAstrisaptatyA yuyudhAnastu saptabhiH
shlokas.71:
bhImasenashchatuHShaShTyA sahadevashcha pa~nchabhiH |
nakulastri.nshatA bANaiH shatAnIkashcha saptabhiH
shikhaNDI dashabhirvIro dharmarAjaH shatena tu
shlokas.72:
ete chAnye cha rAjendra pravIrA jayagRRiddhinaH |
abhyardayanmaheShvAsaM sUtaputraM mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.73:
tAnsUtaputro vishikhairdashabhirdashabhiH shitaiH |
rathe chAru charanvIraH pratyavidhyadari.ndamaH
shlokas.74:
tatrAstravIryaM karNasya lAghavaM cha mahAtmanaH |
apashyAma mahArAja tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.75:
na hyAdadAnaM dadRRishuH sa.ndadhAnaM cha sAyakAn |
vimu~nchantaM cha sa.nrambhAddadRRishuste mahAratham
shlokas.76:
dyaurviyadbhUrdishashchAshu praNunnA nishitaiH sharaiH |
aruNAbhrAvRRitAkAraM tasmindeshe babhau viyat
shlokas.77:
nRRityanniva hi rAdheyashchApahastaH pratApavAn |
yairviddhaH pratyavidhyattAnekaikaM triguNaiH sharaiH
shlokas.78:
dashabhirdashabhishchainAnpunarviddhvA nanAda ha |
sAshvasUtadhvajachChatrAstataste vivaraM daduH
shlokas.81:
tataste pANDavA rAja~nshikhaNDI cha sasAtyakiH |
rAdheyAtparirakShanto rAjAnaM paryavArayan
shlokas.82:
tathaiva tAvakAH sarve karNaM durvAraNaM raNe |
yattAH senAmaheShvAsAH paryarakShanta sarvashaH
shlokas.83:
nAnAvAditraghoShAshcha prAdurAsanvishAM pate |
siMhanAdashcha sa~njaj~ne shUrANAmanivartinAm
shlokas.84:
tataH punaH samAjagmurabhItAH kurupANDavAH |
yudhiShThiramukhAH pArthAH sUtaputramukhA vayam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vidArya karNastAM senAM dharmarAjamupAdravat |
rathahastyashvapattInAM sahasraiH parivAritaH
shlokas.2:
nAnAyudhasahasrANi preShitAnyaribhirvRRiShaH |
ChittvA bANashatairugraistAnavidhyadasambhramaH
shlokas.3:
nichakarta shirA.nsyeShAM bAhUnUrU.nshcha sarvashaH |
te hatA vasudhAM peturbhagnAshchAnye vidudruvuH
shlokas.4:
draviDAndhraniShAdAstu punaH sAtyakichoditAH |
abhyardaya~njighA.nsantaH pattayaH karNamAhave
shlokas.5:
te vibAhushirastrANAH prahatAH karNasAyakaiH |
petuH pRRithivyAM yugapachChinnaM shAlavanaM yathA
shlokas.6:
evaM yodhashatAnyAjau sahasrANyayutAni cha |
hatAnIyurmahIM dehairyashasApUrayandishaH
shlokas.7:
atha vaikartanaM karNaM raNe kruddhamivAntakam |
rurudhuH pANDupA~nchAlA vyAdhiM mantrauShadhairiva
shlokas.8:
sa tAnpramRRidyAbhyapatatpunareva yudhiShThiram |
mantrauShadhikriyAtIto vyAdhiratyulbaNo yathA
shlokas.9:
sa rAjagRRiddhibhI ruddhaH pANDupA~nchAlakekayaiH |
nAshakattAnatikrAntuM mRRityurbrahmavido yathA
shlokas.10:
tato yudhiShThiraH karNamadUrasthaM nivAritam |
abravItparavIraghnaH krodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.11:
karNa karNa vRRithAdRRiShTe sUtaputra vachaH shRRiNu |
sadA spardhasi sa~NgrAme phalgunena yashasvinA
tathAsmAnbAdhase nityaM dhArtarAShTramate sthitaH
shlokas.12:
yadbalaM yachcha te vIryaM pradveSho yashcha pANDuShu |
tatsarvaM darshayasvAdya pauruShaM mahadAsthitaH
yuddhashraddhAM sa te.adyAhaM vineShyAmi mahAhave
shlokas.13:
evamuktvA mahArAja karNaM pANDusutastadA |
suvarNapu~NkhairdashabhirvivyAdhAyasmayaiH shitaiH
shlokas.14:
taM sUtaputro navabhiH pratyavidhyadari.ndamaH |
vatsadantairmaheShvAsaH prahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.15:
tataH kShurAbhyAM pA~nchAlyau chakrarakShau mahAtmanaH |
jaghAna samare shUraH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.16:
tAvubhau dharmarAjasya pravIrau paripArshvataH |
rathAbhyAshe chakAshete chandrasyeva punarvasU
shlokas.17:
yudhiShThiraH punaH karNamavidhyattri.nshatA sharaiH |
suSheNaM satyasenaM cha tribhistribhiratADayat
shlokas.18:
shalyaM navatyA vivyAdha trisaptatyA cha sUtajam |
tA.nshchAsya goptR^InvivyAdha tribhistribhirajihmagaiH
shlokas.19:
tataH prahasyAdhirathirvidhunvAnaH sa kArmukam |
bhittvA bhallena rAjAnaM viddhvA ShaShTyAnadanmudA
shlokas.20:
tataH pravIrAH pANDUnAmabhyadhAvanyudhiShThiram |
sUtaputrAtparIpsantaH karNamabhyardaya~nsharaiH
shlokas.21:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha yuyutsuH pANDya eva cha |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha draupadeyAH prabhadrakAH
shlokas.22:
yamau cha bhImasenashcha shishupAlasya chAtmajaH |
kArUShA matsyasheShAshcha kekayAH kAshikosalAH
ete cha tvaritA vIrA vasuSheNamavArayan
shlokas.23:
janamejayashcha pA~nchAlyaH karNaM vivyAdha sAyakaiH |
varAhakarNairnArAchairnAlIkairnishitaiH sharaiH
vatsadantairvipAThaishcha kShurapraishchaTakAmukhaiH
shlokas.24:
nAnApraharaNaishchograi rathahastyashvasAdinaH |
sarvato.abhyAdravankarNaM parivArya jighA.nsayA
shlokas.25:
sa pANDavAnAM pravaraiH sarvataH samabhidrutaH |
udairayadbrAhmamastraM sharaiH sampUrayandishaH
shlokas.26:
tataH sharamahAjvAlo vIryoShmA karNapAvakaH |
nirdahanpANDavavanaM chAru paryacharadraNe
shlokas.27:
sa sa.nvArya mahAstrANi maheShvAso mahAtmanAm |
prahasya puruShendrasya sharaishchichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.28:
tataH sandhAya navatiM nimeShAnnataparvaNAm |
bibheda kavachaM rAj~no raNe karNaH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.29:
tadvarma hemavikRRitaM rarAja nipatattadA |
savidyudabhraM savituH shiShTaM vAtahataM yathA
shlokas.30:
tada~NgaM puruShendrasya bhraShTavarma vyarochata |
ratnairala~NkRRitaM divyairvyabhraM nishi yathA nabhaH
shlokas.31:
sa vivarmA sharaiH pArtho rudhireNa samukShitaH |
kruddhaH sarvAyasIM shaktiM chikShepAdhirathiM prati
shlokas.32:
tAM jvalantImivAkAshe sharaishchichCheda saptabhiH |
sA ChinnA bhUmimapatanmaheShvAsasya sAyakaiH
shlokas.33:
tato bAhvorlalATe cha hRRidi chaiva yudhiShThiraH |
chaturbhistomaraiH karNaM tADayitvA mudAnadat
shlokas.34:
udbhinnarudhiraH karNaH kruddhaH sarpa iva shvasan |
dhvajaM chichCheda bhallena tribhirvivyAdha pANDavam
iShudhI chAsya chichCheda rathaM cha tilasho.achChinat
shlokas.35:
evaM pArtho vyapAyAtsa nihataprArShTisArathiH |
ashaknuvanpramukhataH sthAtuM karNasya durmanAH
shlokas.36:
tamabhidrutya rAdheyaH skandhaM sa.nspRRishya pANinA |
abravItprahasanrAjankutsayanniva pANDavam
shlokas.37:
kathaM nAma kule jAtaH kShatradharme vyavasthitaH |
prajahyAtsamare shatrUnprANAnrakShanmahAhave
shlokas.38:
na bhavAnkShatradharmeShu kushalo.asIti me matiH |
brAhme bale bhavAnyuktaH svAdhyAye yaj~nakarmaNi
shlokas.39:
mA sma yudhyasva kaunteya mA cha vIrAnsamAsadaH |
mA chainAnapriyaM brUhi mA cha vraja mahAraNam
shlokas.40:
evamuktvA tataH pArthaM visRRijya cha mahAbalaH |
nyahanatpANDavIM senAM vajrahasta ivAsurIm
tataH prAyAddrutaM rAjanvrIDanniva janeshvaraH
shlokas.41:
atha prayAntaM rAjAnamanvayuste tadAchyutam |
chedipANDavapA~nchAlAH sAtyakishcha mahArathaH
draupadeyAstathA shUrA mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.42:
tato yudhiShThirAnIkaM dRRiShTvA karNaH parA~Nmukham |
kurubhiH sahito vIraiH pRRiShThagaiH pRRiShThamanvayAt
shlokas.43:
sha~NkhabherIninAdaishcha kArmukANAM cha nisvanaiH |
babhUva dhArtarAShTrANAM siMhanAdaravastadA
shlokas.44:
yudhiShThirastu kauravya rathamAruhya satvaraH |
shrutakIrtermahArAja dRRiShTavAnkarNavikramam
shlokas.45:
kAlyamAnaM balaM dRRiShTvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
tAnyodhAnabravItkruddho hatainaM vai sahasrashaH
shlokas.46:
tato rAj~nAbhyanuj~nAtAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
bhImasenamukhAH sarve putrA.nste pratyupAdravan
shlokas.47:
abhavattumulaH shabdo yodhAnAM tatra bhArata |
hastyashvarathapattInAM shastrANAM cha tatastataH
shlokas.48:
uttiShThata praharata praitAbhipatateti cha |
iti bruvANA anyonyaM jaghnuryodhA raNAjire
shlokas.49:
abhrachChAyeva tatrAsIchCharavRRiShTibhirambare |
samAvRRittairnaravarairnighnadbhiritaretaram
shlokas.50:
vipatAkAdhvajachChatrA vyashvasUtAyudhA raNe |
vya~NgA~NgAvayavAH petuH kShitau kShINA hateshvarAH
shlokas.51:
pravarANIva shailAnAM shikharANi dvipottamAH |
sArohA nihatAH peturvajrabhinnA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.52:
ChinnabhinnaviparyastairvarmAla~NkAravigrahaiH |
sArohAsturagAH peturhatavIrAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.53:
vipraviddhAyudhA~NgAshcha dviradAshvarathairhatAH |
prativIraishcha saMmarde pattisa~NghAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.54:
vishAlAyatatAmrAkShaiH padmendusadRRishAnanaiH |
shirobhiryuddhashauNDAnAM sarvataH sa.nstRRitA mahI
shlokas.55:
tathA tu vitate vyomni nisvanaM shushruvurjanAH |
vimAnairapsaraHsa~NghairgItavAditranisvanaiH
shlokas.56:
hatAnkRRittAnabhimukhAnvIrAnvIraiH sahasrashaH |
AropyAropya gachChanti vimAneShvapsarogaNAH
shlokas.57:
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM pratyakShaM svargalipsayA |
prahRRiShTamanasaH shUrAH kShipraM jagmuH parasparam
shlokas.58:
rathino rathibhiH sArdhaM chitraM yuyudhurAhave |
pattayaH pattibhirnAgA nAgaiH saha hayairhayAH
shlokas.59:
evaM pravRRitte sa~NgrAme gajavAjijanakShaye |
sainye cha rajasA vyApte sve svA~njaghnuH pare parAn
shlokas.60:
kachAkachi babhau yuddhaM dantAdanti nakhAnakhi |
muShTiyuddhaM niyuddhaM cha dehapApmavinAshanam
shlokas.61:
tathA vartati sa~NgrAme gajavAjijanakShaye |
narAshvagajadehebhyaH prasRRitA lohitApagA
narAshvagajadehAnsA vyuvAha patitAnbahUn
shlokas.62:
narAshvagajasambAdhe narAshvagajasAdinAm |
lohitodA mahAghorA nadI lohitakardamA
narAshvagajadehAnsA vahantI bhIrubhIShaNI
shlokas.63:
tasyAH paramapAraM cha vrajanti vijayaiShiNaH |
gAdhena cha plavantashcha nimajjyonmajjya chApare
shlokas.64:
te tu lohitadigdhA~NgA raktavarmAyudhAmbarAH |
sasnustasyAM papushchAsRRi~Nmamlushcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.65:
rathAnashvAnnarAnnAgAnAyudhAbharaNAni cha |
vasanAnyatha varmANi hanyamAnAnhatAnapi
bhUmiM khaM dyAM dishashchaiva prAyaH pashyAma lohitam
shlokas.66:
lohitasya tu gandhena sparshena cha rasena cha |
rUpeNa chAtiriktena shabdena cha visarpatA
viShAdaH sumahAnAsItprAyaH sainyasya bhArata
shlokas.67:
tattu viprahataM sainyaM bhImasenamukhaistava |
bhUyaH samAdravanvIrAH sAtyakipramukhA rathAH
shlokas.68:
teShAmApatatAM vegamaviShahya mahAtmanAm |
putrANAM te mahatsainyamAsIdrAjanparA~Nmukham
shlokas.69:
tatprakIrNarathAshvebhaM naravAjisamAkulam |
vidhvastacharmakavachaM praviddhAyudhakArmukam
shlokas.70:
vyadravattAvakaM sainyaM loDyamAnaM samantataH |
siMhArditaM mahAraNye yathA gajakulaM tathA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tAnabhidravato dRRiShTvA pANDavA.nstAvakaM balam |
kroshatastava putrasya na sma rAjannyavartata
shlokas.2:
tataH pakShAtprapakShAchcha prapakShaishchApi dakShiNAt |
udastashastrAH kuravo bhImamabhyadravanraNe
shlokas.3:
karNo.api dRRiShTvA dravato dhArtarAShTrAnparA~NmukhAn |
ha.nsavarNAnhayAgryA.nstAnpraiShIdyatra vRRikodaram
shlokas.4:
te preShitA mahArAja shalyenAhavashobhinA |
bhImasenarathaM prApya samasajjanta vAjinaH
shlokas.5:
dRRiShTvA karNaM samAyAntaM bhImaH krodhasamanvitaH |
matiM dadhre vinAshAya karNasya bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
so.abravItsAtyakiM vIraM dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam |
enaM rakShata rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
sa.nshayAnmahato muktaM katha~nchitprekShato mama
shlokas.7:
agrato me kRRito rAjA ChinnasarvaparichChadaH |
duryodhanasya prItyarthaM rAdheyena durAtmanA
shlokas.8:
antamadya kariShyAmi tasya duHkhasya pArShata |
hantA vAsmi raNe karNaM sa vA mAM nihaniShyati
sa~NgrAmeNa sughoreNa satyametadbravImi vaH
shlokas.9:
rAjAnamadya bhavatAM nyAsabhUtaM dadAmi vai |
asya sa.nrakShaNe sarve yatadhvaM vigatajvarAH
shlokas.10:
evamuktvA mahAbAhuH prAyAdAdhirathiM prati |
siMhanAdena mahatA sarvAH saMnAdayandishaH
shlokas.11:
dRRiShTvA tvaritamAyAntaM bhImaM yuddhAbhinandinam |
sUtaputramathovAcha madrANAmIshvaro vibhuH
shlokas.12:
pashya karNa mahAbAhuM kruddhaM pANDavanandanam |
dIrghakAlArjitaM krodhaM moktukAmaM tvayi dhruvam
shlokas.13:
IdRRishaM nAsya rUpaM me dRRiShTapUrvaM kadAchana |
abhimanyau hate karNa rAkShase vA ghaTotkache
shlokas.14:
trailokyasya samastasya shaktaH kruddho nivAraNe |
bibharti yAdRRishaM rUpaM kAlAgnisadRRishaM shubham
shlokas.15:
iti bruvati rAdheyaM madrANAmIshvare nRRipa |
abhyavartata vai karNaM krodhadIpto vRRikodaraH
shlokas.16:
tathAgataM tu samprekShya bhImaM yuddhAbhinandinam |
abravIdvachanaM shalyaM rAdheyaH prahasanniva
shlokas.17:
yaduktaM vachanaM me.adya tvayA madrajaneshvara |
bhImasenaM prati vibho tatsatyaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
eSha shUrashcha vIrashcha krodhanashcha vRRikodaraH |
nirapekShaH sharIre cha prANatashcha balAdhikaH
shlokas.19:
aj~nAtavAsaM vasatA virATanagare tadA |
draupadyAH priyakAmena kevalaM bAhusa.nshrayAt
gUDhabhAvaM samAshritya kIchakaH sagaNo hataH
shlokas.20:
so.adya sa~NgrAmashirasi saMnaddhaH krodhamUrchChitaH |
ki~NkarodyatadaNDena mRRityunApi vrajedraNam
shlokas.21:
chirakAlAbhilaShito mamAyaM tu manorathaH |
arjunaM samare hanyAM mAM vA hanyAddhana~njayaH
sa me kadAchidadyaiva bhavedbhImasamAgamAt
shlokas.22:
nihate bhImasene tu yadi vA virathIkRRite |
abhiyAsyati mAM pArthastanme sAdhu bhaviShyati
atra yanmanyase prAptaM tachChIghraM sampradhAraya
shlokas.23:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM rAdheyasya mahAtmanaH |
uvAcha vachanaM shalyaH sUtaputraM tathAgatam
shlokas.24:
abhiyAsi mahAbAho bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
nirasya bhImasenaM tu tataH prApsyasi phalgunam
shlokas.25:
yaste kAmo.abhilaShitashchirAtprabhRRiti hRRidgataH |
sa vai sampatsyate karNa satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.26:
evamukte tataH karNaH shalyaM punarabhAShata |
hantAhamarjunaM sa~Nkhye mAM vA hantA dhana~njayaH
yuddhe manaH samAdhAya yAhi yAhItyachodayat
shlokas.27:
tataH prAyAdrathenAshu shalyastatra vishAM pate |
yatra bhImo maheShvAso vyadrAvayata vAhinIm
shlokas.28:
tatastUryaninAdashcha bherINAM cha mahAsvanaH |
udatiShThata rAjendra karNabhImasamAgame
shlokas.29:
bhImaseno.atha sa~Nkruddhastava sainyaM durAsadam |
nArAchairvimalaistIkShNairdishaH prAdrAvayadbalI
shlokas.30:
sa saMnipAtastumulo bhImarUpo vishAM pate |
AsIdraudro mahArAja karNapANDavayormRRidhe
tato muhUrtAdrAjendra pANDavaH karNamAdravat
shlokas.31:
tamApatantaM samprekShya karNo vaikartano vRRiShaH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho nArAchena stanAntare
punashchainamameyAtmA sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.32:
sa viddhaH sUtaputreNa ChAdayAmAsa patribhiH |
vivyAdha nishitaiH karNa navabhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.33:
tasya karNo dhanurmadhye dvidhA chichCheda patriNA |
atha taM ChinnadhanvAnamabhyavidhyatstanAntare
nArAchena sutIkShNena sarvAvaraNabhedinA
shlokas.34:
so.anyatkArmukamAdAya sUtaputraM vRRikodaraH |
rAjanmarmasu marmaj~no viddhvA sunishitaiH sharaiH
nanAda balavannAdaM kampayanniva rodasI
shlokas.35:
taM karNaH pa~nchavi.nshatyA nArAchAnAM samArdayat |
madotkaTaM vane dRRiptamulkAbhiriva ku~njaram
shlokas.36:
tataH sAyakabhinnA~NgaH pANDavaH krodhamUrchChitaH |
sa.nrambhAmarShatAmrAkShaH sUtaputravadhechChayA
shlokas.37:
sa kArmuke mahAvegaM bhArasAdhanamuttamam |
girINAmapi bhettAraM sAyakaM samayojayat
shlokas.38:
vikRRiShya balavachchApamA karNAdatimArutiH |
taM mumocha maheShvAsaH kruddhaH karNajighA.nsayA
shlokas.39:
sa visRRiShTo balavatA bANo vajrAshanisvanaH |
adArayadraNe karNaM vajravega ivAchalam
shlokas.40:
sa bhImasenAbhihato sUtaputraH kurUdvaha |
niShasAda rathopasthe visa~nj~naH pRRitanApatiH
shlokas.41:
tato madrAdhipo dRRiShTvA visa~nj~naM sUtanandanam |
apovAha rathenAjau karNamAhavashobhinam
shlokas.42:
tataH parAjite karNe dhArtarAShTrIM mahAchamUm |
vyadrAvayadbhImaseno yathendro dAnavIM chamUm

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
suduShkaramidaM karma kRRitaM bhImena sa~njaya |
yena karNo mahAbAhU rathopasthe nipAtitaH
shlokas.2:
karNo hyeko raNe hantA sRRi~njayAnpANDavaiH saha |
iti duryodhanaH sUta prAbravInmAM muhurmuhuH
shlokas.3:
parAjitaM tu rAdheyaM dRRiShTvA bhImena sa.nyuge |
tataH paraM kimakarotputro duryodhano mama
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vibhrAntaM prekShya rAdheyaM sUtaputraM mahAhave |
mahatyA senayA rAjansodaryAnsamabhAShata
shlokas.5:
shIghraM gachChata bhadraM vo rAdheyaM parirakShata |
bhImasenabhayAgAdhe majjantaM vyasanArNave
shlokas.6:
te tu rAj~nA samAdiShTA bhImasenajighA.nsavaH |
abhyavartanta sa~NkruddhAH pata~NgA iva pAvakam
shlokas.7:
shrutAyurdurdharaH krAtho vivitsurvikaTaH samaH |
niSha~NgI kavachI pAshI tathA nandopanandakau
shlokas.8:
duShpradharShaH subAhushcha vAtavegasuvarchasau |
dhanurgrAho durmadashcha tathA sattvasamaH sahaH
shlokas.9:
ete rathaiH parivRRitA vIryavanto mahAbalAH |
bhImasenaM samAsAdya samantAtparyavArayan
te vyamu~ncha~nsharavrAtAnnAnAli~NgAnsamantataH
shlokas.10:
sa tairabhyardyamAnastu bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
teShAmApatatAM kShipraM sutAnAM te narAdhipa
rathaiH pa~nchAshatA sArdhaM pa~nchAshannyahanadrathAn
shlokas.11:
vivitsostu tataH kruddho bhallenApAharachChiraH |
sakuNDalashirastrANaM pUrNachandropamaM tadA
bhImena cha mahArAja sa papAta hato bhuvi
shlokas.12:
taM dRRiShTvA nihataM shUraM bhrAtaraH sarvataH prabho |
abhyadravanta samare bhImaM bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.13:
tato.aparAbhyAM bhallAbhyAM putrayoste mahAhave |
jahAra samare prANAnbhImo bhImaparAkramaH
shlokas.14:
tau dharAmanvapadyetAM vAtarugNAviva drumau |
vikaTashcha samashchobhau devagarbhasamau nRRipa
shlokas.15:
tatastu tvarito bhImaH krAthaM ninye yamakShayam |
nArAchena sutIkShNena sa hato nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.16:
hAhAkArastatastIvraH sambabhUva janeshvara |
vadhyamAneShu te rAja.nstadA putreShu dhanviShu
shlokas.17:
teShAM sa.nlulite sainye bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
nandopanandau samare prApayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.18:
tataste prAdravanbhItAH putrAste vihvalIkRRitAH |
bhImasenaM raNe dRRiShTvA kAlAntakayamopamam
shlokas.19:
putrA.nste nihatAndRRiShTvA sUtaputro mahAmanAH |
ha.nsavarNAnhayAnbhUyaH prAhiNodyatra pANDavaH
shlokas.20:
te preShitA mahArAja madrarAjena vAjinaH |
bhImasenarathaM prApya samasajjanta vegitAH
shlokas.21:
sa saMnipAtastumulo ghorarUpo vishAM pate |
AsIdraudro mahArAja karNapANDavayormRRidhe
shlokas.22:
dRRiShTvA mama mahArAja tau sametau mahArathau |
AsIdbuddhiH kathaM nUnametadadya bhaviShyati
shlokas.23:
tato muhUrtAdrAjendra nAtikRRichChrAddhasanniva |
virathaM bhImakarmANaM bhImaM karNashchakAra ha
shlokas.24:
viratho bharatashreShThaH prahasannanilopamaH |
gadAhasto mahAbAhurapatatsyandanottamAt
shlokas.25:
nAgAnsaptashatAnrAjannIShAdantAnprahAriNaH |
vyadhamatsahasA bhImaH kruddharUpaH parantapaH
shlokas.26:
dantaveShTeShu netreShu kambheShu sa kaTeShu cha |
marmasvapi cha marmaj~no ninadanvyadhamadbhRRisham
shlokas.27:
tataste prAdravanbhItAH pratIpaM prahitAH punaH |
mahAmAtraistamAvavrurmeghA iva divAkaram
shlokas.28:
tAnsa saptashatAnnAgAnsArohAyudhaketanAn |
bhUmiShTho gadayA jaghne sharanmeghAnivAnilaH
shlokas.29:
tataH subalaputrasya nAgAnatibalAnpunaH |
pothayAmAsa kaunteyo dvApa~nchAshatamAhave
shlokas.30:
tathA rathashataM sAgraM pattI.nshcha shatasho.aparAn |
nyahanatpANDavo yuddhe tApaya.nstava vAhinIm
shlokas.31:
pratApyamAnaM sUryeNa bhImena cha mahAtmanA |
tava sainyaM sa~nchukocha charma vahnigataM yathA
shlokas.32:
te bhImabhayasantrastAstAvakA bharatarShabha |
vihAya samare bhImaM dudruvurvai disho dasha
shlokas.33:
rathAH pa~nchashatAshchAnye hrAdinashcharmavarmiNaH |
bhImamabhyadrava.nstUrNaM sharapUgaiH samantataH
shlokas.34:
tAnsasUtarathAnsarvAnsapatAkAdhvajAyudhAn |
pothayAmAsa gadayA bhImo viShNurivAsurAn
shlokas.35:
tataH shakuninirdiShTAH sAdinaH shUrasaMmatAH |
trisAhasrA yayurbhImaM shaktyRRiShTiprAsapANayaH
shlokas.36:
tAnpratyudgamya yavanAnashvArohAnvarArihA |
vicharanvividhAnmArgAnghAtayAmAsa pothayan
shlokas.37:
