teShAmAsInmahA~nshabdastADitAnAM cha sArvashaH |
asibhishChidyamAnAnAM naDAnAmiva bhArata
shlokas.38:
evaM subalaputrasya trisAhasrAnhayottamAn |
hatvAnyaM rathamAsthAya kruddho rAdheyamabhyayAt
shlokas.39:
karNo.api samare rAjandharmaputramari.ndamam |
sharaiH prachChAdayAmAsa sArathiM chApyapAtayat
shlokas.40:
tataH sampradrutaM sa~Nkhye rathaM dRRiShTvA mahArathaH |
anvadhAvatkiranbANaiH ka~NkapatrairajihmagaiH
shlokas.41:
rAjAnamabhi dhAvantaM sharairAvRRitya rodasI |
kruddhaH prachChAdayAmAsa sharajAlena mArutiH
shlokas.42:
saMnivRRittastatastUrNaM rAdheyaH shatrukarshanaH |
bhImaM prachChAdayAmAsa samantAnnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.43:
bhImasenarathavyagraM karNaM bhArata sAtyakiH |
abhyardayadameyAtmA pArShNigrahaNakAraNAt
abhyavartata karNastamardito.api sharairbhRRisham
shlokas.44:
tAvanyonyaM samAsAdya vRRiShabhau sarvadhanvinAm |
visRRijantau sharA.nshchitrAnvibhrAjetAM manasvinau
shlokas.45:
tAbhyAM viyati rAjendra vitataM bhImadarshanam |
krau~nchapRRiShThAruNaM raudraM bANajAlaM vyadRRishyata
shlokas.46:
naiva sUryaprabhAM khaM vA na dishaH pradishaH kutaH |
prAj~nAsiShma vayaM tAbhyAM sharairmuktaiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.47:
madhyAhne tapato rAjanbhAskarasya mahAprabhAH |
hRRitAH sarvAH sharaughaistaiH karNamAdhavayostadA
shlokas.48:
saubalaM kRRitavarmANaM drauNimAdhirathiM kRRipam |
sa.nsaktAnpANDavairdRRiShTvA nivRRittAH kuravaH punaH
shlokas.49:
teShAmApatatAM shabdastIvra AsIdvishAM pate |
uddhUtAnAM yathA vRRiShTyA sAgarANAM bhayAvahaH
shlokas.50:
te sene bhRRishasa.nvigne dRRiShTvAnyonyaM mahAraNe |
harSheNa mahatA yukte parigRRihya parasparam
shlokas.51:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM madhyaM prApte divAkare |
yAdRRishaM na kadAchiddhi dRRiShTapUrvaM na cha shrutam
shlokas.52:
balaughastu samAsAdya balaughaM sahasA raNe |
upAsarpata vegena jalaugha iva sAgaram
shlokas.53:
AsInninAdaH sumahAnbalaughAnAM parasparam |
garjatAM sAgaraughANAM yathA syAnnisvano mahAn
shlokas.54:
te tu sene samAsAdya vegavatyau parasparam |
ekIbhAvamanuprApte nadyAviva samAgame
shlokas.55:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM ghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha lipsatAM sumahadyashaH
shlokas.56:
kurUNAM garjatAM tatra avichChedakRRitA giraH |
shrUyante vividhA rAjannAmAnyuddishya bhArata
shlokas.57:
yasya yaddhi raNe nya~NgaM pitRRito mAtRRito.api vA |
karmataH shIlato vApi sa tachChrAvayate yudhi
shlokas.58:
tAndRRiShTvA samare shUrA.nstarjayAnAnparasparam |
abhavanme matI rAjannaiShAmastIti jIvitam
shlokas.59:
teShAM dRRiShTvA tu kruddhAnAM vapUMShyamitatejasAm |
abhavanme bhayaM tIvraM kathametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.60:
tataste pANDavA rAjankauravAshcha mahArathAH |
tatakShuH sAyakaistIkShNairnighnanto hi parasparam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kShatriyAste mahArAja parasparavadhaiShiNaH |
anyonyaM samare jaghnuH kRRitavairAH parasparam
shlokas.2:
rathaughAshcha hayaughAshcha naraughAshcha samantataH |
gajaughAshcha mahArAja sa.nsaktAH sma parasparam
shlokas.3:
gadAnAM parighANAM cha kaNapAnAM cha sarpatAm |
prAsAnAM bhiNDipAlAnAM bhushuNDInAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
sampAtaM chAnvapashyAma sa~NgrAme bhRRishadAruNe |
shalabhA iva sampetuH samantAchCharavRRiShTayaH
shlokas.5:
nAgA nAgAnsamAsAdya vyadhamanta parasparam |
hayA hayA.nshcha samare rathino rathinastathA
pattayaH pattisa~Nghaishcha hayasa~NghairhayAstathA
shlokas.6:
pattayo rathamAta~NgAnrathA hastyashvameva cha |
nAgAshcha samare trya~NgaM mamRRiduH shIghragA nRRipa
shlokas.7:
patatAM tatra shUrANAM kroshatAM cha parasparam |
ghoramAyodhanaM jaj~ne pashUnAM vaishasaM yathA
shlokas.8:
rudhireNa samAstIrNA bhAti bhArata medinI |
shakragopagaNAkIrNA prAvRRiShIva yathA dharA
shlokas.9:
yathA vA vAsasI shukle mahArajanara~njite |
bibhRRiyAdyuvatiH shyAmA tadvadAsIdvasundharA
mA.nsashoNitachitreva shAtakaumbhamayIva cha
shlokas.10:
ChinnAnAM chottamA~NgAnAM bAhUnAM chorubhiH saha |
kuNDalAnAM praviddhAnAM bhUShaNAnAM cha bhArata
shlokas.11:
niShkANAmadhisUtrANAM sharIrANAM cha dhanvinAm |
varmaNAM sapatAkAnAM sa~NghAstatrApatanbhuvi
shlokas.12:
gajAngajAH samAsAdya viShANAgrairadArayan |
viShANAbhihatAste cha bhrAjante dviradA yathA
shlokas.13:
rudhireNAvasiktA~NgA gairikaprasravA iva |
yathA bhrAjanti syandantaH parvatA dhAtumaNDitAH
shlokas.14:
tomarAngajibhirmuktAnpratIpAnAsthitAnbahUn |
hastairvicheruste nAgA babha~njushchApare tathA
shlokas.15:
nArAchaishChinnavarmANo bhrAjante sma gajottamAH |
himAgame mahArAja vyabhrA iva mahIdharAH
shlokas.16:
sharaiH kanakapu~Nkhaistu chitA rejurgajottamAH |
ulkAbhiH sampradIptAgrAH parvatA iva mAriSha
shlokas.17:
kechidabhyAhatA nAgA nAgairnaganibhA bhuvi |
nipetuH samare tasminpakShavanta ivAdrayaH
shlokas.18:
apare prAdravannAgAH shalyArtA vraNapIDitAH |
pratimAnaishcha kumbhaishcha petururvyAM mahAhave
shlokas.19:
niSheduH siMhavachchAnye nadanto bhairavAnravAn |
mamlushcha bahavo rAja.nshchukUjushchApare tathA
shlokas.20:
hayAshcha nihatA bANaiH svarNabhANDaparichChadAH |
niShedushchaiva mamlushcha babhramushcha disho dasha
shlokas.21:
apare kRRiShyamANAshcha viveShTanto mahItale |
bhAvAnbahuvidhA.nshchakrustADitAH sharatomaraiH
shlokas.22:
narAstu nihatA bhUmau kUjantastatra mAriSha |
dRRiShTvA cha bAndhavAnanye pitR^Inanye pitAmahAn
shlokas.23:
dhAvamAnAnparA.nshchaiva dRRiShTvAnye tatra bhArata |
gotranAmAni khyAtAni shasha.nsuritaretaram
shlokas.24:
teShAM ChinnA mahArAja bhujAH kanakabhUShaNAH |
udveShTante viveShTante patante chotpatanti cha
shlokas.25:
nipatanti tathA bhUmau sphuranti cha sahasrashaH |
vegA.nshchAnye raNe chakruH sphuranta iva pannagAH
shlokas.26:
te bhujA bhogibhogAbhAshchandanAktA vishAM pate |
lohitArdrA bhRRishaM rejustapanIyadhvajA iva
shlokas.27:
vartamAne tathA ghore sa~Nkule sarvatodisham |
avij~nAtAH sma yudhyante vinighnantaH parasparam
shlokas.28:
bhaumena rajasA kIrNe shastrasampAtasa~Nkule |
naiva sve na pare rAjanvyaj~nAyanta tamovRRite
shlokas.29:
tathA tadabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam |
shoNitodA mahAnadyaH prasasrustatra chAsakRRit
shlokas.30:
shIrShapAShANasa~nChannAH keshashaivalashAdvalAH |
asthisa~NghAtasa~NkIrNA dhanuHsharavarottamAH
shlokas.31:
mA.nsakardamapa~NkAshcha shoNitaughAH sudAruNAH |
nadIH pravartayAmAsuryamarAShTravivardhanIH
shlokas.32:
tA nadyo ghorarUpAshcha nayantyo yamasAdanam |
avagADhA majjayantyaH kShatrasyAjanayanbhayam
shlokas.33:
kravyAdAnAM naravyAghra nardatAM tatra tatra ha |
ghoramAyodhanaM jaj~ne pretarAjapuropamam
shlokas.34:
utthitAnyagaNeyAni kabandhAni samantataH |
nRRityanti vai bhUtagaNAH santRRiptA mA.nsashoNitaiH
shlokas.35:
pItvA cha shoNitaM tatra vasAM pItvA cha bhArata |
medomajjAvasAtRRiptAstRRiptA mA.nsasya chaiva hi
dhAvamAnAshcha dRRishyante kAkagRRidhrabalAstathA
shlokas.36:
shUrAstu samare rAjanbhayaM tyaktvA sudustyajam |
yodhavratasamAkhyAtAshchakruH karmANyabhItavat
shlokas.37:
sharashaktisamAkIrNe kravyAdagaNasa~Nkule |
vyacharanta gaNaiH shUrAH khyApayantaH svapauruSham
shlokas.38:
anyonyaM shrAvayanti sma nAmagotrANi bhArata |
pitRRinAmAni cha raNe gotranAmAni chAbhitaH
shlokas.39:
shrAvayanto hi bahavastatra yodhA vishAM pate |
anyonyamavamRRidnantaH shaktitomarapaTTishaiH
shlokas.40:
vartamAne tadA yuddhe ghorarUpe sudAruNe |
vyaShIdatkauravI senA bhinnA nauriva sAgare

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vartamAne tadA yuddhe kShatriyANAM nimajjane |
gANDIvasya mahAnghoShaH shushruve yudhi mAriSha
shlokas.2:
sa.nshaptakAnAM kadanamakarodyatra pANDavaH |
kosalAnAM tathA rAjannArAyaNabalasya cha
shlokas.3:
sa.nshaptakAstu samare sharavRRiShTiM samantataH |
apAtayanpArthamUrdhni jayagRRiddhAH pramanyavaH
shlokas.4:
tAM vRRiShTiM sahasA rAja.nstarasA dhArayanprabhuH |
vyagAhata raNe pArtho vinighnanrathinAM varaH
shlokas.5:
nigRRihya tu rathAnIkaM ka~NkapatraiH shilAshitaiH |
AsasAda raNe pArthaH susharmANaM mahAratham
shlokas.6:
sa tasya sharavarShANi vavarSha rathinAM varaH |
tathA sa.nshaptakAshchaiva pArthasya samare sthitAH
shlokas.7:
susharmA tu tataH pArthaM viddhvA navabhirAshugaiH |
janArdanaM tribhirbANairabhyahandakShiNe bhuje
tato.apareNa bhallena ketuM vivyAdha mAriSha
shlokas.8:
sa vAnaravaro rAjanvishvakarmakRRito mahAn |
nanAda sumahannAdaM bhIShayanvai nanarda cha
shlokas.9:
kapestu ninadaM shrutvA santrastA tava vAhinI |
bhayaM vipulamAdAya nishcheShTA samapadyata
shlokas.10:
tataH sA shushubhe senA nishcheShTAvasthitA nRRipa |
nAnApuShpasamAkIrNaM yathA chaitrarathaM vanam
shlokas.11:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM yodhAste kurusattama |
arjunaM siShichurbANaiH parvataM jaladA iva
parivavrustadA sarve pANDavasya mahAratham
shlokas.12:
te hayAnrathachakre cha ratheShAshchApi bhArata |
nigRRihya balavattUrNaM siMhanAdamathAnadan
shlokas.13:
apare jagRRihushchaiva keshavasya mahAbhujau |
pArthamanye mahArAja rathasthaM jagRRihurmudA
shlokas.14:
keshavastu tadA bAhU vidhunvanraNamUrdhani |
pAtayAmAsa tAnsarvAnduShTahastIva hastinaH
shlokas.15:
tataH kruddho raNe pArthaH sa.nvRRitastairmahArathaiH |
nigRRihItaM rathaM dRRiShTvA keshavaM chApyabhidrutam
rathArUDhA.nshcha subahUnpadAtI.nshchApyapAtayat
shlokas.16:
AsannA.nshcha tato yodhA~nsharairAsannayodhibhiH |
chyAvayAmAsa samare keshavaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.17:
pashya kRRiShNa mahAbAho sa.nshaptakagaNAnmayA |
kurvANAndAruNaM karma vadhyamAnAnsahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
rathabandhamimaM ghoraM pRRithivyAM nAsti kashchana |
yaH saheta pumA.Nlloke madanyo yadupu~Ngava
shlokas.19:
ityevamuktvA bIbhatsurdevadattamathAdhamat |
pA~nchajanyaM cha kRRiShNo.api pUrayanniva rodasI
shlokas.20:
taM tu sha~NkhasvanaM shrutvA sa.nshaptakavarUthinI |
sa~nchachAla mahArAja vitrastA chAbhavadbhRRisham
shlokas.21:
padabandhaM tatashchakre pANDavaH paravIrahA |
nAgamastraM mahArAja samprodIrya muhurmuhuH
shlokas.22:
yAnuddishya raNe pArthaH padabandhaM chakAra ha |
te baddhAH padabandhena pANDavena mahAtmanA
nishcheShTA abhavanrAjannashmasAramayA iva
shlokas.23:
nishcheShTA.nstu tato yodhAnavadhItpANDunandanaH |
yathendraH samare daityA.nstArakasya vadhe purA
shlokas.24:
te vadhyamAnAH samare mumuchustaM rathottamam |
AyudhAni cha sarvANi visraShTumupachakramuH
shlokas.25:
tataH susharmA rAjendra gRRihItAM vIkShya vAhinIm |
sauparNamastraM tvaritaH prAdushchakre mahArathaH
shlokas.26:
tataH suparNAH sampeturbhakShayanto bhuja~NgamAn |
te vai vidudruvurnAgA dRRiShTvA tAnkhacharAnnRRipa
shlokas.27:
babhau balaM tadvimuktaM padabandhAdvishAM pate |
meghavRRindAdyathA mukto bhAskarastApayanprajAH
shlokas.28:
vipramuktAstu te yodhAH phalgunasya rathaM prati |
sasRRijurbANasa~NghA.nshcha shastrasa~NghA.nshcha mAriSha
shlokas.29:
tAM mahAstramayIM vRRiShTiM sa~nChidya sharavRRiShTibhiH |
vyavAtiShThattato yodhAnvAsaviH paravIrahA
shlokas.30:
susharmA tu tato rAjanbANenAnataparvaNA |
arjunaM hRRidaye viddhvA vivyAdhAnyaistribhiH sharaiH
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.31:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
aindramastramameyAtmA prAdushchakre tvarAnvitaH
tato bANasahasrANi samutpannAni mAriSha
shlokas.32:
sarvadikShu vyadRRishyanta sUdayanto nRRipa dvipAn |
hayAnrathA.nshcha samare shastraiH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.33:
vadhyamAne tataH sainye vipulA bhIH samAvishat |
sa.nshaptakagaNAnAM cha gopAlAnAM cha bhArata
na hi kashchitpumA.nstatra yo.arjunaM pratyayudhyata
shlokas.34:
pashyatAM tatra vIrANAmahanyata mahadbalam |
hanyamAnamapashya.nshcha nishcheShTAH sma parAkrame
shlokas.35:
ayutaM tatra yodhAnAM hatvA pANDusuto raNe |
vyabhrAjata raNe rAjanvidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.36:
chaturdasha sahasrANi yAni shiShTAni bhArata |
rathAnAmayutaM chaiva trisAhasrAshcha dantinaH
shlokas.37:
tataH sa.nshaptakA bhUyaH parivavrurdhana~njayam |
martavyamiti nishchitya jayaM vApi nivartanam
shlokas.38:
tatra yuddhaM mahaddhyAsIttAvakAnAM vishAM pate |
shUreNa balinA sArdhaM pANDavena kirITinA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kRRitavarmA kRRipo drauNiH sUtaputrashcha mAriSha |
ulUkaH saubalashchaiva rAjA cha saha sodaraiH
shlokas.2:
sIdamAnAM chamUM dRRiShTvA pANDuputrabhayArditAm |
samujjihIrShurvegena bhinnAM nAvamivArNave
shlokas.3:
tato yuddhamatIvAsInmuhUrtamiva bhArata |
bhIrUNAM trAsajananaM shUrANAM harShavardhanam
shlokas.4:
kRRipeNa sharavarShANi vipramuktAni sa.nyuge |
sRRi~njayAH shAtayAmAsuH shalabhAnAM vrajA iva
shlokas.5:
shikhaNDI tu tataH kruddho gautamaM tvarito yayau |
vavarSha sharavarShANi samantAdeva brAhmaNe
shlokas.6:
kRRipastu sharavarShaM tadvinihatya mahAstravit |
shikhaNDinaM raNe kruddho vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.7:
tataH shikhaNDI kupItaH sharaiH saptabhirAhave |
kRRipaM vivyAdha subhRRishaM ka~NkapatrairajihmagaiH
shlokas.8:
tataH kRRipaH sharaistIkShNaiH so.atividdho mahArathaH |
vyashvasUtarathaM chakre pArShataM tu dvijottamaH
shlokas.9:
hatAshvAttu tato yAnAdavaplutya mahArathaH |
charmakhaDge cha sa~NgRRihya satvaraM brAhmaNaM yayau
shlokas.10:
tamApatantaM sahasA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
ChAdayAmAsa samare tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.11:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma shilAnAM plavanaM yathA |
nishcheShTo yadraNe rAja~nshikhaNDI samatiShThata
shlokas.12:
kRRipeNa ChAditaM dRRiShTvA nRRipottama shikhaNDinam |
pratyudyayau kRRipaM tUrNaM dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH
shlokas.13:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tato yAntaM shAradvatarathaM prati |
pratijagrAha vegena kRRitavarmA mahArathaH
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThiramathAyAntaM shAradvatarathaM prati |
saputraM sahasenaM cha droNaputro nyavArayat
shlokas.15:
nakulaM sahadevaM cha tvaramANau mahArathau |
pratijagrAha te putraH sharavarSheNa vArayan
shlokas.16:
bhImasenaM karUShA.nshcha kekayAnsahasRRi~njayAn |
karNo vaikartano yuddhe vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.17:
shikhaNDinastato bANAnkRRipaH shAradvato yudhi |
prAhiNottvarayA yukto didhakShuriva mAriSha
shlokas.18:
tA~nsharAnpreShitA.nstena samantAddhemabhUShaNAn |
chichCheda khaDgamAvidhya bhrAmaya.nshcha punaH punaH
shlokas.19:
shatachandraM tatashcharma gautamaH pArShatasya ha |
vyadhamatsAyakaistUrNaM tata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.20:
sa vicharmA mahArAja khaDgapANirupAdravat |
kRRipasya vashamApanno mRRityorAsyamivAturaH
shlokas.21:
shAradvatasharairgrastaM klishyamAnaM mahAbalam |
chitraketusuto rAjansuketustvarito yayau
shlokas.22:
vikiranbrAhmaNaM yuddhe bahubhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
abhyApatadameyAtmA gautamasya rathaM prati
shlokas.23:
dRRiShTvAviShahyaM taM yuddhe brAhmaNaM charitavratam |
apayAtastatastUrNaM shikhaNDI rAjasattama
shlokas.24:
suketustu tato rAjangautamaM navabhiH sharaiH |
viddhvA vivyAdha saptatyA punashchainaM tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.25:
athAsya sasharaM chApaM punashchichCheda mAriSha |
sArathiM cha shareNAsya bhRRishaM marmaNyatADayat
shlokas.26:
gautamastu tataH kruddho dhanurgRRihya navaM dRRiDham |
suketuM tri.nshatA bANaiH sarvamarmasvatADayat
shlokas.27:
sa vihvalitasarvA~NgaH prachachAla rathottame |
bhUmichAle yathA vRRikShashchalatyAkampito bhRRisham
shlokas.28:
chalatastasya kAyAttu shiro jvalitakuNDalam |
soShNIShaM sashirastrANaM kShurapreNAnvapAtayat
shlokas.29:
tachChiraH prApatadbhUmau shyenAhRRitamivAmiSham |
tato.asya kAyo vasudhAM pashchAtprApa tadA chyutaH
shlokas.30:
tasminhate mahArAja trastAstasya padAnugAH |
gautamaM samare tyaktvA dudruvuste disho dasha
shlokas.31:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tu samare saMnivArya mahAbalaH |
kRRitavarmAbravIddhRRiShTastiShTha tiShTheti pArShatam
shlokas.32:
tadabhUttumulaM yuddhaM vRRiShNipArShatayo raNe |
AmiShArthe yathA yuddhaM shyenayorgRRiddhayornRRipa
shlokas.33:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu samare hArdikyaM navabhiH sharaiH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddhaH pIDayanhRRidikAtmajam
shlokas.34:
kRRitavarmA tu samare pArShatena dRRiDhAhataH |
pArShataM sarathaM sAshvaM ChAdayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.35:
sarathashChAdito rAjandhRRiShTadyumno na dRRishyate |
meghairiva parichChanno bhAskaro jaladAgame
shlokas.36:
vidhUya taM bANagaNaM sharaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH |
vyarochata raNe rAjandhRRiShTadyumnaH kRRitavraNaH
shlokas.37:
tatastu pArShataH kruddhaH shastravRRiShTiM sudAruNAm |
kRRitavarmANamAsAdya vyasRRijatpRRitanApatiH
shlokas.38:
tAmApatantIM sahasA shastravRRiShTiM nirantarAm |
sharairanekasAhasrairhArdikyo vyadhamadyudhi
shlokas.39:
dRRiShTvA tu dAritAM yuddhe shastravRRiShTiM duruttarAm |
kRRitavarmANamabhyetya vArayAmAsa pArShataH
shlokas.40:
sArathiM chAsya tarasA prAhiNodyamasAdanam |
bhallena shitadhAreNa sa hataH prApatadrathAt
shlokas.41:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu balavA~njitvA shatruM mahAratham |
kauravAnsamare tUrNaM vArayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.42:
tataste tAvakA yodhA dhRRiShTadyumnamupAdravan |
siMhanAdaravaM kRRitvA tato yuddhamavartata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
drauNiryudhiShThiraM dRRiShTvA shaineyenAbhirakShitam |
draupadeyaistathA shUrairabhyavartata hRRiShTavat
shlokas.2:
kiranniShugaNAnghorAnsvarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn |
darshayanvividhAnmArgA~nshikShArthaM laghuhastavat
shlokas.3:
tataH khaM pUrayAmAsa sharairdivyAstramantritaiH |
yudhiShThiraM cha samare paryavArayadastravit
shlokas.4:
drauNAyanisharachChannaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana |
bANabhUtamabhUtsarvamAyodhanashiro hi tat
shlokas.5:
bANajAlaM diviShThaM tatsvarNajAlavibhUShitam |
shushubhe bharatashreShTha vitAnamiva viShThitam
shlokas.6:
tena Channe raNe rAjanbANajAlena bhAsvatA |
abhrachChAyeva sa~njaj~ne bANaruddhe nabhastale
shlokas.7:
tatrAshcharyamapashyAma bANabhUte tathAvidhe |
na sma sampatate bhUmau dRRiShTvA drauNeH parAkramam
shlokas.8:
lAghavaM droNaputrasya dRRiShTvA tatra mahArathAH |
vyasmayanta mahArAja na chainaM prativIkShitum
shekuste sarvarAjAnastapantamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.9:
sAtyakiryatamAnastu dharmarAjashcha pANDavaH |
tathetarANi sainyAni na sma chakruH parAkramam
shlokas.10:
vadhyamAne tataH sainye draupadeyA mahArathAH |
sAtyakirdharmarAjashcha pA~nchAlAshchApi sa~NgatAH
tyaktvA mRRityubhayaM ghoraM drauNAyanimupAdravan
shlokas.11:
sAtyakiH pa~nchavi.nshatyA drauNiM viddhvA shilAmukhaiH |
punarvivyAdha nArAchaiH saptabhiH svarNabhUShitaiH
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThirastrisaptatyA prativindhyashcha saptabhiH |
shrutakarmA tribhirbANaiH shrutakIrtistu saptabhiH
shlokas.13:
sutasomashcha navabhiH shatAnIkashcha saptabhiH |
anye cha bahavaH shUrA vivyadhustaM samantataH
shlokas.14:
so.atikruddhastato rAjannAshIviSha iva shvasan |
sAtyakiM pa~nchavi.nshatyA prAvidhyata shilAshitaiH
shlokas.15:
shrutakIrtiM cha navabhiH sutasomaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
aShTabhiH shrutakarmANaM prativindhyaM tribhiH sharaiH
shatAnIkaM cha navabhirdharmaputraM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.16:
athetarA.nstataH shUrAndvAbhyAM dvAbhyAmatADayat |
shrutakIrtestathA chApaM chichCheda nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.17:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya shrutakIrtirmahArathaH |
drauNAyaniM tribhirviddhvA vivyAdhAnyaiH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.18:
tato drauNirmahArAja sharavarSheNa bhArata |
ChAdayAmAsa tatsainyaM samantAchcha sharairnRRipAn
shlokas.19:
tataH punarameyAtmA dharmarAjasya kArmukam |
drauNishchichCheda vihasanvivyAdha cha sharaistribhiH
shlokas.20:
tato dharmasuto rAjanpragRRihyAnyanmahaddhanuH |
drauNiM vivyAdha saptatyA bAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.21:
sAtyakistu tataH kruddho drauNeH praharato raNe |
ardhachandreNa tIkShNena dhanushChittvAnadadbhRRisham
shlokas.22:
ChinnadhanvA tato drauNiH shaktyA shaktimatAM varaH |
sArathiM pAtayAmAsa shaineyasya rathAddrutam
shlokas.23:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya droNaputraH pratApavAn |
shaineyaM sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.24:
tasyAshvAH pradrutAH sa~Nkhye patite rathasArathau |
tatra tatraiva dhAvantaH samadRRishyanta bhArata
shlokas.25:
yudhiShThirapurogAste drauNiM shastrabhRRitAM varam |
abhyavarShanta vegena visRRijantaH shitA~nsharAn
shlokas.26:
AgachChamAnA.nstAndRRiShTvA raudrarUpAnparantapaH |
prahasanpratijagrAha droNaputro mahAraNe
shlokas.27:
tataH sharashatajvAlaH senAkakShaM mahArathaH |
drauNirdadAha samare kakShamagniryathA vane
shlokas.28:
tadbalaM pANDuputrasya droNaputrapratApitam |
chukShubhe bharatashreShTha timineva nadImukham
shlokas.29:
dRRiShTvA te cha mahArAja droNaputraparAkramam |
nihatAnmenire sarvAnpANDUndroNasutena vai
shlokas.30:
yudhiShThirastu tvarito drauNiM shliShya mahAratham |
abravIddroNaputraM tu roShAmarShasamanvitaH
shlokas.31:
naiva nAma tava prItirnaiva nAma kRRitaj~natA |
yatastvaM puruShavyAghra mAmevAdya jighA.nsasi
shlokas.32:
brAhmaNena tapaH kAryaM dAnamadhyayanaM tathA |
kShatriyeNa dhanurnAmyaM sa bhavAnbrAhmaNabruvaH
shlokas.33:
miShataste mahAbAho jeShyAmi yudhi kauravAn |
kuruShva samare karma brahmabandhurasi dhruvam
shlokas.34:
evamukto mahArAja droNaputraH smayanniva |
yuktatvaM tachcha sa~nchintya nottaraM ki~nchidabravIt
shlokas.35:
anuktvA cha tataH ki~nchichCharavarSheNa pANDavam |
ChAdayAmAsa samare kruddho.antaka iva prajAH
shlokas.36:
sa~nChAdyamAnastu tadA droNaputreNa mAriSha |
pArtho.apayAtaH shIghraM vai vihAya mahatIM chamUm
shlokas.37:
apayAte tatastasmindharmaputre yudhiShThire |
droNaputraH sthito rAjanpratyAdeshAnmahAtmanaH
shlokas.38:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA tyaktvA drauNiM mahAhave |
prayayau tAvakaM sainyaM yuktaH krUrAya karmaNe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenaM sapA~nchAlyaM chedikekayasa.nvRRitam |
vaikartanaH svayaM ruddhvA vArayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.2:
tatastu chedikArUShAnsRRi~njayA.nshcha mahArathAn |
karNo jaghAna sa~Nkruddho bhImasenasya pashyataH
shlokas.3:
bhImasenastataH karNaM vihAya rathasattamam |
prayayau kauravaM sainyaM kakShamagniriva jvalan
shlokas.4:
sUtaputro.api samare pA~nchAlAnkekayA.nstathA |
sRRi~njayA.nshcha maheShvAsAnnijaghAna sahasrashaH
shlokas.5:
sa.nshaptakeShu pArthashcha kauraveShu vRRikodaraH |
pA~nchAleShu tathA karNaH kShayaM chakrUrmahArathAH
shlokas.6:
te kShatriyA dahyamAnAstribhistaiH pAvakopamaiH |
jagmurvinAshaM samare rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.7:
tato duryodhanaH kruddho nakulaM navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha bharatashreShTha chaturashchAsya vAjinaH
shlokas.8:
tataH punarameyAtmA tava putro janAdhipaH |
kShureNa sahadevasya dhvajaM chichCheda kA~nchanam
shlokas.9:
nakulastu tataH kruddhastava putraM trisaptabhiH |
jaghAna samare rAjansahadevashcha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.10:
tAvubhau bharatashreShThau shreShThau sarvadhanuShmatAm |
vivyAdhorasi sa~NkruddhaH pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.11:
tato.aparAbhyAM bhallAbhyAM dhanuShI samakRRintata |
yamayoH prahasanrAjanvivyAdhaiva cha saptabhiH
shlokas.12:
tAvanye dhanuShI shreShThe shakrachApanibhe shubhe |
pragRRihya rejatuH shUrau devaputrasamau yudhi
shlokas.13:
tatastau rabhasau yuddhe bhrAtarau bhrAtaraM nRRipa |
sharairvavarShaturghorairmahAmeghau yathAchalam
shlokas.14:
tataH kruddho mahArAja tava putro mahArathaH |
pANDuputrau maheShvAsau vArayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.15:
dhanurmaNDalamevAsya dRRishyate yudhi bhArata |
sAyakAshchaiva dRRishyante nishcharantaH samantataH
shlokas.16:
tasya sAyakasa~nChannau chakAshetAM cha pANDavau |
meghachChannau yathA vyomni chandrasUryau hataprabhau
shlokas.17:
te tu bANA mahArAja hemapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH |
AchChAdayandishaH sarvAH sUryasyevA.nshavastadA
shlokas.18:
bANabhUte tatastasminsa~nChanne cha nabhastale |
yamAbhyAM dadRRishe rUpaM kAlAntakayamopamam
shlokas.19:
parAkramaM tu taM dRRiShTvA tava sUnormahArathAH |
mRRityorupAntikaM prAptau mAdrIputrau sma menire
shlokas.20:
tataH senApatI rAjanpANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
pArShataH prayayau tatra yatra rAjA suyodhanaH
shlokas.21:
mAdrIputrau tataH shUrau vyatikramya mahArathau |
dhRRiShTadyumnastava sutaM tADayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.22:
tamavidhyadameyAtmA tava putro.atyamarShaNaH |
pA~nchAlyaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA prahasya puruSharShabha
shlokas.23:
tataH punarameyAtmA putraste pRRithivIpate |
viddhvA nanAda pA~nchAlyaM ShaShTyA pa~nchabhireva cha
shlokas.24:
athAsya sasharaM chApaM hastAvApaM cha mAriSha |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena rAjA chichCheda sa.nyuge
shlokas.25:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM pA~nchAlyaH shatrukarshanaH |
anyadAdatta vegena dhanurbhArasahaM navam
shlokas.26:
prajvalanniva vegena sa.nrambhAdrudhirekShaNaH |
ashobhata maheShvAso dhRRiShTadyumnaH kRRitavraNaH
shlokas.27:
sa pa~nchadasha nArAchA~nshvasataH pannagAniva |
jighA.nsurbharatashreShThaM dhRRiShTadyumno vyavAsRRijat
shlokas.28:
te varma hemavikRRitaM bhittvA rAj~naH shilAshitAH |
vivishurvasudhAM vegAtka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH
shlokas.29:
so.atividdho mahArAja putraste.ativyarAjata |
vasante puShpashabalaH sapuShpa iva ki.nshukaH
shlokas.30:
sa ChinnavarmA nArAchaiH prahArairjarjarachChaviH |
dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhallena kruddhashchichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.31:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM tvaramANo mahIpatiH |
sAyakairdashabhI rAjanbhruvormadhye samArdayat
shlokas.32:
tasya te.ashobhayanvaktraM karmAraparimArjitAH |
praphullaM champakaM yadvadbhramarA madhulipsavaH
shlokas.33:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM dhRRiShTadyumno mahAmanAH |
anyadAdatta vegena dhanurbhallA.nshcha ShoDasha
shlokas.34:
tato duryodhanasyAshvAnhatvA sUtaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena jAtarUpapariShkRRitam
shlokas.35:
rathaM sopaskaraM ChatraM shaktiM khaDgaM gadAM dhvajam |
bhallaishchichCheda navabhiH putrasya tava pArShataH
shlokas.36:
tapanIyA~NgadaM chitraM nAgaM maNimayaM shubham |
dhvajaM kurupateshChinnaM dadRRishuH sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.37:
duryodhanaM tu virathaM ChinnasarvAyudhaM raNe |
bhrAtaraH paryarakShanta sodaryA bharatarShabha
shlokas.38:
tamAropya rathe rAjandaNDadhAro janAdhipam |
apovAha cha sambhrAnto dhRRiShTadyumnasya pashyataH
shlokas.39:
karNastu sAtyakiM jitvA rAjagRRiddhI mahAbalaH |
droNahantAramugreShuM sasArAbhimukhaM raNe
shlokas.40:
taM pRRiShThato.abhyayAttUrNaM shaineyo vituda~nsharaiH |
vAraNaM jaghanopAnte viShANAbhyAmiva dvipaH
shlokas.41:
sa bhArata mahAnAsIdyodhAnAM sumahAtmanAm |
karNapArShatayormadhye tvadIyAnAM mahAraNaH
shlokas.42:
na pANDavAnAM nAsmAkaM yodhaH kashchitparA~NmukhaH |
pratyadRRishyata yatkarNaH pA~nchAlA.nstvarito yayau
shlokas.43:
tasminkShaNe narashreShTha gajavAjinarakShayaH |
prAdurAsIdubhayato rAjanmadhya~Ngate.ahani
shlokas.44:
pA~nchAlAstu mahArAja tvaritA vijigIShavaH |
sarvato.abhyadravankarNaM patatriNa iva drumam
shlokas.45:
teShAmAdhirathiH kruddho yatamAnAnmanasvinaH |
vichinvanneva bANAgraiH samAsAdayadagrataH
shlokas.46:
vyAghraketuM susharmANaM sha~NkuM chograM dhana~njayam |
shuklaM cha rochamAnaM cha siMhasenaM cha durjayam
shlokas.47:
te vIrA rathavegena parivavrurnarottamam |
sRRijantaM sAyakAnkruddhaM karNamAhavashobhinam
shlokas.48:
yudhyamAnA.nstu tA~nshUrAnmanujendraH pratApavAn |
aShTAbhiraShTau rAdheyo nyahanannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.49:
athAparAnmahArAja sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
jaghAna bahusAhasrAnyodhAnyuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.50:
viShNuM cha viShNukarmANaM devApiM bhadrameva cha |
daNDaM cha samare rAja.nshchitraM chitrAyudhaM harim
shlokas.51:
siMhaketuM rochamAnaM shalabhaM cha mahAratham |
nijaghAna susa~NkruddhashchedInAM cha mahArathAn
shlokas.52:
teShAmAdadataH prANAnAsIdAdhirathervapuH |
shoNitAbhyukShitA~Ngasya rudrasyevorjitaM mahat
shlokas.53:
tatra bhArata karNena mAta~NgAstADitAH sharaiH |
sarvato.abhyadravanbhItAH kurvanto mahadAkulam
shlokas.54:
nipetururvyAM samare karNasAyakapIDitAH |
kurvanto vividhAnnAdAnvajranunnA ivAchalAH
shlokas.55:
gajavAjimanuShyaishcha nipatadbhiH samantataH |
rathaishchAvagatairmArge paryastIryata medinI
shlokas.56:
naiva bhIShmo na cha droNo nApyanye yudhi tAvakAH |
chakruH sma tAdRRishaM karma yAdRRishaM vai kRRitaM raNe
shlokas.57:
sUtaputreNa nAgeShu ratheShu cha hayeShu cha |
nareShu cha naravyAghra kRRitaM sma kadanaM mahat
shlokas.58:
mRRigamadhye yathA siMho dRRishyate nirbhayashcharan |
pA~nchAlAnAM tathA madhye karNo.acharadabhItavat
shlokas.59:
yathA mRRigagaNA.nstrastAnsiMho drAvayate dishaH |
pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrAtAnkarNo drAvayate tathA
shlokas.60:
siMhAsyaM cha yathA prApya na jIvanti mRRigAH kvachit |
tathA karNamanuprApya na jIvanti mahArathAH
shlokas.61:
vaishvAnaraM yathA dIptaM dahyante prApya vai janAH |
karNAgninA raNe tadvaddagdhA bhArata sRRi~njayAH
shlokas.62:
karNena chediShvekena pA~nchAleShu cha bhArata |
vishrAvya nAma nihatA bahavaH shUrasaMmatAH
shlokas.63:
mama chAsInmanuShyendra dRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam |
naiko.apyAdhiratherjIvanpA~nchAlyo mokShyate yudhi
shlokas.64:
pA~nchAlAnvidhamansa~Nkhye sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
abhyadhAvata sa~Nkruddho dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.65:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha rAjAnaM draupadeyAshcha mAriSha |
parivavruramitraghnaM shatashashchApare janAH
shlokas.66:
shikhaNDI sahadevashcha nakulo nAkulistathA |
janamejayaH shinernaptA bahavashcha prabhadrakAH
shlokas.67:
ete purogamA bhUtvA dhRRiShTadyumnasya sa.nyuge |
karNamasyantamiShvastrairvicheruramitaujasaH
shlokas.68:
tA.nstatrAdhirathiH sa~Nkhye chedipA~nchAlapANDavAn |
eko bahUnabhyapatadgarutmanpannagAniva
shlokas.69:
bhImasenastu sa~NkruddhaH kurUnmadrAnsakekayAn |
ekaH sa~Nkhye maheShvAso yodhayanbahvashobhata
shlokas.70:
tatra marmasu bhImena nArAchaistADitA gajAH |
prapatanto hatArohAH kampayanti sma medinIm
shlokas.71:
vAjinashcha hatArohAH pattayashcha gatAsavaH |
sherate yudhi nirbhinnA vamanto rudhiraM bahu
shlokas.72:
sahasrashashcha rathinaH patitAH patitAyudhAH |
akShatAH samadRRishyanta bhImAdbhItA gatAsavaH
shlokas.73:
rathibhirvAjibhiH sUtaiH pattibhishcha tathA gajaiH |
bhImasenasharachChinnairAstIrNA vasudhAbhavat
shlokas.75:
nishcheShTaM tumule dInaM babhau tasminmahAraNe |
prasannasalilaH kAle yathA syAtsAgaro nRRipa
shlokas.76:
manyuvIryabalopetaM balAtparyavaropitam |
abhavattava putrasya tatsainyamiShubhistadA
rudhiraughapariklinnaM rudhirArdraM babhUva ha
shlokas.77:
sUtaputro raNe kruddhaH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
bhImasenaH kurU.nshchApi drAvayanbahvashobhata
shlokas.78:
vartamAne tathA raudre sa~NgrAme.adbhutadarshane |
nihatya pRRitanAmadhye sa.nshaptakagaNAnbahUn
shlokas.79:
arjuno jayatAM shreShTho vAsudevamathAbravIt |
prabhagnaM balametaddhi yotsyamAnaM janArdana
shlokas.80:
ete dhAvanti sagaNAH sa.nshaptakamahArathAH |
apArayanto madbANAnsiMhashabdAnmRRigA iva
shlokas.81:
dIryate cha mahatsainyaM sRRi~njayAnAM mahAraNe |
hastikakShyo hyasau kRRiShNa ketuH karNasya dhImataH
dRRishyate rAjasainyasya madhye vicharato muhuH
shlokas.82:
na cha karNaM raNe shaktA jetumanye mahArathAH |
jAnIte hi bhavAnkarNaM vIryavantaM parAkrame
shlokas.84:
tatra yAhi yataH karNo drAvayatyeSha no balam |
varjayitvA raNe yAhi sUtaputraM mahAratham |
shramo mA bAdhate kRRiShNa yathA vA tava rochate
shlokas.85:
etachChrutvA mahArAja govindaH prahasanniva |
abravIdarjunaM tUrNaM kauravA~njahi pANDava
shlokas.86:
tatastava mahatsainyaM govindapreritA hayAH |
ha.nsavarNAH pravivishurvahantaH kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.87:
keshavaprahitairashvaiH shvetaiH kA~nchanabhUShaNaiH |
pravishadbhistava balaM chaturdishamabhidyata
shlokas.88:
tau vidArya mahAsenAM praviShTau keshavArjunau |
kruddhau sa.nrambharaktAkShau vyabhrAjetAM mahAdyutI
shlokas.89:
yuddhashauNDau samAhUtAvaribhistau raNAdhvaram |
yajvabhirvidhinAhUtau makhe devAvivAshvinau
shlokas.90:
kruddhau tau tu naravyAghrau vegavantau babhUvatuH |
talashabdena ruShitau yathA nAgau mahAhave
shlokas.91:
vigAhansa rathAnIkamashvasa~NghA.nshcha phalgunaH |
vyacharatpRRitanAmadhye pAshahasta ivAntakaH
shlokas.92:
taM dRRiShTvA yudhi vikrAntaM senAyAM tava bhArata |
sa.nshaptakagaNAnbhUyaH putraste samachodayat
shlokas.93:
tato rathasahasreNa dviradAnAM tribhiH shataiH |
chaturdashasahasraishcha turagANAM mahAhave
shlokas.94:
dvAbhyAM shatasahasrAbhyAM padAtInAM cha dhanvinAm |
shUrANAM nAmalabdhAnAM viditAnAM samantataH
abhyavartanta tau vIrau ChAdayanto mahArathAH
shlokas.95:
sa ChAdyamAnaH samare sharaiH parabalArdanaH |
darshayanraudramAtmAnaM pAshahasta ivAntakaH
nighnansa.nshaptakAnpArthaH prekShaNIyataro.abhavat
shlokas.97:
kirITibhujanirmuktaiH sampatadbhirmahAsharaiH |
samAchChannaM babhau sarvaM kAdraveyairiva prabho
shlokas.99:
hatvA dasha sahasrANi pArthivAnAM mahArathaH |
sa.nshaptakAnAM kaunteyaH prapakShaM tvarito.abhyayAt
shlokas.100:
prapakShaM sa samAsAdya pArthaH kAmbojarakShitam |
pramamAtha balAdbANairdAnavAniva vAsavaH
shlokas.101:
prachichChedAshu bhallaishcha dviShatAmAtatAyinAm |
shastrapANI.nstathA bAhU.nstathApi cha shirA.nsyuta
shlokas.104:
asyAsyato.ardhachandrAbhyAM sa bAhU parighopamau |
pUrNachandrAbhavaktraM cha kShureNAbhyahanachChiraH
shlokas.105:
sa papAta tato vAhAtsvalohitaparisravaH |
manaHshilAgireH shRRi~NgaM vajreNevAvadAritam
shlokas.106:
sudakShiNAdavarajaM kAmbojaM dadRRishurhatam |
prA.nshuM kamalapatrAkShamatyarthaM priyadarshanam
kA~nchanastambhasa~NkAshaM bhinnaM hemagiriM yathA
shlokas.107:
tato.abhavatpunaryuddhaM ghoramadbhutadarshanam |
nAnAvasthAshcha yodhAnAM babhUvustatra yudhyatAm
shlokas.108:
eteShvAvarjitairashvaiH kAmbojairyavanaiH shakaiH |
shoNitAktaistadA raktaM sarvamAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.109:
rathai rathAshvasUtaishcha hatArohaishcha vAjibhiH |
dviradaishcha hatArohairmahAmAtrairhatadvipaiH
anyonyena mahArAja kRRito ghoro janakShayaH
shlokas.110:
tasminprapakShe pakShe cha vadhyamAne mahAtmanA |
arjunaM jayatAM shreShThaM tvarito drauNirAyayau
shlokas.111:
vidhunvAno mahachchApaM kArtasvaravibhUShitam |
AdadAnaH sharAnghorAnsvarashmIniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.112:
taiH patadbhirmahArAja drauNimuktaiH samantataH |
sa~nChAditau rathasthau tAvubhau kRRiShNadhana~njayau
shlokas.113:
tataH sharashataistIkShNairbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
nishcheShTau tAvubhau chakre yuddhe mAdhavapANDavau
shlokas.114:
hAhAkRRitamabhUtsarvaM ja~NgamaM sthAvaraM tathA |
charAcharasya goptArau dRRiShTvA sa~nChAditau sharaiH
shlokas.115:
siddhachAraNasa~NghAshcha sampeturvai samantataH |
chintayanto bhavedadya lokAnAM svastyapItyaha
shlokas.116:
na mayA tAdRRisho rAjandRRiShTapUrvaH parAkramaH |
sa~njaj~ne yAdRRisho drauNeH kRRiShNau sa~nChAdayiShyataH
shlokas.117:
drauNestu dhanuShaH shabdamahitatrAsanaM raNe |
ashrauShaM bahusho rAjansiMhasya nadato yathA
shlokas.118:
jyA chAsya charato yuddhe savyadakShiNamasyataH |
vidyudambudamadhyasthA bhrAjamAneva sAbhavat
shlokas.119:
sa tathA kShiprakArI cha dRRiDhahastashcha pANDavaH |
saMmohaM paramaM gatvA praikShata droNajaM tataH
shlokas.120:
sa vikramaM hRRitaM mene AtmanaH sumahAtmanA |
tathAsya samare rAjanvapurAsItsudurdRRisham
shlokas.121:
drauNipANDavayorevaM vartamAne mahAraNe |
vardhamAne cha rAjendra droNaputre mahAbale
hIyamAne cha kaunteye kRRiShNaM roShaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.122:
sa roShAnniHshvasanrAjannirdahanniva chakShuShA |
drauNiM hyapashyatsa~NgrAme phalgunaM cha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.123:
tataH kruddho.abravItkRRiShNaH pArthaM sapraNayaM tadA |
atyadbhutamidaM pArtha tava pashyAmi sa.nyuge
atishete hi yatra tvA droNaputro.adya bhArata
shlokas.124:
kachchitte gANDivaM haste rathe tiShThasi chArjuna |
kachchitkushalinau bAhU kachchidvIryaM tadeva te
shlokas.125:
evamuktastu kRRiShNena kShiptvA bhallA.nshchaturdasha |
tvaramANastvarAkAle drauNerdhanurathAchChinat
dhvajaM ChatraM patAkAM cha rathaM shaktiM gadAM tathA
shlokas.126:
jatrudeshe cha subhRRishaM vatsadantairatADayat |
sa mUrchChAM paramAM gatvA dhvajayaShTiM samAshritaH
shlokas.127:
taM visa~nj~naM mahArAja kirITibhayapIDitam |
apovAha raNAtsUto rakShamANo dhana~njayAt
shlokas.128:
etasminneva kAle tu vijayaH shatrutApanaH |
nyavadhIttAvakaM sainyaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
pashyatastava putrasya tasya vIrasya bhArata
shlokas.129:
evameSha kShayo vRRittastAvakAnAM paraiH saha |
krUro vishasano ghoro rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.130:
sa.nshaptakA.nshcha kaunteyaH kurU.nshchApi vRRikodaraH |
vasuSheNaM cha pA~nchAlaH kRRitsnena vyadhamadraNe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tvaramANaH punaH kRRiShNaH pArthamabhyavadachChanaiH |
pashya kauravya rAjAnamapayAtA.nshcha pANDavAn
shlokas.2:
karNaM pashya mahAra~Nge jvalantamiva pAvakam |
asau bhImo maheShvAsaH saMnivRRitto raNaM prati
shlokas.3:
tamete.anu nivartante dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
pA~nchAlAnAM sRRi~njayAnAM pANDavAnAM cha yanmukham
nivRRittaishcha tathA pArthairbhagnaM shatrubalaM mahat
shlokas.4:
kauravAndravato hyeSha karNo dhArayate.arjuna |
antakapratimo vege shakratulyaparAkramaH
shlokas.5:
asau gachChati kauravya drauNirastrabhRRitAM varaH |
tameSha pradrutaH sa~Nkhye dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH
shlokas.6:
sarvaM vyAchaShTa durdharSho vAsudevaH kirITine |
tato rAjanprAdurAsInmahAghoro mahAraNaH
shlokas.7:
siMhanAdaravAshchAtra prAdurAsansamAgame |
ubhayoH senayo rAjanmRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH punaH samAjagmurabhItAH kurusRRi~njayAH |
yudhiShThiramukhAH pArthA vaikartanamukhA vayam
shlokas.2:
tataH pravavRRite bhImaH sa~NgrAmo lomaharShaNaH |
karNasya pANDavAnAM cha yamarAShTravivardhanaH
shlokas.3:
tasminpravRRitte sa~NgrAme tumule shoNitodake |
sa.nshaptakeShu shUreShu ki~nchichChiShTeShu bhArata
shlokas.4:
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja sahitaH sarvarAjabhiH |
karNamevAbhidudrAva pANDavAshcha mahArathAH
shlokas.5:
AgachChamAnA.nstAnsa~Nkhye prahRRiShTAnvijayaiShiNaH |
dadhAraiko raNe karNo jalaughAniva parvataH
shlokas.6:
tamAsAdya tu te karNaM vyashIryanta mahArathAH |
yathAchalaM samAsAdya jalaughAH sarvatodisham
tayorAsInmahArAja sa~NgrAmo lomaharShaNaH
shlokas.7:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu rAdheyaM shareNa nataparvaNA |
tADayAmAsa sa~NkruddhastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.8:
vijayaM tu dhanuHshreShThaM vidhunvAno mahArathaH |
pArShatasya dhanushChittvA sharAnAshIviShopamAn
tADayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH pArShataM navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.9:
te varma hemavikRRitaM bhittvA tasya mahAtmanaH |
shoNitAktA vyarAjanta shakragopA ivAnagha
shlokas.10:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
anyaddhanurupAdAya sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn
karNaM vivyAdha saptatyA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.11:
tathaiva rAjankarNo.api pArShataM shatrutApanam |
droNashatruM maheShvAso vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
tasya karNo mahArAja sharaM kanakabhUShaNam |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho mRRityudaNDamivAparam
shlokas.13:
tamApatantaM sahasA ghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
chichCheda saptadhA rAja~nshaineyaH kRRitahastavat
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA vinihitaM bANaM sharaiH karNo vishAM pate |
sAtyakiM sharavarSheNa samantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.15:
vivyAdha chainaM samare nArAchaistatra saptabhiH |
taM pratyavidhyachChaineyaH sharairhemavibhUShitaiH
shlokas.16:
tato yuddhamatIvAsIchchakShuHshrotrabhayAvaham |
rAjanghoraM cha chitraM cha prekShaNIyaM samantataH
shlokas.17:
sarveShAM tatra bhUtAnAM lomaharSho vyajAyata |
taddRRiShTvA samare karma karNashaineyayornRRipa
shlokas.18:
etasminnantare drauNirabhyayAtsumahAbalam |
pArShataM shatrudamanaM shatruvIryAsunAshanam
shlokas.19:
abhyabhAShata sa~Nkruddho drauNirdUre dhana~njaye |
tiShTha tiShThAdya brahmaghna na me jIvanvimokShyase
shlokas.20:
ityuktvA subhRRishaM vIraH shIghrakRRinnishitaiH sharaiH |
pArShataM ChAdayAmAsa ghorarUpaiH sutejanaiH
yatamAnaM paraM shaktyA yatamAno mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
yathA hi samare drauNiH pArShataM vIkShya mAriSha |
tathA drauNiM raNe dRRiShTvA pArShataH paravIrahA
nAtihRRiShTamanA bhUtvA manyate mRRityumAtmanaH
shlokas.22:
drauNistu dRRiShTvA rAjendra dhRRiShTadyumnaM raNe sthitam |
krodhena niHshvasanvIraH pArShataM samupAdravat
tAvanyonyaM tu dRRiShTvaiva sa.nrambhaM jagmatuH param
shlokas.23:
athAbravInmahArAja droNaputraH pratApavAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM samIpasthaM tvaramANo vishAM pate
pA~nchAlApasadAdya tvAM preShayiShyAmi mRRityave
shlokas.24:
pApaM hi yattvayA karma ghnatA droNaM purA kRRitam |
adya tvA patsyate tadvai yathA hyakushalaM tathA
shlokas.25:
arakShyamANaH pArthena yadi tiShThasi sa.nyuge |
nApakramasi vA mUDha satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.26:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
prativAkyaM sa evAsirmAmako dAsyate tava
yenaiva te piturdattaM yatamAnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.27:
yadi tAvanmayA droNo nihato brAhmaNabruvaH |
tvAmidAnIM kathaM yuddhe na haniShyAmi vikramAt
shlokas.28:
evamuktvA mahArAja senApatiramarShaNaH |
nishitenAtha bANena drauNiM vivyAdha pArShataH
shlokas.29:
tato droNiH susa~NkruddhaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
prAchChAdayaddisho rAjandhRRiShTadyumnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.30:
naivAntarikShaM na disho naiva yodhAH samantataH |
dRRishyante vai mahArAja sharaishChannAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.31:
tathaiva pArShato rAjandrauNimAhavashobhinam |
sharaiH sa~nChAdayAmAsa sUtaputrasya pashyataH
shlokas.32:
rAdheyo.api mahArAja pA~nchAlAnsaha pANDavaiH |
draupadeyAnyudhAmanyuM sAtyakiM cha mahAratham
ekaH sa vArayAmAsa prekShaNIyaH samantataH
shlokas.33:
dhRRiShTadyumno.api samare drauNeshchichCheda kArmukam |
tadapAsya dhanushChinnamanyadAdatta kArmukam
vegavatsamare ghoraM sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn
shlokas.34:
sa pArShatasya rAjendra dhanuH shaktiM gadAM dhvajam |
hayAnsUtaM rathaM chaiva nimeShAdvyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.35:
sa ChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
khaDgamAdatta vipulaM shatachandraM cha bhAnumat
shlokas.36:
drauNistadapi rAjendra bhallaiH kShipraM mahArathaH |
chichCheda samare vIraH kShiprahasto dRRiDhAyudhaH
rathAdanavarUDhasya tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.37:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tu virathaM hatAshvaM ChinnakArmukam |
sharaishcha bahudhA viddhamastraishcha shakalIkRRitam
nAtaradbharatashreShTha yatamAno mahArathaH
shlokas.38:
tasyAntamiShubhI rAjanyadA drauNirna jagmivAn |
atha tyaktvA dhanurvIraH pArShataM tvarito.anvagAt
shlokas.39:
AsIdAdravato rAjanvegastasya mahAtmanaH |
garuDasyeva patato jighRRikShoH pannagottamam
shlokas.40:
etasminneva kAle tu mAdhavo.arjunamabravIt |
pashya pArtha yathA drauNiH pArShatasya vadhaM prati
yatnaM karoti vipulaM hanyAchchainamasa.nshayam
shlokas.41:
taM mochaya mahAbAho pArShataM shatrutApanam |
drauNerAsyamanuprAptaM mRRityorAsyagataM yathA
shlokas.42:
evamuktvA mahArAja vAsudevaH pratApavAn |
praiShayattatra turagAnyatra drauNirvyavasthitaH
shlokas.43:
te hayAshchandrasa~NkAshAH keshavena prachoditAH |
pibanta iva tadvyoma jagmurdrauNirathaM prati
shlokas.44:
dRRiShTvAyAntau mahAvIryAvubhau kRRiShNadhana~njayau |
dhRRiShTadyumnavadhe rAja.nshchakre yatnaM mahAbalaH
shlokas.45:
vikRRiShyamANaM dRRiShTvaiva dhRRiShTadyumnaM janeshvara |
sharA.nshchikShepa vai pArtho drauNiM prati mahAbalaH
shlokas.46:
te sharA hemavikRRitA gANDIvapreShitA bhRRisham |
drauNimAsAdya vivishurvalmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.47:
sa vidhvastaiH sharairghorairdroNaputraH pratApavAn |
rathamAruruhe vIro dhana~njayasharArditaH
pragRRihya cha dhanuH shreShThaM pArthaM vivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.48:
etasminnantare vIraH sahadevo janAdhipa |
apovAha rathenAjau pArShataM shatrutApanam
shlokas.49:
arjuno.api mahArAja drauNiM vivyAdha patribhiH |
taM droNaputraH sa~Nkruddho bAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.50:
krodhitastu raNe pArtho nArAchaM kAlasaMmitam |
droNaputrAya chikShepa kAladaNDamivAparam
sa brAhmaNasyA.nsadeshe nipapAta mahAdyutiH
shlokas.51:
sa vihvalo mahArAja sharavegena sa.nyuge |
niShasAda rathopasthe vaiklavyaM cha paraM yayau
shlokas.52:
tataH karNo mahArAja vyAkShipadvijayaM dhanuH |
arjunaM samare kruddhaH prekShamANo muhurmuhuH
dvairathaM chApi pArthena kAmayAno mahAraNe
shlokas.53:
taM tu hitvA hataM vIraM sArathiH shatrukarshanam |
apovAha rathenAjau tvaramANo raNAjirAt
shlokas.54:
athotkruShTaM mahArAja pA~nchAlairjitakAshibhiH |
mokShitaM pArShataM dRRiShTvA droNaputraM cha pIDitam
shlokas.55:
vAditrANi cha divyAni prAvAdyanta sahasrashaH |
siMhanAdashcha sa~njaj~ne dRRiShTvA ghoraM mahAdbhutam
shlokas.56:
evaM kRRitvAbravItpArtho vAsudevaM dhana~njayaH |
yAhi sa.nshaptakAnkRRiShNa kAryametatparaM mama
shlokas.57:
tataH prayAto dAshArhaH shrutvA pANDavabhAShitam |
rathenAtipatAkena manomArutaraMhasA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etasminnantare kRRiShNaH pArthaM vachanamabravIt |
darshayanniva kaunteyaM dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.2:
eSha pANDava te bhrAtA dhArtarAShTrairmahAbalaiH |
jighA.nsubhirmaheShvAsairdrutaM pArthAnusaryate
shlokas.3:
tathAnuyAnti sa.nrabdhAH pA~nchAlA yuddhadurmadAH |
yudhiShThiraM mahAtmAnaM parIpsanto mahAjavAH
shlokas.4:
eSha duryodhanaH pArtha rathAnIkena da.nshitaH |
rAjA sarvasya lokasya rAjAnamanudhAvati
shlokas.5:
jighA.nsuH puruShavyAghraM bhrAtRRibhiH sahito balI |
AshIviShasamasparshaiH sarvayuddhavishAradaiH
shlokas.6:
ete jighRRikShavo yAnti dvipAshvarathapattayaH |
yudhiShThiraM dhArtarAShTrA ratnottamamivArthinaH
shlokas.7:
pashya sAtvatabhImAbhyAM niruddhAdhiShThitaH prabhuH |
jihIrShavo.amRRitaM daityAH shakrAgnibhyAmivAvashAH
shlokas.8:
ete bahutvAttvaritAH punargachChanti pANDavam |
samudramiva vAryoghAH prAvRRiTkAle mahArathAH
shlokas.9:
nadantaH siMhanAdA.nshcha dhamantashchApi vArijAn |
balavanto maheShvAsA vidhunvanto dhanUMShi cha
shlokas.10:
mRRityormukhagataM manye kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
hutamagnau cha bhadraM te duryodhanavashaM gatam
shlokas.11:
yathAyuktamanIkaM hi dhArtarAShTrasya pANDava |
nAsya shakro.api muchyeta samprApto bANagocharam
shlokas.12:
duryodhanasya shUrasya drauNeH shAradvatasya cha |
karNasya cheShuvego vai parvatAnapi dArayet
shlokas.13:
duryodhanasya shUrasya sharaughA~nshIghramasyataH |
sa~NkruddhasyAntakasyeva ko vegaM sa.nsahedraNe
shlokas.14:
karNena cha kRRito rAjA vimukhaH shatrutApanaH |
balavA.Nllaghuhastashcha kRRitI yuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.15:
rAdheyaH pANDavashreShThaM shaktaH pIDayituM raNe |
sahito dhRRitarAShTrasya putraiH shUro mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.16:
tasyaivaM yudhyamAnasya sa~NgrAme sa.nyatAtmanaH |
anyairapi cha pArthasya hRRitaM varma mahArathaiH
shlokas.17:
upavAsakRRisho rAjA bhRRishaM bharatasattama |
brAhme bale sthito hyeSha na kShatre.atibale vibho
shlokas.18:
na jIvati mahArAjo manye pArtha yudhiShThiraH |
yadbhImasenaH sahate siMhanAdamamarShaNaH
shlokas.19:
nardatAM dhArtarAShTrANAM punaH punarari.ndama |
dhamatAM cha mahAsha~NkhAnsa~NgrAme jitakAshinAm
shlokas.20:
yudhiShThiraM pANDaveyaM hateti bharatarShabha |
sa~nchodayatyasau karNo dhArtarAShTrAnmahAbalAn
shlokas.21:
sthUNAkarNendrajAlena pArtha pAshupatena cha |
prachChAdayanto rAjAnamanuyAnti mahArathAH
Aturo me mato rAjA saMniShevyashcha bhArata
shlokas.22:
yathainamanuvartante pA~nchAlAH saha pANDavaiH |
tvaramANAstvarAkAle sarvashastrabhRRitAM varAH
majjantamiva pAtAle balino.apyujjihIrShavaH
shlokas.23:
na keturdRRishyate rAj~naH karNena nihataH sharaiH |
pashyatoryamayoH pArtha sAtyakeshcha shikhaNDinaH
shlokas.24:
dhRRiShTadyumnasya bhImasya shatAnIkasya vA vibho |
pA~nchAlAnAM cha sarveShAM chedInAM chaiva bhArata
shlokas.25:
eSha karNo raNe pArtha pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
sharairvidhva.nsayati vai nalinImiva ku~njaraH
shlokas.26:
ete dravanti rathinastvadIyAH pANDunandana |
pashya pashya yathA pArtha gachChantyete mahArathAH
shlokas.27:
ete bhArata mAta~NgAH karNenAbhihatA raNe |
ArtanAdAnvikurvANA vidravanti disho dasha
shlokas.28:
rathAnAM dravatAM vRRindaM pashya pArtha samantataH |
drAvyamANaM raNe chaiva karNenAmitrakarshinA
shlokas.29:
hastikakShyAM raNe pashya charantIM tatra tatra ha |
rathasthaM sUtaputrasya ketuM ketumatAM vara
shlokas.30:
asau dhAvati rAdheyo bhImasenarathaM prati |
kira~nsharashatAnIva vinighna.nstava vAhinIm
shlokas.31:
etAnpashya cha pA~nchAlAndrAvyamANAnmahAtmanA |
shakreNeva yathA daityAnhanyamAnAnmahAhave
shlokas.32:
eSha karNo raNe jitvA pA~nchAlAnpANDusRRi~njayAn |
disho viprekShate sarvAstvadarthamiti me matiH
shlokas.33:
pashya pArtha dhanuH shreShThaM vikarShansAdhu shobhate |
shatrU~njitvA yathA shakro devasa~NghaiH samAvRRitaH
shlokas.34:
ete nadanti kauravyA dRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam |
trAsayanto raNe pArthAnsRRi~njayA.nshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.35:
eSha sarvAtmanA pANDU.nstrAsayitvA mahAraNe |
abhibhAShati rAdheyaH sarvasainyAni mAnadaH
shlokas.36:
abhidravata gachChadhvaM drutaM dravata kauravAH |
yathA jIvanna vaH kashchinmuchyate yudhi sRRi~njayaH
shlokas.37:
tathA kuruta sa.nyattA vayaM yAsyAma pRRiShThataH |
evamuktvA yayAveSha pRRiShThato vikira~nsharaiH
shlokas.38:
pashya karNaM raNe pArtha shvetachChavivirAjitam |
udayaM parvataM yadvachChobhayanvai divAkaraH
shlokas.39:
pUrNachandranikAshena mUrdhni ChatreNa bhArata |
dhriyamANena samare tathA shatashalAkinA
shlokas.40:
eSha tvAM prekShate karNaH sakaTAkSho vishAM pate |
uttamaM yatnamAsthAya dhruvameShyati sa.nyuge
shlokas.41:
pashya hyenaM mahAbAho vidhunvAnaM mahaddhanuH |
sharA.nshchAshIviShAkArAnvisRRijantaM mahAbalam
shlokas.42:
asau nivRRitto rAdheyo dRRishyate vAnaradhvaja |
vadhAya chAtmano.abhyeti dIpasya shalabho yathA
shlokas.43:
karNamekAkinaM dRRiShTvA rathAnIkena bhArata |
rirakShiShuH susa.nyatto dhArtarAShTro.abhivartate
shlokas.44:
sArvaiH sahaibhirduShTAtmA vadhya eSha prayatnataH |
tvayA yashashcha rAjyaM cha sukhaM chottamamichChatA
shlokas.45:
AtmAnaM cha kRRitAtmAnaM samIkShya bharatarShabha |
kRRitAgasaM cha rAdheyaM dharmAtmani yudhiShThire
shlokas.46:
pratipadyasva rAdheyaM prAptakAlamanantaram |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA pratyehi rathayUthapam
shlokas.47:
pa~ncha hyetAni mukhyAnAM rathAnAM rathasattama |
shatAnyAyAnti vegena balinAM bhImatejasAm
shlokas.48:
pa~ncha nAgasahasrANi dviguNA vAjinastathA |
abhisaMhatya kaunteya padAtiprayutAni cha
anyonyarakShitaM vIra balaM tvAmabhivartate
shlokas.49:
sUtaputre maheShvAse darshayAtmAnamAtmanA |
uttamaM yatnamAsthAya pratyehi bharatarShabha
shlokas.50:
asau karNaH susa.nrabdhaH pA~nchAlAnabhidhAvati |
ketumasya hi pashyAmi dhRRiShTadyumnarathaM prati
samuchChetsyati pA~nchAlAniti manye parantapa
shlokas.51:
AchakShe te priyaM pArtha tadevaM bharatarShabha |
rAjA jIvati kauravyo dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.52:
asau bhimo mahAbAhuH saMnivRRittashchamUmukhe |
vRRitaH sRRi~njayasainyena sAtyakena cha bhArata
shlokas.53:
vadhyanta ete samare kauravA nishitaiH sharaiH |
bhImasenena kaunteya pA~nchAlaishcha mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.54:
senA hi dhArtarAShTrasya vimukhA chAbhavadraNAt |
vipradhAvati vegena bhImasya nihatA sharaiH
shlokas.55:
vipannasasyeva mahI rudhireNa samukShitA |
bhAratI bharatashreShTha senA kRRipaNadarshanA
shlokas.56:
nivRRittaM pashya kaunteya bhImasenaM yudhAM patim |
AshIviShamiva kruddhaM tasmAddravati vAhinI
shlokas.57:
pItaraktAsitasitAstArAchandrArkamaNDitAH |
patAkA viprakIryante ChatrANyetAni chArjuna
shlokas.58:
sauvarNA rAjatAshchaiva taijasAshcha pRRithagvidhAH |
ketavo vinipAtyante hastyashvaM viprakIryate
shlokas.59:
rathebhyaH prapatantyete rathino vigatAsavaH |
nAnAvarNairhatA bANaiH pA~nchAlairapalAyibhiH
shlokas.60:
nirmanuShyAngajAnashvAnrathA.nshchaiva dhana~njaya |
samAdravanti pA~nchAlA dhArtarAShTrA.nstarasvinaH
shlokas.61:
mRRidnanti cha naravyAghrA bhImasenavyapAshrayAt |
balaM pareShAM durdharShaM tyaktvA prANAnari.ndama
shlokas.62:
ete nadanti pA~nchAlA dhamantyapi cha vArijAn |
abhidravanti cha raNe nighnantaH sAyakaiH parAn
shlokas.63:
pashya svargasya mAhAtmyaM pA~nchAlA hi parantapa |
dhArtarAShTrAnvinighnanti kruddhAH siMhA iva dvipAn
shlokas.64:
sarvatashchAbhipannaiShA dhArtarAShTrI mahAchamUH |
pA~nchAlairmAnasAdetya ha.nsairga~Ngeva vegitaiH
shlokas.65:
subhRRishaM cha parAkrAntAH pA~nchAlAnAM nivAraNe |
kRRipakarNAdayo vIrA RRiShabhANAmivarShabhAH
shlokas.66:
sunimagnA.nshcha bhImAstrairdhArtarAShTrAnmahArathAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhA vIrA ghnanti shatrUnsahasrashaH
viShaNNabhUyiShTharathA dhArtarAShTrI mahAchamUH
shlokas.67:
pashya bhImena nArAchaishChinnA nAgAH patantyamI |
vajrivajrAhatAnIva shikharANi mahIbhRRitAm
shlokas.68:
bhImasenasya nirviddhA bANaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
svAnyanIkAni mRRidnanto dravantyete mahAgajAH
shlokas.69:
nAbhijAnAsi bhImasya siMhanAdaM durutsaham |
nadato.arjuna sa~NgrAme vIrasya jitakAshinaH
shlokas.70:
eSha naiShAdirabhyeti dvipamukhyena pANDavam |
jighA.nsustomaraiH kruddho daNDapANirivAntakaH
shlokas.72:
hatvainaM punarAyAti nAgAnanyAnprahAriNaH |
pashya nIlAmbudanibhAnmahAmAtrairadhiShThitAn
shaktitomarasa~NkAshairvinighnantaM vRRikodaram
shlokas.73:
sapta sapta cha nAgA.nstAnvaijayantIshcha sadhvajAH |
nihatya nishitairbANaishChinnAH pArthAgrajena te
dashabhirdashabhishchaiko nArAchairnihato gajaH
shlokas.74:
na chAsau dhArtarAShTrANAM shrUyate ninadastathA |
pura.ndarasame kruddhe nivRRitte bharatarShabhe
shlokas.75:
akShauhiNyastathA tisro dhArtarAShTrasya saMhatAH |
kruddhena narasiMhena bhImasenena vAritAH
shlokas.76:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenena tatkarma kRRitaM dRRiShTvA suduShkaram |
arjuno vyadhamachChiShTAnahitAnnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.77:
te vadhyamAnAH samare sa.nshaptakagaNAH prabho |
shakrasyAtithitAM gatvA vishokA hyabhavanmudA
shlokas.78:
pArthashcha puruShavyAghraH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
jaghAna dhArtarAShTrasya chaturvidhabalAM chamUm

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
nivRRitte bhImasene cha pANDave cha yudhiShThire |
vadhyamAne bale chApi mAmake pANDusRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.2:
dravamANe balaughe cha nirAkrande muhurmuhuH |
kimakurvanta kuravastanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA bhImaM mahAbAhuM sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
krodharaktekShaNo rAjanbhImasenamupAdravat
shlokas.4:
tAvakaM cha balaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenAtparA~Nmukham |
yatnena mahatA rAjanparyavasthApayadbalI
shlokas.5:
vyavasthApya mahAbAhustava putrasya vAhinIm |
pratyudyayau tadA karNaH pANDavAnyuddhadurmadAn
shlokas.6:
pratyudyayustu rAdheyaM pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
dhunvAnAH kArmukANyAjau vikShipantashcha sAyakAn
shlokas.7:
bhImasenaH shinernaptA shikhaNDI janamejayaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha balavAnsarve chApi prabhadrakAH
shlokas.8:
pA~nchAlAshcha naravyAghrAH samantAttava vAhinIm |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhAH samare jitakAshinaH
shlokas.9:
tathaiva tAvakA rAjanpANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
abhyadravanta tvaritA jighA.nsanto mahArathAH
shlokas.10:
rathanAgAshvakalilaM pattidhvajasamAkulam |
babhUva puruShavyAghra sainyamadbhutadarshanam
shlokas.11:
shikhaNDI cha yayau karNaM dhRRiShTadyumnaH sutaM tava |
duHshAsanaM mahArAja mahatyA senayA vRRitam
shlokas.12:
nakulo vRRiShasenaM cha chitrasenaM yudhiShThiraH |
ulUkaM samare rAjansahadevaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.13:
sAtyakiH shakuniM chApi bhImasenashcha kauravAn |
arjunaM cha raNe yattaM droNaputro mahArathaH
shlokas.14:
yudhAmanyuM maheShvAsaM gautamo.abhyapatadraNe |
kRRitavarmA cha balavAnuttamaujasamAdravat
shlokas.15:
bhImasenaH kurUnsarvAnputrA.nshcha tava mAriSha |
sahAnIkAnmahAbAhureka evAbhyavArayat
shlokas.16:
shikhaNDI cha tataH karNaM vicharantamabhItavat |
bhIShmahantA mahArAja vArayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.17:
pratirabdhastataH karNo roShAtprasphuritAdharaH |
shikhaNDinaM tribhirbANairbhruvormadhye vyatADayat
shlokas.18:
dhAraya.nstu sa tAnbANA~nshikhaNDI bahvashobhata |
rAjataH parvato yadvattribhiH shRRi~NgaiH samanvitaH
shlokas.19:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH sUtaputreNa sa.nyuge |
karNaM vivyAdha samare navatyA nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.20:
tasya karNo hayAnhatvA sArathiM cha tribhiH sharaiH |
unmamAtha dhvajaM chAsya kShurapreNa mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
hatAshvAttu tato yAnAdavaplutya mahArathaH |
shaktiM chikShepa karNAya sa~NkruddhaH shatrutApanaH
shlokas.22:
tAM ChittvA samare karNastribhirbhArata sAyakaiH |
shikhaNDinamathAvidhyannavabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.23:
karNachApachyutAnbANAnvarjaya.nstu narottamaH |
apayAtastatastUrNaM shikhaNDI jayatAM varaH
shlokas.24:
tataH karNo mahArAja pANDusainyAnyashAtayat |
tUlarAshiM samAsAdya yathA vAyurmahAjavaH
shlokas.25:
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja tava putreNa pIDitaH |
duHshAsanaM tribhirbANairabhyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.26:
tasya duHshAsano bAhuM savyaM vivyAdha mAriSha |
shitena rukmapu~Nkhena bhallena nataparvaNA
shlokas.27:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu nirviddhaH sharaM ghoramamarShaNaH |
duHshAsanAya sa~NkruddhaH preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.28:
ApatantaM mahAvegaM dhRRiShTadyumnasamIritam |
sharaishchichCheda putraste tribhireva vishAM pate
shlokas.29:
athAparaiH saptadashairbhallaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM samAsAdya bAhvorurasi chArdayat
shlokas.30:
tataH sa pArShataH kruddho dhanushchichCheda mAriSha |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena tata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.31:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya putraste bharatarShabha |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM sharavrAtaiH samantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.32:
tava putrasya te dRRiShTvA vikramaM taM mahAtmanaH |
vyahasanta raNe yodhAH siddhAshchApsarasAM gaNAH
shlokas.33:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tAvakAnAM paraiH saha |
ghoraM prANabhRRitAM kAle ghorarUpaM parantapa
shlokas.34:
nakulaM vRRiShasenastu viddhvA pa~nchabhirAyasaiH |
pituH samIpe tiShThantaM tribhiranyairavidhyata
shlokas.35:
nakulastu tataH kruddho vRRiShasenaM smayanniva |
nArAchena sutIkShNena vivyAdha hRRidaye dRRiDham
shlokas.36:
so.atividdho balavatA shatruNA shatrukarshanaH |
shatruM vivyAdha vi.nshatyA sa cha taM pa~nchabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.37:
tataH sharasahasreNa tAvubhau puruSharShabhau |
anyonyamAchChAdayatAmathAbhajyata vAhinI
shlokas.38:
dRRiShTvA tu pradrutAM senAM dhArtarAShTrasya sUtajaH |
nivArayAmAsa balAdanupatya vishAM pate
nivRRitte tu tataH karNe nakulaH kauravAnyayau
shlokas.39:
karNaputrastu samare hitvA nakulameva tu |
jugopa chakraM tvaritaM rAdheyasyaiva mAriSha
shlokas.40:
ulUkastu raNe kruddhaH sahadevena vAritaH |
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo hatvA sahadevaH pratApavAn
sArathiM preShayAmAsa yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.41:
ulUkastu tato yAnAdavaplutya vishAM pate |
trigartAnAM balaM pUrNaM jagAma pitRRinandanaH
shlokas.42:
sAtyakiH shakuniM viddhvA vi.nshatyA nishitaiH sharaiH |
dhvajaM chichCheda bhallena saubalasya hasanniva
shlokas.43:
saubalastasya samare kruddho rAjanpratApavAn |
vidArya kavachaM bhUyo dhvajaM chichCheda kA~nchanam
shlokas.44:
athainaM nishitairbANaiH sAtyakiH pratyavidhyata |
sArathiM cha mahArAja tribhireva samArdayat
athAsya vAhA.nstvaritaH sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.45:
tato.avaplutya sahasA shakunirbharatarShabha |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNamulUkasya mahArathaH
apovAhAtha shIghraM sa shaineyAdyuddhashAlinaH
shlokas.46:
sAtyakistu raNe rAja.nstAvakAnAmanIkinIm |
abhidudrAva vegena tato.anIkamabhidyata
shlokas.47:
shaineyasharanunnaM tu tataH sainyaM vishAM pate |
bheje dasha dishastUrNaM nyapatachcha gatAsuvat
shlokas.48:
bhImasenaM tava suto vArayAmAsa sa.nyuge |
taM tu bhImo muhUrtena vyashvasUtarathadhvajam
chakre lokeshvaraM tatra tenAtuShyanta chAraNAH
shlokas.49:
tato.apAyAnnRRipastatra bhImasenasya gocharAt |
kurusainyaM tataH sarvaM bhImasenamupAdravat
tatra rAvo mahAnAsIdbhImamekaM jighA.nsatAm
shlokas.50:
yudhAmanyuH kRRipaM viddhvA dhanurasyAshu chichChide |
athAnyaddhanurAdAya kRRipaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.51:
yudhAmanyordhvajaM sUtaM ChatraM chApAtayatkShitau |
tato.apAyAdrathenaiva yudhAmanyurmahArathaH
shlokas.52:
uttamaujAstu hArdikyaM sharairbhImaparAkramam |
ChAdayAmAsa sahasA megho vRRiShTyA yathAchalam
shlokas.53:
tadyuddhaM sumahachchAsIdghorarUpaM parantapa |
yAdRRishaM na mayA yuddhaM dRRiShTapUrvaM vishAM pate
shlokas.54:
kRRitavarmA tato rAjannuttamaujasamAhave |
hRRidi vivyAdha sa tadA rathopastha upAvishat
shlokas.55:
sArathistamapovAha rathena rathinAM varam |
tatastu satvaraM rAjanpANDusainyamupAdravat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
drauNistu rathava.nshena mahatA parivAritaH |
ApatatsahasA rAjanyatra rAjA vyavasthitaH
shlokas.2:
tamApatantaM sahasA shUraH shaurisahAyavAn |
dadhAra sahasA pArtho veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.3:
tataH kruddho mahArAja droNaputraH pratApavAn |
arjunaM vAsudevaM cha ChAdayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.4:
avachChannau tataH kRRiShNau dRRiShTvA tatra mahArathAH |
vismayaM paramaM gatvA praikShanta kuravastadA
shlokas.5:
arjunastu tato divyamastraM chakre hasanniva |
tadastraM brAhmaNo yuddhe vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.6:
yadyaddhi vyAkShipadyuddhe pANDavo.astraM jighA.nsayA |
tattadastraM maheShvAso droNaputro vyashAtayat
shlokas.7:
astrayuddhe tato rAjanvartamAne bhayAvahe |
apashyAma raNe drauNiM vyAttAnanamivAntakam
shlokas.8:
sa disho vidishashchaiva ChAdayitvA vijihmagaiH |
vAsudevaM tribhirbANairavidhyaddakShiNe bhuje
shlokas.9:
tato.arjuno hayAnhatvA sarvA.nstasya mahAtmanaH |
chakAra samare bhUmiM shoNitaughatara~NgiNIm
shlokas.10:
nihatA rathinaH petuH pArthachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
hayAshcha paryadhAvanta muktayoktrAstatastataH
shlokas.11:
taddRRiShTvA karma pArthasya drauNirAhavashobhinaH |
avAkiradraNe kRRiShNaM samantAnnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
tato.arjunaM mahArAja drauNirAyamya patriNA |
vakShodeshe samAsAdya tADayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.13:
so.atividdho raNe tena droNaputreNa bhArata |
Adatta parighaM ghoraM drauNeshchainamavAkShipat
shlokas.14:
tamApatantaM parighaM kArtasvaravibhUShitam |
drauNishchichCheda sahasA tata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.15:
so.anekadhApatadbhUmau bhAradvAjasya sAyakaiH |
vishIrNaH parvato rAjanyathA syAnmAtarishvanA
shlokas.16:
tato.arjuno raNe drauNiM vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAharat
shlokas.17:
sa sa~NgRRihya svayaM vAhAnkRRiShNau prAchChAdayachCharaiH |
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma drauNerAshu parAkramam
shlokas.18:
ayachChatturagAnyachcha phalgunaM chApyayodhayat |
tadasya samare rAjansarve yodhA apUjayan
shlokas.19:
yadA tvagrasyata raNe droNaputreNa phalgunaH |
tato rashmInrathAshvAnAM kShurapraishchichChide jayaH
shlokas.20:
prAdrava.nsturagAste tu sharavegaprabAdhitAH |
tato.abhUnninado bhUyastava sainyasya bhArata
shlokas.21:
pANDavAstu jayaM labdhvA tava sainyamupAdravan |
samantAnnishitAnbANAnvimu~nchanto jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.22:
pANDavaistu mahArAja dhArtarAShTrI mahAchamUH |
punaH punaratho vIrairabhajyata jayoddhataiH
shlokas.23:
pashyatAM te mahArAja putrANAM chitrayodhinAm |
shakuneH saubaleyasya karNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
vAryamANA mahAsenA putraistava janeshvara |
nAvatiShThata sa~NgrAme tADyamAnA samantataH
shlokas.25:
tato yodhairmahArAja palAyadbhistatastataH |
abhavadvyAkulaM bhItaiH putrANAM te mahadbalam
shlokas.26:
tiShTha tiShTheti satataM sUtaputrasya jalpataH |
nAvatiShThata sA senA vadhyamAnA mahAtmabhiH
shlokas.27:
athotkruShTaM mahArAja pANDavairjitakAshibhiH |
dhArtarAShTrabalaM dRRiShTvA dravamANaM samantataH
shlokas.28:
tato duryodhanaH karNamabravItpraNayAdiva |
pashya karNa yathA senA pANDavairarditA bhRRisham
shlokas.29:
tvayi tiShThati santrAsAtpalAyati samantataH |
etajj~nAtvA mahAbAho kuru prAptamari.ndama
shlokas.30:
sahasrANi cha yodhAnAM tvAmeva puruSharShabha |
kroshanti samare vIra drAvyamANAni pANDavaiH
shlokas.31:
etachChrutvA tu rAdheyo duryodhanavacho mahat |
madrarAjamidaM vAkyamabravItsUtanandanaH
shlokas.32:
pashya me bhujayorvIryamastrANAM cha janeshvara |
adya hanmi raNe sarvAnpA~nchAlAnpANDubhiH saha
vAhayAshvAnnaravyAghra bhadreNaiva janeshvara
shlokas.33:
evamuktvA mahArAja sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
pragRRihya vijayaM vIro dhanuHshreShThaM purAtanam
sajyaM kRRitvA mahArAja saMmRRijya cha punaH punaH
shlokas.34:
saMnivArya cha yodhAnsvAnsatyena shapathena cha |
prAyojayadameyAtmA bhArgavAstraM mahAbalaH
shlokas.35:
tato rAjansahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
koTishashcha sharAstIkShNA niragachChanmahAmRRidhe
shlokas.36:
jvalitaistairmahAghoraiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH |
sa~nChannA pANDavI senA na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.37:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsItpA~nchAlAnAM vishAM pate |
pIDitAnAM balavatA bhArgavAstreNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.38:
nipatadbhirgajai rAjannaraishchApi sahasrashaH |
rathaishchApi naravyAghra hayaishchApi samantataH
shlokas.39:
prAkampata mahI rAjannihataistaistatastataH |
vyAkulaM sarvamabhavatpANDavAnAM mahadbalam
shlokas.40:
karNastveko yudhAM shreShTho vidhUma iva pAvakaH |
daha~nshatrUnnaravyAghra shushubhe sa parantapaH
shlokas.41:
te vadhyamAnAH karNena pA~nchAlAshchedibhiH saha |
tatra tatra vyamuhyanta vanadAhe yathA dvipAH
chukrushuste naravyAghra yathAprAgvA narottamAH
shlokas.42:
teShAM tu kroshatAM shrutvA bhItAnAM raNamUrdhani |
dhAvatAM cha disho rAjanvitrastAnAM samantataH
ArtanAdo mahA.nstatra pretAnAmiva samplave
shlokas.43:
vadhyamAnA.nstu tAndRRiShTvA sUtaputreNa mAriSha |
vitresuH sarvabhUtAni tiryagyonigatAnyapi
shlokas.44:
te vadhyamAnAH samare sUtaputreNa sRRi~njayAH |
arjunaM vAsudevaM cha vyAkroshanta muhurmuhuH
pretarAjapure yadvatpretarAjaM vichetasaH
shlokas.45:
athAbravIdvAsudevaM kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
bhArgavAstraM mahAghoraM dRRiShTvA tatra sabhIritam
shlokas.46:
pashya kRRiShNa mahAbAho bhArgavAstrasya vikramam |
naitadastraM hi samare shakyaM hantuM katha~nchana
shlokas.47:
sUtaputraM cha sa.nrabdhaM pashya kRRiShNa mahAraNe |
antakapratimaM vIraM kurvANaM karma dAruNam
shlokas.48:
sutIkShNaM chodayannashvAnprekShate mAM muhurmuhuH |
na cha pashyAmi samare karNasya prapalAyitam
shlokas.49:
jIvanprApnoti puruShaH sa~Nkhye jayaparAjayau |
jitasya tu hRRiShIkesha vadha eva kuto jayaH
shlokas.50:
tato janArdanaH prAyAddraShTumichChanyudhiShThiram |
shrameNa grAhayiShya.nshcha karNaM yuddhena mAriSha
shlokas.51:
arjunaM chAbravItkRRiShNo bhRRishaM rAjA parikShataH |
tamAshvAsya kurushreShTha tataH karNaM haniShyasi
shlokas.52:
tato dhana~njayo draShTuM rAjAnaM bANapIDitam |
rathena prayayau kShipraM sa~NgrAme keshavAj~nayA
shlokas.53:
gachChanneva tu kaunteyo dharmarAjadidRRikShayA |
sainyamAlokayAmAsa nApashyattatra chAgrajam
shlokas.54:
yuddhaM kRRitvA tu kaunteyo droNaputreNa bhArata |
duHsahaM vajriNA sa~Nkhye parAjigye bhRRigoH sutam
shlokas.55:
drauNiM parAjitya tatogradhanvA; kRRitvA mahadduShkaramAryakarma |
AlokayAmAsa tataH svasainyaM; dhana~njayaH shatrubhirapradhRRiShyaH
shlokas.56:
sa yudhyamAnaH pRRitanAmukhasthA;~nshUrA~nshUro harShayansavyasAchI |
pUrvApadAnaiH prathitaiH prasha.nsa;nsthirA.nshchakArAtmarathAnanIke
shlokas.57:
apashyamAnastu kirITamAlI; yudhi jyeShThaM bhrAtaramAjamIDham |
uvAcha bhImaM tarasAbhyupetya; rAj~naH pravRRittistviha keti rAjan
shlokas.58:
bhIma uvAcha||
apayAta ito rAjA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
karNabANavibhugnA~Ngo yadi jIvetkatha~nchana
shlokas.59:
arjuna uvAcha||
tasmAdbhavA~nshIghramitaH prayAtu; rAj~naH pravRRittyai kurusattamasya |
nUnaM hi viddho.atibhRRishaM pRRiShatkaiH; karNena rAjA shibiraM gato.asau
shlokas.60:
yaH samprahAre nishi sampravRRitte; droNena viddho.atibhRRishaM tarasvI |
tasthau cha tatrApi jayapratIkSho; droNena yAvanna hataH kilAsIt
shlokas.61:
sa sa.nshayaM gamitaH pANDavAgryaH; sa~Nkhye.adya karNena mahAnubhAvaH |
j~nAtuM prayAhyAshu tamadya bhIma; sthAsyAmyahaM shatrugaNAnnirudhya
shlokas.62:
bhIma uvAcha||
tvameva jAnIhi mahAnubhAva; rAj~naH pravRRittiM bharatarShabhasya |
ahaM hi yadyarjuna yAmi tatra; vakShyanti mAM bhIta iti pravIrAH
shlokas.63:
tato.abravIdarjuno bhImasenaM; sa.nshaptakAH pratyanIkaM sthitA me |
etAnahatvA na mayA tu shakya;mito.apayAtuM ripusa~NghagoShThAt
shlokas.64:
athAbravIdarjunaM bhImasenaH; svavIryamAshritya kurupravIra |
sa.nshaptakAnpratiyotsyAmi sa~Nkhye; sarvAnahaM yAhi dhana~njayeti
shlokas.65:
tadbhImasenasya vacho nishamya; sudurvachaM bhrAturamitramadhye |
draShTuM kurushreShThamabhiprayAtuM; provAcha vRRiShNipravaraM tadAnIm
shlokas.66:
chodayAshvAnhRRiShIkesha vigAhyaitaM rathArNavam |
ajAtashatruM rAjAnaM draShTumichChAmi keshava
shlokas.67:
tato hayAnsarvadAshArhamukhyaH; prAchodayadbhImamuvAcha chedam |
naitachchitraM tava karmAdya vIra; yAsyAmahe jahi bhImArisa~NghAn
shlokas.68:
tato yayau hRRiShIkesho yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
shIghrAchChIghrataraM rAjanvAjibhirgaruDopamaiH
shlokas.69:
pratyanIke vyavasthApya bhImasenamari.ndamam |
sa.ndishya chaiva rAjendra yuddhaM prati vRRikodaram
shlokas.70:
tatastu gatvA puruShapravIrau; rAjAnamAsAdya shayAnamekam |
rathAdubhau pratyavaruhya tasmA;dvavandaturdharmarAjasya pAdau
shlokas.71:
tau dRRiShTvA puruShavyAghrau kShemiNau puruSharShabha |
mudAbhyupagatau kRRiShNAvashvinAviva vAsavam
shlokas.72:
tAvabhyanandadrAjA hi vivasvAnashvinAviva |
hate mahAsure jambhe shakraviShNU yathA guruH
shlokas.73:
manyamAno hataM karNaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
harShagadgadayA vAchA prItaH prAha parantapau

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
mahAsattvau tu tau dRRiShTvA sahitau keshavArjunau |
hatamAdhirathiM mene sa~Nkhye gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.2:
tAvabhyanandatkaunteyaH sAmnA paramavalgunA |
smitapUrvamamitraghnaH pUjayanbharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
svAgataM devakIputra svAgataM te dhana~njaya |
priyaM me darshanaM bADhaM yuvayorachyutArjunau
shlokas.4:
akShatAbhyAmariShTAbhyAM kathaM yudhya mahAratham |
AshIviShasamaM yuddhe sarvashastravishAradam
shlokas.5:
agragaM dhArtarAShTrANAM sarveShAM sharma varma cha |
rakShitaM vRRiShasenena suSheNena cha dhanvinA
shlokas.6:
anuj~nAtaM mahAvIryaM rameNAstreShu durjayam |
trAtAraM dhArtarAShTrANAM gantAraM vAhinImukhe
shlokas.7:
hantAramarisainyAnAmamitragaNamardanam |
duryodhanahite yuktamasmadyuddhAya chodyatam
shlokas.8:
apradhRRiShyaM mahAyuddhe devairapi savAsavaiH |
analAnilayostulyaM tejasA cha balena cha
shlokas.9:
pAtAlamiva gambhIraM suhRRidAnandavardhanam |
antakAbhamamitrANAM karNaM hatvA mahAhave
diShTyA yuvAmanuprAptau jitvAsuramivAmarau
shlokas.10:
tena yuddhamadInena mayA hyadyAchyutArjunau |
kupitenAntakeneva prajAH sarvA jighA.nsatA
shlokas.11:
tena ketushcha me Chinno hatau cha pArShNisArathI |
hatavAhaH kRRitashchAsmi yuyudhAnasya pashyataH
shlokas.12:
dhRRiShTadyumnasya yamayorvIrasya cha shikhaNDinaH |
pashyatAM draupadeyAnAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.13:
etA~njitvA mahAvIryAnkarNaH shatrugaNAnbahUn |
jitavAnmAM mahAbAho yatamAnaM mahAraNe
shlokas.14:
anusRRitya cha mAM yuddhe paruShANyuktavAnbahu |
tatra tatra yudhAM shreShThaH paribhUya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.15:
bhImasenaprabhAvAttu yajjIvAmi dhana~njaya |
bahunAtra kimuktena nAhaM tatsoDhumutsahe
shlokas.16:
trayodashAhaM varShANi yasmAdbhIto dhana~njaya |
na sma nidrAM labhe rAtrau na chAhani sukhaM kvachit
shlokas.17:
tasya dveSheNa sa.nyuktaH paridahye dhana~njaya |
Atmano maraNaM jAnanvAdhrINasa iva dvipaH
shlokas.18:
yasyAyamagamatkAlashchintayAnasya me vibho |
kathaM shakyo mayA karNo yuddhe kShapayituM bhavet
shlokas.19:
jAgratsvapa.nshcha kaunteya karNameva sadA hyaham |
pashyAmi tatra tatraiva karNabhUtamidaM jagat
shlokas.20:
yatra yatra hi gachChAmi karNAdbhIto dhana~njaya |
tatra tatra hi pashyAmi karNamevAgrataH sthitam
shlokas.21:
so.ahaM tenaiva vIreNa samareShvapalAyinA |
sahayaH sarathaH pArtha jitvA jIvanvisarjitaH
shlokas.22:
ko nu me jIvitenArtho rAjyenArtho.atha vA punaH |
mamaivaM dhikkRRitasyeha karNenAhavashobhinA
shlokas.23:
na prAptapUrvaM yadbhIShmAtkRRipAddroNAchcha sa.nyuge |
tatprAptamadya me yuddhe sUtaputrAnmahArathAt
shlokas.24:
tattvA pRRichChAmi kaunteya yathA hyakushalastathA |
tanmamAchakShva kArtsnyena yathA karNastvayA hataH
shlokas.25:
shakravIryasamo yuddhe yamatulyaparAkramaH |
rAmatulyastathAstre yaH sa kathaM vai niShUditaH
shlokas.26:
mahArathaH samAkhyAtaH sarvayuddhavishAradaH |
dhanurdharANAM pravaraH sarveShAmekapUruShaH
shlokas.27:
pUjito dhRRitarAShTreNa saputreNa vishAM pate |
sadA tvadarthaM rAdheyaH sa kathaM nihatastvayA
shlokas.28:
dhRRitarAShTro hi yodheShu sarveShveva sadArjuna |
tava mRRityuM raNe karNaM manyate puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.29:
sa tvayA puruShavyAghra kathaM yuddhe niShUditaH |
taM mamAchakShva bIbhatso yathA karNo hatastvayA
shlokas.30:
sotsedhamasya cha shiraH pashyatAM suhRRidAM hRRitam |
tvayA puruShashArdUla shArdUlena yathA ruroH
shlokas.31:
yaH paryupAsItpradisho dishashcha; tvAM sUtaputraH samare parIpsan |
ditsuH karNaH samare hastipUgaM; sa hIdAnIM ka~NkapatraiH sutIkShNaiH
shlokas.32:
tvayA raNe nihataH sUtaputraH; kachchichChete bhUmitale durAtmA |
kachchitpriyaM me paramaM tvayAdya; kRRitaM raNe sUtaputraM nihatya
shlokas.33:
yaH sarvataH paryapatattvadarthe; madAnvito garvitaH sUtaputraH |
sa shUramAnI samare sametya; kachchittvayA nihataH sa.nyuge.adya
shlokas.34:
raukmaM rathaM hastivaraishcha yuktaM; rathaM ditsuryaH parebhyastvadarthe |
sadA raNe spardhate yaH sa pApaH; kachchittvayA nihatastAta yuddhe
shlokas.35:
yo.asau nityaM shUramadena matto; vikatthate sa.nsadi kauravANAm |
priyo.atyarthaM tasya suyodhanasya; kachchitsa pApo nihatastvayAdya
shlokas.36:
kachchitsamAgamya dhanuHpramuktai;stvatpreShitairlohitArthairviha~NgaiH |
shete.adya pApaH sa vibhinnagAtraH; kachchidbhagno dhArtarAShTrasya bAhuH
shlokas.37:
yo.asau sadA shlAghate rAjamadhye; duryodhanaM harShayandarpapUrNaH |
ahaM hantA phalgunasyeti mohA;tkachchiddhatastasya na vai tathA rathaH
shlokas.38:
nAhaM pAdau dhAvayiShye kadA chi;dyAvatsthitaH pArtha ityalpabuddhiH |
vrataM tasyaitatsarvadA shakrasUno; kachchittvayA nihataH so.adya karNaH
shlokas.39:
yo.asau kRRiShNAmabravIdduShTabuddhiH; karNaH sabhAyAM kuruvIramadhye |
kiM pANDavA.nstvaM na jahAsi kRRiShNe; sudurbalAnpatitAnhInasattvAn
shlokas.40:
yattatkarNaH pratyajAnAttvadarthe; nAhatvAhaM saha kRRiShNena pArtham |
ihopayAteti sa pApabuddhiH; kachchichChete sharasambhinnagAtraH
shlokas.41:
kachchitsa~NgrAme vidito vA tadAyaM; samAgamaH sRRi~njayakauravANAm |
yatrAvasthAmIdRRishIM prApito.ahaM; kachchittvayA so.adya hataH sametya
shlokas.42:
kachchittvayA tasya sumandabuddhe;rgANDIvamuktairvishikhairjvaladbhiH |
sakuNDalaM bhAnumaduttamA~NgaM; kAyAtprakRRittaM yudhi savyasAchin
shlokas.43:
yattanmayA bANasamarpitena; dhyAto.asi karNasya vadhAya vIra |
tanme tvayA kachchidamoghamadya; dhyAtaM kRRitaM karNanipAtanena
shlokas.44:
yaddarpapUrNaH sa suyodhano.asmA;navekShate karNasamAshrayeNa |
kachchittvayA so.adya samAshrayo.asya; bhagnaH parAkramya suyodhanasya
shlokas.45:
yo naH purA ShaNDhatilAnavocha;tsabhAmadhye pArthivAnAM samakSham |
sa durmatiH kachchidupetya sa~Nkhye; tvayA hataH sUtaputro.atyamarShI
shlokas.46:
yaH sUtaputraH prahasandurAtmA; purAbravInnirjitAM saubalena |
svayaM prasahyAnaya yAj~nasenI;mapIha kachchitsa hatastvayAdya
shlokas.47:
yaH shastrabhRRichChreShThatamaM pRRithivyAM; pitAmahaM vyAkShipadalpachetAH |
sa~NkhyAyamAno.ardharathaH sa kachchi;ttvayA hato.adyAdhirathirdurAtmA
shlokas.48:
amarShaNaM nikRRitisamIraNeritaM; hRRidi shritaM jvalanamimaM sadA mama |
hato mayA so.adya sametya pApadhI;riti bruvanprashamaya me.adya phalguna

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taddharmashIlasya vacho nishamya; rAj~naH kruddhasyAdhirathau mahAtmA |
uvAcha durdharShamadInasattvaM; yudhiShThiraM jiShNuranantavIryaH
shlokas.2:
sa.nshaptakairyudhyamAnasya me.adya; senAgrayAyI kurusainyasya rAjan |
AshIviShAbhAnkhagamAnpramu~ncha;ndrauNiH purastAtsahasA vyatiShThat
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA rathaM meghanibhaM mamema;mambaShThasenA maraNe vyatiShThat |
teShAmahaM pa~ncha shatAni hatvA; tato drauNimagamaM pArthivAgrya
shlokas.4:
tato.aparAnbANasa~NghAnanekA;nAkarNapUrNAyatavipramuktAn |
sasarja shikShAstrabalaprayatnai;stathA yathA prAvRRiShi kAlameghaH
shlokas.5:
naivAdadAnaM na cha sa.ndadhAnaM; jAnImahe katareNAsyatIti |
vAmena vA yadi vA dakShiNena; sa droNaputraH samare paryavartat
shlokas.6:
avidhyanmAM pa~nchabhirdroNaputraH; shitaiH sharaiH pa~nchabhirvAsudevam |
ahaM tu taM tri.nshatA vajrakalpaiH; samArdayaM nimiShasyAntareNa
shlokas.7:
sa vikSharanrudhiraM sarvagAtrai; rathAnIkaM sUtasUnorvivesha |
mayAbhibhUtaH sainikAnAM prabarhA;nasAvapashyanrudhireNa pradigdhAn
shlokas.8:
tato.abhibhUtaM yudhi vIkShya sainyaM; vidhvastayodhaM drutavAjinAgam |
pa~nchAshatA rathamukhyaiH sametaH; karNastvaranmAmupAyAtpramAthI
shlokas.9:
tAnsUdayitvAhamapAsya karNaM; draShTuM bhavantaM tvarayAbhiyAtaH |
sarve pA~nchAlA hyudvijante sma karNA;dgandhAdgAvaH kesariNo yathaiva
shlokas.10:
mahAjhaShasyeva mukhaM prapannAH; prabhadrakAH karNamabhi dravanti |
mRRityorAsyaM vyAttamivAnvapadya;nprabhadrakAH karNamAsAdya rAjan
shlokas.11:
AyAhi pashyAdya yuyutsamAnaM; mAM sUtaputraM cha vRRitau jayAya |
ShaTsAhasrA bhArata rAjaputrAH; svargAya lokAya rathA nimagnAH
shlokas.12:
sametyAhaM sUtaputreNa sa~Nkhye; vRRitreNa vajrIva narendramukhya |
yotsye bhRRishaM bhArata sUtaputra;masminsa~NgrAme yadi vai dRRishyate.adya
shlokas.13:
karNaM na chedadya nihanmi rAja;nsabAndhavaM yudhyamAnaM prasahya |
pratishrutyAkurvatAM vai gatiryA; kaShTAM gachCheyaM tAmahaM rAjasiMha
shlokas.14:
Amantraye tvAM brUhi jayaM raNe me; purA bhImaM dhArtarAShTrA grasante |
sautiM haniShyAmi narendrasiMha; sainyaM tathA shatrugaNA.nshcha sarvAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutvA karNaM kalyamudAravIryaM; kruddhaH pArthaH phalgunasyAmitaujAH |
dhana~njayaM vAkyamuvAcha chedaM; yudhiShThiraH karNasharAbhitaptaH
shlokas.2:
idaM yadi dvaitavane hyavakShyaH; karNaM yoddhuM na prasahe nRRipeti |
vayaM tadA prAptakAlAni sarve; vRRittAnyupaiShyAma tadaiva pArtha
shlokas.3:
mayi pratishrutya vadhaM hi tasya; balasya chAptasya tathaiva vIra |
AnIya naH shatrumadhyaM sa kasmA;tsamutkShipya sthaNDile pratyapiMShThAH
shlokas.4:
anvAshiShma vayamarjuna tvayi; yiyAsavo bahu kalyANamiShTam |
tannaH sarvaM viphalaM rAjaputra; phalArthinAM nichula ivAtipuShpaH
shlokas.5:
prachChAditaM baDishamivAmiSheNa; prachChAdito gavaya ivApavAchA |
anarthakaM me darshitavAnasi tvaM; rAjyArthino rAjyarUpaM vinAsham
shlokas.6:
yattatpRRithAM vAguvAchAntarikShe; saptAhajAte tvayi mandabuddhau |
jAtaH putro vAsavavikramo.ayaM; sarvA~nshUrA~nshAtravA~njeShyatIti
shlokas.7:
ayaM jetA khANDave devasa~NghA;nsarvANi bhUtAnyapi chottamaujAH |
ayaM jetA madrakali~NgakekayA;nayaM kurUnhanti cha rAjamadhye
shlokas.8:
asmAtparo na bhavitA dhanurdharo; na vai bhUtaH kashchana jAtu jetA |
ichChannAryaH sarvabhUtAni kuryA;dvashe vashI sarvasamAptavidyaH
shlokas.9:
kAntyA shashA~Nkasya javena vAyoH; sthairyeNa meroH kShamayA pRRithivyAH |
sUryasya bhAsA dhanadasya lakShmyA; shauryeNa shakrasya balena viShNoH
shlokas.10:
tulyo mahAtmA tava kunti putro; jAto.aditerviShNurivArihantA |
sveShAM jayAya dviShatAM vadhAya; khyAto.amitaujAH kulatantukartA
shlokas.11:
ityantarikShe shatashRRi~NgamUrdhni; tapasvinAM shRRiNvatAM vAguvAcha |
eva.nvidhaM tvAM tachcha nAbhUttavAdya; devA hi nUnamanRRitaM vadanti
shlokas.12:
tathApareShAmRRiShisattamAnAM; shrutvA giraM pUjayatAM sadaiva |
na saMnatiM praimi suyodhanasya; na tvA jAnAmyAdhiratherbhayArtam
shlokas.13:
tvaShTrA kRRitaM vAhamakUjanAkShaM; shubhaM samAsthAya kapidhvajaM tvam |
khaDgaM gRRihItvA hemachitraM samiddhaM; dhanushchedaM gANDivaM tAlamAtram
sa keshavenohyamAnaH kathaM nu; karNAdbhIto vyapayAto.asi pArtha
shlokas.14:
dhanushchaitatkeshavAya pradAya; yantAbhaviShyastvaM raNe cheddurAtman |
tato.ahaniShyatkeshavaH karNamugraM; marutpatirvRRitramivAttavajraH
shlokas.15:
mAse.apatiShyaH pa~nchame tvaM prakRRichChre; na vA garbho.apyabhaviShyaH pRRithAyAH |
tatte shramo rAjaputrAbhaviShya;nna sa~NgrAmAdapayAtuM durAtman

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yudhiShThireNaivamuktaH kaunteyaH shvetavAhanaH |
asiM jagrAha sa~Nkruddho jighA.nsurbharatarShabham
shlokas.2:
tasya kopaM samudvIkShya chittaj~naH keshavastadA |
uvAcha kimidaM pArtha gRRihItaH khaDga ityuta
shlokas.3:
neha pashyAmi yoddhavyaM tava ki~nchiddhana~njaya |
te dhvastA dhArtarAShTrA hi sarve bhImena dhImatA
shlokas.4:
apayAto.asi kaunteya rAjA draShTavya ityapi |
sa rAjA bhavatA dRRiShTaH kushalI cha yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
taM dRRiShTvA nRRipashArdUlaM shArdUlasamavikramam |
harShakAle tu samprApte kasmAttvA manyurAvishat
shlokas.6:
na taM pashyAmi kaunteya yaste vadhyo bhavediha |
kasmAdbhavAnmahAkhaDgaM parigRRihNAti satvaram
shlokas.7:
tattvA pRRichChAmi kaunteya kimidaM te chikIrShitam |
parAmRRishasi yatkruddhaH khaDgamadbhutavikrama
shlokas.8:
evamuktastu kRRiShNena prekShamANo yudhiShThiram |
arjunaH prAha govindaM kruddhaH sarpa iva shvasan
shlokas.9:
dada gANDIvamanyasmA iti mAM yo.abhichodayet |
ChindyAmahaM shirastasya ityupA.nshuvrataM mama
shlokas.10:
tadukto.ahamadInAtmanrAj~nAmitaparAkrama |
samakShaM tava govinda na tatkShantumihotsahe
shlokas.11:
tasmAdenaM vadhiShyAmi rAjAnaM dharmabhIrukam |
pratij~nAM pAlayiShyAmi hatvemaM narasattamam
etadarthaM mayA khaDgo gRRihIto yadunandana
shlokas.12:
so.ahaM yudhiShThiraM hatvA satye.apyAnRRiNyatAM gataH |
vishoko vijvarashchApi bhaviShyAmi janArdana
shlokas.13:
kiM vA tvaM manyase prAptamasminkAle samutthite |
tvamasya jagatastAta vettha sarvaM gatAgatam
tattathA prakariShyAmi yathA mAM vakShyate bhavAn
shlokas.14:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
idAnIM pArtha jAnAmi na vRRiddhAH sevitAstvayA |
akAle puruShavyAghra sa.nrambhakriyayAnayA
na hi dharmavibhAgaj~naH kuryAdevaM dhana~njaya
shlokas.15:
akAryANAM cha kAryANAM sa.nyogaM yaH karoti vai |
kAryANAmakriyANAM cha sa pArtha puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.16:
anusRRitya tu ye dharmaM kavayaH samupasthitAH |
samAsavistaravidAM na teShAM vettha nishchayam
shlokas.17:
anishchayaj~no hi naraH kAryAkAryavinishchaye |
avasho muhyate pArtha yathA tvaM mUDha eva tu
shlokas.18:
na hi kAryamakAryaM vA sukhaM j~nAtuM katha~nchana |
shrutena j~nAyate sarvaM tachcha tvaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.19:
avij~nAnAdbhavAnyachcha dharmaM rakShati dharmavit |
prANinAM hi vadhaM pArtha dhArmiko nAvabudhyate
shlokas.20:
prANinAmavadhastAta sarvajyAyAnmato mama |
anRRitaM tu bhavedvAchyaM na cha hi.nsyAtkatha~nchana
shlokas.21:
sa kathaM bhrAtaraM jyeShThaM rAjAnaM dharmakovidam |
hanyAdbhavAnnarashreShTha prAkRRito.anyaH pumAniva
shlokas.22:
ayudhyamAnasya vadhastathAshastrasya bhArata |
parA~Nmukhasya dravataH sharaNaM vAbhigachChataH
kRRitA~njaleH prapannasya na vadhaH pUjyate budhaiH
shlokas.23:
tvayA chaiva vrataM pArtha bAlenaiva kRRitaM purA |
tasmAdadharmasa.nyuktaM mauDhyAtkarma vyavasyasi
shlokas.24:
sa guruM pArtha kasmAttvaM hanyA dharmamanusmaran |
asampradhArya dharmANAM gatiM sUkShmAM duranvayAm
shlokas.25:
idaM dharmarahasyaM cha vakShyAmi bharatarShabha |
yadbrUyAttava bhIShmo vA dharmaj~no vA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.26:
viduro vA tathA kShattA kuntI vApi yashasvinI |
tatte vakShyAmi tattvena tannibodha dhana~njaya
shlokas.27:
satyasya vachanaM sAdhu na satyAdvidyate param |
tattvenaitatsudurj~neyaM yasya satyamanuShThitam
shlokas.28:
bhavetsatyamavaktavyaM vaktavyamanRRitaM bhavet |
sarvasvasyApahAre tu vaktavyamanRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.29:
prANAtyaye vivAhe cha vaktavyamanRRitaM bhavet |
