yatrAnRRitaM bhavetsatyaM satyaM chApyanRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.30:
tAdRRishaM pashyate bAlo yasya satyamanuShThitam |
satyAnRRite vinishchitya tato bhavati dharmavit
shlokas.31:
kimAshcharyaM kRRitapraj~naH puruSho.api sudAruNaH |
sumahatprApnuyAtpuNyaM balAko.andhavadhAdiva
shlokas.32:
kimAshcharyaM punarmUDho dharmakAmo.apyapaNDitaH |
sumahatprApnuyAtpApamApagAmiva kaushikaH
shlokas.33:
arjuna uvAcha||
AchakShva bhagavannetadyathA vidyAmahaM tathA |
balAkAndhAbhisambaddhaM nadInAM kaushikasya cha
shlokas.34:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
mRRigavyAdho.abhavatkashchidbalAko nAma bhArata |
yAtrArthaM putradArasya mRRigAnhanti na kAmataH
shlokas.35:
so.andhau cha mAtApitarau bibhartyanyA.nshcha sa.nshritAn |
svadharmanirato nityaM satyavAganasUyakaH
shlokas.36:
sa kadAchinmRRigA.NllipsurnAnvavindatprayatnavAn |
athApashyatsa pItodaM shvApadaM ghrANachakShuSham
shlokas.37:
adRRiShTapUrvamapi tatsattvaM tena hataM tadA |
anveva cha tato vyomnaH puShpavarShamavApatat
shlokas.38:
apsarogItavAditrairnAditaM cha manoramam |
vimAnamAgamatsvargAnmRRigavyAdhaninIShayA
shlokas.39:
tadbhUtaM sarvabhUtAnAmabhAvAya kilArjuna |
tapastaptvA varaM prAptaM kRRitamandhaM svayambhuvA
shlokas.40:
taddhatvA sarvabhUtAnAmabhAvakRRitanishchayam |
tato balAkaH svaragAdevaM dharmaH sudurvidaH
shlokas.41:
kaushiko.apyabhavadviprastapasvI na bahushrutaH |
nadInAM sa~Ngame grAmAdadUre sa kilAvasat
shlokas.42:
satyaM mayA sadA vAchyamiti tasyAbhavadvratam |
satyavAdIti vikhyAtaH sa tadAsIddhana~njaya
shlokas.43:
atha dasyubhayAtkechittadA tadvanamAvishan |
dasyavo.api gatAH krUrA vyamArganta prayatnataH
shlokas.44:
atha kaushikamabhyetya prAhustaM satyavAdinam |
katamena pathA yAtA bhagavanbahavo janAH
satyena pRRiShTaH prabrUhi yadi tAnvettha sha.nsa naH
shlokas.45:
sa pRRiShTaH kaushikaH satyaM vachanaM tAnuvAcha ha |
bahuvRRikShalatAgulmametadvanamupAshritAH
tataste tAnsamAsAdya krUrA jaghnuriti shrutiH
shlokas.46:
tenAdharmeNa mahatA vAgduruktena kaushikaH |
gataH sukaShTaM narakaM sUkShmadharmeShvakovidaH
aprabhUtashruto mUDho dharmANAmavibhAgavit
shlokas.47:
vRRiddhAnapRRiShTvA sa.ndehaM mahachChvabhramito.arhati |
tatra te lakShaNoddeshaH kashchideva bhaviShyati
shlokas.48:
duShkaraM paramaj~nAnaM tarkeNAtra vyavasyati |
shrutirdharma iti hyeke vadanti bahavo janAH
shlokas.49:
na tvetatpratisUyAmi na hi sarvaM vidhIyate |
prabhavArthAya bhUtAnAM dharmapravachanaM kRRitam
shlokas.50:
dhAraNAddharmamityAhurdharmo dhArayati prajAH |
yaH syAddhAraNasa.nyuktaH sa dharma iti nishchayaH
shlokas.51:
ye.anyAyena jihIrShanto janA ichChanti karhichit |
akUjanena chenmokSho nAtra kUjetkatha~nchana
shlokas.52:
avashyaM kUjitavyaM vA sha~NkeranvApyakUjataH |
shreyastatrAnRRitaM vaktuM satyAditi vichAritam
shlokas.53:
prANAtyaye vivAhe vA sarvaj~nAtidhanakShaye |
narmaNyabhipravRRitte vA pravaktavyaM mRRiShA bhavet
adharmaM nAtra pashyanti dharmatattvArthadarshinaH
shlokas.54:
yaH stenaiH saha sambandhAnmuchyate shapathairapi |
shreyastatrAnRRitaM vaktuM tatsatyamavichAritam
shlokas.55:
na cha tebhyo dhanaM deyaM shakye sati katha~nchana |
pApebhyo hi dhanaM dattaM dAtAramapi pIDayet
tasmAddharmArthamanRRitamuktvA nAnRRitavAgbhavet
shlokas.56:
eSha te lakShaNoddeshaH samuddiShTo yathAvidhi |
etachChrutvA brUhi pArtha yadi vadhyo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.57:
arjuna uvAcha||
yathA brUyAnmahAprAj~no yathA brUyAnmahAmatiH |
hitaM chaiva yathAsmAkaM tathaitadvachanaM tava
shlokas.58:
bhavAnmAtRRisamo.asmAkaM tathA pitRRisamo.api cha |
gatishcha paramA kRRiShNa tena te vAkyamadbhutam
shlokas.59:
na hi te triShu lokeShu vidyate.aviditaM kvachit |
tasmAdbhavAnparaM dharmaM veda sarvaM yathAtatham
shlokas.60:
avadhyaM pANDavaM manye dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
tasminsamayasa.nyoge brUhi ki~nchidanugraham
idaM chAparamatraiva shRRiNu hRRitsthaM vivakShitam
shlokas.61:
jAnAsi dAshArha mama vrataM tvaM; yo mAM brUyAtkashchana mAnuSheShu |
anyasmai tvaM gANDivaM dehi pArtha; yastvatto.astrairbhavitA vA vishiShTaH
shlokas.62:
hanyAmahaM keshava taM prasahya; bhImo hanyAttUbaraketi choktaH |
tanme rAjA proktavA.nste samakShaM; dhanurdehItyasakRRidvRRiShNisiMha
shlokas.63:
taM hatvA chetkeshava jIvaloke; sthAtA kAlaM nAhamapyalpamAtram |
sA cha pratij~nA mama lokaprabuddhA; bhavetsatyA dharmabhRRitAM variShTha
yathA jIvetpANDavo.ahaM cha kRRiShNa; tathA buddhiM dAtumadyArhasi tvam
shlokas.64:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
rAjA shrAnto jagato vikShatashcha; karNena sa~Nkhye nishitairbANasa~NghaiH |
tasmAtpArtha tvAM paruShANyavocha;tkarNe dyUtaM hyadya raNe nibaddham
shlokas.65:
tasminhate kuravo nirjitAH syu;revambuddhiH pArthivo dharmaputraH |
yadAvamAnaM labhate mahAntaM; tadA jIvanmRRita ityuchyate saH
shlokas.66:
tanmAnitaH pArthivo.ayaM sadaiva; tvayA sabhImena tathA yamAbhyAm |
vRRiddhaishcha loke puruShapravIrai;stasyAvamAnaM kalayA tvaM prayu~NkShva
shlokas.67:
tvamityatrabhavantaM tvaM brUhi pArtha yudhiShThiram |
tvamityukto hi nihato gururbhavati bhArata
shlokas.68:
evamAchara kaunteya dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
adharmayuktaM sa.nyogaM kuruShvaivaM kurUdvaha
shlokas.69:
atharvA~NgirasI hyeShA shrutInAmuttamA shrutiH |
avichAryaiva kAryaiShA shreyaHkAmairnaraiH sadA
shlokas.70:
vadho hyayaM pANDava dharmarAj~na;stvatto yukto vetsyate chaivameShaH |
tato.asya pAdAvabhivAdya pashchA;chChamaM brUyAH sAntvapUrvaM cha pArtham
shlokas.71:
bhrAtA prAj~nastava kopaM na jAtu; kuryAdrAjA ka~nchana pANDaveyaH |
mukto.anRRitAdbhrAtRRivadhAchcha pArtha; hRRiShTaH karNaM tvaM jahi sUtaputram
shlokas.72:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ityevamuktastu janArdanena; pArthaH prashasyAtha suhRRidvadhaM tam |
tato.abravIdarjuno dharmarAja;manuktapUrvaM paruShaM prasahya
shlokas.73:
mA tvaM rAjanvyAhara vyAharatsu; na tiShThase kroshamAtre raNArdhe |
bhImastu mAmarhati garhaNAya; yo yudhyate sarvayodhapravIraH
shlokas.74:
kAle hi shatrUnpratipIDya sa~Nkhye; hatvA cha shUrAnpRRithivIpatI.nstAn |
yaH ku~njarANAmadhikaM sahasraM; hatvAnadattumulaM siMhanAdam
shlokas.75:
suduShkaraM karma karoti vIraH; kartuM yathA nArhasi tvaM kadAchit |
rathAdavaplutya gadAM parAmRRishaM;stayA nihantyashvanaradvipAnraNe
shlokas.76:
varAsinA vAjirathAshvaku~njarAM;stathA rathA~NgairdhanuShA cha hantyarIn |
pramRRidya padbhyAmahitAnnihanti yaH; punashcha dorbhyAM shatamanyuvikramaH
shlokas.77:
mahAbalo vaishravaNAntakopamaH; prasahya hantA dviShatAM yathArham |
sa bhImaseno.arhati garhaNAM me; na tvaM nityaM rakShyase yaH suhRRidbhiH
shlokas.78:
mahArathAnnAgavarAnhayA.nshcha; padAtimukhyAnapi cha pramathya |
eko bhImo dhArtarAShTreShu magnaH; sa mAmupAlabdhumari.ndamo.arhati
shlokas.79:
kali~Ngava~NgA~NganiShAdamAgadhA;nsadAmadAnnIlabalAhakopamAn |
nihanti yaH shatrugaNAnanekashaH; sa mAbhivaktuM prabhavatyanAgasam
shlokas.80:
suyuktamAsthAya rathaM hi kAle; dhanurvikarSha~nsharapUrNamuShTiH |
sRRijatyasau sharavarShANi vIro; mahAhave megha ivAmbudhArAH
shlokas.81:
balaM tu vAchi dvijasattamAnAM; kShAtraM budhA bAhubalaM vadanti |
tvaM vAgbalo bhArata niShThurashcha; tvameva mAM vetsi yathAvidho.aham
shlokas.82:
yatAmi nityaM tava kartumiShTaM; dAraiH sutairjIvitenAtmanA cha |
evaM cha mAM vAgvishikhairniha.nsi; tvattaH sukhaM na vayaM vidma ki~nchit
shlokas.83:
avAma.nsthA mAM draupadItalpasa.nstho; mahArathAnpratihanmi tvadarthe |
tenAtisha~NkI bhArata niShThuro.asi; tvattaH sukhaM nAbhijAnAmi ki~nchit
shlokas.84:
proktaH svayaM satyasandhena mRRityu;stava priyArthaM naradeva yuddhe |
vIraH shikhaNDI draupado.asau mahAtmA; mayAbhiguptena hatashcha tena
shlokas.85:
na chAbhinandAmi tavAdhirAjyaM; yatastvamakSheShvahitAya saktaH |
svayaM kRRitvA pApamanAryajuShTa;mebhiryuddhe tartumichChasyarI.nstu
shlokas.86:
akSheShu doShA bahavo vidharmAH; shrutAstvayA sahadevo.abravIdyAn |
tAnnaiShi santartumasAdhujuShTA;nyena sma sarve nirayaM prapannAH
shlokas.87:
tvaM devitA tvatkRRite rAjyanAsha;stvatsambhavaM vyasanaM no narendra |
mAsmAnkrUrairvAkpratodaistuda tvaM; bhUyo rAjankopayannalpabhAgyAn
shlokas.88:
etA vAchaH paruShAH savyasAchI; sthirapraj~naM shrAvayitvA tatakSha |
tadAnutepe surarAjaputro; viniHshvasa.nshchApyasimudbabarha
shlokas.89:
tamAha kRRiShNaH kimidaM punarbhavA;nvikoshamAkAshanibhaM karotyasim |
prabrUhi satyaM punaruttaraM vidhe;rvachaH pravakShyAmyahamarthasiddhaye
shlokas.90:
ityeva pRRiShTaH puruShottamena; suduHkhitaH keshavamAha vAkyam |
ahaM haniShye svasharIrameva; prasahya yenAhitamAcharaM vai
shlokas.91:
nishamya tatpArthavacho.abravIdidaM; dhana~njayaM dharmabhRRitAM variShThaH |
prabrUhi pArtha svaguNAnihAtmana;stathA svahArdaM bhavatIha sadyaH
shlokas.92:
tathAstu kRRiShNetyabhinandya vAkyaM; dhana~njayaH prAha dhanurvinAmya |
yudhiShThiraM dharmabhRRitAM variShThaM; shRRiNuShva rAjanniti shakrasUnuH
shlokas.93:
na mAdRRisho.anyo naradeva vidyate; dhanurdharo devamRRite pinAkinam |
ahaM hi tenAnumato mahAtmanA; kShaNena hanyAM sacharAcharaM jagat
shlokas.94:
mayA hi rAjansadigIshvarA disho; vijitya sarvA bhavataH kRRitA vashe |
sa rAjasUyashcha samAptadakShiNaH; sabhA cha divyA bhavato mamaujasA
shlokas.95:
pANau pRRiShatkA likhitA mameme; dhanushcha sa~Nkhye vitataM sabANam |
pAdau cha me sasharau sahadhvajau; na mAdRRishaM yuddhagataM jayanti
shlokas.96:
hatA udIchyA nihatAH pratIchyAH; prAchyA nirastA dAkShiNAtyA vishastAH |
sa.nshaptakAnAM ki~nchidevAvashiShTaM; sarvasya sainyasya hataM mayArdham
shlokas.97:
shete mayA nihatA bhAratI cha; chamU rAjandevachamUprakAshA |
ye nAstraj~nAstAnahaM hanmi shastrai;stasmAllokaM neha karomi bhasmasAt
shlokas.98:
ityevamuktvA punarAha pArtho; yudhiShThiraM dharmabhRRitAM variShTham |
apyaputrA tena rAdhA bhavitrI; kuntI mayA vA tadRRitaM viddhi rAjan
prasIda rAjankShama yanmayoktaM; kAle bhavAnvetsyati tannamaste
shlokas.99:
prasAdya rAjAnamamitrasAhaM; sthito.abravIchchainamabhiprapannaH |
yAmyeSha bhImaM samarAtpramoktuM; sarvAtmanA sUtaputraM cha hantum
shlokas.100:
tava priyArthaM mama jIvitaM hi; bravImi satyaM tadavehi rAjan |
iti prAyAdupasa~NgRRihya pAdau; samutthito dIptatejAH kirITI
nedaM chirAtkShipramidaM bhaviShya;tyAvartate.asAvabhiyAmi chainam
shlokas.101:
etachChrutvA pANDavo dharmarAjo; bhrAturvAkyaM paruShaM phalgunasya |
utthAya tasmAchChayanAduvAcha; pArthaM tato duHkhaparItachetAH
shlokas.102:
kRRitaM mayA pArtha yathA na sAdhu; yena prAptaM vyasanaM vaH sughoram |
tasmAchChirashChinddhi mamedamadya; kulAntakasyAdhamapUruShasya
shlokas.103:
pApasya pApavyasanAnvitasya; vimUDhabuddheralasasya bhIroH |
vRRiddhAvamantuH paruShasya chaiva; kiM te chiraM mAmanuvRRitya rUkSham
shlokas.104:
gachChAmyahaM vanamevAdya pApaH; sukhaM bhavAnvartatAM madvihInaH |
yogyo rAjA bhImaseno mahAtmA; klIbasya vA mama kiM rAjyakRRityam
shlokas.105:
na chAsmi shaktaH paruShANi soDhuM; punastavemAni ruShAnvitasya |
bhImo.astu rAjA mama jIvitena; kiM kAryamadyAvamatasya vIra
shlokas.106:
ityevamuktvA sahasotpapAta; rAjA tatastachChayanaM vihAya |
iyeSha nirgantumatho vanAya; taM vAsudevaH praNato.abhyuvAcha
shlokas.107:
rAjanviditametatte yathA gANDIvadhanvanaH |
pratij~nA satyasandhasya gANDIvaM prati vishrutA
shlokas.108:
brUyAdya evaM gANDIvaM dehyanyasmai tvamityuta |
sa vadhyo.asya pumA.Nlloke tvayA chokto.ayamIdRRisham
shlokas.109:
ataH satyAM pratij~nAM tAM pArthena parirakShatA |
machChandAdavamAno.ayaM kRRitastava mahIpate
gurUNAmavamAno hi vadha ityabhidhIyate
shlokas.110:
tasmAttvaM vai mahAbAho mama pArthasya chobhayoH |
vyatikramamimaM rAjansa~NkShamasvArjunaM prati
shlokas.111:
sharaNaM tvAM mahArAja prapannau sva ubhAvapi |
kShantumarhasi me rAjanpraNatasyAbhiyAchataH
shlokas.112:
rAdheyasyAdya pApasya bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam |
satyaM te pratijAnAmi hataM viddhyadya sUtajam
yasyechChasi vadhaM tasya gatamevAdya jIvitam
shlokas.113:
iti kRRiShNavachaH shrutvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
sasambhramaM hRRiShIkeshamutthApya praNataM tadA
kRRitA~njalimidaM vAkyamuvAchAnantaraM vachaH
shlokas.114:
evametadyathAttha tvamastyeSho.atikramo mama |
anunIto.asmi govinda tAritashchAdya mAdhava
mokShitA vyasanAdghorAdvayamadya tvayAchyuta
shlokas.115:
bhavantaM nAthamAsAdya AvAM vyasanasAgarAt |
ghorAdadya samuttIrNAvubhAvaj~nAnamohitau
shlokas.116:
tvadbuddhiplavamAsAdya duHkhashokArNavAdvayam |
samuttIrNAH sahAmAtyAH sanAthAH sma tvayAchyuta

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
iti sma kRRiShNavachanAtpratyuchchArya yudhiShThiram |
babhUva vimanAH pArthaH ki~nchitkRRitveva pAtakam
shlokas.2:
tato.abravIdvAsudevaH prahasanniva pANDavam |
kathaM nAma bhavedetadyadi tvaM pArtha dharmajam
asinA tIkShNadhAreNa hanyA dharme vyavasthitam
shlokas.3:
tvamityuktvaiva rAjAnamevaM kashmalamAvishaH |
hatvA tu nRRipatiM pArtha akariShyaH kimuttaram
evaM sudurvido dharmo mandapraj~nairvisheShataH
shlokas.4:
sa bhavAndharmabhIrutvAddhruvamaiShyanmahattamaH |
narakaM ghorarUpaM cha bhrAturjyeShThasya vai vadhAt
shlokas.5:
sa tvaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShThaM rAjAnaM dharmasaMhitam |
prasAdaya kurushreShThametadatra mataM mama
shlokas.6:
prasAdya bhaktyA rAjAnaM prItaM chaiva yudhiShThiram |
prayAmastvaritA yoddhuM sUtaputrarathaM prati
shlokas.7:
hatvA sudurjayaM karNaM tvamadya nishitaiH sharaiH |
vipulAM prItimAdhatsva dharmaputrasya mAnada
shlokas.8:
etadatra mahAbAho prAptakAlaM mataM mama |
evaM kRRite kRRitaM chaiva tava kAryaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.9:
tato.arjuno mahArAja lajjayA vai samanvitaH |
dharmarAjasya charaNau prapede shirasAnagha
shlokas.10:
uvAcha bharatashreShTha prasIdeti punaH punaH |
kShamasva rAjanyatproktaM dharmakAmena bhIruNA
shlokas.11:
pAdayoH patitaM dRRiShTvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
dhana~njayamamitraghnaM rudantaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
utthApya bhrAtaraM rAjA dharmarAjo dhana~njayam |
samAshliShya cha sasnehaM praruroda mahIpatiH
shlokas.13:
ruditvA tu chiraM kAlaM bhrAtarau sumahAdyutI |
kRRitashauchau naravyAghrau prItimantau babhUvatuH
shlokas.14:
tata AshliShya sa premNA mUrdhni chAghrAya pANDavam |
prItyA paramayA yuktaH prasmaya.nshchAbravIjjayam
shlokas.15:
karNena me mahAbAho sarvasainyasya pashyataH |
kavachaM cha dhvajashchaiva dhanuH shaktirhayA gadA
sharaiH kRRittA maheShvAsa yatamAnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.16:
so.ahaM j~nAtvA raNe tasya karma dRRiShTvA cha phalguna |
vyavasIdAmi duHkhena na cha me jIvitaM priyam
shlokas.17:
tamadya yadi vai vIra na haniShyasi sUtajam |
prANAneva parityakShye jIvitArtho hi ko mama
shlokas.18:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha vijayo bharatarShabha |
satyena te shape rAjanprasAdena tavaiva cha
bhImena cha narashreShTha yamAbhyAM cha mahIpate
shlokas.19:
yathAdya samare karNaM haniShyAmi hato.atha vA |
mahItale patiShyAmi satyenAyudhamAlabhe
shlokas.20:
evamAbhAShya rAjAnamabravInmAdhavaM vachaH |
adya karNaM raNe kRRiShNa sUdayiShye na sa.nshayaH
tadanudhyAhi bhadraM te vadhaM tasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.21:
evamukto.abravItpArthaM keshavo rAjasattama |
shakto.asmi bharatashreShTha yatnaM kartuM yathAbalam
shlokas.22:
evaM chApi hi me kAmo nityameva mahAratha |
kathaM bhavAnraNe karNaM nihanyAditi me matiH
shlokas.23:
bhUyashchovAcha matimAnmAdhavo dharmanandanam |
yudhiShThiremaM bIbhatsuM tvaM sAntvayitumarhasi
anuj~nAtuM cha karNasya vadhAyAdya durAtmanaH
shlokas.24:
shrutvA hyayamahaM chaiva tvAM karNasharapIDitam |
pravRRittiM j~nAtumAyAtAviha pANDavanandana
shlokas.25:
diShTyAsi rAjannirujo diShTyA na grahaNaM gataH |
parisAntvaya bIbhatsuM jayamAshAdhi chAnagha
shlokas.26:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ehyehi pArtha bIbhatso mAM pariShvaja pANDava |
vaktavyamukto.asmyahitaM tvayA kShAntaM cha tanmayA
shlokas.27:
ahaM tvAmanujAnAmi jahi karNaM dhana~njaya |
manyuM cha mA kRRithAH pArtha yanmayokto.asi dAruNam
shlokas.28:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato dhana~njayo rAja~nshirasA praNatastadA |
pAdau jagrAha pANibhyAM bhrAturjyeShThasya mAriSha
shlokas.29:
samutthApya tato rAjA pariShvajya cha pIDitam |
mUrdhnyupAghrAya chaivainamidaM punaruvAcha ha
shlokas.30:
dhana~njaya mahAbAho mAnito.asmi dRRiDhaM tvayA |
mAhAtmyaM vijayaM chaiva bhUyaH prApnuhi shAshvatam
shlokas.31:
arjuna uvAcha||
adya taM pApakarmANaM sAnubandhaM raNe sharaiH |
nayAmyantaM samAsAdya rAdheyaM balagarvitam
shlokas.32:
yena tvaM pIDito bANairdRRiDhamAyamya kArmukam |
tasyAdya karmaNaH karNaH phalaM prApsyati dAruNam
shlokas.33:
adya tvAmahameShyAmi karNaM hatvA mahIpate |
sabhAjayitumAkrandAditi satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.34:
nAhatvA vinivarte.ahaM karNamadya raNAjirAt |
iti satyena te pAdau spRRishAmi jagatIpate
shlokas.35:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prasAdya dharmarAjAnaM prahRRiShTenAntarAtmanA |
pArthaH provAcha govindaM sUtaputravadhodyataH
shlokas.36:
kalpyatAM cha ratho bhUyo yujyantAM cha hayottamAH |
AyudhAni cha sarvANi sajjyantAM vai mahArathe
shlokas.37:
upAvRRittAshcha turagAH shikShitAshchAshvasAdinaH |
rathopakaraNaiH sarvairupAyAntu tvarAnvitAH
shlokas.38:
evamukte mahArAja phalgunena mahAtmanA |
uvAcha dArukaM kRRiShNaH kuru sarvaM yathAbravIt
arjuno bharatashreShThaH shreShThaH sarvadhanuShmatAm
shlokas.39:
Aj~naptastvatha kRRiShNena dAruko rAjasattama |
yojayAmAsa sa rathaM vaiyAghraM shatrutApanam
shlokas.40:
yuktaM tu rathamAsthAya dArukeNa mahAtmanA |
ApRRichChya dharmarAjAnaM brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchya cha
sama~NgalasvastyayanamAruroha rathottamam
shlokas.41:
tasya rAjA mahAprAj~no dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
AshiSho.ayu~Nkta paramA yuktAH karNavadhaM prati
shlokas.42:
taM prayAntaM maheShvAsaM dRRiShTvA bhUtAni bhArata |
nihataM menire karNaM pANDavena mahAtmanA
shlokas.43:
babhUvurvimalAH sarvA disho rAjansamantataH |
chAShAshcha shatapatrAshcha krau~nchAshchaiva janeshvara
pradakShiNamakurvanta tadA vai pANDunandanam
shlokas.44:
bahavaH pakShiNo rAjanpuMnAmAnaH shubhAH shivAH |
tvarayanto.arjunaM yuddhe hRRiShTarUpA vavAshire
shlokas.45:
ka~NkA gRRidhrA vaDAshchaiva vAyasAshcha vishAM pate |
agratastasya gachChanti bhakShyahetorbhayAnakAH
shlokas.46:
nimittAni cha dhanyAni pArthasya prashasha.nsire |
vinAshamarisainyAnAM karNasya cha vadhaM tathA
shlokas.47:
prayAtasyAtha pArthasya mahAnsvedo vyajAyata |
chintA cha vipulA jaj~ne kathaM nvetadbhaviShyati
shlokas.48:
tato gANDIvadhanvAnamabravInmadhusUdanaH |
dRRiShTvA pArthaM tadAyastaM chintAparigataM tadA
shlokas.49:
gANDIvadhanvansa~NgrAme ye tvayA dhanuShA jitAH |
na teShAM mAnuSho jetA tvadanya iha vidyate
shlokas.50:
dRRiShTA hi bahavaH shUrAH shakratulyaparAkramAH |
tvAM prApya samare vIraM ye gatAH paramAM gatim
shlokas.51:
ko hi droNaM cha bhIShmaM cha bhagadattaM cha mAriSha |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kAmbojaM cha sudakShiNam
shlokas.52:
shrutAyuShaM mahAvIryamachyutAyuShameva cha |
pratyudgamya bhavetkShemI yo na syAttvamiva kShamI
shlokas.53:
tava hyastrANi divyAni lAghavaM balameva cha |
vedhaH pAtashcha lakShashcha yogashchaiva tavArjuna
asaMmohashcha yuddheShu vij~nAnasya cha saMnatiH
shlokas.54:
bhavAndevAsurAnsarvAnhanyAtsahacharAcharAn |
pRRithivyAM hi raNe pArtha na yoddhA tvatsamaH pumAn
shlokas.55:
dhanurgrahA hi ye kechitkShatriyA yuddhadurmadAH |
A devAttvatsamaM teShAM na pashyAmi shRRiNomi vA
shlokas.56:
brahmaNA cha prajAH sRRiShTA gANDIvaM cha mahAdbhutam |
yena tvaM yudhyase pArtha tasmAnnAsti tvayA samaH
shlokas.57:
avashyaM tu mayA vAchyaM yatpathyaM tava pANDava |
mAvama.nsthA mahAbAho karNamAhavashobhinam
shlokas.58:
karNo hi balavAndhRRiShTaH kRRitAstrashcha mahArathaH |
kRRitI cha chitrayodhI cha deshe kAle cha kovidaH
shlokas.59:
tejasA vahnisadRRisho vAyuvegasamo jave |
antakapratimaH krodhe siMhasaMhanano balI
shlokas.60:
ayoratnirmahAbAhurvyUDhoraskaH sudurjayaH |
atimAnI cha shUrashcha pravIraH priyadarshanaH
shlokas.61:
sarvairyodhaguNairyukto mitrANAmabhaya~NkaraH |
satataM pANDavadveShI dhArtarAShTrahite rataH
shlokas.62:
sarvairavadhyo rAdheyo devairapi savAsavaiH |
RRite tvAmiti me buddhistvamadya jahi sUtajam
shlokas.63:
devairapi hi sa.nyattairbibhradbhirmA.nsashoNitam |
ashakyaH samare jetuM sarvairapi yuyutsubhiH
shlokas.64:
durAtmAnaM pApamatiM nRRisha.nsaM; duShTapraj~naM pANDaveyeShu nityam |
hInasvArthaM pANDaveyairvirodhe; hatvA karNaM dhiShThitArtho bhavAdya
shlokas.65:
vIraM manyata AtmAnaM yena pApaH suyodhanaH |
tamadya mUlaM pApAnAM jaya sautiM dhana~njaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH punarameyAtmA keshavo.arjunamabravIt |
kRRitasa~NkalpamAyastaM vadhe karNasya sarvashaH
shlokas.2:
adya saptadashAhAni vartamAnasya bhArata |
vinAshasyAtighorasya naravAraNavAjinAm
shlokas.3:
bhUtvA hi vipulA senA tAvakAnAM paraiH saha |
anyonyaM samare prApya ki~nchichCheShA vishAM pate
shlokas.4:
bhUtvA hi kauravAH pArtha prabhUtagajavAjinaH |
tvAM vai shatruM samAsAdya vinaShTA raNamUrdhani
shlokas.5:
ete cha sarve pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAshcha sahAnvayAH |
tvAM samAsAdya durdharShaM pANDavAshcha vyavasthitAH
shlokas.6:
pA~nchAlaiH pANDavairmatsyaiH kArUShaishchedikekayaiH |
tvayA guptairamitraghna kRRitaH shatrugaNakShayaH
shlokas.7:
ko hi shakto raNe jetuM kauravA.nstAta sa~NgatAn |
anyatra pANDavAnyuddhe tvayA guptAnmahArathAn
shlokas.8:
tvaM hi shakto raNe jetuM sasurAsuramAnuShAn |
trI.NllokAnsamamudyuktAnkiM punaH kauravaM balam
shlokas.9:
bhagadattaM hi rAjAnaM ko.anyaH shaktastvayA vinA |
jetuM puruShashArdUla yo.api syAdvAsavopamaH
shlokas.10:
tathemAM vipulAM senAM guptAM pArtha tvayAnagha |
na shekuH pArthivAH sarve chakShurbhirabhivIkShitum
shlokas.11:
tathaiva satataM pArtha rakShitAbhyAM tvayA raNe |
dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDibhyAM bhIShmadroNau nipAtitau
shlokas.12:
ko hi shakto raNe pArtha pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathau |
bhIShmadroNau yudhA jetuM shakratulyaparAkramau
shlokas.13:
ko hi shAntanavaM sa~Nkhye droNaM vaikartanaM kRRipam |
drauNiM cha saumadattiM cha kRRitavarmANameva cha
saindhavaM madrarAjaM cha rAjAnaM cha suyodhanam
shlokas.14:
vIrAnkRRitAstrAnsamare sarvAnevAnuvartinaH |
akShauhiNIpatInugrAnsa.nrabdhAnyuddhadurmadAn
shlokas.15:
shreNyashcha bahulAH kShINAH pradIrNAshvarathadvipAH |
nAnAjanapadAshchogrAH kShatriyANAmamarShiNAm
shlokas.16:
govAsadAsamIyAnAM vasAtInAM cha bhArata |
vrAtyAnAM vATadhAnAnAM bhojAnAM chApi mAninAm
shlokas.17:
udIrNAshcha mahAsenA brahmakShatrasya bhArata |
tvAM samAsAdya nidhanaM gatAH sAshvarathadvipAH
shlokas.18:
ugrAshcha krUrakarmANastukhArA yavanAH khashAH |
dArvAbhisArA daradAH shakA ramaThata~NgaNAH
shlokas.19:
andhrakAshcha pulindAshcha kirAtAshchogravikramAH |
mlechChAshcha pArvatIyAshcha sAgarAnUpavAsinaH
sa.nrambhiNo yuddhashauNDA balino dRRibdhapANayaH
shlokas.20:
ete suyodhanasyArthe sa.nrabdhAH kurubhiH saha |
na shakyA yudhi nirjetuM tvadanyena parantapa
shlokas.21:
dhArtarAShTramudagraM hi vyUDhaM dRRiShTvA mahAbalam |
yasya tvaM na bhavestrAtA pratIyAtko nu mAnavaH
shlokas.22:
tatsAgaramivoddhUtaM rajasA sa.nvRRitaM balam |
vidArya pANDavaiH kruddhaistvayA guptairhataM vibho
shlokas.23:
mAgadhAnAmadhipatirjayatseno mahAbalaH |
adya saptaiva chAhAni hataH sa~Nkhye.abhimanyunA
shlokas.24:
tato dasha sahasrANi gajAnAM bhImakarmaNAm |
jaghAna gadayA bhImastasya rAj~naH parichChadam
tato.anye.api hatA nAgA rathAshcha shatasho balAt
shlokas.25:
tadevaM samare tAta vartamAne mahAbhaye |
bhImasenaM samAsAdya tvAM cha pANDava kauravAH
savAjirathanAgAshcha mRRityulokamito gatAH
shlokas.26:
tathA senAmukhe tatra nihate pArtha pANDavaiH |
bhIShmaH prAsRRijadugrANi sharavarShANi mAriSha
shlokas.27:
sa chedikAshipA~nchAlAnkarUShAnmatsyakekayAn |
sharaiH prachChAdya nidhanamanayatparuShAstravit
shlokas.28:
tasya chApachyutairbANaiH paradehavidAraNaiH |
pUrNamAkAshamabhavadrukmapu~NkhairajihmagaiH
shlokas.29:
gatyA dashamyA te gatvA jaghnurvAjirathadvipAn |
hitvA nava gatIrduShTAH sa bANAnvyAyato.amuchat
shlokas.30:
dinAni dasha bhIShmeNa nighnatA tAvakaM balam |
shUnyAH kRRitA rathopasthA hatAshcha gajavAjinaH
shlokas.31:
darshayitvAtmano rUpaM rudropendrasamaM yudhi |
pANDavAnAmanIkAni pravigAhya vyashAtayat
shlokas.32:
vinighnanpRRithivIpAlA.nshchedipA~nchAlakekayAn |
vyadahatpANDavIM senAM narAshvagajasa~NkulAm
shlokas.33:
majjantamaplave mandamujjihIrShuH suyodhanam |
tathA charantaM samare tapantamiva bhAskaram
na shekuH sRRi~njayA draShTuM tathaivAnye mahIkShitaH
shlokas.34:
vicharantaM tathA taM tu sa~NgrAme jitakAshinam |
sarvodyogena sahasA pANDavAH samupAdravan
shlokas.35:
sa tu vidrAvya samare pANDavAnsRRi~njayAnapi |
eka eva raNe bhIShma ekavIratvamAgataH
shlokas.36:
taM shikhaNDI samAsAdya tvayA gupto mahAratham |
jaghAna puruShavyAghraM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.37:
sa eSha patitaH shete sharatalpe pitAmahaH |
tvAM prApya puruShavyAghra gRRidhraH prApyeva vAyasam
shlokas.38:
droNaH pa~ncha dinAnyugro vidhamya ripuvAhinIH |
kRRitvA vyUhaM mahAyuddhe pAtayitvA mahArathAn
shlokas.39:
jayadrathasya samare kRRitvA rakShAM mahArathaH |
antakapratimashchogrAM rAtriM yuddhvAdahatprajAH
shlokas.40:
adyeti dve dine vIro bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM samAsAdya sa gataH paramAM gatim
shlokas.41:
yadi chaiva parAnyuddhe sUtaputramukhAnrathAn |
nAvArayiShyaH sa~NgrAme na sma droNo vyana~NkShyata
shlokas.42:
bhavatA tu balaM sarvaM dhArtarAShTrasya vAritam |
tato droNo hato yuddhe pArShatena dhana~njaya
shlokas.43:
ka ivAnyo raNe kuryAttvadanyaH kShatriyo yudhi |
yAdRRishaM te kRRitaM pArtha jayadrathavadhaM prati
shlokas.44:
nivArya senAM mahatIM hatvA shUrA.nshcha pArthivAn |
nihataH saindhavo rAjA tvayAstrabalatejasA
shlokas.45:
AshcharyaM sindhurAjasya vadhaM jAnanti pArthivAH |
anAshcharyaM hi tattvattastvaM hi pArtha mahArathaH
shlokas.46:
tvAM hi prApya raNe kShatramekAhAditi bhArata |
tapyamAnamasa.nyuktaM na bhavediti me matiH
shlokas.47:
seyaM pArtha chamUrghorA dhArtarAShTrasya sa.nyuge |
hatA sasarvavIrA hi bhIShmadroNau yadA hatau
shlokas.48:
shIrNapravarayodhAdya hatavAjinaradvipA |
hInA sUryendunakShatrairdyaurivAbhAti bhAratI
shlokas.49:
vidhvastA hi raNe pArtha seneyaM bhImavikramAt |
AsurIva purA senA shakrasyeva parAkramaiH
shlokas.50:
teShAM hatAvashiShTAstu pa~ncha santi mahArathAH |
ashvatthAmA kRRitavarmA karNo madrAdhipaH kRRipaH
shlokas.51:
tA.nstvamadya naravyAghra hatvA pa~ncha mahArathAn |
hatAmitraH prayachChorvIM rAj~naH sadvIpapattanAm
shlokas.52:
sAkAshajalapAtAlAM saparvatamahAvanAm |
prApnotvamitavIryashrIradya pArtho vasundharAm
shlokas.53:
etAM purA viShNuriva hatvA daiteyadAnavAn |
prayachCha medinIM rAj~ne shakrAyeva yathA hariH
shlokas.54:
adya modantu pA~nchAlA nihateShvariShu tvayA |
viShNunA nihateShveva dAnaveyeShu devatAH
shlokas.55:
yadi vA dvipadAM shreShTha droNaM mAnayato gurum |
ashvatthAmni kRRipA te.asti kRRipe chAchAryagauravAt
shlokas.56:
atyantopachitAnvA tvaM mAnayanbhrAtRRibAndhavAn |
kRRitavarmANamAsAdya na neShyasi yamakShayam
shlokas.57:
bhrAtaraM mAturAsAdya shalyaM madrajanAdhipam |
yadi tvamaravindAkSha dayAvAnna jighA.nsasi
shlokas.58:
imaM pApamatiM kShudramatyantaM pANDavAnprati |
karNamadya narashreShTha jahyAshu nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.59:
etatte sukRRitaM karma nAtra ki~nchinna yujyate |
vayamapyatra jAnImo nAtra doSho.asti kashchana
shlokas.60:
dahane yatsaputrAyA nishi mAtustavAnagha |
dyUtArthe yachcha yuShmAsu prAvartata suyodhanaH
tatra sarvatra duShTAtmA karNo mUlamihArjuna
shlokas.61:
karNAddhi manyate trANaM nityameva suyodhanaH |
tato mAmapi sa.nrabdho nigrahItuM prachakrame
shlokas.62:
sthirA buddhirnarendrasya dhArtarAShTrasya mAnada |
karNaH pArthAnraNe sarvAnvijeShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.63:
karNamAshritya kaunteya dhArtarAShTreNa vigrahaH |
rochito bhavatA sArdhaM jAnatApi balaM tava
shlokas.64:
karNo hi bhAShate nityamahaM pArthAnsamAgatAn |
vAsudevaM sarAjAnaM vijeShyAmi mahAraNe
shlokas.65:
protsAhayandurAtmAnaM dhArtarAShTraM sudurmatiH |
samitau garjate karNastamadya jahi bhArata
shlokas.66:
yachcha yuShmAsu pApaM vai dhArtarAShTraH prayuktavAn |
tatra sarvatra duShTAtmA karNaH pApamatirmukham
shlokas.67:
yachcha taddhArtarAShTrANAM krUraiH ShaDbhirmahArathaiH |
apashyaM nihataM vIraM saubhadramRRiShabhekShaNam
shlokas.68:
droNadrauNikRRipAnvIrAnkampayanto mahArathAn |
nirmanuShyA.nshcha mAta~NgAnvirathA.nshcha mahArathAn
shlokas.69:
vyashvArohA.nshcha turagAnpattInvyAyudhajIvitAn |
kurvantamRRiShabhaskandhaM kuruvRRiShNiyashaskaram
shlokas.71:
sharaiH saubhadramAyastaM dahantamiva vAhinIm |
tanme dahati gAtrANi sakhe satyena te shape
shlokas.72:
yattatrApi cha duShTAtmA karNo.abhyadruhyata prabho |
ashaknuva.nshchAbhimanyoH karNaH sthAtuM raNe.agrataH
shlokas.73:
saubhadrasharanirbhinno visa~nj~naH shoNitokShitaH |
niHshvasankrodhasa.ndIpto vimukhaH sAyakArditaH
shlokas.74:
apayAnakRRitotsAho nirAshashchApi jIvite |
tasthau suvihvalaH sa~Nkhye prahArajanitashramaH
shlokas.75:
atha droNasya samare tatkAlasadRRishaM tadA |
shrutvA karNo vachaH krUraM tatashchichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.76:
tatashChinnAyudhaM tena raNe pa~ncha mahArathAH |
sa chaiva nikRRitipraj~naH prAvadhIchCharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.77:
yachcha karNo.abravItkRRiShNAM sabhAyAM paruShaM vachaH |
pramukhe pANDaveyAnAM kurUNAM cha nRRisha.nsavat
shlokas.78:
vinaShTAH pANDavAH kRRiShNe shAshvataM narakaM gatAH |
patimanyaM pRRithushroNi vRRiNIShva mitabhAShiNi
shlokas.79:
lekhAbhru dhRRitarAShTrasya dAsI bhUtvA niveshanam |
pravishArAlapakShmAkShi na santi patayastava
shlokas.80:
ityuktavAnadharmaj~nastadA paramadurmatiH |
pApaH pApaM vachaH karNaH shRRiNvatastava bhArata
shlokas.81:
tasya pApasya tadvAkyaM suvarNavikRRitAH sharAH |
shamayantu shilAdhautAstvayAstA jIvitachChidaH
shlokas.82:
yAni chAnyAni duShTAtmA pApAni kRRitavA.nstvayi |
tAnyadya jIvitaM chAsya shamayantu sharAstava
shlokas.83:
gANDIvaprahitAnghorAnadya gAtraiH spRRisha~nsharAn |
karNaH smaratu duShTAtmA vachanaM droNabhIShmayoH
shlokas.84:
suvarNapu~NkhA nArAchAH shatrughnA vaidyutaprabhAH |
tvayAstAstasya marmANi bhittvA pAsyanti shoNitam
shlokas.85:
ugrAstvadbhujanirmuktA marma bhittvA shitAH sharAH |
adya karNaM mahAvegAH preShayantu yamakShayam
shlokas.86:
adya hAhAkRRitA dInA viShaNNAstvachCharArditAH |
prapatantaM rathAtkarNaM pashyantu vasudhAdhipAH
shlokas.87:
adya svashoNite magnaM shayAnaM patitaM bhuvi |
apaviddhAyudhaM karNaM pashyantu suhRRido nijAH
shlokas.88:
hastikakShyo mahAnasya bhallenonmathitastvayA |
prakampamAnaH patatu bhUmAvAdhiratherdhvajaH
shlokas.89:
tvayA sharashataishChinnaM rathaM hemavibhUShitam |
hatayodhaM samutsRRijya bhItaH shalyaH palAyatAm
shlokas.90:
tataH suyodhano dRRiShTvA hatamAdhirathiM tvayA |
nirAsho jIvite tvadya rAjye chaiva dhana~njaya
shlokas.91:
ete dravanti pA~nchAlA vadhyamAnAH shitaiH sharaiH |
karNena bharatashreShTha pANDavAnujjihIrShavaH
shlokas.92:
pA~nchAlAndraupadeyA.nshcha dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
dhRRiShTadyumnatanUjA.nshcha shatAnIkaM cha nAkulim
shlokas.93:
nakulaM sahadevaM cha durmukhaM janamejayam |
suvarmANaM sAtyakiM cha viddhi karNavashaM gatAn
shlokas.94:
abhyAhatAnAM karNena pA~nchAlAnAM mahAraNe |
shrUyate ninado ghorastvadbandhUnAM parantapa
shlokas.95:
na tveva bhItAH pA~nchAlAH katha~nchitsyuH parA~NmukhAH |
na hi mRRityuM maheShvAsA gaNayanti mahArathAH
shlokas.96:
ya ekaH pANDavIM senAM sharaughaiH samaveShTayat |
taM samAsAdya pA~nchAlA bhIShmaM nAsanparA~NmukhAH
shlokas.97:
tathA jvalantamastrAgniM guruM sarvadhanuShmatAm |
nirdahantaM samArohandurdharShaM droNamojasA
shlokas.98:
te nityamuditA jetuM yuddhe shatrUnari.ndamAH |
na jAtvAdhiratherbhItAH pA~nchAlAH syuH parA~NmukhAH
shlokas.99:
teShAmApatatAM shUraH pA~nchAlAnAM tarasvinAm |
Adatte.asU~nsharaiH karNaH pata~NgAnAmivAnalaH
shlokas.100:
tA.nstathAbhimukhAnvIrAnmitrArthe tyaktajIvitAn |
kShayaM nayati rAdheyaH pA~nchAlA~nshatasho raNe
shlokas.101:
astraM hi rAmAtkarNena bhArgavAdRRiShisattamAt |
yadupAttaM purA ghoraM tasya rUpamudIryate
shlokas.102:
tApanaM sarvasainyAnAM ghorarUpaM sudAruNam |
samAvRRitya mahAsenAM jvalati svena tejasA
shlokas.103:
ete charanti sa~NgrAme karNachApachyutAH sharAH |
bhramarANAmiva vrAtAstApayantaH sma tAvakAn
shlokas.104:
ete charanti pA~nchAlA dikShu sarvAsu bhArata |
karNAstraM samare prApya durnivAramanAtmabhiH
shlokas.105:
eSha bhImo dRRiDhakrodho vRRitaH pArtha samantataH |
sRRi~njayairyodhayankarNaM pIDyate sma shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.106:
pANDavAnsRRi~njayA.nshchaiva pA~nchAlA.nshchaiva bhArata |
hanyAdupekShitaH karNo rogo dehamivAtataH
shlokas.107:
nAnyaM tvatto.abhipashyAmi yodhaM yaudhiShThire bale |
yaH samAsAdya rAdheyaM svastimAnAvrajedgRRiham
shlokas.108:
tamadya nishitairbANairnihatya bharatarShabha |
yathApratij~naM pArtha tvaM kRRitvA kIrtimavApnuhi
shlokas.109:
tvaM hi shakto raNe jetuM sakarNAnapi kauravAn |
nAnyo yudhi yudhAM shreShTha satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.110:
etatkRRitvA mahatkarma hatvA karNaM mahAratham |
kRRitArthaH saphalaH pArtha sukhI bhava narottama

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa keshavasya bIbhatsuH shrutvA bhArata bhAShitam |
vishokaH samprahRRiShTashcha kShaNena samapadyata
shlokas.2:
tato jyAmanumRRijyAshu vyAkShipadgANDivaM dhanuH |
dadhre karNavinAshAya keshavaM chAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.3:
tvayA nAthena govinda dhruva eSha jayo mama |
prasanno yasya me.adya tvaM bhUtabhavyabhavatprabhuH
shlokas.4:
tvatsahAyo hyahaM kRRiShNa trI.NllokAnvai samAgatAn |
prApayeyaM paraM lokaM kimu karNaM mahAraNe
shlokas.5:
pashyAmi dravatIM senAM pA~nchAlAnAM janArdana |
pashyAmi karNaM samare vicharantamabhItavat
shlokas.6:
bhArgavAstraM cha pashyAmi vicharantaM samantataH |
sRRiShTaM karNena vArShNeya shakreNeva mahAshanim
shlokas.7:
ayaM khalu sa sa~NgrAmo yatra kRRiShNa mayA kRRitam |
kathayiShyanti bhUtAni yAvadbhUmirdhariShyati
shlokas.8:
adya kRRiShNa vikarNA me karNaM neShyanti mRRityave |
gANDIvamuktAH kShiNvanto mama hastaprachoditAH
shlokas.9:
adya rAjA dhRRitarAShTraH svAM buddhimavama.nsyate |
duryodhanamarAjyArhaM yayA rAjye.abhyaShechayat
shlokas.10:
adya rAjyAtsukhAchchaiva shriyo rAShTrAttathA purAt |
putrebhyashcha mahAbAho dhRRitarAShTro viyokShyate
shlokas.11:
adya duryodhano rAjA jIvitAchcha nirAshakaH |
bhaviShyati hate karNe kRRiShNa satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.12:
adya dRRiShTvA mayA karNaM sharairvishakalIkRRitam |
smaratAM tava vAkyAni shamaM prati janeshvaraH
shlokas.13:
adyAsau saubalaH kRRiShNa glahaM jAnAtu vai sharAn |
durodaraM cha gANDIvaM maNDalaM cha rathaM mama
shlokas.14:
yo.asau raNe naraM nAnyaM pRRithivyAmabhimanyate |
tasyAdya sUtaputrasya bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
gANDIvasRRiShTA dAsyanti karNasya paramAM gatim
shlokas.15:
adya tapsyati rAdheyaH pA~nchAlIM yattadAbravIt |
sabhAmadhye vachaH krUraM kutsayanpANDavAnprati
shlokas.16:
ye vai ShaNDhatilAstatra bhavitAro.adya te tilAH |
hate vaikartane karNe sUtaputre durAtmani
shlokas.17:
ahaM vaH pANDuputrebhyastrAsyAmIti yadabravIt |
anRRitaM tatkariShyanti mAmakA nishitAH sharAH
shlokas.18:
hantAhaM pANDavAnsarvAnsaputrAniti yo.abravIt |
tamadya karNaM hantAsmi miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.19:
yasya vIrye samAshvasya dhArtarAShTro bRRihanmanAH |
avAmanyata durbuddhirnityamasmAndurAtmavAn
tamadya karNaM rAdheyaM hantAsmi madhusUdana
shlokas.20:
adya karNe hate kRRiShNa dhArtarAShTrAH sarAjakAH |
vidravantu disho bhItAH siMhatrastA mRRigA iva
shlokas.21:
adya duryodhano rAjA pRRithivImanvavekShatAm |
hate karNe mayA sa~Nkhye saputre sasuhRRijjane
shlokas.22:
adya karNaM hataM dRRiShTvA dhArtarAShTro.atyamarShaNaH |
jAnAtu mAM raNe kRRiShNa pravaraM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.23:
adyAhamanRRiNaH kRRiShNa bhaviShyAmi dhanurbhRRitAm |
krodhasya cha kurUNAM cha sharANAM gANDivasya cha
shlokas.24:
adya duHkhamahaM mokShye trayodashasamArjitam |
hatvA karNaM raNe kRRiShNa shambaraM maghavAniva
shlokas.25:
adya karNe hate yuddhe somakAnAM mahArathAH |
kRRitaM kAryaM cha manyantAM mitrakAryepsavo yudhi
shlokas.26:
na jAne cha kathaM prItiH shaineyasyAdya mAdhava |
bhaviShyati hate karNe mayi chApi jayAdhike
shlokas.27:
ahaM hatvA raNe karNaM putraM chAsya mahAratham |
prItiM dAsyAmi bhImasya yamayoH sAtyakerapi
shlokas.28:
dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDibhyAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha mAdhava |
adhyAnRRiNyaM gamiShyAmi hatvA karNaM mahAraNe
shlokas.29:
adya pashyantu sa~NgrAme dhana~njayamamarShaNam |
yudhyantaM kauravAnsa~Nkhye pAtayantaM cha sUtajam
bhavatsakAshe vakShye cha punarevAtmasa.nstavam
shlokas.30:
dhanurvede matsamo nAsti loke; parAkrame vA mama ko.asti tulyaH |
ko vApyanyo matsamo.asti kShamAyAM; tathA krodhe sadRRisho.anyo na me.asti
shlokas.31:
ahaM dhanuShmAnasurAnsurA.nshcha; sarvANi bhUtAni cha sa~NgatAni |
svabAhuvIryAdgamaye parAbhavaM; matpauruShaM viddhi paraH parebhyaH
shlokas.32:
sharArchiShA gANDivenAhamekaH; sarvAnkurUnbAhlikA.nshchAbhipatya |
himAtyaye kakShagato yathAgni;stahA daheyaM sagaNAnprasahya
shlokas.33:
pANau pRRiShatkA likhitA mamaite; dhanushcha savye nihitaM sabANam |
pAdau cha me sarathau sadhvajau cha; na mAdRRishaM yuddhagataM jayanti

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
teShAmanIkAni bRRihaddhvajAni; raNe samRRiddhAni samAgatAni |
garjanti bherIninadonmukhAni; meghairyathA meghagaNAstapAnte
shlokas.2:
mahAgajAbhrAkulamastratoyaM; vAditranemItalashabdavachcha |
hiraNyachitrAyudhavaidyutaM cha; mahArathairAvRRitashabdavachcha
shlokas.3:
tadbhImavegaM rudhiraughavAhi; khaDgAkulaM kShatriyajIvavAhi |
anArtavaM krUramaniShTavarShaM; babhUva tatsaMharaNaM prajAnAm
shlokas.4:
rathAnsasUtAnsahayAngajA.nshcha; sarvAnarInmRRityuvashaM sharaughaiH |
ninye hayA.nshchaiva tathA sasAdI;npadAtisa~NghA.nshcha tathaiva pArthaH
shlokas.5:
kRRipaH shikhaNDI cha raNe sametau; duryodhanaM sAtyakirabhyagachChata |
shrutashravA droNasutena sArdhaM; yudhAmanyushchitrasenena chApi
shlokas.6:
karNasya putrastu rathI suSheNaM; samAgataH sRRi~njayA.nshchottamaujAH |
gAndhArarAjaM sahadevaH kShudhArto; maharShabhaM siMha ivAbhyadhAvat
shlokas.7:
shatAnIko nAkuliH karNaputraM; yuvA yuvAnaM vRRiShasenaM sharaughaiH |
samArdayatkarNasutashcha vIraH; pA~nchAleyaM sharavarShairanekaiH
shlokas.8:
ratharShabhaH kRRitavarmANamArchCha;nmAdrIputro nakulashchitrayodhI |
pA~nchAlAnAmadhipo yAj~naseniH; senApatiM karNamArchChatsasainyam
shlokas.9:
duHshAsano bhArata bhAratI cha; sa.nshaptakAnAM pRRitanA samRRiddhA |
bhImaM raNe shastrabhRRitAM variShThaM; tadA samArchChattamasahyavegam
shlokas.10:
karNAtmajaM tatra jaghAna shUra;stathAchChinachchottamaujAH prasahya |
tasyottamA~NgaM nipapAta bhUmau; ninAdayadgAM ninadena khaM cha
shlokas.11:
suSheNashIrShaM patitaM pRRithivyAM; vilokya karNo.atha tadArtarUpaH |
krodhAddhayA.nstasya rathaM dhvajaM cha; bANaiH sudhArairnishitairnyakRRintat
shlokas.12:
sa tUttamaujA nishitaiH pRRiShatkai;rvivyAdha khaDgena cha bhAsvareNa |
pArShNiM hayA.nshchaiva kRRipasya hatvA; shikhaNDivAhaM sa tato.abhyarohat
shlokas.13:
kRRipaM tu dRRiShTvA virathaM rathastho; naichChachCharaistADayituM shikhaNDI |
taM drauNirAvArya rathaM kRRipaM sma; samujjahre pa~NkagatAM yathA gAm
shlokas.14:
hiraNyavarmA nishitaiH pRRiShatkai;stavAtmajAnAmanilAtmajo vai |
atApayatsainyamatIva bhImaH; kAle shuchau madhyagato yathArkaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
atha tvidAnIM tumule vimarde; dviShadbhireko bahubhiH samAvRRitaH |
mahAbhaye sArathimityuvAcha; bhImashchamUM vArayandhArtarAShTrIm
tvaM sArathe yAhi javena vAhai;rnayAmyetAndhArtarAShTrAnyamAya
shlokas.2:
sa~nchodito bhImasenena chaivaM; sa sArathiH putrabalaM tvadIyam |
prAyAttataH sArathirugravego; yato bhImastadbalaM gantumaichChat
shlokas.3:
tato.apare nAgarathAshvapattibhiH; pratyudyayuH kuravastaM samantAt |
bhImasya vAhAgryamudAravegaM; samantato bANagaNairnijaghnuH
shlokas.4:
tataH sharAnApatato mahAtmA; chichCheda bANaistapanIyapu~NkhaiH |
te vai nipetustapanIyapu~NkhA; dvidhA tridhA bhImasharairnikRRittAH
shlokas.5:
tato rAjannAgarathAshvayUnAM; bhImAhatAnAM tava rAjamadhye |
ghoro ninAdaH prababhau narendra; vajrAhatAnAmiva parvatAnAm
shlokas.6:
te vadhyamAnAshcha narendramukhyA; nirbhinnA vai bhImasenapravekaiH |
bhImaM samantAtsamare.adhyaroha;nvRRikShaM shakuntA iva puShpahetoH
shlokas.7:
tato.abhipAtaM tava sainyamadhye; prAdushchakre vegamivAttavegaH |
yathAntakAle kShapayandidhakShu;rbhUtAntakRRitkAla ivAttadaNDaH
shlokas.8:
tasyAtivegasya raNe.ativegaM; nAshaknuvandhArayituM tvadIyAH |
vyAttAnanasyApatato yathaiva; kAlasya kAle harataH prajA vai
shlokas.9:
tato balaM bhArata bhAratAnAM; pradahyamAnaM samare mahAtman |
bhItaM disho.akIryata bhImanunnaM; mahAnilenAbhragaNo yathaiva
shlokas.10:
tato dhImAnsArathimabravIdbalI; sa bhImasenaH punareva hRRiShTaH |
sUtAbhijAnIhi parAnsvakAnvA; rathAndhvajA.nshchApatataH sametAn
yudhyannahaM nAbhijAnAmi kiM chi;nmA sainyaM svaM ChAdayiShye pRRiShatkaiH
shlokas.11:
arInvishokAbhinirIkShya sarvato; manastu chintA pradunoti me bhRRisham |
rAjAturo nAgamadyatkirITI; bahUni duHkhAnyabhijAto.asmi sUta
shlokas.12:
etadduHkhaM sArathe dharmarAjo; yanmAM hitvA yAtavA~nshatrumadhye |
nainaM jIvannApi jAnAmyajIva;nbIbhatsuM vA tanmamAdyAtiduHkham
shlokas.13:
so.ahaM dviShatsainyamudagrakalpaM; vinAshayiShye paramapratItaH |
etAnnihatyAjimadhye sametA;nprIto bhaviShyAmi saha tvayAdya
shlokas.14:
sarvA.nstUNIrAnmArgaNAnvAnvavekShya; kiM shiShTaM syAtsAyakAnAM rathe me |
kA vA jAtiH kiM pramANaM cha teShAM; j~nAtvA vyaktaM tanmamAchakShva sUta
shlokas.15:
vishoka uvAcha||
ShaNmArgaNAnAmayutAni vIra; kShurAshcha bhallAshcha tathAyutAkhyAH |
nArAchAnAM dve sahasre tu vIra; trINyeva cha pradarANAM cha pArtha
shlokas.16:
astyAyudhaM pANDaveyAvashiShTaM; na yadvahechChakaTaM ShaDgavIyam |
etadvidvanmu~ncha sahasrasho.api; gadAsibAhudraviNaM cha te.asti
shlokas.17:
bhIma uvAcha||
sUtAdyemaM pashya bhImapramuktaiH; sambhindadbhiH pArthivAnAshuvegaiH |
ugrairbANairAhavaM ghorarUpaM; naShTAdityaM mRRityulokena tulyam
shlokas.18:
adyaiva tadviditaM pArthivAnAM; bhaviShyati AkumAraM cha sUta |
nimagno vA samare bhImasena; ekaH kurUnvA samare vijetA
shlokas.19:
sarve sa~Nkhye kuravo niShpatantu; mAM vA lokAH kIrtayantvAkumAram |
sarvAnekastAnahaM pAtayiShye; te vA sarve bhImasenaM tudantu
shlokas.20:
AshAstAraH karma chApyuttamaM vA; tanme devAH kevalaM sAdhayantu |
AyAtvihAdyArjunaH shatrughAtI; shakrastUrNaM yaj~na ivopahUtaH
shlokas.21:
IkShasvaitAM bhAratIM dIryamANA;mete kasmAdvidravante narendrAH |
vyaktaM dhImAnsavyasAchI narAgryaH; sainyaM hyetachChAdayatyAshu bANaiH
shlokas.22:
pashya dhvajA.nshcha dravato vishoka; nAgAnhayAnpattisa~NghA.nshcha sa~Nkhye |
rathAnvishIrNA~nsharashaktitADitA;npashyasvaitAnrathinashchaiva sUta
shlokas.23:
ApUryate kauravI chApyabhIkShNaM; senA hyasau subhRRishaM hanyamAnA |
dhana~njayasyAshanitulyavegai;rgrastA sharairbarhisuvarNavAjaiH
shlokas.24:
ete dravanti sma rathAshvanAgAH; padAtisa~NghAnavamardayantaH |
saMmuhyamAnAH kauravAH sarva eva; dravanti nAgA iva dAvabhItAH
hAhAkRRitAshchaiva raNe vishoka; mu~nchanti nAdAnvipulAngajendrAH
shlokas.25:
vishoka uvAcha||
sarve kAmAH pANDava te samRRiddhAH; kapidhvajo dRRishyate hastisainye |
nIlAddhanAdvidyutamuchcharantIM; tathApashyaM visphuradvai dhanustat
shlokas.26:
kapirhyasau vIkShyate sarvato vai; dhvajAgramAruhya dhana~njayasya |
divAkarAbho maNireSha divyo; vibhrAjate chaiva kirITasa.nsthaH
shlokas.27:
pArshve bhImaM pANDurAbhraprakAshaM; pashyemaM tvaM devadattaM sughoSham |
abhIshuhastasya janArdanasya; vigAhamAnasya chamUM pareShAm
shlokas.28:
raviprabhaM vajranAbhaM kShurAntaM; pArshve sthitaM pashya janArdanasya |
chakraM yasho vardhayatkeshavasya; sadArchitaM yadubhiH pashya vIra
shlokas.29:
bhIma uvAcha||
dadAmi te grAmavarA.nshchaturdasha; priyAkhyAne sArathe suprasannaH |
dasIshataM chApi rathA.nshcha vi.nshatiM; yadarjunaM vedayase vishoka

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutvA cha rathanirghoShaM siMhanAdaM cha sa.nyuge |
arjunaH prAha govindaM shIghraM chodaya vAjinaH
shlokas.2:
arjunasya vachaH shrutvA govindo.arjunamabravIt |
eSha gachChAmi sukShipraM yatra bhImo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.3:
AyAntamashvairhimasha~NkhavarNaiH; suvarNamuktAmaNijAlanaddhaiH |
jambhaM jighA.nsuM pragRRihItavajraM; jayAya devendramivogramanyum
shlokas.4:
rathAshvamAta~NgapadAtisa~NghA; bANasvanairnemikhurasvanaishcha |
saMnAdayanto vasudhAM dishashcha; kruddhA nRRisiMhA jayamabhyudIyuH
shlokas.5:
teShAM cha pArthasya mahattadAsI;ddehAsupApmakShapaNaM suyuddham |
trailokyahetorasurairyathAsI;ddevasya viShNorjayatAM varasya
shlokas.6:
tairastamuchchAvachamAyudhaugha;mekaH prachichCheda kirITamAlI |
kShurArdhachandrairnishitaishcha bANaiH; shirA.nsi teShAM bahudhA cha bAhUn
shlokas.7:
ChatrANi vAlavyajanAni ketU;nashvAnrathAnpattigaNAndvipA.nshcha |
te petururvyAM bahudhA virUpA; vAtaprabhagnAni yathA vanAni
shlokas.8:
suvarNajAlAvatatA mahAgajAH; savaijayantIdhvajayodhakalpitAH |
suvarNapu~NkhairiShubhiH samAchitA;shchakAshire prajvalitA yathAchalAH
shlokas.9:
vidArya nAgA.nshcha rathA.nshcha vAjinaH; sharottamairvAsavavajrasaMnibhaiH |
drutaM yayau karNajighA.nsayA tathA; yathA marutvAnbalabhedane purA
shlokas.10:
tataH sa puruShavyAghraH sUtasainyamari.ndama |
pravivesha mahAbAhurmakaraH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.11:
taM dRRiShTvA tAvakA rAjanrathapattisamanvitAH |
gajAshvasAdibahulAH pANDavaM samupAdravan
shlokas.12:
tatrAbhidravatAM pArthamArAvaH sumahAnabhUt |
sAgarasyeva mattasya yathA syAtsalilasvanaH
shlokas.13:
te tu taM puruShavyAghraM vyAghrA iva mahArathAH |
abhyadravanta sa~NgrAme tyaktvA prANakRRitaM bhayam
shlokas.14:
teShAmApatatAM tatra sharavarShANi mu~nchatAm |
arjuno vyadhamatsainyaM mahAvAto ghanAniva
shlokas.15:
te.arjunaM sahitA bhUtvA rathava.nshaiH prahAriNaH |
abhiyAya maheShvAsA vivyadhurnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
tato.arjunaH sahasrANi rathavAraNavAjinAm |
preShayAmAsa vishikhairyamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.17:
te vadhyamAnAH samare pArthachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
tatra tatra sma lIyante bhaye jAte mahArathAH
shlokas.18:
teShAM chatuHshatAnvIrAnyatamAnAnmahArathAn |
arjuno nishitairbANairanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.19:
te vadhyamAnAH samare nAnAli~NgaiH shitaiH sharaiH |
arjunaM samabhityajya dudruvurvai disho bhayAt
shlokas.20:
teShAM shabdo mahAnAsIddravatAM vAhinImukhe |
mahaughasyeva bhadraM te girimAsAdya dIryataH
shlokas.21:
tAM tu senAM bhRRishaM viddhvA drAvayitvArjunaH sharaiH |
prAyAdabhimukhaH pArthaH sUtAnIkAni mAriSha
shlokas.22:
tasya shabdo mahAnAsItparAnabhimukhasya vai |
garuDasyeva patataH pannagArthe yathA purA
shlokas.23:
taM tu shabdamabhishrutya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
babhUva paramaprItaH pArthadarshanalAlasaH
shlokas.24:
shrutvaiva pArthamAyAntaM bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
tyaktvA prANAnmahArAja senAM tava mamarda ha
shlokas.25:
sa vAyuvegapratimo vAyuvegasamo jave |
vAyuvadvyacharadbhImo vAyuputraH pratApavAn
shlokas.26:
tenArdyamAnA rAjendra senA tava vishAM pate |
vyabhrAmyata mahArAja bhinnA nauriva sAgare
shlokas.27:
tAM tu senAM tadA bhImo darshayanpANilAghavam |
sharairavachakartograiH preShayiShyanyamakShayam
shlokas.28:
tatra bhArata bhImasya balaM dRRiShTvAtimAnuSham |
vyatrasyanta raNe yodhAH kAlasyeva yugakShaye
shlokas.29:
tathArditAnbhImabalAnbhImasenena bhArata |
dRRiShTvA duryodhano rAjA idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.30:
sainikAnsa maheShvAso yodhA.nshcha bharatarShabha |
samAdishadraNe sarvAnhata bhImamiti sma ha
tasminhate hataM manye sarvasainyamasheShataH
shlokas.31:
pratigRRihya cha tAmAj~nAM tava putrasya pArthivAH |
bhImaM prachChAdayAmAsuH sharavarShaiH samantataH
shlokas.32:
gajAshcha bahulA rAjannarAshcha jayagRRiddhinaH |
rathA hayAshcha rAjendra parivavrurvRRikodaram
shlokas.33:
sa taiH parivRRitaH shUraiH shUro rAjansamantataH |
shushubhe bharatashreShTha nakShatrairiva chandramAH
shlokas.34:
sa rarAja tathA sa~Nkhye darshanIyo narottamaH |
nirvisheShaM mahArAja yathA hi vijayastathA
shlokas.35:
tatra te pArthivAH sarve sharavRRiShTIH samAsRRijan |
krodharaktekShaNAH krUrA hantukAmA vRRikodaram
shlokas.36:
sa vidArya mahAsenAM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nishchakrAma raNAdbhImo matsyo jAlAdivAmbhasi
shlokas.37:
hatvA dasha sahasrANi gajAnAmanivartinAm |
nRRiNAM shatasahasre dve dve shate chaiva bhArata
shlokas.38:
pa~ncha chAshvasahasrANi rathAnAM shatameva cha |
hatvA prAsyandayadbhImo nadIM shoNitakardamAm
shlokas.39:
shoNitodAM rathAvartAM hastigrAhasamAkulAm |
naramInAmashvanakrAM keshashaivalashAdvalAm
shlokas.40:
sa~nChinnabhujanAgendrAM bahuratnApahAriNIm |
UrugrAhAM majjapa~NkAM shIrShopalasamAkulAm
shlokas.41:
dhanuShkAshAM sharAvApAM gadAparighaketanAm |
yodhavrAtavatIM sa~Nkhye vahantIM yamasAdanam
shlokas.42:
kShaNena puruShavyAghraH prAvartayata nimnagAm |
yathA vaitaraNImugrAM dustarAmakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.43:
yato yataH pANDaveyaH pravRRitto rathasattamaH |
tatastato.apAtayata yodhA~nshatasahasrashaH
shlokas.44:
evaM dRRiShTvA kRRitaM karma bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
duryodhano mahArAja shakuniM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.45:
jaya mAtula sa~NgrAme bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
asmi~njite jitaM manye pANDaveyaM mahAbalam
shlokas.46:
tataH prAyAnmahArAja saubaleyaH pratApavAn |
raNAya mahate yukto bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.47:
sa samAsAdya sa~NgrAme bhImaM bhImaparAkramam |
vArayAmAsa taM vIro veleva makarAlayam
sa nyavartata taM bhImo vAryamANaH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.48:
shakunistasya rAjendra vAme pArshve stanAntare |
preShayAmAsa nArAchAnrukmapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn
shlokas.49:
varma bhittvA tu sauvarNaM bANAstasya mahAtmanaH |
nyamajjanta mahArAja ka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH
shlokas.50:
so.atividdho raNe bhImaH sharaM hemavibhUShitam |
preShayAmAsa sahasA saubalaM prati bhArata
shlokas.51:
tamAyAntaM sharaM ghoraM shakuniH shatrutApanaH |
chichCheda shatadhA rAjankRRitahasto mahAbalaH
shlokas.52:
tasminnipatite bhUmau bhImaH kruddho vishAM pate |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena saubalasya hasanniva
shlokas.53:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM saubaleyaH pratApavAn |
anyadAdatta vegena dhanurbhallA.nshcha ShoDasha
shlokas.54:
taistasya tu mahArAja bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
chaturbhiH sArathiM hyArchChadbhImaM pa~nchabhireva cha
shlokas.55:
dhvajamekena chichCheda ChatraM dvAbhyAM vishAM pate |
chaturbhishchaturo vAhAnvivyAdha subalAtmajaH
shlokas.56:
tataH kruddho mahArAja bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
shaktiM chikShepa samare rukmadaNDAmayasmayIm
shlokas.57:
sA bhImabhujanirmuktA nAgajihveva cha~nchalA |
nipapAta rathe tUrNaM saubalasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.58:
tatastAmeva sa~NgRRihya shaktiM kanakabhUShaNAm |
bhImasenAya chikShepa kruddharUpo vishAM pate
shlokas.59:
sA nirbhidya bhujaM savyaM pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
papAta cha tato bhUmau yathA vidyunnabhashchyutA
shlokas.60:
athotkruShTaM mahArAja dhArtarAShTraiH samantataH |
na tu taM mamRRiShe bhImaH siMhanAdaM tarasvinAm
shlokas.61:
sa sa~NgRRihya dhanuH sajyaM tvaramANo mahArathaH |
muhUrtAdiva rAjendra ChAdayAmAsa sAyakaiH
saubalasya balaM sa~Nkhye tyaktvAtmAnaM mahAbalaH
shlokas.62:
tasyAshvA.nshchaturo hatvA sUtaM chaiva vishAM pate |
dhvajaM chichCheda bhallena tvaramANaH parAkramI
shlokas.63:
hatAshvaM rathamutsRRijya tvaramANo narottamaH |
tasthau visphAraya.nshchApaM krodharaktekShaNaH shvasan
sharaishcha bahudhA rAjanbhImamArchChatsamantataH
shlokas.64:
pratihatya tu vegena bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
dhanushchichCheda sa~Nkruddho vivyAdha cha shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.65:
so.atividdho balavatA shatruNA shatrukarshanaH |
nipapAta tato bhUmau ki~nchitprANo narAdhipa
shlokas.66:
tatastaM vihvalaM j~nAtvA putrastava vishAM pate |
apovAha rathenAjau bhImasenasya pashyataH
shlokas.67:
rathasthe tu naravyAghre dhArtarAShTrAH parA~NmukhAH |
pradudruvurdisho bhItA bhImAjjAte mahAbhaye
shlokas.68:
saubale nirjite rAjanbhImasenena dhanvinA |
bhayena mahatA bhagnaH putro duryodhanastava
apAyAjjavanairashvaiH sApekSho mAtulaM prati
shlokas.69:
parA~NmukhaM tu rAjAnaM dRRiShTvA sainyAni bhArata |
viprajagmuH samutsRRijya dvairathAni samantataH
shlokas.71:
te vadhyamAnA bhImena dhArtarAShTrAH parA~NmukhAH |
karNamAsAdya samare sthitA rAjansamantataH
sa hi teShAM mahAvIryo dvIpo.abhUtsumahAbalaH
shlokas.72:
bhinnanaukA yathA rAjandvIpamAsAdya nirvRRitAH |
bhavanti puruShavyAghra nAvikAH kAlaparyaye
shlokas.73:
tathA karNaM samAsAdya tAvakA bharatarShabha |
samAshvastAH sthitA rAjansamprahRRiShTAH parasparam
samAjagmushcha yuddhAya mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tato bhagneShu sainyeShu bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
duryodhano.abravItkiM nu saubalo vApi sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
karNo vA jayatAM shreShTho yodhA vA mAmakA yudhi |
kRRipo vA kRRitavarmA cha drauNirduHshAsano.api vA
shlokas.3:
atyadbhutamidaM manye pANDaveyasya vikramam |
yathApratij~naM yodhAnAM rAdheyaH kRRitavAnapi
shlokas.4:
kurUNAmapi sarveShAM karNaH shatruniShUdanaH |
sharma varma pratiShThA cha jIvitAshA cha sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA kaunteyenAmitaujasA |
rAdheyAnAmadhirathaH karNaH kimakarodyudhi
shlokas.6:
putrA vA mama durdharShA rAjAno vA mahArathAH |
etanme sarvamAchakShva kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
aparAhNe mahArAja sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
jaghAna somakAnsarvAnbhImasenasya pashyataH
bhImo.apyatibalaH sainyaM dhArtarAShTraM vyapothayat
shlokas.8:
drAvyamANaM balaM dRRiShTvA bhImasenena dhImatA |
yantAramabravItkarNaH pA~nchAlAneva mA vaha
shlokas.9:
madrarAjastataH shalyaH shvetAnashvAnmahAjavAn |
prAhiNochchedipA~nchAlAnkarUShA.nshcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.10:
pravishya cha sa tAM senAM shalyaH parabalArdanaH |
nyayachChatturagAnhRRiShTo yatra yatraichChadagraNIH
shlokas.11:
taM rathaM meghasa~NkAshaM vaiyAghraparivAraNam |
sa.ndRRishya pANDupA~nchAlAstrastA AsanvishAM pate
shlokas.12:
tato rathasya ninadaH prAdurAsInmahAraNe |
parjanyasamanirghoShaH parvatasyeva dIryataH
shlokas.13:
tataH sharashataistIkShNaiH karNo.apyAkarNaniHsRRitaiH |
jaghAna pANDavabalaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.14:
taM tathA samare karma kurvANamatimAnuSham |
parivavrurmaheShvAsAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH
shlokas.15:
taM shikhaNDI cha bhImashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha draupadeyAH sasAtyakAH
parivavrurjighA.nsanto rAdheyaM sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.16:
sAtyakistu tataH karNaM vi.nshatyA nishitaiH sharaiH |
atADayadraNe shUro jatrudeshe narottamaH
shlokas.17:
shikhaNDI pa~nchavi.nshatyA dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pa~nchabhiH |
draupadeyAshchatuHShaShTyA sahadevashcha saptabhiH
nakulashcha shatenAjau karNaM vivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.18:
bhImasenastu rAdheyaM navatyA nataparvaNAm |
vivyAdha samare kruddho jatrudeshe mahAbalaH
shlokas.19:
tataH prahasyAdhirathirvikShipandhanuruttamam |
mumocha nishitAnbANAnpIDayansumahAbalaH
tAnpratyavidhyadrAdheyaH pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.20:
sAtyakestu dhanushChittvA dhvajaM cha puruSharShabhaH |
athainaM navabhirbANairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.21:
bhImasenastu taM kruddho vivyAdha tri.nshatA sharaiH |
sArathiM cha tribhirbANairAjaghAna parantapaH
shlokas.22:
virathAndraupadeyA.nshcha chakAra puruSharShabhaH |
akShNornimeShamAtreNa tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.23:
vimukhIkRRitya tAnsarvA~nsharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
pA~nchAlAnahanachChUrashchedInAM cha mahArathAn
shlokas.24:
te vadhyamAnAH samare chedimatsyA vishAM pate |
karNamekamabhidrutya sharasa~NghaiH samArdayan
tA~njaghAna shitairbANaiH sUtaputro mahArathaH
shlokas.25:
etadatyadbhutaM karNe dRRiShTavAnasmi bhArata |
yadekaH samare shUrAnsUtaputraH pratApavAn
shlokas.26:
yatamAnAnparaM shaktyAyodhayattA.nshcha dhanvinaH |
pANDaveyAnmahArAja sharairvAritavAnraNe
shlokas.27:
tatra bhArata karNasya lAghavena mahAtmanaH |
tutuShurdevatAH sarvAH siddhAshcha paramarShayaH
shlokas.28:
apUjayanmaheShvAsA dhArtarAShTrA narottamam |
karNaM rathavarashreShThaM shreShThaM sarvadhanuShmatAm
shlokas.29:
tataH karNo mahArAja dadAha ripuvAhinIm |
kakShamiddho yathA vahnirnidAghe jvalito mahAn
shlokas.30:
te vadhyamAnAH karNena pANDaveyAstatastataH |
prAdravanta raNe bhItAH karNaM dRRiShTvA mahAbalam
shlokas.31:
tatrAkrando mahAnAsItpA~nchAlAnAM mahAraNe |
vadhyatAM sAyakaistIkShNaiH karNachApavarachyutaiH
shlokas.32:
tena shabdena vitrastA pANDavAnAM mahAchamUH |
karNamekaM raNe yodhaM menire tatra shAtravAH
shlokas.33:
tatrAdbhutaM paraM chakre rAdheyaH shatrukarshanaH |
yadekaM pANDavAH sarve na shekurabhivIkShitum
shlokas.34:
yathaughaH parvatashreShThamAsAdyAbhipradIryate |
tathA tatpANDavaM sainyaM karNamAsAdya dIryate
shlokas.35:
karNo.api samare rAjanvidhUmo.agniriva jvalan |
daha.nstasthau mahAbAhuH pANDavAnAM mahAchamUm
shlokas.36:
shirA.nsi cha mahArAja karNA.nshcha~nchalakuNDalAn |
bAhU.nshcha vIro vIrANAM chichCheda laghu cheShubhiH
shlokas.37:
hastidantAntsarUnkhaDgAndhvajA~nshaktIrhayAngajAn |
rathA.nshcha vividhAnrAjanpatAkA vyajanAni cha
shlokas.38:
akSheShAyugayoktrANi chakrANi vividhAni cha |
chichCheda shatadhA karNo yodhavratamanuShThitaH
shlokas.39:
tatra bhArata karNena nihatairgajavAjibhiH |
agamyarUpA pRRithivI mA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.40:
viShamaM cha samaM chaiva hatairashvapadAtibhiH |
rathaishcha ku~njaraishchaiva na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.41:
nApi sve na pare yodhAH prAj~nAyanta parasparam |
ghore sharAndhakAre tu karNAstre cha vijRRimbhite
shlokas.42:
rAdheyachApanirmuktaiH sharaiH kA~nchanabhUShitaiH |
sa~nChAditA mahArAja yatamAnA mahArathAH
shlokas.43:
te pANDaveyAH samare karNena sma punaH punaH |
abhajyanta mahArAja yatamAnA mahArathAH
shlokas.44:
mRRigasa~NghAnyathA kruddhaH siMho drAvayate vane |
karNastu samare yodhA.nstatra tatra mahAyashAH
kAlayAmAsa tatsainyaM yathA pashugaNAnvRRikaH
shlokas.45:
dRRiShTvA tu pANDavIM senAM dhArtarAShTrAH parA~NmukhIm |
abhijagmurmaheShvAsA ruvanto bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.46:
duryodhano hi rAjendra mudA paramayA yutaH |
vAdayAmAsa saMhRRiShTo nAnAvAdyAni sarvashaH
shlokas.47:
pA~nchAlApi maheShvAsA bhagnA bhagnA narottamAH |
nyavartanta yathA shUrA mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam
shlokas.48:
tAnnivRRittAnraNe shUrAnrAdheyaH shatrutApanaH |
anekasho mahArAja babha~nja puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.49:
tatra bhArata karNena pA~nchAlA vi.nshatI rathAH |
nihatAH sAdayaH krodhAchchedayashcha paraHshatAH
shlokas.50:
kRRitvA shUnyAnrathopasthAnvAjipRRiShThA.nshcha bhArata |
nirmanuShyAngajaskandhAnpAdAtA.nshchaiva vidrutAn
shlokas.51:
Aditya iva madhyAhne durnirIkShyaH parantapaH |
kAlAntakavapuH krUraH sUtaputrashchachAra ha
shlokas.52:
evametAnmahArAja naravAjirathadvipAn |
hatvA tasthau maheShvAsaH karNo.arigaNasUdanaH
shlokas.53:
yathA bhUtagaNAnhatvA kAlastiShThenmahAbalaH |
tathA sa somakAnhatvA tasthAveko mahArathaH
shlokas.54:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma pA~nchAlAnAM parAkramam |
vadhyamAnApi karNena nAjahU raNamUrdhani
shlokas.55:
rAjA duHshAsanashchaiva kRRipaH shAradvatastathA |
ashvatthAmA kRRitavarmA shakunishchApi saubalaH
nyahananpANDavIM senAM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.56:
karNaputrau cha rAjendra bhrAtarau satyavikramau |
anAshayetAM balinaH pA~nchAlAnvai tatastataH
tatra yuddhaM tadA hyAsItkrUraM vishasanaM mahat
shlokas.57:
tathaiva pANDavAH shUrA dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
draupadeyAshcha sa~NkruddhA abhyaghna.nstAvakaM balam
shlokas.58:
evameSha kShayo vRRittaH pANDavAnAM tatastataH |
tAvakAnAmapi raNe bhImaM prApya mahAbalam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjunastu mahArAja kRRitvA sainyaM pRRithagvidham |
sUtaputraM susa.nrabdhaM dRRiShTvA chaiva mahAraNe
shlokas.2:
shoNitodAM mahIM kRRitvA mA.nsamajjAsthivAhinIm |
vAsudevamidaM vAkyamabravItpuruSharShabha
shlokas.3:
eSha ketU raNe kRRiShNa sUtaputrasya dRRishyate |
bhImasenAdayashchaite yodhayanti mahArathAn
ete dravanti pA~nchAlAH karNAttrastA janArdana
shlokas.4:
eSha duryodhano rAjA shvetachChatreNa bhAsvatA |
karNena bhagnAnpA~nchAlAndrAvayanbahu shobhate
shlokas.5:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha drauNishchaiva mahAbalaH |
ete rakShanti rAjAnaM sUtaputreNa rakShitAH
avadhyamAnAste.asmAbhirghAtayiShyanti somakAn
shlokas.6:
eSha shalyo rathopasthe rashmisa~nchArakovidaH |
sUtaputrarathaM kRRiShNa vAhayanbahu shobhate
shlokas.7:
tatra me buddhirutpannA vAhayAtra mahAratham |
nAhatvA samare karNaM nivartiShye katha~nchana
shlokas.8:
rAdheyo.apyanyathA pArthAnsRRi~njayA.nshcha mahArathAn |
niHsheShAnsamare kuryAtpashyatornau janArdana
shlokas.9:
tataH prAyAdrathenAshu keshavastava vAhinIm |
karNaM prati maheShvAsaM dvairathe savyasAchinA
shlokas.10:
prayAtashcha mahAbAhuH pANDavAnuj~nayA hariH |
AshvAsayanrathenaiva pANDusainyAni sarvashaH
shlokas.11:
rathaghoShaH sa sa~NgrAme pANDaveyasya sambabhau |
vAsavAshanitulyasya mahaughasyeva mAriSha
shlokas.12:
mahatA rathaghoSheNa pANDavaH satyavikramaH |
abhyayAdaprameyAtmA vijayastava vAhinIm
shlokas.13:
tamAyAntaM samIkShyaiva shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim |
madrarAjo.abravItkarNaM ketuM dRRiShTvA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.14:
ayaM sa ratha AyAti shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
nighnannamitrAnsamare yaM karNa paripRRichChasi
shlokas.15:
eSha tiShThati kaunteyaH sa.nspRRishangANDivaM dhanuH |
taM haniShyasi chedadya tannaH shreyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.16:
eShA vidIryate senA dhArtarAShTrI samantataH |
arjunasya bhayAttUrNaM nighnataH shAtravAnbahUn
shlokas.17:
varjayansarvasainyAni tvarate hi dhana~njayaH |
tvadarthamiti manye.ahaM yathAsyodIryate vapuH
shlokas.18:
na hyavasthApyate pArtho yuyutsuH kenachitsaha |
tvAmRRite krodhadIpto hi pIDyamAne vRRikodare
shlokas.19:
virathaM dharmarAjaM cha dRRiShTvA sudRRiDhavikShatam |
shikhaNDinaM sAtyakiM cha dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam
shlokas.20:
draupadeyAnyudhAmanyumuttamaujasameva cha |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha bhrAtarau dvau samIkShya cha
shlokas.21:
sahasaikarathaH pArthastvAmabhyeti parantapa |
krodharaktekShaNaH kruddho jighA.nsuH sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.22:
tvarito.abhipatatyasmA.nstyaktvA sainyAnyasa.nshayam |
tvaM karNa pratiyAhyenaM nAstyanyo hi dhanurdharaH
shlokas.23:
na taM pashyAmi loke.asmi.nstvatto.apyanyaM dhanurdharam |
arjunaM samare kruddhaM yo velAmiva dhArayet
shlokas.24:
na chAsya rakShAM pashyAmi pRRiShThato na cha pArshvataH |
eka evAbhiyAti tvAM pashya sAphalyamAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
tvaM hi kRRiShNau raNe shaktaH sa.nsAdhayitumAhave |
tavaiSha bhAro rAdheya pratyudyAhi dhana~njayam
shlokas.26:
tvaM kRRito hyeva bhIShmeNa droNadrauNikRRipairapi |
savyasAchipratirathastaM nivartaya pANDavam
shlokas.27:
lelihAnaM yathA sarpaM garjantamRRiShabhaM yathA |
layasthitaM yathA vyAghraM jahi karNa dhana~njayam
shlokas.28:
ete dravanti samare dhArtarAShTrA mahArathAH |
arjunasya bhayAttUrNaM nirapekShA janAdhipAH
shlokas.29:
dravatAmatha teShAM tu yudhi nAnyo.asti mAnavaH |
bhayahA yo bhavedvIra tvAmRRite sUtanandana
shlokas.30:
ete tvAM kuravaH sarve dvIpamAsAdya sa.nyuge |
viShThitAH puruShavyAghra tvattaH sharaNakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.31:
vaidehAmbaShThakAmbojAstathA nagnajitastvayA |
gAndhArAshcha yayA dhRRityA jitAH sa~Nkhye sudurjayAH
shlokas.32:
tAM dhRRitiM kuru rAdheya tataH pratyehi pANDavam |
vAsudevaM cha vArShNeyaM prIyamANaM kirITinA
shlokas.33:
karNa uvAcha||
prakRRitistho hi me shalya idAnIM saMmatastathA |
pratibhAsi mahAbAho vibhIshchaiva dhana~njayAt
shlokas.34:
pashya bAhvorbalaM me.adya shikShitasya cha pashya me |
eko.adya nihaniShyAmi pANDavAnAM mahAchamUm
shlokas.35:
kRRiShNau cha puruShavyAghrau tachcha satyaM bravImi te |
nAhatvA yudhi tau vIrAvapayAsye katha~nchana
shlokas.36:
svapsye vA nihatastAbhyAmasatyo hi raNe jayaH |
kRRitArtho vA bhaviShyAmi hatvA tAvatha vA hataH
shlokas.37:
naitAdRRisho jAtu babhUva loke; rathottamo yAvadanushrutaM naH |
tamIdRRishaM pratiyotsyAmi pArthaM; mahAhave pashya cha pauruShaM me
shlokas.38:
rathe charatyeSha rathapravIraH; shIghrairhayaiH kauravarAjaputraH |
sa vAdya mAM neShyati kRRichChrameta;tkarNasyAntAdetadantAH stha sarve
shlokas.39:
asvedinau rAjaputrasya hastA;vavepinau jAtakiNau bRRihantau |
dRRiDhAyudhaH kRRitimAnkShiprahasto; na pANDaveyena samo.asti yodhaH
shlokas.40:
gRRihNAtyanekAnapi ka~NkapatrA;nekaM yathA tAnkShitipAnpramathya |
te kroshamAtraM nipatantyamoghAH; kastena yodho.asti samaH pRRithivyAm
shlokas.41:
atoShayatpANDaveyo hutAshaM; kRRiShNadvitIyo.atirathastarasvI |
lebhe chakraM yatra kRRiShNo mahAtmA; dhanurgANDIvaM pANDavaH savyasAchI
shlokas.42:
shvetAshvayuktaM cha sughoShamagryaM; rathaM mahAbAhuradInasattvaH |
maheShudhI chAkShayau divyarUpau; shastrANi divyAni cha havyavAhAt
shlokas.43:
tathendraloke nijaghAna daityA;nasa~NkhyeyAnkAlakeyA.nshcha sarvAn |
lebhe sha~NkhaM devadattaM sma tatra; ko nAma tenAbhyadhikaH pRRithivyAm
shlokas.44:
mahAdevaM toShayAmAsa chaiva; sAkShAtsuyuddhena mahAnubhAvaH |
lebhe tataH pAshupataM sughoraM; trailokyasaMhArakaraM mahAstram
shlokas.45:
pRRithakpRRithaglokapAlAH sametA; dadurhyastrANyaprameyANi yasya |
yaistA~njaghAnAshu raNe nRRisiMhA;nsa kAlakha~njAnasurAnsametAn
shlokas.46:
tathA virATasya pure sametA;nsarvAnasmAnekarathena jitvA |
jahAra tadgodhanamAjimadhye; vastrANi chAdatta mahArathebhyaH
shlokas.47:
tamIdRRishaM vIryaguNopapannaM; kRRiShNadvitIyaM varaye raNAya |
anantavIryeNa cha keshavena; nArAyaNenApratimena guptam
shlokas.48:
varShAyutairyasya guNA na shakyA; vaktuM sametairapi sarvalokaiH |
mahAtmanaH sha~NkhachakrAsipANe;rviShNorjiShNorvasudevAtmajasya
bhayaM me vai jAyate sAdhvasaM cha; dRRiShTvA kRRiShNAvekarathe sametau
shlokas.49:
ubhau hi shUrau kRRitinau dRRiDhAstrau; mahArathau saMhananopapannau |
etAdRRishau phalgunavAsudevau; ko.anyaH pratIyAnmadRRite nu shalya
shlokas.50:
etAvahaM yudhi vA pAtayiShye; mAM vA kRRiShNau nihaniShyato.adya |
iti bruva~nshalyamamitrahantA; karNo raNe megha ivonnanAda
shlokas.51:
abhyetya putreNa tavAbhinanditaH; sametya chovAcha kurupravIrAn |
kRRipaM cha bhojaM cha mahAbhujAvubhau; tathaiva gAndhAranRRipaM sahAnujam
guroH sutaM chAvarajaM tathAtmanaH; padAtino.atha dvipasAdino.anyAn
shlokas.52:
nirundhatAbhidravatAchyutArjunau; shrameNa sa.nyojayatAshu sarvataH |
yathA bhavadbhirbhRRishavikShatAvubhau; sukhena hanyAmahamadya bhUmipAH
shlokas.53:
tatheti choktvA tvaritAH sma te.arjunaM; jighA.nsavo vIratamAH samabhyayuH |
nadInadAnbhUrijalo mahArNavo; yathA tathA tAnsamare.arjuno.agrasat
shlokas.54:
na sa.ndadhAno na tathA sharottamA;npramu~nchamAno ripubhiH pradRRishyate |
dhana~njayastasya sharaishcha dAritA; hatAshcha peturnaravAjiku~njarAH
shlokas.55:
sharArchiShaM gANDivachArumaNDalaM; yugAntasUryapratimAnatejasam |
na kauravAH shekurudIkShituM jayaM; yathA raviM vyAdhitachakShuSho janAH
shlokas.56:
tamabhyadhAvadvisRRija~nsharAnkRRipa;stathaiva bhojastava chAtmajaH svayam |
jighA.nsubhistAnkushalaiH sharottamA;nmahAhave sa~njavitAnprayatnataH
sharaiH prachichCheda cha pANDavastvara;nparAbhinadvakShasi cha tribhistribhiH
shlokas.57:
sa gANDivAbhyAyatapUrNamaNDala;stapanripUnarjunabhAskaro babhau |
sharograrashmiH shuchishukramadhyago; yathaiva sUryaH pariveShagastathA
shlokas.58:
athAgryabANairdashabhirdhana~njayaM; parAbhinaddroNasuto.achyutaM tribhiH |
chaturbhirashvA.nshchaturaH kapiM tathA; sharaiH sa nArAchavarairavAkirat
shlokas.59:
tathA tu tattatsphuradAttakArmukaM; tribhiH sharairyantRRishiraH kShureNa |
hayA.nshchaturbhishchaturastribhirdhvajaM; dhana~njayo drauNirathAnnyapAtayat
shlokas.60:
sa roShapUrNo.ashanivajrahATakai;rala~NkRRitaM takShakabhogavarchasam |
subandhanaM kArmukamanyadAdade; yathA mahAhipravaraM girestathA
shlokas.61:
svamAyudhaM chopavikIrya bhUtale; dhanushcha kRRitvA saguNaM guNAdhikaH |
samAnayAnAvajitau narottamau; sharottamairdrauNiravidhyadantikAt
shlokas.62:
kRRipashcha bhojashcha tathAtmajashcha te; tamonudaM vAridharA ivApatan |
kRRipasya pArthaH sasharaM sharAsanaM; hayAndhvajaM sArathimeva patribhiH
shlokas.63:
sharaiH prachichCheda tavAtmajasya; dhvajaM dhanushcha prachakarta nardataH |
jaghAna chAshvAnkRRitavarmaNaH shubhA;ndhvajaM cha chichCheda tataH pratApavAn
shlokas.64:
savAjisUteShvasanAnsaketanA;~njaghAna nAgAshvarathA.nstvara.nshcha saH |
tataH prakIrNaM sumahadbalaM tava; pradAritaM seturivAmbhasA yathA
tato.arjunasyAshu rathena keshava;shchakAra shatrUnapasavyamAturAn
shlokas.65:
tataH prayAntaM tvaritaM dhana~njayaM; shatakratuM vRRitranijaghnuShaM yathA |
samanvadhAvanpunaruchChritairdhvajai; rathaiH suyuktairapare yuyutsavaH
shlokas.66:
athAbhisRRitya prativArya tAnarI;ndhana~njayasyAbhi rathaM mahArathAH |
shikhaNDishaineyayamAH shitaiH sharai;rvidArayanto vyanadansubhairavam
shlokas.67:
tato.abhijaghnuH kupitAH parasparaM; sharaistadA~njogatibhiH sutejanaiH |
kurupravIrAH saha sRRi~njayairyathA;surAH purA devavarairayodhayan
shlokas.68:
jayepsavaH svargamanAya chotsukAH; patanti nAgAshvarathAH parantapa |
jagarjuruchchairbalavachcha vivyadhuH; sharaiH sumuktairitaretaraM pRRithak
shlokas.69:
sharAndhakAre tu mahAtmabhiH kRRite; mahAmRRidhe yodhavaraiH parasparam |
babhurdashAshA na divaM cha pArthiva; prabhA cha sUryasya tamovRRitAbhavat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAjankurUNAM pravarairbalairbhImamabhidrutam |
majjantamiva kaunteyamujjihIrShurdhana~njayaH
shlokas.2:
vimRRidya sUtaputrasya senAM bhArata sAyakaiH |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya paravIrAndhana~njayaH
shlokas.3:
tato.asyAmbaramAvRRitya sharajAlAni bhAgashaH |
adRRishyanta tathAnye cha nighnantastava vAhinIm
shlokas.4:
sa pakShisa~NghAcharitamAkAshaM pUraya~nsharaiH |
dhana~njayo mahArAja kurUNAmantako.abhavat
shlokas.5:
tato bhallaiH kShurapraishcha nArAchairnirmalairapi |
gAtrANi prAkShiNotpArthaH shirA.nsi cha chakarta ha
shlokas.6:
ChinnagAtrairvikavachairvishiraskaiH samantataH |
patitaishcha patadbhishcha yodhairAsItsamAvRRitam
shlokas.7:
dhana~njayasharAbhyastaiH syandanAshvanaradvipaiH |
raNabhUmirabhUdrAjanmahAvaitaraNI yathA
shlokas.8:
IShAchakrAkShabha~Ngaishcha vyashvaiH sAshvaishcha yudhyatAm |
sasUtairhatasUtaishcha rathaiH stIrNAbhavanmahI
shlokas.9:
suvarNavarmasaMnAhairyodhaiH kanakabhUShaNaiH |
AsthitAH kRRitavarmANo bhadrA nityamadA dvipAH
kruddhAH kruddhairmahAmAtraiH preShitArjunamabhyayuH
shlokas.10:
chatuHshatAH sharavarShairhatAH petuH kirITinA |
paryastAnIva shRRi~NgANi sasattvAni mahAgireH
shlokas.11:
dhana~njayasharAbhyastaiH stIrNA bhUrvaravAraNaiH |
abhipede.arjunaratho ghanAnbhindannivA.nshumAn
shlokas.12:
hatairgajamanuShyAshvairbhagnaishcha bahudhA rathaiH |
vishastrapatrakavachairyuddhashauNDairgatAsubhiH
apaviddhAyudhairmArgaH stIrNo.abhUtphalgunena vai
shlokas.13:
vyasphUrjayachcha gANDIvaM sumahadbhairavasvanam |
ghoro vajraviniShpeShaH stanayitnorivAmbare
shlokas.14:
tataH prAdIryata chamUrdhana~njayasharAhatA |
mahAvAtasamAviddhA mahAnauriva sAgare
shlokas.15:
nAnArUpAH praharaNAH sharA gANDIvachoditAH |
alAtolkAshaniprakhyAstava sainyaM vinirdahan
shlokas.16:
mahAgirau veNuvanaM nishi prajvalitaM yathA |
tathA tava mahatsainyaM prAsphurachCharapIDitam
shlokas.17:
sampiShTadagdhavidhvastaM tava sainyaM kirITinA |
hataM pravihataM bANaiH sarvataH pradrutaM dishaH
shlokas.18:
mahAvane mRRigagaNA dAvAgnigrasitA yathA |
kuravaH paryavartanta nirdagdhAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.19:
utsRRijya hi mahAbAhuM bhImasenaM tadA raNe |
balaM kurUNAmudvignaM sarvamAsItparA~Nmukham
shlokas.20:
tataH kuruShu bhagneShu bIbhatsuraparAjitaH |
bhImasenaM samAsAdya muhUrtaM so.abhyavartata
shlokas.21:
samAgamya sa bhImena mantrayitvA cha phalgunaH |
vishalyamarujaM chAsmai kathayitvA yudhiShThiram
shlokas.22:
bhImasenAbhyanuj~nAtastataH prAyAddhana~njayaH |
nAdayanrathaghoSheNa pRRithivIM dyAM cha bhArata
shlokas.23:
tataH parivRRito bhImairdashabhiH shatrupu~NgavaiH |
duHshAsanAdavarajaistava putrairdhana~njayaH
shlokas.24:
te tamabhyardayanbANairulkAbhiriva ku~njaram |
AtateShvasanAH krUrA nRRityanta iva bhArata
shlokas.25:
apasavyA.nstu tA.nshchakre rathena madhusUdanaH |
tataste prAdrava~nshUrAH parA~Nmukharathe.arjune
shlokas.26:
teShAmApatatAM ketUnrathA.nshchApAni sAyakAn |
nArAchairardhachandraishcha kShipraM pArtho nyapAtayat
shlokas.27:
athAnyairdashabhirbhallaiH shirA.nsyeShAM nyapAtayat |
roShasa.nraktanetrANi sa.ndaShTauShThAni bhUtale
tAni vaktrANi vibabhurvyomni tArAgaNA iva
shlokas.28:
tA.nstu bhallairmahAvegairdashabhirdasha kauravAn |
rukmA~NgadAnrukmapu~NkhairviddhvA prAyAdamitrahA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taM tu yAntaM mahAvegairashvaiH kapivaradhvajam |
yuddhAyAbhyadravanvIrAH kurUNAM navatI rathAH
parivavrurnaravyAghrA naravyAghraM raNe.arjunam
shlokas.2:
kRRiShNaH shvetAnmahAvegAnashvAnkanakabhUShaNAn |
muktAjAlapratichChannAnpraiShItkarNarathaM prati
shlokas.3:
tataH karNarathaM yAntamarInghnantaM dhana~njayam |
bANavarShairabhighnantaH sa.nshaptakarathA yayuH
shlokas.4:
tvaramANA.nstu tAnsarvAnsasUteShvasanadhvajAn |
jaghAna navatiM vIrAnarjuno nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.5:
te.apatanta hatA bANairnAnArUpaiH kirITinA |
savimAnA yathA siddhAH svargAtpuNyakShaye tathA
shlokas.6:
tataH sarathanAgAshvAH kuravaH kurusattama |
nirbhayA bharatashreShThamabhyavartanta phalgunam
shlokas.7:
tadAyastamamuktAstramudIrNavaravAraNam |
putrANAM te mahatsainyaM samarautsIddhana~njayaH
shlokas.8:
shaktyRRiShTitomaraprAsairgadAnistri.nshasAyakaiH |
prAchChAdayanmaheShvAsAH kuravaH kurunandanam
shlokas.9:
tAM kurUNAM pravitatAM shastravRRiShTiM samudyatAm |
vyadhamatpANDavo bANaistamaH sUrya ivA.nshubhiH
shlokas.10:
tato mlechChAH sthitairmattaistrayodashashatairgajaiH |
pArshvato.abhyahananpArthaM tava putrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.11:
karNinAlIkanArAchaistomaraiH prAsashaktibhiH |
kampanairbhiNDipAlaishcha rathasthaM pArthamArdayan
shlokas.12:
tAmastravRRiShTiM prahitAM dvipasthairyavanaiH smayan |
chichCheda nishitairbhallairardhachandraishcha phalgunaH
shlokas.13:
atha tAndviradAnsarvAnnAnAli~NgairmahAsharaiH |
sapatAkAnsahArohAngirInvajrairivAbhinat
shlokas.14:
te hemapu~NkhairiShubhirAchitA hemamAlinaH |
hatAH peturmahAnAgAH sAgnijvAlA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.15:
tato gANDIvanirghoSho mahAnAsIdvishAM pate |
stanatAM kUjatAM chaiva manuShyagajavAjinAm
shlokas.16:
ku~njarAshcha hatA rAjanprAdrava.nste samantataH |
ashvAshcha paryadhAvanta hatArohA disho dasha
shlokas.17:
rathA hInA mahArAja rathibhirvAjibhistathA |
gandharvanagarAkArA dRRishyante sma sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
ashvArohA mahArAja dhAvamAnAstatastataH |
tatra tatraiva dRRishyante patitAH pArthasAyakaiH
shlokas.19:
tasminkShaNe pANDavasya bAhvorbalamadRRishyata |
yatsAdino vAraNA.nshcha rathA.nshchaiko.ajayadyudhi
shlokas.20:
tatastrya~NgeNa mahatA balena bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTvA parivRRitaM rAjanbhImasenaH kirITinam
shlokas.21:
hatAvasheShAnutsRRijya tvadIyAnkatichidrathAn |
javenAbhyadravadrAjandhana~njayarathaM prati
shlokas.22:
tatastatprAdravatsainyaM hatabhUyiShThamAturam |
dRRiShTvA yadarjunaM bhImo jagAma bhrAtaraM prati
shlokas.23:
hatAvashiShTA.nsturagAnarjunena mahAjavAn |
bhImo vyadhamadabhrAnto gadApANirmahAhave
shlokas.24:
kAlarAtrimivAtyugrAM naranAgAshvabhojanAm |
prAkArATTapuradvAradAraNImatidAruNAm
shlokas.25:
tato gadAM nRRinAgAshveShvAshu bhImo vyavAsRRijat |
sA jaghAna bahUnashvAnashvArohA.nshcha mAriSha
shlokas.26:
kA.nsyAyasatanutrA.nstAnnarAnashvA.nshcha pANDavaH |
pothayAmAsa gadayA sashabdaM te.apatanhatAH
shlokas.27:
hatvA tu tadgajAnIkaM bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
punaH svarathamAsthAya pRRiShThato.arjunamanvagAt
shlokas.28:
hataM parA~NmukhaprAyaM nirutsAhaM paraM balam |
vyAlambata mahArAja prAyashaH shastraveShTitam
shlokas.29:
vilambamAnaM tatsainyamapragalbhamavasthitam |
dRRiShTvA prAchChAdayadbANairarjunaH prANatApanaiH
shlokas.30:
tataH kurUNAmabhavadArtanAdo mahAmRRidhe |
rathAshvanAgAsuharairvadhyatAmarjuneShubhiH
shlokas.31:
hAhAkRRitaM bhRRishaM tasthau lIyamAnaM parasparam |
alAtachakravatsainyaM tadAbhramata tAvakam
shlokas.32:
AdIptaM tava tatsainyaM sharaishChinnatanuchChadam |
AsItsvashoNitaklinnaM phullAshokavanaM yathA
shlokas.33:
taddRRiShTvA kuravastatra vikrAntaM savyasAchinaH |
nirAshAH samapadyanta sarve karNasya jIvite
shlokas.34:
aviShahyaM tu pArthasya sharasampAtamAhave |
matvA nyavartankuravo jitA gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.35:
te hitvA samare pArthaM vadhyamAnAshcha sAyakaiH |
pradudruvurdisho bhItAshchukrushushchApi sUtajam
shlokas.36:
abhyadravata tAnpArthaH kira~nsharashatAnbahUn |
harShayanpANDavAnyodhAnbhImasenapurogamAn
shlokas.37:
putrAstu te mahArAja jagmuH karNarathaM prati |
agAdhe majjatAM teShAM dvIpaH karNo.abhavattadA
shlokas.38:
kuravo hi mahArAja nirviShAH pannagA iva |
karNamevopalIyanta bhayAdgANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.39:
yathA sarvANi bhUtAni mRRityorbhItAni bhArata |
dharmamevopalIyante karmavanti hi yAni cha
shlokas.40:
tathA karNaM maheShvAsaM putrAstava narAdhipa |
upAlIyanta santrAsAtpANDavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.41:
tA~nshoNitapariklinnAnviShamasthA~nsharAturAn |
mA bhaiShTetyabravItkarNo hyabhito mAmiteti cha
shlokas.42:
sambhagnaM hi balaM dRRiShTvA balAtpArthena tAvakam |
dhanurvisphArayankarNastasthau shatrujighA.nsayA
pA~nchAlAnpunarAdhAvatpashyataH savyasAchinaH
shlokas.43:
tataH kShaNena kShitipAH kShatajapratimekShaNAH |
karNaM vavarShurbANaughairyathA meghA mahIdharam
shlokas.44:
tataH sharasahasrANi karNamuktAni mAriSha |
vyayojayanta pA~nchAlAnprANaiH prANabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.45:
tato raNo mahAnAsItpA~nchAlAnAM vishAM pate |
vadhyatAM sUtaputreNa mitrArthe.amitraghAtinAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH karNaH kuruShu pradruteShu; varUthinA shvetahayena rAjan |
pA~nchAlaputrAnvyadhamatsUtaputro; maheShubhirvAta ivAbhrasa~NghAn
shlokas.2:
sUtaM rathAda~njalikena pAtya; jaghAna chAshvA~njanamejayasya |
shatAnIkaM sutasomaM cha bhallai;ravAkiraddhanuShI chApyakRRintat
shlokas.3:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM nirbibhedAtha ShaDbhi;rjaghAna chAshvaM dakShiNaM tasya sa~Nkhye |
hatvA chAshvAnsAtyakeH sUtaputraH; kaikeyaputraM nyavadhIdvishokam
shlokas.4:
tamabhyadhAvannihate kumAre; kaikeyasenApatirugradhanvA |
sharairvibhinnaM bhRRishamugravegaiH; karNAtmajaM so.abhyahanatsuSheNam
shlokas.5:
tasyArdhachandraistribhiruchchakarta; prasahya bAhU cha shirashcha karNaH |
sa syandanAdgAmapatadgatAsuH; parashvadhaiH shAla ivAvarugNaH
shlokas.6:
hatAshvama~njogatibhiH suSheNaH; shinipravIraM nishitaiH pRRiShatkaiH |
prachChAdya nRRityanniva sautiputraH; shaineyabANAbhihataH papAta
shlokas.7:
putre hate krodhaparItachetAH; karNaH shinInAmRRiShabhaM jighA.nsuH |
hato.asi shaineya iti bruvansa; vyavAsRRijadbANamamitrasAham
shlokas.8:
sa tasya chichCheda sharaM shikhaNDI; tribhistribhishcha pratutoda karNam |
shikhaNDinaH kArmukaM sa dhvajaM cha; chChittvA sharAbhyAmahanatsujAtam
shlokas.9:
shikhaNDinaM ShaDbhiravidhyadugro; dAnto dhArShTadyumnashirashchakarta |
athAbhinatsutasomaM shareNa; sa sa.nshitenAdhirathirmahAtmA
shlokas.10:
athAkrande tumule vartamAne; dhArShTadyumne nihate tatra kRRiShNaH |
apA~nchAlyaM kriyate yAhi pArtha; karNaM jahItyabravIdrAjasiMha
shlokas.11:
tataH prahasyAshu narapravIro; rathaM rathenAdhiratherjagAma |
bhaye teShAM trANamichChansubAhu;rabhyAhatAnAM rathayUthapena
shlokas.12:
visphArya gANDIvamathograghoShaM; jyayA samAhatya tale bhRRishaM cha |
bANAndhakAraM sahasaiva kRRitvA; jaghAna nAgAshvarathAnnarA.nshcha
shlokas.13:
taM bhImaseno.anu yayau rathena; pRRiShThe rakShanpANDavamekavIram |
tau rAjaputrau tvaritau rathAbhyAM; karNAya yAtAvaribhirvimuktau
shlokas.14:
atrAntare sumahatsUtaputra;shchakre yuddhaM somakAnsampramRRidnan |
rathAshvamAta~NgagaNA~njaghAna; prachChAdayAmAsa dishaH sharaishcha
shlokas.15:
tamuttamaujA janamejayashcha; kruddhau yudhAmanyushikhaNDinau cha |
karNaM vineduH sahitAH pRRiShatkaiH; saMmardamAnAH saha pArShatena
shlokas.16:
te pa~ncha pA~nchAlarathAH surUpai;rvaikartanaM karNamabhidravantaH |
tasmAdrathAchchyAvayituM na sheku;rdhairyAtkRRitAtmAnamivendriyANi
shlokas.17:
teShAM dhanUMShi dhvajavAjisUtAM;stUNaM patAkAshcha nikRRitya bANaiH |
tAnpa~nchabhiH sa tvahanatpRRiShatkaiH; karNastataH siMha ivonnanAda
shlokas.18:
tasyAsyatastAnabhinighnatashcha; jyAbANahastasya dhanuHsvanena |
sAdridrumA syAtpRRithivI vishIrNA; ityeva matvA janatA vyaShIdat
shlokas.19:
sa shakrachApapratimena dhanvanA; bhRRishAtatenAdhirathiH sharAnsRRijan |
babhau raNe dIptamarIchimaNDalo; yathA.nshumAlI pariveShavA.nstathA
shlokas.20:
shikhaNDinaM dvAdashabhiH parAbhina;chChitaiH sharaiH ShaDbhirathottamaujasam |
tribhiryudhAmanyumavidhyadAshugai;stribhistribhiH somakapArShatAtmajau
shlokas.21:
parAjitAH pa~ncha mahArathAstu te; mahAhave sUtasutena mAriSha |
nirudyamAstasthuramitramardanA; yathendriyArthAtmavatA parAjitAH
shlokas.22:
nimajjatastAnatha karNasAgare; vipannanAvo vaNijo yathArNave |
uddadhrire naubhirivArNavAdrathaiH; sukalpitairdraupadijAH svamAtulAn
shlokas.23:
tataH shinInAmRRiShabhaH shitaiH sharai;rnikRRitya karNaprahitAniShUnbahUn |
vidArya karNaM nishitairayasmayai;stavAtmajaM jyeShThamavidhyadaShTabhiH
shlokas.24:
kRRipo.atha bhojashcha tavAtmajastathA; svayaM cha karNo nishitairatADayat |
sa taishchaturbhiryuyudhe yadUttamo; digIshvarairdaityapatiryathA tathA
shlokas.25:
samAnateneShvasanena kUjatA; bhRRishAtatenAmitabANavarShiNA |
babhUva durdharShataraH sa sAtyakiH; sharannabhomadhyagato yathA raviH
shlokas.26:
punaH samAsAdya rathAnsuda.nshitAH; shinipravIraM jugupuH parantapAH |
sametya pA~nchAlarathA mahAraNe; marudgaNAH shakramivArinigrahe
shlokas.27:
tato.abhavadyuddhamatIva dAruNaM; tavAhitAnAM tava sainikaiH saha |
rathAshvamAta~NgavinAshanaM tathA; yathA surANAmasuraiH purAbhavat
shlokas.28:
rathadvipA vAjipadAtayo.api vA; bhramanti nAnAvidhashastraveShTitAH |
paraspareNAbhihatAshcha chaskhalu;rvinedurArtA vyasavo.apatanta cha
shlokas.29:
tathA gate bhImamabhIstavAtmajaH; sasAra rAjAvarajaH kira~nsharaiH |
tamabhyadhAvattvarito vRRikodaro; mahAruruM siMha ivAbhipetivAn
shlokas.30:
tatastayoryuddhamatItamAnuShaM; pradIvyatoH prANadurodare.abhavat |
paraspareNAbhiniviShTaroShayo;rudagrayoH shambarashakrayoryathA
shlokas.31:
sharaiH sharIrAntakaraiH sutejanai;rnijaghnatustAvitaretaraM bhRRisham |
sakRRitprabhinnAviva vAshitAntare; mahAgajau manmathasaktachetasau
shlokas.32:
tavAtmajasyAtha vRRikodarastvara;ndhanuH kShurAbhyAM dhvajameva chAchChinat |
lalATamapyasya bibheda patriNA; shirashcha kAyAtprajahAra sAratheH
shlokas.33:
sa rAjaputro.anyadavApya kArmukaM; vRRikodaraM dvAdashabhiH parAbhinat |
svayaM niyachCha.nsturagAnajihmagaiH; sharaishcha bhImaM punarabhyavIvRRiShat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
