tatrAkarodduShkaraM rAjaputro; duHshAsanastumule yudhyamAnaH |
chichCheda bhImasya dhanuH kShureNa; ShaDbhiH sharaiH sArathimapyavidhyat
shlokas.2:
tato.abhinadbahubhiH kShiprameva; vareShubhirbhImasenaM mahAtmA |
sa vikSharannAga iva prabhinno; gadAmasmai tumule prAhiNodvai
shlokas.3:
tayAharaddasha dhanvantarANi; duHshAsanaM bhImasenaH prasahya |
tayA hataH patito vepamAno; duHshAsano gadayA vegavatyA
shlokas.4:
hayAH sasUtAshcha hatA narendra; chUrNIkRRitashchAsya rathaH patantyA |
vidhvastavarmAbharaNAmbarasra;gvicheShTamAno bhRRishavedanArtaH
shlokas.5:
tataH smRRitvA bhImasenastarasvI; sApatnakaM yatprayuktaM sutaiste |
rathAdavaplutya gataH sa bhUmau; yatnena tasminpraNidhAya chakShuH
shlokas.6:
asiM samuddhRRitya shitaM sudhAraM; kaNThe samAkramya cha vepamAnam |
utkRRitya vakShaH patitasya bhUmA;vathApibachChoNitamasya koShNam
AsvAdya chAsvAdya cha vIkShamANaH; kruddho.ativelaM prajagAda vAkyam
shlokas.7:
stanyasya mAturmadhusarpiSho vA; mAdhvIkapAnasya cha satkRRitasya |
divyasya vA toyarasasya pAnA;tpayodadhibhyAM mathitAchcha mukhyAt
sarvebhya evAbhyadhiko raso.ayaM; mato mamAdyAhitalohitasya
shlokas.8:
evaM bruvANaM punarAdravanta;mAsvAdya valgantamatiprahRRiShTam |
ye bhImasenaM dadRRishustadAnIM; bhayena te.api vyathitA nipetuH
shlokas.9:
ye chApi tatrApatitA manuShyA;steShAM karebhyaH patitaM cha shastram |
bhayAchcha sa~nchukrushuruchchakaiste; nimIlitAkShA dadRRishushcha tanna
shlokas.10:
ye tatra bhImaM dadRRishuH samantA;ddauHshAsanaM tadrudhiraM pibantam |
sarve palAyanta bhayAbhipannA; nAyaM manuShya iti bhAShamANAH
shlokas.11:
shRRiNvatAM lokavIrANAmidaM vachanamabravIt |
eSha te rudhiraM kaNThAtpibAmi puruShAdhama
brUhIdAnIM susa.nrabdhaH punargauriti gauriti
shlokas.12:
pramANakoTyAM shayanaM kAlakUTasya bhojanam |
dashanaM chAhibhiH kaShTaM dAhaM cha jatuveshmani
shlokas.13:
dyUtena rAjyaharaNamaraNye vasatishcha yA |
iShvastrANi cha sa~NgrAmeShvasukhAni cha veshmani
shlokas.14:
duHkhAnyetAni jAnImo na sukhAni kadAchana |
dhRRitarAShTrasya daurAtmyAtsaputrasya sadA vayam
shlokas.15:
ityuktvA vachanaM rAja~njayaM prApya vRRikodaraH |
punarAha mahArAja smaya.nstau keshavArjunau
shlokas.16:
duHshAsane yadraNe sa.nshrutaM me; tadvai sarvaM kRRitamadyeha vIrau |
adyaiva dAsyAmyaparaM dvitIyaM; duryodhanaM yaj~napashuM vishasya
shiro mRRiditvA cha padA durAtmanaH; shAntiM lapsye kauravANAM samakSham
shlokas.17:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM prahRRiShTo; nanAda chochchai rudhirArdragAtraH |
nanarta chaivAtibalo mahAtmA; vRRitraM nihatyeva sahasranetraH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duHshAsane tu nihate putrAstava mahArathAH |
mahAkrodhaviShA vIrAH samareShvapalAyinaH
dasha rAjanmahAvIryo bhImaM prAchChAdaya~nsharaiH
shlokas.2:
kavachI niSha~NgI pAshI daNDadhAro dhanurdharaH |
alolupaH shalaH sandho vAtavegasuvarchasau
shlokas.3:
ete sametya sahitA bhrAtRRivyasanakarshitAH |
bhImasenaM mahAbAhuM mArgaNaiH samavArayan
shlokas.4:
sa vAryamANo vishikhaiH samantAttairmahArathaiH |
bhImaH krodhAbhiraktAkShaH kruddhaH kAla ivAbabhau
shlokas.5:
tA.nstu bhallairmahAvegairdashabhirdashabhiH shitaiH |
rukmA~Ngado rukmapu~NkhaiH pArtho ninye yamakShayam
shlokas.6:
hateShu teShu vIreShu pradudrAva balaM tava |
pashyataH sUtaputrasya pANDavasya bhayArditam
shlokas.7:
tataH karNo mahArAja pravivesha mahAraNam |
dRRiShTvA bhImasya vikrAntamantakasya prajAsviva
shlokas.8:
tasya tvAkArabhAvaj~naH shalyaH samitishobhanaH |
uvAcha vachanaM karNaM prAptakAlamari.ndama
mA vyathAM kuru rAdheya naitattvayyupapadyate
shlokas.9:
ete dravanti rAjAno bhImasenabhayArditAH |
duryodhanashcha saMmUDho bhrAtRRivyasanaduHkhitaH
shlokas.10:
duHshAsanasya rudhire pIyamAne mahAtmanA |
vyApannachetasashchaiva shokopahatamanyavaH
shlokas.11:
duryodhanamupAsante parivArya samantataH |
kRRipaprabhRRitayaH karNa hatasheShAshcha sodarAH
shlokas.12:
pANDavA labdhalakShAshcha dhana~njayapurogamAH |
tvAmevAbhimukhAH shUrA yuddhAya samupAsthitAH
shlokas.13:
sa tvaM puruShashArdUla pauruShe mahati sthitaH |
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya pratyudyAhi dhana~njayam
shlokas.14:
bhAro hi dhArtarAShTreNa tvayi sarvaH samarpitaH |
tamudvaha mahAbAho yathAshakti yathAbalam
jaye syAdvipulA kIrtirdhruvaH svargaH parAjaye
shlokas.15:
vRRiShasenashcha rAdheya sa~Nkruddhastanayastava |
tvayi mohasamApanne pANDavAnabhidhAvati
shlokas.16:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM shalyasyAmitatejasaH |
hRRidi mAnuShyakaM bhAvaM chakre yuddhAya susthiram
shlokas.17:
tataH kruddho vRRiShaseno.abhyadhAva;dAtasthivA.nsaM svarathaM hatArim |
vRRikodaraM kAlamivAttadaNDaM; gadAhastaM pothamAnaM tvadIyAn
shlokas.18:
tamabhyadhAvannakulaH pravIro; roShAdamitraM pratudanpRRiShatkaiH |
karNasya putraM samare prahRRiShTaM; jiShNurjighA.nsurmaghaveva jambham
shlokas.19:
tato dhvajaM sphATikachitrakambuM; chichCheda vIro nakulaH kShureNa |
karNAtmajasyeShvasanaM cha chitraM; bhallena jAmbUnadapaTTanaddham
shlokas.20:
athAnyadAdAya dhanuH sushIghraM; karNAtmajaH pANDavamabhyavidhyat |
divyairmahAstrairnakulaM mahAstro; duHshAsanasyApachitiM yiyAsuH
shlokas.21:
tataH kruddho nakulastaM mahAtmA; sharairmaholkApratimairavidhyat |
divyairastrairabhyavidhyachcha so.api; karNasya putro nakulaM kRRitAstraH
shlokas.22:
karNasya putro nakulasya rAja;nsarvAnashvAnakShiNoduttamAstraiH |
vanAyujAnsukumArasya shubhrA;nala~NkRRitA~njAtarUpeNa shIghrAn
shlokas.23:
tato hatAshvAdavaruhya yAnA;dAdAya charma ruchiraM chAShTachandram |
AkAshasa~NkAshamasiM gRRihItvA; poplUyamAnaH khagavachchachAra
shlokas.24:
tato.antarikShe nRRivarAshvanAgAM;shchichCheda mArgAnvicharanvichitrAn |
te prApatannasinA gAM vishastA; yathAshvamedhe pashavaH shamitrA
shlokas.25:
dvisAhasrA viditA yuddhashauNDA; nAnAdeshyAH subhRRitAH satyasandhAH |
ekena shIghraM nakulena kRRittAH; sArepsunevottamachandanAste
shlokas.26:
tamApatantaM nakulaM so.abhipatya; samantataH sAyakairabhyavidhyat |
sa tudyamAno nakulaH pRRiShatkai;rvivyAdha vIraM sa chukopa viddhaH
shlokas.27:
taM karNaputro vidhamantamekaM; narAshvamAta~NgarathapravekAn |
krIDantamaShTAdashabhiH pRRiShatkai;rvivyAdha vIraM sa chukopa viddhaH
shlokas.28:
tato.abhyadhAvatsamare jighA.nsuH; karNAtmajaM pANDusuto nRRivIraH |
tasyeShubhirvyadhamatkarNaputro; mahAraNe charma sahasratAram
shlokas.29:
tasyAyasaM nishitaM tIkShNadhAra;masiM vikoshaM gurubhArasAham |
dviShachCharIrApaharaM sughora;mAdhunvataH sarpamivograrUpam
shlokas.30:
kShipraM sharaiH ShaDbhiramitrasAha;shchakarta khaDgaM nishitaiH sudhAraiH |
punashcha pItairnishitaiH pRRiShatkaiH; stanAntare gADhamathAbhyavidhyat
shlokas.31:
sa bhImasenasya rathaM hatAshvo; mAdrIsutaH karNasutAbhitaptaH |
Apupluve siMha ivAchalAgraM; samprekShamANasya dhana~njayasya
shlokas.32:
nakulamatha viditvA ChinnabANAsanAsiM; virathamarisharArtaM karNaputrAstrabhagnam |
pavanadhutapatAkA hrAdino valgitAshvA; varapuruShaniyattAste rathAH shIghramIyuH
shlokas.33:
drupadasutavariShThAH pa~ncha shaineyaShaShThA; drupadaduhitRRiputrAH pa~ncha chAmitrasAhAH |
dviradarathanarAshvAnsUdayantastvadIyA;nbhujagapatinikAshairmArgaNairAttashastrAH
shlokas.34:
atha tava rathamukhyAstAnpratIyustvaranto; hRRidikasutakRRipau cha drauNiduryodhanau cha |
shakunishukavRRikAshcha krAthadevAvRRidhau cha; dviradajaladaghoShaiH syandanaiH kArmukaishcha
shlokas.35:
tava naravaravaryAstAndashaikaM cha vIrA;npravarasharavarAgryaistADayanto.abhyarundhan |
navajaladasavarNairhastibhistAnudIyu;rgirishikharanikAshairbhImavegaiH kuNindAH
shlokas.36:
sukalpitA haimavatA madotkaTA; raNAbhikAmaiH kRRitibhiH samAsthitAH |
suvarNajAlAvatatA babhurgajA;stathA yathA vai jaladAH savidyutaH
shlokas.37:
kuNindaputro dashabhirmahAyasaiH; kRRipaM sasUtAshvamapIDayadbhRRisham |
tataH sharadvatsutasAyakairhataH; sahaiva nAgena papAta bhUtale
shlokas.38:
kuNindaputrAvarajastu tomarai;rdivAkarA.nshupratimairayasmayaiH |
rathaM cha vikShobhya nanAda nardata;stato.asya gAndhArapatiH shiro.aharat
shlokas.39:
tataH kuNindeShu hateShu teShvatha; prahRRiShTarUpAstava te mahArathAH |
bhRRishaM pradadhmurlavaNAmbusambhavA;nparA.nshcha bANAsanapANayo.abhyayuH
shlokas.40:
athAbhavadyuddhamatIva dAruNaM; punaH kurUNAM saha pANDusRRi~njayaiH |
sharAsishaktyRRiShTigadAparashvadhai;rnarAshvanAgAsuharaM bhRRishAkulam
shlokas.41:
rathAshvamAta~NgapadAtibhistataH; parasparaM viprahatApatankShitau |
yathA savidyutstanitA balAhakAH; samAsthitA digbhya ivogramArutaiH
shlokas.42:
tataH shatAnIkahatAnmahAgajAM;stathA rathAnpattigaNA.nshcha tAvakAn |
jaghAna bhojashcha hayAnathApata;nvishastrakRRittAH kRRitavarmaNA dvipAH
shlokas.43:
athApare drauNisharAhatA dvipA;strayaH sasarvAyudhayodhaketavaH |
nipetururvyAM vyasavaH prapAtitA;stathA yathA vajrahatA mahAchalAH
shlokas.44:
kuNindarAjAvarajAdanantaraH; stanAntare patrivarairatADayat |
tavAtmajaM tasya tavAtmajaH sharaiH; shitaiH sharIraM bibhide dvipaM cha tam
shlokas.45:
sa nAgarAjaH saha rAjasUnunA; papAta raktaM bahu sarvataH kSharan |
shachIshavajraprahato.ambudAgame; yathA jalaM gairikaparvatastathA
shlokas.46:
kuNindaputraprahito.aparadvipaH; shukaM sasUtAshvarathaM vyapothayat |
tato.apatatkrAthasharAbhidAritaH; saheshvaro vajrahato yathA giriH
shlokas.47:
rathI dvipasthena hato.apatachCharaiH; krAthAdhipaH parvatajena durjayaH |
savAjisUteShvasanastathApata;dyathA mahAvAtahato mahAdrumaH
shlokas.48:
vRRiko dvipasthaM girirAjavAsinaM; bhRRishaM sharairdvAdashabhiH parAbhinat |
tato vRRikaM sAshvarathaM mahAjavaM; tvara.nshchaturbhishcharaNe vyapothayat
shlokas.49:
sa nAgarAjaH saniyantRRiko.apata;tparAhato babhrusuteShubhirbhRRisham |
sa chApi devAvRRidhasUnurarditaH; papAta nunnaH sahadevasUnunA
shlokas.50:
viShANapotrAparagAtraghAtinA; gajena hantuM shakuneH kuNindajaH |
jagAma vegena bhRRishArdaya.nshcha taM; tato.asya gAndhArapatiH shiro.aharat
shlokas.51:
tataH shatAnIkahatA mahAgajA; hayA rathAH pattigaNAshcha tAvakAH |
suparNavAtaprahatA yathA nagA;stathA gatA gAmavashA vichUrNitAH
shlokas.52:
tato.abhyavidhyadbahubhiH shitaiH sharaiH; kuNindaputro nakulAtmajaM smayan |
tato.asya kAyAnnichakarta nAkuliH; shiraH kShureNAmbujasaMnibhAnanam
shlokas.53:
tataH shatAnIkamavidhyadAshugai;stribhiH shitaiH karNasuto.arjunaM tribhiH |
tribhishcha bhImaM nakulaM cha saptabhi;rjanArdanaM dvAdashabhishcha sAyakaiH
shlokas.54:
tadasya karmAtimanuShyakarmaNaH; samIkShya hRRiShTAH kuravo.abhyapUjayan |
parAkramaj~nAstu dhana~njayasya te; huto.ayamagnAviti taM tu menire
shlokas.55:
tataH kirITI paravIraghAtI; hatAshvamAlokya narapravIram |
tamabhyadhAvadvRRiShasenamAhave; sa sUtajasya pramukhe sthitaM tadA
shlokas.56:
tamApatantaM naravIramugraM; mahAhave bANasahasradhAriNam |
abhyApatatkarNasuto mahAratho; yathaiva chendraM namuchiH purAtane
shlokas.57:
tato.adbhutenaikashatena pArthaM; sharairviddhvA sUtaputrasya putraH |
nanAda nAdaM sumahAnubhAvo; viddhveva shakraM namuchiH purA vai
shlokas.58:
punaH sa pArthaM vRRiShasena ugrai;rbANairavidhyadbhujamUlamadhye |
tathaiva kRRiShNaM navabhiH samArdaya;tpunashcha pArthaM dashabhiH shitAgraiH
shlokas.59:
tataH kirITI raNamUrdhni kopA;tkRRitvA trishAkhAM bhrukuTiM lalATe |
mumocha bANAnvishikhAnmahAtmA; vadhAya rAjansUtaputrasya sa~Nkhye
shlokas.60:
vivyAdha chainaM dashabhiH pRRiShatkai;rmarmasvasaktaM prasabhaM kirITI |
chichCheda chAsyeShvasanaM bhujau cha; kShuraishchaturbhiH shira eva chograiH
shlokas.61:
sa pArthabANAbhihataH papAta; rathAdvibAhurvishirA dharAyAm |
supuShpitaH parNadharo.atikAyo; vAteritaH shAla ivAdrishRRi~NgAt
shlokas.62:
taM prekShya bANAbhihataM patantaM; rathAtsutaM sUtajaH kShiprakArI |
rathaM rathenAshu jagAma vegA;tkirITinaH putravadhAbhitaptaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vRRiShasenaM hataM dRRiShTvA shokAmarShasamanvitaH |
muktvA shokodbhavaM vAri netrAbhyAM sahasA vRRiShaH
shlokas.2:
rathena karNastejasvI jagAmAbhimukho ripUn |
yuddhAyAmarShatAmrAkShaH samAhUya dhana~njayam
shlokas.3:
tau rathau sUryasa~NkAshau vaiyAghraparivAraNau |
sametau dadRRishustatra dvAvivArkau samAgatau
shlokas.4:
shvetAshvau puruShAdityAvAsthitAvarimardanau |
shushubhAte mahAtmAnau chandrAdityau yathA divi
shlokas.5:
tau dRRiShTvA vismayaM jagmuH sarvabhUtAni mAriSha |
trailokyavijaye yattAvindravairochanAviva
shlokas.6:
rathajyAtalanirhrAdairbANasha~Nkharavairapi |
tau rathAvabhidhAvantau samAlokya mahIkShitAm
shlokas.7:
dhvajau cha dRRiShTvA sa.nsaktau vismayaH samapadyata |
hastikakShyAM cha karNasya vAnaraM cha kirITinaH
shlokas.8:
tau rathau samprasaktau cha dRRiShTvA bhArata pArthivAH |
siMhanAdaravA.nshchakruH sAdhuvAdA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.9:
shrutvA tu dvairathaM tAbhyAM tatra yodhAH samantataH |
chakrurbAhuvalaM chaiva tathA chelavalaM mahat
shlokas.10:
AjagmuH kuravastatra vAditrAnugatAstadA |
karNaM praharShayantashcha sha~NkhAndadhmushcha puShkalAn
shlokas.11:
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve harShayanto dhana~njayam |
tUryasha~NkhaninAdena dishaH sarvA vyanAdayan
shlokas.12:
kShveDitAsphoTitotkruShTaistumulaM sarvato.abhavat |
bAhughoShAshcha vIrANAM karNArjunasamAgame
shlokas.13:
tau dRRiShTvA puruShavyAghrau rathasthau rathinAM varau |
pragRRihItamahAchApau sharashaktigadAyudhau
shlokas.14:
varmiNau baddhanistri.nshau shvetAshvau sha~Nkhashobhinau |
tUNIravarasampannau dvAvapi sma sudarshanau
shlokas.15:
raktachandanadigdhA~Ngau samadau vRRiShabhAviva |
AshIviShasamaprakhyau yamakAlAntakopamau
shlokas.16:
indravRRitrAviva kruddhau sUryAchandramasaprabhau |
mahAgrahAviva krUrau yugAnte samupasthitau
shlokas.17:
devagarbhau devasamau devatulyau cha rUpataH |
sametau puruShavyAghrau prekShya karNadhana~njayau
shlokas.18:
ubhau varAyudhadharAvubhau raNakRRitashramau |
ubhau cha bAhushabdena nAdayantau nabhastalam
shlokas.19:
ubhau vishrutakarmANau pauruSheNa balena cha |
ubhau cha sadRRishau yuddhe shambarAmararAjayoH
shlokas.20:
kArtavIryasamau yuddhe tathA dAsharatheH samau |
viShNuvIryasamau vIrye tathA bhavasamau yudhi
shlokas.21:
ubhau shvetahayau rAjanrathapravaravAhinau |
sArathI pravarau chaiva tayorAstAM mahAbalau
shlokas.22:
tau tu dRRiShTvA mahArAja rAjamAnau mahArathau |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAnAM vismayaH samapadyata
shlokas.23:
dhArtarAShTrAstataH karNaM sabalA bharatarShabha |
parivavrurmahAtmAnaM kShipramAhavashobhinam
shlokas.24:
tathaiva pANDavA hRRiShTA dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH |
parivavrurmahAtmAnaM pArthamapratimaM yudhi
shlokas.25:
tAvakAnAM raNe karNo glaha AsIdvishAM pate |
tathaiva pANDaveyAnAM glahaH pArtho.abhavadyudhi
shlokas.26:
ta eva sabhyAstatrAsanprekShakAshchAbhavansma te |
tatraiShAM glahamAnAnAM dhruvau jayaparAjayau
shlokas.27:
tAbhyAM dyUtaM samAyattaM vijayAyetarAya vA |
asmAkaM paNDavAnAM cha sthitAnAM raNamUrdhani
shlokas.28:
tau tu sthitau mahArAja samare yuddhashAlinau |
anyonyaM pratisa.nrabdhAvanyonyasya jayaiShiNau
shlokas.29:
tAvubhau prajihIrShetAmindravRRitrAvivAbhitaH |
bhImarUpadharAvAstAM mahAdhUmAviva grahau
shlokas.30:
tato.antarikShe sAkShepA vivAdA bharatarShabha |
mitho bhedAshcha bhUtAnAmAsankarNArjunAntare
vyAshrayanta disho bhinnAH sarvalokAshcha mAriSha
shlokas.31:
devadAnavagandharvAH pishAchoragarAkShasAH |
pratipakShagrahaM chakruH karNArjunasamAgame
shlokas.32:
dyaurAsItkarNato vyagrA sanakShatrA vishAM pate |
bhUmirvishAlA pArthasya mAtA putrasya bhArata
shlokas.33:
saritaH sAgarAshchaiva girayashcha narottama |
vRRikShAshchauShadhayastatra vyAshrayanta kirITinam
shlokas.34:
asurA yAtudhAnAshcha guhyakAshcha parantapa |
karNataH samapadyanta khecharANi vayA.nsi cha
shlokas.35:
ratnAni nidhayaH sarve vedAshchAkhyAnapa~nchamAH |
sopavedopaniShadaH sarahasyAH sasa~NgrahAH
shlokas.36:
vAsukishchitrasenashcha takShakashchopatakShakaH |
parvatAshcha tathA sarve kAdraveyAshcha sAnvayAH
viShavanto mahAroShA nAgAshchArjunato.abhavan
shlokas.37:
airAvatAH saurabheyA vaishAleyAshcha bhoginaH |
ete.abhavannarjunataH kShudrasarpAstu karNataH
shlokas.38:
IhAmRRigA vyADamRRigA ma~NgalyAshcha mRRigadvijAH |
pArthasya vijayaM rAjansarva evAbhisa.nshritAH
shlokas.39:
vasavo marutaH sAdhyA rudrA vishve.ashvinau tathA |
agnirindrashcha somashcha pavanashcha disho dasha
dhana~njayamupAjagmurAdityAH karNato.abhavan
shlokas.40:
devAstu pitRRibhiH sArdhaM sagaNArjunato.abhavan |
yamo vaishravaNashchaiva varuNashcha yato.arjunaH
shlokas.41:
devabrahmanRRiparShINAM gaNAH pANDavato.abhavan |
tumburupramukhA rAjangandharvAshcha yato.arjunaH
shlokas.42:
prAveyAH saha mauneyairgandharvApsarasAM gaNAH |
IhAmRRigavyADamRRigairdvipAshcha rathapattibhiH
shlokas.43:
uhyamAnAstathA meghairvAyunA cha manIShiNaH |
didRRikShavaH samAjagmuH karNArjunasamAgamam
shlokas.44:
devadAnavagandharvA nAgA yakShAH patatriNaH |
maharShayo vedavidaH pitarashcha svadhAbhujaH
shlokas.45:
tapo vidyAstathauShadhyo nAnArUpAmbaratviShaH |
antarikShe mahArAja vinadanto.avatasthire
shlokas.46:
brahmA brahmarShibhiH sArdhaM prajApatibhireva cha |
bhavenAvasthito yAnaM divyaM taM deshamabhyayAt
shlokas.47:
dRRiShTvA prajApatiM devAH svayambhuvamupAgaman |
samo.astu deva vijaya etayornarasiMhayoH
shlokas.48:
tadupashrutya maghavA praNipatya pitAmaham |
karNArjunavinAshena mA nashyatvakhilaM jagat
shlokas.49:
svayambho brUhi tadvAkyaM samo.astu vijayo.anayoH |
tattathAstu namaste.astu prasIda bhagavanmama
shlokas.50:
brahmeshAnAvatho vAkyamUchatustridasheshvaram |
vijayo dhruva evAstu vijayasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.51:
manasvI balavA~nshUraH kRRitAstrashcha tapodhanaH |
bibharti cha mahAtejA dhanurvedamasheShataH
shlokas.52:
atikramechcha mAhAtmyAddiShTametasya paryayAt |
atikrAnte cha lokAnAmabhAvo niyato bhavet
shlokas.53:
na vidyate vyavasthAnaM kRRiShNayoH kruddhayoH kvachit |
sraShTArau hyasatashchobhau satashcha puruSharShabhau
shlokas.54:
naranArAyaNAvetau purANAvRRiShisattamau |
aniyattau niyantArAvabhItau sma parantapau
shlokas.55:
karNo lokAnayaM mukhyAnprApnotu puruSharShabhaH |
vIro vaikartanaH shUro vijayastvastu kRRiShNayoH
shlokas.56:
vasUnAM cha salokatvaM marutAM vA samApnuyAt |
sahito droNabhIShmAbhyAM nAkaloke mahIyatAm
shlokas.57:
ityukto devadevAbhyAM sahasrAkSho.abravIdvachaH |
Amantrya sarvabhUtAni brahmeshAnAnushAsanAt
shlokas.58:
shrutaM bhavadbhiryatproktaM bhagavadbhyAM jagaddhitam |
tattathA nAnyathA taddhi tiShThadhvaM gatamanyavaH
shlokas.59:
iti shrutvendravachanaM sarvabhUtAni mAriSha |
vismitAnyabhavanrAjanpUjayAM chakrire cha tat
shlokas.60:
vyasRRija.nshcha sugandhIni nAnArUpANi khAttathA |
puShpavarShANi vibudhA devatUryANyavAdayan
shlokas.61:
didRRikShavashchApratimaM dvairathaM narasiMhayoH |
devadAnavagandharvAH sarva evAvatasthire
rathau cha tau shvetahayau yuktaketU mahAsvanau
shlokas.62:
samAgatA lokavIrAH sha~NkhAndadhmuH pRRithakpRRithak |
vAsudevArjunau vIrau karNashalyau cha bhArata
shlokas.63:
tadbhIrusantrAsakaraM yuddhaM samabhavattadA |
anyonyaspardhinorvIrye shakrashambarayoriva
shlokas.64:
tayordhvajau vItamAlau shushubhAte rathasthitau |
pRRithagrUpau samArChantau krodhaM yuddhe parasparam
shlokas.65:
karNasyAshIviShanibhA ratnasAravatI dRRiDhA |
pura.ndaradhanuHprakhyA hastikakShyA vyarAjata
shlokas.66:
kapishreShThastu pArthasya vyAditAsyo bhaya~NkaraH |
bhIShayanneva daMShTrAbhirdurnirIkShyo raviryathA
shlokas.67:
yuddhAbhilAShuko bhUtvA dhvajo gANDIvadhanvanaH |
karNadhvajamupAtiShThatso.avadIdabhinardayan
shlokas.68:
utpatya cha mahAvegaH kakShyAmabhyahanatkapiH |
nakhaishcha dashanaishchaiva garuDaH pannagaM yathA
shlokas.69:
suki~NkiNIkAbharaNA kAlapAshopamAyasI |
abhyadravatsusa~NkruddhA nAgakakShyA mahAkapim
shlokas.70:
ubhayoruttame yuddhe dvairathe dyUta AhRRite |
prakurvAte dhvajau yuddhaM pratyaheShanhayAnhayAH
shlokas.71:
avidhyatpuNDarIkAkShaH shalyaM nayanasAyakaiH |
sa chApi puNDarIkAkShaM tathaivAbhisamaikShata
shlokas.72:
tatrAjayadvAsudevaH shalyaM nayanasAyakaiH |
karNaM chApyajayaddRRiShTyA kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.73:
athAbravItsUtaputraH shalyamAbhAShya sasmitam |
yadi pArtho raNe hanyAdadya mAmiha karhichit
kimuttaraM tadA te syAtsakhe satyaM bravIhi me
shlokas.74:
shalya uvAcha||
yadi karNa raNe hanyAdadya tvAM shvetavAhanaH |
ubhAvekarathenAhaM hanyAM mAdhavapANDavau
shlokas.75:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evameva tu govi.ndamarjunaH pratyabhAShata |
taM prahasyAbravItkRRiShNaH pArthaM paramidaM vachaH
shlokas.76:
pateddivAkaraH sthAnAchChIryetAnekadhA kShitiH |
shaityamagniriyAnna tvA karNo hanyAddhana~njayam
shlokas.77:
yadi tvevaM katha~nchitsyAllokaparyasanaM yathA |
hanyAM karNaM tathA shalyaM bAhubhyAmeva sa.nyuge
shlokas.78:
iti kRRiShNavachaH shrutvA prahasankapiketanaH |
arjunaH pratyuvAchedaM kRRiShNamakliShTakAriNam
mamApyetAvaparyAptau karNashalyau janArdana
shlokas.79:
sapatAkAdhvajaM karNaM sashalyarathavAjinam |
sachChatrakavachaM chaiva sashaktisharakArmukam
shlokas.80:
draShTAsyadya sharaiH karNaM raNe kRRittamanekadhA |
adyainaM sarathaM sAshvaM sashaktikavachAyudham
na hi me shAmyate vairaM kRRiShNAM yatprAhasatpurA
shlokas.81:
adya draShTAsi govinda karNamunmathitaM mayA |
vAraNeneva mattena puShpitaM jagatIruham
shlokas.82:
adya tA madhurA vAchaH shrotAsi madhusUdana |
adyAbhimanyujananImanRRiNaH sAntvayiShyasi
kuntIM pitRRiShvasAraM cha samprahRRiShTo janArdana
shlokas.83:
adya bAShpamukhIM kRRiShNAM sAntvayiShyasi mAdhava |
vAgbhishchAmRRitakalpAbhirdharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taddevanAgAsurasiddhasa~Nghai;rgandharvayakShApsarasAM cha sa~NghaiH |
brahmarShirAjarShisuparNajuShTaM; babhau viyadvismayanIyarUpam
shlokas.2:
nAnadyamAnaM ninadairmanoj~nai;rvAditragItastutibhishcha nRRittaiH |
sarve.antarikShe dadRRishurmanuShyAH; khasthA.nshcha tAnvismayanIyarUpAn
shlokas.3:
tataH prahRRiShTAH kurupANDuyodhA; vAditrapatrAyudhasiMhanAdaiH |
ninAdayanto vasudhAM dishashcha; svanena sarve dviShato nijaghnuH
shlokas.4:
nAnAshvamAta~NgarathAyutAkulaM; varAsishaktyRRiShTinipAtaduHsaham |
abhIrujuShTaM hatadehasa~NkulaM; raNAjiraM lohitaraktamAbabhau
shlokas.5:
tathA pravRRitte.astrabhRRitAM parAbhave; dhana~njayashchAdhirathishcha sAyakaiH |
dishashcha sainyaM cha shitairajihmagaiH; parasparaM prorNuvatuH sma da.nshitau
shlokas.6:
tatastvadIyAshcha pare cha sAyakaiH; kRRite.andhakAre vividurna ki~nchana |
bhayAttu tAveva rathau samAshrayaM;stamonudau khe prasRRitA ivA.nshavaH
shlokas.7:
tato.astramastreNa parasparasya tau; vidhUya vAtAviva pUrvapashchimau |
ghanAndhakAre vitate tamonudau; yathoditau tadvadatIva rejatuH
shlokas.8:
na chAbhimantavyamiti prachoditAH; pare tvadIyAshcha tadAvatasthire |
mahArathau tau parivArya sarvataH; surAsurA vAsavashambarAviva
shlokas.9:
mRRida~NgabherIpaNavAnakasvanai;rninAdite bhArata sha~NkhanisvanaiH |
sasiMhanAdau babhaturnarottamau; shashA~NkasUryAviva meghasamplave
shlokas.10:
mahAdhanurmaNDalamadhyagAvubhau; suvarchasau bANasahasrarashminau |
didhakShamANau sacharAcharaM jaga;dyugAstasUryAviva duHsahau raNe
shlokas.11:
ubhAvajeyAvahitAntakAvubhau; jighA.nsatustau kRRitinau parasparam |
mahAhave vIravarau samIyatu;ryathendrajambhAviva karNapANDavau
shlokas.12:
tato mahAstrANi mahAdhanurdharau; vimu~nchamAnAviShubhirbhayAnakaiH |
narAshvanAgAnamitau nijaghnatuH; parasparaM jaghnaturuttameShubhiH
shlokas.13:
tato visasruH punararditAH sharai;rnarottamAbhyAM kurupANDavAshrayAH |
sanAgapattyashvarathA disho gatA;stathA yathA siMhabhayAdvanaukasaH
shlokas.14:
tatastu duryodhanabhojasaubalAH; kRRipashcha shAradvatasUnunA saha |
mahArathAH pa~ncha dhana~njayAchyutau; sharaiH sharIrAntakarairatADayan
shlokas.15:
dhanUMShi teShAmiShudhInhayAndhvajA;nrathA.nshcha sUtA.nshcha dhana~njayaH sharaiH |
samaM cha chichCheda parAbhinachcha tA;~nsharottamairdvAdashabhishcha sUtajam
shlokas.16:
athAbhyadhAva.nstvaritAH shataM rathAH; shataM cha nAgArjunamAtatAyinaH |
shakAstukhArA yavanAshcha sAdinaH; sahaiva kAmbojavarairjighA.nsavaH
shlokas.17:
varAyudhAnpANigatAnkaraiH saha; kShurairnyakRRinta.nstvaritAH shirA.nsi cha |
hayA.nshcha nAgA.nshcha rathA.nshcha yudhyatAM; dhana~njayaH shatrugaNaM tamakShiNot
shlokas.18:
tato.antarikShe suratUryanisvanAH; sasAdhuvAdA hRRiShitaiH samIritAH |
nipeturapyuttamapuShpavRRiShTayaH; surUpagandhAH pavaneritAH shivAH
shlokas.19:
tadadbhutaM devamanuShyasAkShikaM; samIkShya bhUtAni visiShmiyurnRRipa |
tavAtmajaH sUtasutashcha na vyathAM; na vismayaM jagmaturekanishchayau
shlokas.20:
athAbravIddroNasutastavAtmajaM; karaM kareNa pratipIDya sAntvayan |
prasIda duryodhana shAmya pANDavai;ralaM virodhena dhigastu vigraham
shlokas.21:
hato gururbrahmasamo mahAstravi;ttathaiva bhIShmapramukhA nararShabhAH |
ahaM tvavadhyo mama chApi mAtulaH; prashAdhi rAjyaM saha pANDavaishchiram
shlokas.22:
dhana~njayaH sthAsyati vArito mayA; janArdano naiva virodhamichChati |
yudhiShThiro bhUtahite sadA rato; vRRikodarastadvashagastathA yamau
shlokas.23:
tvayA cha pArthaishcha paraspareNa; prajAH shivaM prApnuyurichChati tvayi |
vrajantu sheShAH svapurANi pArthivA; nivRRittavairAshcha bhavantu sainikAH
shlokas.24:
na chedvachaH shroShyasi me narAdhipa; dhruvaM prataptAsi hato.aribhiryudhi |
idaM cha dRRiShTaM jagatA saha tvayA; kRRitaM yadekena kirITamAlinA
yathA na kuryAdbalabhinna chAntako; na cha prachetA bhagavAnna yakSharAT
shlokas.25:
ato.api bhUyA.nshcha guNairdhana~njayaH; sa chAbhipatsyatyakhilaM vacho mama |
tavAnuyAtrAM cha tathA kariShyati; prasIda rAja~njagataH shamAya vai
shlokas.26:
mamApi mAnaH paramaH sadA tvayi; bravImyatastvAM paramAchcha sauhRRidAt |
nivArayiShyAmi hi karNamapyahaM; yadA bhavAnsapraNayo bhaviShyati
shlokas.27:
vadanti mitraM sahajaM vichakShaNA;stathaiva sAmnA cha dhanena chArjitam |
pratApatashchopanataM chaturvidhaM; tadasti sarvaM tvayi pANDaveShu cha
shlokas.28:
nisargataste tava vIra bAndhavAH; punashcha sAmnA cha samApnuhi sthiram |
tvayi prasanne yadi mitratAmiyu;rdhruvaM narendrendra tathA tvamAchara
shlokas.29:
sa evamuktaH suhRRidA vacho hitaM; vichintya niHshvasya cha durmanAbravIt |
yathA bhavAnAha sakhe tathaiva ta;nmamApi cha j~nApayato vachaH shRRiNu
shlokas.30:
nihatya duHshAsanamuktavAnbahu; prasahya shArdUlavadeSha durmatiH |
vRRikodarastaddhRRidaye mama sthitaM; na tatparokShaM bhavataH kutaH shamaH
shlokas.31:
na chApi karNaM guruputra sa.nstavA;dupArametyarhasi vaktumachyuta |
shrameNa yukto mahatAdya phalguna;stameSha karNaH prasabhaM haniShyati
shlokas.32:
tamevamuktvAbhyanunIya chAsakRRi;ttavAtmajaH svAnanushAsti sainikAn |
samAghnatAbhidravatAhitAnimA;nsabANashabdAnkimu joShamAsyate

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tau sha~NkhabherIninade samRRiddhe; samIyatuH shvetahayau narAgryau |
vaikartanaH sUtaputro.arjunashcha; durmantrite tava putrasya rAjan
shlokas.2:
yathA gajau haimavatau prabhinnau; pragRRihya dantAviva vAshitArthe |
tathA samAjagmaturugravegau; dhana~njayashchAdhirathishcha vIrau
shlokas.3:
balAhakeneva yathA balAhako; yadRRichChayA vA giriNA giriryathA |
tathA dhanurjyAtalaneminisvanau; samIyatustAviShuvarShavarShiNau
shlokas.4:
pravRRiddhashRRi~NgadrumavIrudoShadhI; pravRRiddhanAnAvidhaparvataukasau |
yathAchalau vA galitau mahAbalau; tathA mahAstrairitaretaraM ghnataH
shlokas.5:
sa saMnipAtastu tayormahAnabhU;tsureshavairochanayoryathA purA |
sharairvibhugnA~NganiyantRRivAhanaH; suduHsaho.anyaiH paTushoNitodakaH
shlokas.6:
prabhUtapadmotpalamatsyakachChapau; mahAhradau pakShigaNAnunAditau |
susaMnikRRiShTAvaniloddhatau yathA; tathA rathau tau dhvajinau samIyatuH
shlokas.7:
ubhau mahendrasya samAnavikramA;vubhau mahendrapratimau mahArathau |
mahendravajrapratimaishcha sAyakai;rmahendravRRitrAviva samprajahratuH
shlokas.8:
sanAgapattyashvarathe ubhe bale; vichitravarNAbharaNAmbarasraje |
chakampatushchonnamataH sma vismayA;dviyadgatAshchArjunakarNasa.nyuge
shlokas.9:
bhujAH savajrA~NgulayaH samuchChritAH; sasiMhanAdA hRRiShitairdidRRikShubhiH |
yadArjunaM mattamiva dvipo dvipaM; samabhyayAdAdhirathirjighA.nsayA
shlokas.10:
abhyakroshansomakAstatra pArthaM; tvarasva yAhyarjuna vidhya karNam |
Chindhyasya mUrdhAnamalaM chireNa; shraddhAM cha rAjyAddhRRitarAShTrasUnoH
shlokas.11:
tathAsmAkaM bahavastatra yodhAH; karNaM tadA yAhi yAhItyavochan |
jahyarjunaM karNa tataH sachIrAH; punarvanaM yAntu chirAya pArthAH
shlokas.12:
tataH karNaH prathamaM tatra pArthaM; maheShubhirdashabhiH paryavidhyat |
tamarjunaH pratyavidhyachChitAgraiH; kakShAntare dashabhiratIva kruddhaH
shlokas.13:
parasparaM tau vishikhaiH sutIkShNai;statakShatuH sUtaputro.arjunashcha |
parasparasyAntarepsU vimarde; subhImamabhyAyayatuH prahRRiShTau
shlokas.14:
amRRiShyamANashcha mahAvimarde; tatrAkrudhyadbhImaseno mahAtmA |
athAbravItpANinA pANimAghna;nsa.ndaShTauShTho nRRityati vAdayanniva
kathaM nu tvAM sUtaputraH kirITi;nmaheShubhirdashabhiravidhyadagre
shlokas.15:
yayA dhRRityA sarvabhUtAnyajaiShI;rgrAsaM dadadvahnaye khANDave tvam |
tayA dhRRityA sUtaputraM jahi tva;mahaM vainaM gadayA pothayiShye
shlokas.16:
athAbravIdvAsudevo.api pArthaM; dRRiShTvA ratheShUnpratihanyamAnAn |
amImRRidatsarvathA te.adya karNo; hyastrairastrANi kimidaM kirITin
shlokas.17:
sa vIra kiM muhyasi nAvadhIyase; nadantyete kuravaH samprahRRiShTAH |
karNaM puraskRRitya vidurhi sarve; tvadastramastrairvinipAtyamAnam
shlokas.18:
yayA dhRRityA nihataM tAmasAstraM; yuge yuge rAkShasAshchApi ghorAH |
dambhodbhavAshchAsurAshchAhaveShu; tayA dhRRityA tvaM jahi sUtaputram
shlokas.19:
anena vAsya kShuraneminAdya; sa~nChinddhi mUrdhAnamareH prasahya |
mayA nisRRiShTena sudarshanena; vajreNa shakro namucherivAreH
shlokas.20:
kirAtarUpI bhagavAnyayA cha; tvayA mahatyA paritoShito.abhUt |
tAM tvaM dhRRitiM vIra punargRRihItvA; sahAnubandhaM jahi sUtaputram
shlokas.21:
tato mahIM sAgaramekhalAM tvaM; sapattanAM grAmavatIM samRRiddhAm |
prayachCha rAj~ne nihatArisa~NghAM; yashashcha pArthAtulamApnuhi tvam
shlokas.22:
sa~nchodito bhImajanArdanAbhyAM; smRRitvA tadAtmAnamavekShya sattvam |
mahAtmanashchAgamane viditvA; prayojanaM keshavamityuvAcha
shlokas.23:
prAduShkaromyeSha mahAstramugraM; shivAya lokasya vadhAya sauteH |
tanme.anujAnAtu bhavAnsurAshcha; brahmA bhavo brahmavidashcha sarve
shlokas.24:
ityUchivAnbrAhmamasahyamastraM; prAdushchakre manasA sa.nvidheyam |
tato dishashcha pradishashcha sarvAH; samAvRRiNotsAyakairbhUritejAH
sasarja bANAnbharatarShabho.api; shata.nshatAnekavadAshuvegAn
shlokas.25:
vaikartanenApi tathAjimadhye; sahasrasho bANagaNA visRRiShTAH |
te ghoShiNaH pANDavamabhyupeyuH; parjanyamuktA iva vAridhArAH
shlokas.26:
sa bhImasenaM cha janArdanaM cha; kirITinaM chApyamanuShyakarmA |
tribhistribhirbhImabalo nihatya; nanAda ghoraM mahatA svareNa
shlokas.27:
sa karNabANAbhihataH kirITI; bhImaM tathA prekShya janArdanaM cha |
amRRiShyamANaH punareva pArthaH; sharAndashAShTau cha samudbabarha
shlokas.28:
suSheNamekena shareNa viddhvA; shalyaM chaturbhistribhireva karNam |
tataH sumuktairdashabhirjaghAna; sabhApatiM kA~nchanavarmanaddham
shlokas.29:
sa rAjaputro vishirA vibAhu;rvivAjisUto vidhanurviketuH |
tato rathAgrAdapatatprabhagnaH; parashvadhaiH shAla ivAbhikRRittaH
shlokas.30:
punashcha karNaM tribhiraShTabhishcha; dvAbhyAM chaturbhirdashabhishcha viddhvA |
chatuHshatAndviradAnsAyudhIyA;nhatvA rathAnaShTashataM jaghAna
sahasramashvA.nshcha punashcha sAdI;naShTau sahasrANi cha pattivIrAn
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTvAjimukhyAvatha yudhyamAnau; didRRikShavaH shUravarAvarighnau |
karNaM cha pArthaM cha niyamya vAhA;nkhasthA mahIsthAshcha janAvatasthuH
shlokas.32:
tato dhanurjyA sahasAtikRRiShTA; sughoShamAchChidyata pANDavasya |
tasminkShaNe sUtaputrastu pArthaM; samAchinotkShudrakANAM shatena
shlokas.33:
nirmuktasarpapratimaishcha tIkShNai;stailapradhautaiH khagapatravAjaiH |
ShaShTyA nArAchairvAsudevaM bibheda; tadantaraM somakAH prAdravanta
shlokas.34:
tato dhanurjyAmavadhamya shIghraM; sharAnastAnAdhirathervidhamya |
susa.nrabdhaH karNasharakShatA~Ngo; raNe pArthaH somakAnpratyagRRihNAt
na pakShiNaH sampatantyantarikShe; kShepIyasAstreNa kRRite.andhakAre
shlokas.35:
shalyaM cha pArtho dashabhiH pRRiShatkai;rbhRRishaM tanutre prahasannavidhyat |
tataH karNaM dvAdashabhiH sumuktai;rviddhvA punaH saptabhirabhyavidhyat
shlokas.36:
sa pArthabANAsanaveganunnai;rdRRiDhAhataH patribhirugravegaiH |
vibhinnagAtraH kShatajokShitA~NgaH; karNo babhau rudra ivAtateShuH
shlokas.37:
tatastribhishcha tridashAdhipopamaM; sharairbibhedAdhirathirdhana~njayam |
sharA.nstu pa~ncha jvalitAnivoragA;npravIrayAmAsa jighA.nsurachyute
shlokas.38:
te varma bhittvA puruShottamasya; suvarNachitraM nyapatansumuktAH |
vegena gAmAvivishuH suvegAH; snAtvA cha karNAbhimukhAH pratIyuH
shlokas.39:
tAnpa~nchabhallaistvaritaiH sumuktai;stridhA tridhaikaikamathochchakarta |
dhana~njayaste nyapatanpRRithivyAM; mahAhayastakShakaputrapakShAH
shlokas.40:
tataH prajajvAla kirITamAlI; krodhena kakShaM pradahannivAgniH |
sa karNamAkarNavikRRiShTasRRiShTaiH; sharaiH sharIrAntakarairjvaladbhiH
marmasvavidhyatsa chachAla duHkhA;ddhairyAttu tasthAvatimAtradhairyaH
shlokas.41:
tataH sharaughaiH pradisho dishashcha; raviprabhA karNarathashcha rAjan |
adRRishya AsItkupite dhana~njaye; tuShAranIhAravRRitaM yathA nabhaH
shlokas.42:
sa chakrarakShAnatha pAdarakShA;npuraHsarAnpRRiShThagopA.nshcha sarvAn |
duryodhanenAnumatAnarighnA;nsamuchchitAnsurathAnsArabhUtAn
shlokas.43:
dvisAhasrAnsamare savyasAchI; kurupravIrAnRRiShabhaH kurUNAm |
kShaNena sarvAnsarathAshvasUtA;nninAya rAjankShayamekavIraH
shlokas.44:
athApalAyanta vihAya karNaM; tavAtmajAH kuravashchAvashiShTAH |
hatAnavAkIrya sharakShatA.nshcha; lAlapyamAnA.nstanayAnpitR^I.nshcha
shlokas.45:
sa sarvataH prekShya disho vishUnyA; bhayAvadIrNaiH kurubhirvihInaH |
na vivyathe bhArata tatra karNaH; pratIpamevArjunamabhyadhAvat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato.apayAtAH sharapAtamAtra;mavasthitAH kuravo bhinnasenAH |
vidyutprakAshaM dadRRishuH samantA;ddhana~njayAstraM samudIryamANam
shlokas.2:
tadarjunAstraM grasate sma vIrA;nviyattathAkAshamanantaghoSham |
kruddhena pArthena tadAshu sRRiShTaM; vadhAya karNasya mahAvimarde
shlokas.3:
rAmAdupAttena mahAmahimnA; AtharvaNenArivinAshanena |
tadarjunAstraM vyadhamaddahantaM; pArthaM cha bANairnishitairnijaghne
shlokas.4:
tato vimardaH sumahAnbabhUva; tasyArjunasyAdhiratheshcha rAjan |
anyonyamAsAdayatoH pRRiShatkai;rviShANaghAtairdvipayorivograiH
shlokas.5:
tato ripughnaM samadhatta karNaH; susa.nshitaM sarpamukhaM jvalantam |
raudraM sharaM sa.nyati supradhautaM; pArthArthamatyarthachirAya guptam
shlokas.6:
sadArchitaM chandanachUrNashAyinaM; suvarNanAlIshayanaM mahAviSham |
pradIptamairAvatava.nshasambhavaM; shiro jihIrShuryudhi phalgunasya
shlokas.7:
tamabravInmadrarAjo mahAtmA; vaikartanaM prekShya hi saMhiteShum |
na karNa grIvAmiShureSha prApsyate; sa.nlakShya sandhatsva sharaM shiroghnam
shlokas.8:
athAbravItkrodhasa.nraktanetraH; karNaH shalyaM sandhiteShuH prasahya |
na sandhatte dviH sharaM shalya karNo; na mAdRRishAH shAThyayuktA bhavanti
shlokas.9:
tathaivamuktvA visasarja taM sharaM; balAhakaM varShaghanAbhipUjitam |
hato.asi vai phalguna ityavocha;ttatastvarannUrjitamutsasarja
shlokas.10:
sandhIyamAnaM bhujagaM dRRiShTvA karNena mAdhavaH |
Akramya syandanaM padbhyAM balena balinAM varaH
shlokas.11:
avagADhe rathe bhUmau jAnubhyAmagamanhayAH |
tataH sharaH so.abhyahanatkirITaM tasya dhImataH
shlokas.12:
athArjunasyottamagAtrabhUShaNaM; dharAviyaddyosalileShu vishrutam |
balAstrasargottamayatnamanyubhiH; shareNa mUrdhnaH sa jahAra sUtajaH
shlokas.13:
divAkarendujvalanagrahatviShaM; suvarNamuktAmaNijAlabhUShitam |
pura.ndarArthaM tapasA prayatnataH; svayaM kRRitaM yadbhuvanasya sUnunA
shlokas.14:
mahArharUpaM dviShatAM bhaya~NkaraM; vibhAti chAtyarthasukhaM sugandhi tat |
nijaghnuShe devaripUnsureshvaraH; svayaM dadau yatsumanAH kirITine
shlokas.15:
harAmbupAkhaNDalavittagoptRRibhiH; pinAkapAshAshanisAyakottamaiH |
surottamairapyaviShahyamardituM; prasahya nAgena jahAra yadvRRiShaH
shlokas.16:
taduttameShUnmathitaM viShAgninA; pradIptamarchiShmadabhikShiti priyam |
papAta pArthasya kirITamuttamaM; divAkaro.astAdiva parvatAjjvalan
shlokas.17:
tataH kirITaM bahuratnamaNDitaM; jahAra nAgo.arjunamUrdhato balAt |
gireH sujAtA~NkurapuShpitadrumaM; mahendravajraH shikharaM yathottamam
shlokas.18:
mahI viyaddyauH salilAni vAyunA; yathA vibhinnAni vibhAnti bhArata |
tathaiva shabdo bhuvaneShvabhUttadA; janA vyavasyanvyathitAshcha chaskhaluH
shlokas.19:
tataH samudgrathya sitena vAsasA; svamUrdhajAnavyathitaH sthito.arjunaH |
vibhAti sampUrNamarIchibhAsvatA; shirogatenodayaparvato yathA
shlokas.20:
balAhakaH karNabhujeritastato; hutAshanArkapratimadyutirmahAn |
mahoragaH kRRitavairo.arjunena; kirITamAsAdya samutpapAta
shlokas.21:
tamabravIdviddhi kRRitAgasaM me; kRRiShNAdya mAturvadhajAtavairam |
tataH kRRiShNaH pArthamuvAcha sa~Nkhye; mahoragaM kRRitavairaM jahi tvam
shlokas.22:
sa evamukto madhusUdanena; gANDIvadhanvA ripuShUgradhanvA |
uvAcha ko nveSha mamAdya nAgaH; svayaM ya AgAdgaruDasya vaktram
shlokas.23:
kRRiShNa uvAcha||
yo.asau tvayA khANDave chitrabhAnuM; santarpayAnena dhanurdhareNa |
viyadgato bANanikRRittadeho; hyanekarUpo nihatAsya mAtA
shlokas.24:
tatastu jiShNuH parihRRitya sheShAM;shchichCheda ShaDbhirnishitaiH sudhAraiH |
nAgaM viyattiryagivotpatantaM; sa ChinnagAtro nipapAta bhUmau
shlokas.25:
tasminmuhUrte dashabhiH pRRiShatkaiH; shilAshitairbarhiNavAjitaishcha |
vivyAdha karNaH puruShapravIraM; dhana~njayaM tiryagavekShamANam
shlokas.26:
tato.arjuno dvAdashabhirvimuktai;rAkarNamuktairnishitaiH samarpya |
nArAchamAshIviShatulyavega;mAkarNapUrNAyatamutsasarja
shlokas.27:
sa chitravarmeShuvaro vidArya; prANAnnirasyanniva sAdhu muktaH |
karNasya pItvA rudhiraM vivesha; vasundharAM shoNitavAjadigdhaH
shlokas.28:
tato vRRiSho bANanipAtakopito; mahorago daNDavighaTTito yathA |
tathAshukArI vyasRRijachCharottamA;nmahAviShaH sarpa ivottamaM viSham
shlokas.29:
janArdanaM dvAdashabhiH parAbhina;nnavairnavatyA cha sharaistathArjunam |
shareNa ghoreNa punashcha pANDavaM; vibhidya karNo.abhyanadajjahAsa cha
shlokas.30:
tamasya harShaM mamRRiShe na pANDavo; bibheda marmANi tato.asya marmavit |
paraM sharaiH patribhirindravikrama;stathA yathendro balamojasAhanat
shlokas.31:
tataH sharANAM navatIrnavArjunaH; sasarja karNe.antakadaNDasaMnibhAH |
sharairbhRRishAyastatanuH pravivyathe; tathA yathA vajravidArito.achalaH
shlokas.32:
maNipravekottamavajrahATakai;rala~NkRRitaM chAsya varA~NgabhUShaNam |
praviddhamurvyAM nipapAta patribhi;rdhana~njayenottamakuNDale.api cha
shlokas.33:
mahAdhanaM shilpivaraiH prayatnataH; kRRitaM yadasyottamavarma bhAsvaram |
sudIrghakAlena tadasya pANDavaH; kShaNena bANairbahudhA vyashAtayat
shlokas.34:
sa taM vivarmANamathottameShubhiH; sharaishchaturbhiH kupitaH parAbhinat |
sa vivyathe.atyarthamariprahArito; yathAturaH pittakaphAnilavraNaiH
shlokas.35:
mahAdhanurmaNDalaniHsRRitaiH shitaiH; kriyAprayatnaprahitairbalena cha |
tatakSha karNaM bahubhiH sharottamai;rbibheda marmasvapi chArjunastvaran
shlokas.36:
dRRiDhAhataH patribhirugravegaiH; pArthena karNo vividhaiH shitAgraiH |
babhau girirgairikadhAturaktaH; kSharanprapAtairiva raktamambhaH
shlokas.37:
sAshvaM tu karNaM sarathaM kirITI; samAchinodbhArata vatsadantaiH |
prachChAdayAmAsa dishashcha bANaiH; sarvaprayatnAttapanIyapu~NkhaiH
shlokas.38:
sa vatsadantaiH pRRithupInavakShAH; samAchitaH smAdhirathirvibhAti |
supuShpitAshokapalAshashAlmali;ryathAchalaH spandanachandanAyutaH
shlokas.39:
sharaiH sharIre bahudhA samarpitai;rvibhAti karNaH samare vishAM pate |
mahIruhairAchitasAnukandaro; yathA mahendraH shubhakarNikAravAn
shlokas.40:
sa bANasa~NghAndhanuShA vyavAsRRija;nvibhAti karNaH sharajAlarashmivAn |
salohito raktagabhastimaNDalo; divAkaro.astAbhimukho yathA tathA
shlokas.41:
bAhvantarAdAdhirathervimuktA;nbANAnmahAhIniva dIpyamAnAn |
vyadhva.nsayannarjunabAhumuktAH; sharAH samAsAdya dishaH shitAgrAH
shlokas.42:
tatashchakramapatattasya bhUmau; sa vihvalaH samare sUtaputraH |
ghUrNe rathe brAhmaNasyAbhishApA;drAmAdupAtte.apratibhAti chAstre
shlokas.43:
amRRiShyamANo vyasanAni tAni; hastau vidhunvansa vigarhamANaH |
dharmapradhAnAnabhipAti dharma; ityabruvandharmavidaH sadaiva
mamApi nimno.adya na pAti bhaktA;nmanye na nityaM paripAti dharmaH
shlokas.44:
evaM bruvanpraskhalitAshvasUto; vichAlyamAno.arjunashastrapAtaiH |
marmAbhighAtAchchalitaH kriyAsu; punaH punardharmamagarhadAjau
shlokas.45:
tataH sharairbhImatarairavidhyattribhirAhave |
haste karNastadA pArthamabhyavidhyachcha saptabhiH
shlokas.46:
tato.arjunaH saptadasha tigmatejAnajihmagAn |
indrAshanisamAnghorAnasRRijatpAvakopamAn
shlokas.47:
nirbhidya te bhImavegA nyapatanpRRithivItale |
kampitAtmA tathA karNaH shaktyA cheShTAmadarshayat
shlokas.48:
balenAtha sa sa.nstabhya brahmAstraM samudairayat |
aindrAstramarjunashchApi taddRRiShTvAbhinyamantrayat
shlokas.49:
gANDIvaM jyAM cha bANA.nshcha anumantrya dhana~njayaH |
asRRijachCharavarShANi varShANIva pura.ndaraH
shlokas.50:
tatastejomayA bANA rathAtpArthasya niHsRRitAH |
prAdurAsanmahAvIryAH karNasya rathamantikAt
shlokas.51:
tAnkarNastvagrato.abhyastAnmoghA.nshchakre mahArathaH |
tato.abravIdvRRiShNivIrastasminnastre vinAshite
shlokas.52:
visRRijAstraM paraM pArtha rAdheyo grasate sharAn |
brahmAstramarjunashchApi saMmantryAtha prayojayat
shlokas.53:
ChAdayitvA tato bANaiH karNaM prabhrAmya chArjunaH |
tasya karNaH sharaiH kruddhashchichCheda jyAM sutejanaiH
shlokas.54:
tato jyAmavadhAyAnyAmanumRRijya cha pANDavaH |
sharairavAkiratkarNaM dIpyamAnaiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.55:
tasya jyAchChedanaM karNo jyAvadhAnaM cha sa.nyuge |
nAnvabudhyata shIghratvAttadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.56:
astrairastrANi rAdheyaH pratyahansavyasAchinaH |
chakre chAbhyadhikaM pArthAtsvavIryaM pratidarshayan
shlokas.57:
tataH kRRiShNo.arjunaM dRRiShTvA karNAstreNAbhipIDitam |
abhyasyetyabravItpArthamAtiShThAstramanuttamam
shlokas.58:
tato.anyamagnisadRRishaM sharaM sarpaviShopamam |
ashmasAramayaM divyamanumantrya dhana~njayaH
shlokas.59:
raudramastraM samAdAya kSheptukAmaH kirITavAn |
tato.agrasanmahI chakraM rAdheyasya mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.60:
grastachakrastu rAdheyaH kopAdashrUNyavartayat |
so.abravIdarjunaM chApi muhUrtaM kShama pANDava
shlokas.61:
madhye chakramavagrastaM dRRiShTvA daivAdidaM mama |
pArtha kApuruShAchIrNamabhisandhiM vivarjaya
shlokas.62:
prakIrNakeshe vimukhe brAhmaNe cha kRRitA~njalau |
sharaNAgate nyastashastre tathA vyasanage.arjuna
shlokas.63:
abANe bhraShTakavache bhraShTabhagnAyudhe tathA |
na shUrAH praharantyAjau na rAj~ne pArthivAstathA
tvaM cha shUro.asi kaunteya tasmAtkShama muhUrtakam
shlokas.64:
yAvachchakramidaM bhUmeruddharAmi dhana~njaya |
na mAM rathastho bhUmiShThamasajjaM hantumarhasi
na vAsudevAttvatto vA pANDaveya bibhemyaham
shlokas.65:
tvaM hi kShatriyadAyAdo mahAkulavivardhanaH |
smRRitvA dharmopadeshaM tvaM muhUrtaM kShama pANDava

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
athAbravIdvAsudevo rathastho; rAdheya diShTyA smarasIha dharmam |
prAyeNa nIchA vyasaneShu magnA; nindanti daivaM kukRRitaM na tattat
shlokas.2:
yaddraupadImekavastrAM sabhAyA;mAnAyya tvaM chaiva suyodhanashcha |
duHshAsanaH shakuniH saubalashcha; na te karNa pratyabhAttatra dharmaH
shlokas.3:
yadA sabhAyAM kaunteyamanakShaj~naM yudhiShThiram |
akShaj~naH shakunirjetA tadA dharmaH kva te gataH
shlokas.4:
yadA rajasvalAM kRRiShNAM duHshAsanavashe sthitAm |
sabhAyAM prAhasaH karNa kva te dharmastadA gataH
shlokas.5:
rAjyalubdhaH punaH karNa samAhvayasi pANDavam |
gAndhArarAjamAshritya kva te dharmastadA gataH
shlokas.6:
evamukte tu rAdheye vAsudevena pANDavam |
manyurabhyAvishattIvraH smRRitvA tattaddhana~njayam
shlokas.7:
tasya krodhena sarvebhyaH srotobhyastejaso.archiShaH |
prAdurAsanmahArAja tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.8:
taM samIkShya tataH karNo brahmAstreNa dhana~njayam |
abhyavarShatpunaryatnamakarodrathasarjane
tadastramastreNAvArya prajahArAsya pANDavaH
shlokas.9:
tato.anyadastraM kaunteyo dayitaM jAtavedasaH |
mumocha karNamuddishya tatprajajvAla vai bhRRisham
shlokas.10:
vAruNena tataH karNaH shamayAmAsa pAvakam |
jImUtaishcha dishaH sarvAshchakre timiradurdinAH
shlokas.11:
pANDaveyastvasambhrAnto vAyavyAstreNa vIryavAn |
apovAha tadAbhrANi rAdheyasya prapashyataH
shlokas.12:
taM hastikakShyApravaraM cha bANaiH; suvarNamuktAmaNivajramRRiShTam |
kAlaprayatnottamashilpiyatnaiH; kRRitaM surUpaM vitamaskamuchchaiH
shlokas.13:
UrjaskaraM tava sainyasya nitya;mamitravitrAsanamIDyarUpam |
vikhyAtamAdityasamasya loke; tviShA samaM pAvakabhAnuchandraiH
shlokas.14:
tataH kShureNAdhiratheH kirITI; suvarNapu~Nkhena shitena yattaH |
shriyA jvalantaM dhvajamunmamAtha; mahArathasyAdhirathermahAtmA
shlokas.15:
yashashcha dharmashcha jayashcha mAriSha; priyANi sarvANi cha tena ketunA |
tadA kurUNAM hRRidayAni chApata;nbabhUva hAheti cha nisvano mahAn
shlokas.16:
atha tvarankarNavadhAya pANDavo; mahendravajrAnaladaNDasaMnibham |
Adatta pArtho.a~njalikaM niSha~NgA;tsahasrarashmeriva rashmimuttamam
shlokas.17:
marmachChidaM shoNitamA.nsadigdhaM; vaishvAnarArkapratimaM mahArham |
narAshvanAgAsuharaM tryaratniM; ShaDvAjama~njogatimugravegam
shlokas.18:
sahasranetrAshanitulyatejasaM; samAnakravyAdamivAtiduHsaham |
pinAkanArAyaNachakrasaMnibhaM; bhaya~NkaraM prANabhRRitAM vinAshanam
shlokas.19:
yuktvA mahAstreNa pareNa mantravi;dvikRRiShya gANDIvamuvAcha sasvanam |
ayaM mahAstro.apratimo dhRRitaH sharaH; sharIrabhichchAsuharashcha durhRRidaH
shlokas.20:
tapo.asti taptaM guravashcha toShitA; mayA yadiShTaM suhRRidAM tathA shrutam |
anena satyena nihantvayaM sharaH; suda.nshitaH karNamariM mamAjitaH
shlokas.21:
ityUchivA.nstaM sa mumocha bANaM; dhana~njayaH karNavadhAya ghoram |
kRRityAmatharvA~NgirasImivogrAM; dIptAmasahyAM yudhi mRRityunApi
shlokas.22:
bruvankirITI tamatiprahRRiShTo; ayaM sharo me vijayAvaho.astu |
jighA.nsurarkendusamaprabhAvaH; karNaM samAptiM nayatAM yamAya
shlokas.23:
teneShuvaryeNa kirITamAlI; prahRRiShTarUpo vijayAvahena |
jighA.nsurarkendusamaprabheNa; chakre viShaktaM ripumAtatAyI
shlokas.24:
tadudyatAdityasamAnavarchasaM; sharannabhomadhyagabhAskaropamam |
varA~NgamurvyAmapatachchamUpate;rdivAkaro.astAdiva raktamaNDalaH
shlokas.25:
tadasya dehI satataM sukhoditaM; svarUpamatyarthamudArakarmaNaH |
pareNa kRRichChreNa sharIramatyaja;dgRRihaM maharddhIva sasa~NgamIshvaraH
shlokas.26:
sharairvibhugnaM vyasu tadvivarmaNaH; papAta karNasya sharIramuchChritam |
sravadvraNaM gairikatoyavisravaM; gireryathA vajrahataM shirastathA
shlokas.27:
dehAttu karNasya nipAtitasya; tejo dIptaM khaM vigAhyAchireNa |
tadadbhutaM sarvamanuShyayodhAH; pashyanti rAjannihate sma karNe
shlokas.28:
taM somakAH prekShya hataM shayAnaM; prItA nAdaM saha sainyairakurvan |
tUryANi chAjaghnuratIva hRRiShTA; vAsA.nsi chaivAdudhuvurbhujA.nshcha
balAnvitAshchApyapare hyanRRitya;nnanyonyamAshliShya nadanta UchuH
shlokas.29:
dRRiShTvA tu karNaM bhuvi niShTanantaM; hataM rathAtsAyakenAvabhinnam |
mahAnilenAgnimivApaviddhaM; yaj~nAvasAne shayane nishAnte
shlokas.30:
sharairAchitasarvA~NgaH shoNitaughapariplutaH |
vibhAti dehaH karNasya svarashmibhirivA.nshumAn
shlokas.31:
pratApya senAmAmitrIM dIptaiH sharagabhastibhiH |
balinArjunakAlena nIto.astaM karNabhAskaraH
shlokas.32:
astaM gachChanyathAdityaH prabhAmAdAya gachChati |
evaM jIvitamAdAya karNasyeShurjagAma ha
shlokas.33:
aparAhNe parAhNasya sUtaputrasya mAriSha |
Chinnama~njalikenAjau sotsedhamapatachChiraH
shlokas.34:
uparyupari sainyAnAM tasya shatrostada~njasA |
shiraH karNasya sotsedhamiShuH so.apAharaddrutam
shlokas.35:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNaM tu shUraM patitaM pRRithivyAM; sharAchitaM shoNitadigdhagAtram |
dRRiShTvA shayAnaM bhuvi madrarAja;shChinnadhvajenApayayau rathena
shlokas.36:
karNe hate kuravaH prAdravanta; bhayArditA gADhaviddhAshcha sa~Nkhye |
avekShamANA muhurarjunasya; dhvajaM mahAntaM vapuShA jvalantam
shlokas.37:
sahasranetrapratimAnakarmaNaH; sahasrapatrapratimAnanaM shubham |
sahasrarashmirdinasa~NkShaye yathA; tathApatattasya shiro vasundharAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shalyastu karNArjunayorvimarde; balAni dRRiShTvA mRRiditAni bANaiH |
duryodhanaM yAntamavekShamANo; sa.ndarshayadbhArata yuddhabhUmim
shlokas.2:
nipAtitasyandanavAjinAgaM; dRRiShTvA balaM taddhatasUtaputram |
duryodhano.ashrupratipUrNanetro; muhurmuhurnyashvasadArtarUpaH
shlokas.3:
karNaM tu shUraM patitaM pRRithivyAM; sharAchitaM shoNitadigdhagAtram |
yadRRichChayA sUryamivAvanisthaM; didRRikShavaH samparivArya tasthuH
shlokas.4:
prahRRiShTavitrastaviShaNNavismRRitA;stathApare shokagatA ivAbhavan |
pare tvadIyAshcha paraspareNa; yathA yathaiShAM prakRRitistathAbhavan
shlokas.5:
praviddhavarmAbharaNAmbarAyudhaM; dhana~njayenAbhihataM hataujasam |
nishamya karNaM kuravaH pradudruvu;rhatarShabhA gAva ivAkulAkulAH
shlokas.6:
kRRitvA vimardaM bhRRishamarjunena; karNaM hataM kesariNeva nAgam |
dRRiShTvA shayAnaM bhuvi madrarAjo; bhIto.apasarpatsarathaH sushIghram
shlokas.7:
madrAdhipashchApi vimUDhachetA;stUrNaM rathenApahRRitadhvajena |
duryodhanasyAntikametya shIghraM; sambhAShya duHkhArtamuvAcha vAkyam
shlokas.8:
vishIrNanAgAshvarathapravIraM; balaM tvadiyaM yamarAShTrakalpam |
anyonyamAsAdya hataM mahadbhi;rnarAshvanAgairgirikUTakalpaiH
shlokas.9:
naitAdRRishaM bhArata yuddhamAsI;dyathAdya karNArjunayorbabhUva |
grastau hi karNena sametya kRRiShNA;vanye cha sarve tava shatravo ye
shlokas.10:
daivaM tu yattatsvavashaM pravRRittaM; tatpANDavAnpAti hinasti chAsmAn |
tavArthasiddhyarthakarA hi sarve; prasahya vIrA nihatA dviShadbhiH
shlokas.11:
kuberavaivasvatavAsavAnAM; tulyaprabhAvAmbupateshcha vIrAH |
vIryeNa shauryeNa balena chaiva; taistaishcha yuktA vipulairguNaughaiH
shlokas.12:
avadhyakalpA nihatA narendrA;stavArthakAmA yudhi pANDaveyaiH |
tanmA shucho bhArata diShTameta;tparyAyasiddhirna sadAsti siddhiH
shlokas.13:
etadvacho madrapaternishamya; svaM chApanItaM manasA nirIkShya |
duryodhano dInamanA visa~nj~naH; punaH punarnyashvasadArtarUpaH
shlokas.14:
taM dhyAnamUkaM kRRipaNaM bhRRishArta;mArtAyanirdInamuvAcha vAkyam |
pashyedamugraM naravAjinAgai;rAyodhanaM vIrahataiH prapannam
shlokas.15:
mahIdharAbhaiH patitairmahAgajaiH; sakRRitpraviddhaiH sharaviddhamarmabhiH |
tairvihvaladbhishcha gatAsubhishcha; pradhvastayantrAyudhavarmayodhaiH
shlokas.16:
vajrApaviddhairiva chAchalendrai;rvibhinnapAShANamRRigadrumauShadhaiH |
praviddhaghaNTA~NkushatomaradhvajaiH; sahemamAlai rudhiraughasamplutaiH
shlokas.17:
sharAvabhinnaiH patitaishcha vAjibhiH; shvasadbhiranyaiH kShatajaM vamadbhiH |
dInaiH stanadbhiH parivRRittanetrai;rmahIM dashadbhiH kRRipaNaM nadadbhiH
shlokas.18:
tathApaviddhairgajavAjiyodhai;rmandAsubhishchaiva gatAsubhishcha |
narAshvanAgaishcha rathaishcha marditai;rmahI mahAvaitaraNIva durdRRishA
shlokas.19:
gajairnikRRittAparahastagAtrai;rudvepamAnaiH patitaiH pRRithivyAm |
yashasvibhirnAgarathAshvayodhibhiH; padAtibhishchAbhimukhairhataiH paraiH
vishIrNavarmAbharaNAmbarAyudhai;rvRRitA nishAntairiva pAvakairmahI
shlokas.20:
sharaprahArAbhihatairmahAbalai;ravekShyamANaiH patitaiH sahasrashaH |
pranaShTasa~nj~naiH punaruchChvasadbhi;rmahI babhUvAnugatairivAgnibhiH
divashchyutairbhUratidIptimadbhi;rnaktaM grahairdyauramaleva dIptaiH
shlokas.21:
sharAstu karNArjunabAhumuktA; vidArya nAgAshvamanuShyadehAn |
prANAnnirasyAshu mahImatIyu;rmahoragA vAsamivAbhito.astraiH
shlokas.22:
hatairmanuShyAshvagajaishcha sa~Nkhye; sharAvabhinnaishcha rathairbabhUva |
dhana~njayasyAdhiratheshcha mArge; gajairagamyA vasudhAtidurgA
shlokas.23:
rathairvareShUnmathitaishcha yodhaiH; sa.nsyUtasUtAshvavarAyudhadhvajaiH |
vishIrNashastrairvinikRRittabandhurai;rnikRRittachakrAkShayugatriveNubhiH
shlokas.24:
vimuktayantrairnihatairayasmayai;rhatAnuSha~NgairviniSha~NgabandhuraiH |
prabhagnanIDairmaNihemamaNDitaiH; stRRitA mahI dyauriva shAradairghanaiH
shlokas.25:
vikRRiShyamaNairjavanairala~NkRRitai;rhateshvarairAjirathaiH sukalpitaiH |
manuShyamAta~NgarathAshvarAshibhi;rdrutaM vrajanto bahudhA vichUrNitAH
shlokas.26:
sahemapaTTAH parighAH parashvadhAH; kaDa~NgarAyomusalAni paTTishAH |
petushcha khaDgA vimalA vikoshA; gadAshcha jAmbUnadapaTTabaddhAH
shlokas.27:
chApAni rukmA~NgadabhUShaNAni; sharAshcha kArtasvarachitrapu~NkhAH |
RRiShTyashcha pItA vimalA vikoshAH; prAsAH sakhaDgAH kanakAvabhAsAH
shlokas.28:
ChatrANi vAlavyajanAni sha~NkhAH; srajashcha puShpottamahemachitrAH |
kuthAH patAkAmbaraveShTitAshcha; kirITamAlA mukuTAshcha shubhrAH
shlokas.29:
prakIrNakA viprakIrNAH kuthAshcha; pradhAnamuktAtaralAshcha hArAH |
ApIDakeyUravarA~NgadAni; graiveyaniShkAH sasuvarNasUtrAH
shlokas.30:
maNyuttamA vajrasuvarNamuktA; ratnAni chochchAvachama~NgalAni |
gAtrANi chAtyantasukhochitAni; shirA.nsi chendupratimAnanAni
shlokas.31:
dehA.nshcha bhogA.nshcha parichChadA.nshcha; tyaktvA manoj~nAni sukhAni chApi |
svadharmaniShThAM mahatImavApya; vyAptA.nshcha lokAnyashasA samIyuH
shlokas.32:
ityevamuktvA virarAma shalyo; duryodhanaH shokaparItachetAH |
hA karNa hA karNa iti bruvANa; Arto visa~nj~no bhRRishamashrunetraH
shlokas.33:
taM droNaputrapramukhA narendrAH; sarve samAshvAsya saha prayAnti |
nirIkShamANA muhurarjunasya; dhvajaM mahAntaM yashasA jvalantam
shlokas.34:
narAshvamAta~NgasharIrajena; raktena siktA rudhireNa bhUmiH |
raktAmbarasraktapanIyayogA;nnArI prakAshA iva sarvagamyA
shlokas.35:
prachChannarUpA rudhireNa rAja;nraudre muhUrte.ativirAjamAnAH |
naivAvatasthuH kuravaH samIkShya; pravrAjitA devalokAshcha sarve
shlokas.36:
vadhena karNasya suduHkhitAste; hA karNa hA karNa iti bruvANAH |
drutaM prayAtAH shibirANi rAja;ndivAkaraM raktamavekShamANAH
shlokas.37:
gANDIvamuktaistu suvarNapu~NkhaiH; shitaiH sharaiH shoNitadigdhavAjaiH |
sharaishchitA~Ngo bhuvi bhAti karNo; hato.api sansUrya ivA.nshumAlI
shlokas.38:
karNasya dehaM rudhirAvasiktaM; bhaktAnukampI bhagavAnvivasvAn |
spRRiShTvA karairlohitaraktarUpaH; siShNAsurabhyeti paraM samudram
shlokas.39:
itIva sa~nchintya surarShisa~NghAH; samprasthitA yAnti yathAniketam |
sa~nchintayitvA cha janA visasru;ryathAsukhaM khaM cha mahItalaM cha
shlokas.40:
tadadbhutaM prANabhRRitAM bhaya~NkaraM; nishamya yuddhaM kuruvIramukhyayoH |
dhana~njayasyAdhiratheshcha vismitAH; prasha.nsamAnAH prayayustadA janAH
shlokas.41:
sharaiH sa~NkRRittavarmANaM vIraM vishasane hatam |
gatAsumapi rAdheyaM naiva lakShmIrvyamu~nchata
shlokas.42:
nAnAbharaNavAnrAjanmRRiShTajAmbUnadA~NgadaH |
hato vaikartanaH shete pAdapo.a~NkuravAniva
shlokas.43:
kanakottamasa~NkAshaH pradIpta iva pAvakaH |
saputraH puruShavyAghraH sa.nshAntaH pArthatejasA
pratApya pANDavAnrAjanpA~nchAlA.nshchAstratejasA
shlokas.44:
dadAnItyeva yo.avochanna nAstItyarthito.arthibhiH |
sadbhiH sadA satpuruShaH sa hato dvairathe vRRiShaH
shlokas.45:
yasya brAhmaNasAtsarvamAtmArthaM na mahAtmanaH |
nAdeyaM brAhmaNeShvAsIdyasya svamapi jIvitam
shlokas.46:
sadA nR^INAM priyo dAtA priyadAno divaM gataH |
AdAya tava putrANAM jayAshAM sharma varma cha
shlokas.47:
hate sma karNe sarito na sravanti; jagAma chAstaM kaluSho divAkaraH |
grahashcha tiryagjvalitArkavarNo; yamasya putro.abhyudiyAya rAjan
shlokas.48:
nabhaH paphAlAtha nanAda chorvI; vavushcha vAtAH paruShAtivelam |
dishaH sadhUmAshcha bhRRishaM prajajvalu;rmahArNavAshchukShubhire cha sasvanAH
shlokas.49:
sakAnanAH sAdrichayAshchakampuH; pravivyathurbhUtagaNAshcha mAriSha |
bRRihaspatI rohiNIM samprapIDya; babhUva chandrArkasamAnavarNaH
shlokas.50:
hate karNe na disho viprajaj~nu;stamovRRitA dyaurvichachAla bhUmiH |
papAta cholkA jvalanaprakAshA; nishAcharAshchApyabhavanprahRRiShTAH
shlokas.51:
shashiprakAshAnanamarjuno yadA; kShureNa karNasya shiro nyapAtayat |
athAntarikShe divi cheha chAsakRRi;dbabhUva hAheti janasya nisvanaH
shlokas.52:
sa devagandharvamanuShyapUjitaM; nihatya karNaM ripumAhave.arjunaH |
rarAja pArthaH parameNa tejasA; vRRitraM nihatyeva sahasralochanaH
shlokas.53:
tato rathenAmbudavRRindanAdinA; sharannabhomadhyagabhAskaratviShA |
patAkinA bhImaninAdaketunA; himendusha~NkhasphaTikAvabhAsinA
suvarNamuktAmaNivajravidrumai;rala~NkRRitenApratimAnaraMhasA
shlokas.54:
narottamau pANDavakeshimardanA;vudAhitAvagnidivAkaropamau |
raNAjire vItabhayau virejatuH; samAnayAnAviva viShNuvAsavau
shlokas.55:
tato dhanurjyAtalaneminisvanaiH; prasahya kRRitvA cha ripUnhataprabhAn |
sa.nsAdhayitvaiva kurU~nsharaughaiH; kapidhvajaH pakShivaradhvajashcha
prasahya sha~Nkhau dhamatuH sughoShau; manA.nsyarINAmavasAdayantau
shlokas.56:
suvarNajAlAvatatau mahAsvanau; himAvadAtau parigRRihya pANibhiH |
chuchumbatuH sha~Nkhavarau nRRiNAM varau; varAnanAbhyAM yugapachcha dadhmatuH
shlokas.57:
pA~nchajanyasya nirghoSho devadattasya chobhayoH |
pRRithivImantarikShaM cha dyAmapashchApyapUrayat
shlokas.58:
tau sha~Nkhashabdena ninAdayantau; vanAni shailAnsarito dishashcha |
vitrAsayantau tava putrasenAM; yudhiShThiraM nandayataH sma vIrau
shlokas.59:
tataH prayAtAH kuravo javena; shrutvaiva sha~NkhasvanamIryamANam |
vihAya madrAdhipatiM patiM cha; duryodhanaM bhArata bhAratAnAm
shlokas.60:
mahAhave taM bahu shobhamAnaM; dhana~njayaM bhUtagaNAH sametAH |
tadAnvamodanta janArdanaM cha; prabhAkarAvabhyuditau yathaiva
shlokas.61:
samAchitau karNasharaiH parantapA;vubhau vyabhAtAM samare.achyutArjunau |
tamo nihatyAbhyuditau yathAmalau; shashA~NkasUryAviva rashmimAlinau
shlokas.62:
vihAya tAnbANagaNAnathAgatau; suhRRidvRRitAvapratimAnavikramau |
sukhaM praviShTau shibiraM svamIshvarau; sadasyahUtAviva vAsavAchyutau
shlokas.63:
sadevagandharvamanuShyachAraNai;rmaharShibhiryakShamahoragairapi |
jayAbhivRRiddhyA parayAbhipUjitau; nihatya karNaM paramAhave tadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA nipAtite karNe tava sainye cha vidrute |
AshliShya pArthaM dAshArho harShAdvachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
hato balabhidA vRRitrastvayA karNo dhana~njaya |
vadhaM vai karNavRRitrAbhyAM kathayiShyanti mAnavAH
shlokas.3:
vajriNA nihato vRRitraH sa.nyuge bhUritejasA |
tvayA tu nihataH karNo dhanuShA nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.4:
tamimaM vikramaM loke prathitaM te yashovaham |
nivedayAvaH kaunteya dharmarAjAya dhImate
shlokas.5:
vadhaM karNasya sa~NgrAme dIrghakAlachikIrShitam |
nivedya dharmarAjasya tvamAnRRiNyaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.6:
tathetyukte keshavastu pArthena yadupu~NgavaH |
paryavartayadavyagro rathaM rathavarasya tam
shlokas.7:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM yudhAmanyuM mAdrIputrau vRRikodaram |
yuyudhAnaM cha govinda idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
parAnabhimukhA yattAstiShThadhvaM bhadramastu vaH |
yAvadAvedyate rAj~ne hataH karNo.arjunena vai
shlokas.9:
sa taiH shUrairanuj~nAto yayau rAjaniveshanam |
pArthamAdAya govindo dadarsha cha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.10:
shayAnaM rAjashArdUlaM kA~nchane shayanottame |
agRRihNItAM cha charaNau muditau pArthivasya tau
shlokas.11:
tayoH praharShamAlakShya prahArA.nshchAtimAnuShAn |
rAdheyaM nihataM matvA samuttasthau yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
tato.asmai tadyathAvRRittaM vAsudevaH priya.nvadaH |
kathayAmAsa karNasya nidhanaM yadunandanaH
shlokas.13:
IShadutsmayamAnastu kRRiShNo rAjAnamabravIt |
yudhiShThiraM hatAmitraM kRRitA~njalirathAchyutaH
shlokas.14:
diShTyA gANDIvadhanvA cha pANDavashcha vRRikodaraH |
tvaM chApi kushalI rAjanmAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.15:
muktA vIrakShayAdasmAtsa~NgrAmAllomaharShaNAt |
kShipramuttarakAlAni kuru kAryANi pArthiva
shlokas.16:
hato vaikartanaH krUraH sUtaputro mahAbalaH |
diShTyA jayasi rAjendra diShTyA vardhasi pANDava
shlokas.17:
yaH sa dyUtajitAM kRRiShNAM prAhasatpuruShAdhamaH |
tasyAdya sUtaputrasya bhUmiH pibati shoNitam
shlokas.18:
shete.asau sharadIrNA~NgaH shatruste kurupu~Ngava |
taM pashya puruShavyAghra vibhinnaM bahudhA sharaiH
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThirastu dAshArhaM prahRRiShTaH pratyapUjayat |
diShTyA diShTyeti rAjendra prItyA chedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.20:
naitachchitraM mahAbAho tvayi devakinandana |
tvayA sArathinA pArtho yatkuryAdadya pauruSham
shlokas.21:
pragRRihya cha kurushreShThaH sA~NgadaM dakShiNaM bhujam |
uvAcha dharmabhRRitpArtha ubhau tau keshavArjunau
shlokas.22:
naranArAyaNau devau kathitau nAradena ha |
dharmasa.nsthApane yuktau purANau puruShottamau
shlokas.23:
asakRRichchApi medhAvI kRRiShNadvaipAyano mama |
kathAmetAM mahAbAho divyAmakathayatprabhuH
shlokas.24:
tava kRRiShNa prabhAveNa gANDIvena dhana~njayaH |
jayatyabhimukhA~nshatrUnna chAsIdvimukhaH kvachit
shlokas.25:
jayashchaiva dhruvo.asmAkaM na tvasmAkaM parAjayaH |
yadA tvaM yudhi pArthasya sArathyamupajagmivAn
shlokas.26:
evamuktvA mahArAja taM rathaM hemabhUShitam |
dantavarNairhayairyuktaM kAlavAlairmahArathaH
shlokas.27:
AsthAya puruShavyAghraH svabalenAbhisa.nvRRitaH |
kRRiShNArjunAbhyAM vIrAbhyAmanumanya tataH priyam
shlokas.28:
Agato bahuvRRittAntaM draShTumAyodhanaM tadA |
AbhAShamANastau vIrAvubhau mAdhavaphalgunau
shlokas.29:
sa dadarsha raNe karNaM shayAnaM puruSharShabham |
gANDIvamuktairvishikhaiH sarvataH shakalIkRRitam
shlokas.30:
saputraM nihataM dRRiShTvA karNaM rAjA yudhiShThiraH |
prashasha.nsa naravyAghrAvubhau mAdhavapANDavau
shlokas.31:
adya rAjAsmi govinda pRRithivyAM bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
tvayA nAthena vIreNa viduShA paripAlitaH
shlokas.32:
hataM dRRiShTvA naravyAghraM rAdheyamabhimAninam |
nirAsho.adya durAtmAsau dhArtarAShTro bhaviShyati
jIvitAchchApi rAjyAchcha hate karNe mahArathe
shlokas.33:
tvatprasAdAdvayaM chaiva kRRitArthAH puruSharShabha |
tvaM cha gANDIvadhanvA cha vijayI yadunandana
diShTyA jayasi govinda diShTyA karNo nipAtitaH
shlokas.34:
evaM sa bahusho hRRiShTaH prashasha.nsa janArdanam |
arjunaM chApi rAjendra dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.35:
tato bhImaprabhRRitibhiH sarvaishcha bhrAtRRibhirvRRitam |
vardhayanti sma rAjAnaM harShayuktA mahArathAH
shlokas.36:
nakulaH sahadevashcha pANDavashcha vRRikodaraH |
sAtyakishcha mahArAja vRRiShNInAM pravaro rathaH
shlokas.37:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha pANDupA~nchAlasRRi~njayAH |
pUjayanti sma kaunteyaM nihate sUtanandane
shlokas.38:
te vardhayitvA nRRipatiM pANDuputraM yudhiShThiram |
jitakAshino labdhalakShA yuddhashauNDAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.39:
stuvantaH stavayuktAbhirvAgbhiH kRRiShNau parantapau |
jagmuH svashibirAyaiva mudA yuktA mahArathAH
shlokas.40:
evameSha kShayo vRRittaH sumahA.NllomaharShaNaH |
tava durmantrite rAjannatItaM kiM nu shochasi
shlokas.41:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tadapriyaM rAjandhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
papAta bhUmau nishcheShTaH kauravyaH paramArtivAn
tathA satyavratA devI gAndhArI dharmadarshinI
shlokas.42:
taM pratyagRRihNAdviduro nRRipatiM sa~njayastathA |
paryAshvAsayatashchaivaM tAvubhAveva bhUmipam
shlokas.43:
tathaivotthApayAmAsurgAndhArIM rAjayoShitaH |
tAbhyAmAshvAsito rAjA tUShNImAsIdvichetanaH
